This reinforced self-evolving loop enables joint optimization of the segmentation model and pseudo-labels, progressively enhancing label reliability under sparse supervision. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg demonstrate improvements over existing methods, validating its effectiveness and generalization.

</details>


### [71] [PointQ-Bench: Benchmarking Diagnostic and Interpretable Point Cloud Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28241)
*Duanchu Wang,Cheng Li,Junjie Yang,Jing Huang,Zihang Cheng,Zhi Gao,ZhuBohong,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PointQ-Bench是一个拓展点云质量评估(PCQA)从标量评分到全面质量理解的基准，包含3,083个点云样本、12,332个问答对，支持异常感知、缺陷诊断、可用性分级和开放质量报告四项任务，实验发现主流模型存在感知-诊断差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PCQA研究主要聚焦于标量分数预测，无法满足实际检测场景中识别缺陷、表征主导问题类型、评估下游可用性和提供证据支持描述的需求。

Method: 构建了包含3,083个点云（真实扫描、模拟失真、AI生成内容）的基准，覆盖八类主要问题，每样本标注MOS、质量等级、问题标签、专家描述和12,332个问答对。提出SSFRQ-5D五维评估协议用于开放质量描述评估。

Result: 14个视觉-语言模型和传统PCQA基线实验显示一致的感知-诊断差距：模型在粗粒度缺陷感知上有初步能力，但在基础诊断和质量校准上困难；2D多模态大模型普遍优于3D视觉语言模型；额外视图或点级输入的效果因任务、数据源和模型而异。

Conclusion: PointQ-Bench为推进可靠和可解释的点云质量理解提供了诊断性测试平台，揭示了当前模型在质量理解上的关键不足。

Abstract: Point cloud quality plays a critical role in 3D acquisition, reconstruction, rendering, and perception, yet existing point cloud quality assessment (PCQA) research remains largely centered on scalar score prediction. In practical inspection scenarios, quality assessment often involves identifying defects, characterizing dominant issue types, assessing downstream usability, and providing evidence-supported descriptions, which are not explicitly evaluated by current benchmarks. We introduce PointQ-Bench, a benchmark designed to extend PCQA from scalar scoring toward comprehensive quality understanding. PointQ-Bench consists of 3,083 point clouds spanning authentic scans, simulated distortions, and AI-generated content, covering eight major issue types. Each sample is annotated with mean opinion scores (MOS), quality levels, issue tags, expert-grounded descriptions, and 12,332 question-answer pairs. The benchmark supports three perception-oriented tasks: anomaly sensing, defect diagnosis, and usability grading, as well as a cognition-oriented task of open-ended quality reporting. To evaluate free-form quality descriptions, we further propose SSFRQ-5D, a five-dimensional evaluation protocol validated through human-AI agreement analysis. Extensive experiments on 14 vision-language models and traditional PCQA baselines reveal a consistent perception-diagnosis gap: while current models exhibit emerging abilities in coarse defect perception, they struggle with grounded diagnosis and quality calibration. Strong 2D MLLMs generally outperform existing 3D VLMs, and the benefit of additional views or point-level inputs is non-uniform, varying across tasks, data sources, and models, particularly under boundary-ambiguous conditions. Overall, PointQ-Bench provides a diagnostic testbed for advancing reliable and interpretable point cloud quality understanding.

</details>


### [72] [Category-Level 3D Correspondence in Camera Space via Morphable Object Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28257)
*Leonhard Sommer,Artur Jesslen,Basavaraj Sunagad,Adam Kortylewski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了从单张图像进行类别级3D对应关系预测的问题，提出无需显式对应监督即可通过共享可变形物体先验学习该能力。为此构建了包含178k图像、50个家居类别的HouseCorr3D基准数据集，并提出了Morpheus方法，通过解耦规范形状、变形和物体姿态来学习可变形类别级形状先验，从而隐式产生语义上有意义的3D对应关系，在该基准上取得了最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类别级姿态估计方法无法捕捉物体部件、功能和交互所需的细粒度语义信息，且缺乏大规模、具有遮挡区域对应标注和显式对称性标注的基准数据集来推动类别级3D对应关系研究。

Method: 提出Morpheus方法，通过解耦规范形状（canonical shape）、变形（deformation）和物体姿态（object pose）来学习可变形类别级形状先验；构建HouseCorr3D数据集，包含50个家居类别、280个实例、178k图像，提供遮挡区域的amodal对应标签和显式对称性标注。

Result: Morpheus方法在HouseCorr3D基准上取得了最先进的3D对应关系预测性能，表明语义3D物体理解可以从隐式学习中产生而无需直接对应监督。

Conclusion: 通过共享规范空间下的形状先验学习，语义上有意义的3D对应关系可以隐式涌现，为无需密集标注的3D物体理解提供了新方向。

Abstract: Understanding 3D objects from images is fundamental to robotics and AR/VR applications. While recent work has made progress in category-level pose estimation, current representations fail to capture the fine-grained semantics needed for reasoning about object parts, functions, and interactions. In this work, we study category-level 3D correspondence in camera space -- predicting, from a single image, 3D locations that remain consistent across instances within a category -- and show that it can emerge without explicit correspondence supervision by learning a shared morphable object prior. To enable research in this direction, we introduce HouseCorr3D, the first large-scale benchmark for monocular category-level 3D correspondence with 178k images across 50 household object categories, 280 unique instances, and 3D keypoint annotations directly on CAD models. Crucially, HouseCorr3D provides amodal correspondence labels for occluded regions and explicit symmetry annotations, addressing key limitations of existing datasets. We further propose Morpheus, a method that learns morphable category-level shape priors by disentangling canonical shape, deformation, and object pose. Through this shared canonical grounding, semantically meaningful 3D correspondences in camera space emerge implicitly. These emerging 3D correspondences set a new state of the art on HouseCorr3D, demonstrating that semantic 3D object understanding can arise without direct correspondence supervision. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/GenIntel/HouseCorr3D.

</details>


### [73] [MORI-Seg: Learning Morphological Geometry for Instance Segmentation without Instance Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28261)
*Leiyue Zhao,Tianyu Shi,Daniel Reisenbuchler,Xinzi He,Junchao Zhu,Tianyuan Yao,Yuechen Yang,Yanfan Zhu,Junlin Guo,Gelei Xu,Haichun Yang,Yuankai Huo,Mert R. Sabuncu,Yihe Yang,Ruining Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MORI-Seg框架，无需实例级标注，仅用语义分割掩码即可实现实例分割，通过形态感知几何表示和类别条件特征解耦模块，在肾脏病理图像上取得优于传统后处理方法的分割效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开病理数据集多为语义分割标注（同类相邻结构合并为单个区域），无法进行可靠的实例级分析；启发式后处理方法在拥挤、粘连区域效果差；基于深度学习的实例分割需要昂贵的实例级标注。因此需要一种无需实例标注的实例分割方法。

Method: 提出MORI-Seg框架，包含两个核心创新：(1) 形态感知几何表示——联合建模以物体为中心的距离场和边界带表示，编码内部结构和接触界面；(2) 类别条件特征解耦模块——促进实例内一致性和实例间分离。仅使用语义掩码监督，以端到端方式将连通语义区域分解为独立实例掩码。

Result: 在肾脏病理图像上，相比经典后处理流程和代表性语义到实例学习方法，MORI-Seg实现了更高的实例分割精度和更可靠的形态计量分析结果。

Conclusion: MORI-Seg证明了仅利用语义标注即可有效学习实例分割，无需人工实例级标注，为大规模病理图像的形态计量分析提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Instance-level quantification of kidney functional units is essential for morphometric analysis, yet most publicly available pathology datasets provide only semantic segmentation annotations, where adjacent structures of the same class are merged into single regions. This prevents reliable instance-level analysis and limits downstream quantitative studies. Existing heuristic post-processing methods often yield suboptimal instance separation, particularly in crowded and adherent regions, while deep learning-based instance segmentation approaches typically require intensive instance-level annotations that are costly and labor-intensive to obtain. We propose MORI-Seg, a deep learning framework that enables instance segmentation without requiring instance-level annotations. Instead of heuristic splitting or instance supervision, MORI-Seg learns morphology-aware geometric representations directly from semantic masks by jointly modeling object-centric distance fields and boundary-band representations to encode interior structure and contact interfaces. A class-conditioned feature disentanglement module further promotes intra-instance coherence and inter-instance separation. Under semantic-only supervision, MORI-Seg decomposes connected semantic regions into distinct instance masks in an end-to-end manner. Experiments demonstrate improved instance separation accuracy and more reliable morphometric quantification compared with classical post-processing pipelines and representative semantic-to-instance learning approaches. The official implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/ddrrnn123/MORI-Seg.

</details>


### [74] [Every9D-21M: Large-Scale Real-World 9D Canonicalization of Everyday Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28270)
*Leonhard Sommer,Emil Akopyan,Adam Kortylewski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Every9D-21M是一个包含2180万张真实世界图像、覆盖700个日常物体类别的大规模9D姿态数据集，比现有数据集大两个数量级。它通过多视角几何重建点云、跨实例对齐和少量人工标注实现规模化构建，并引入跨类别方向规则实现对称感知评估。实验证明在该数据集上训练能显著提升模型在ImageNet3D、PASCAL3D+和HANDAL上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有9D姿态估计数据集规模有限：最大真实世界数据集仅包含9个类别的1.7万张标注图像，缺乏大规模监督数据，难以训练泛化能力强的模型。

Method: 1) 利用物体中心视频通过多视角几何重建物体级点云；2) 将相似实例对齐到共享规范坐标系；3) 仅对极少量参考物体（<0.01%）人工标注规范姿态，然后通过跨实例对齐传播到其余实例；4) 从多视角验证传播的规范姿态；5) 引入跨类别方向规则诱导类别级对称性。

Result: 数据集包含2180万张真实图像、10.9万个物体中心视频、700个类别。在Every9D-21M上训练提升了在ImageNet3D、PASCAL3D+上的性能，且泛化到HANDAL的能力显著优于在ImageNet3D上训练。

Conclusion: 大规模真实世界9D姿态数据能有效提升模型的泛化能力，为9D姿态基础模型提供了重要的训练资源。

Abstract: Estimating the 9D pose of everyday objects from a single real-world image remains challenging. This is largely due to the lack of large-scale supervision. Most existing datasets either rely heavily on synthetic renderings or provide limited coverage of real-world objects: the largest real-world 9D pose dataset to date contains only 17K annotated objects across 9 categories. We address this gap with Every9D-21M, a dataset of 9D pose annotations for 21.8M real-world images from 109K object- centric videos spanning 700 everyday object categories - two orders of magnitude larger than prior real-world 9D pose benchmarks in both image and category count. To achieve this scale, we leverage object-centric videos by reconstructing object- level point clouds via multi-view geometry and aligning similar instances into a shared canonical coordinate frame. Canonical poses are manually annotated for only a small set of reference objects (fewer than 0.01% of all images) and propagated to the remaining instances via cross-instance alignment. All propagated canonical poses are then verified from multiple viewpoints. We further introduce cross-category orientation rules that induce category-level symmetries, enabling symmetry-aware evaluation. Beyond establishing dedicated training and evaluation splits as a benchmark for 9D pose foundation models, we show that training on Every9D-21M improves performance on ImageNet3D and PASCAL3D+, and generalizes to HANDAL substantially better than training on ImageNet3D. Data and code are available at https://github.com/GenIntel/Every9D.

</details>


### [75] [LV-OSD: Language-Vision-Complementary Open-Set Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28271)
*Yupeng Zhang,Ruize Han,Wei Feng,Song Wang,Liang Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出语言-视觉互补开放集目标检测（LV-OSD）新问题，允许用户同时使用文本和/或图像提示来指定目标类别。为此设计了双分支检测框架LVDor，包含多模态提示（MPr）构建、目标引导的提示动态加权（TPDW）模块实现跨模态对齐，以及训练时的提示随机掩码（PRM）机制，实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放集目标检测通常只支持单一模态（文本或图像）的类别指定方式，但在实际应用中用户可能需要灵活结合文本描述和图像样本共同指定目标类别。这种语言-视觉互补的开放集检测场景更常见且实用，但目前缺乏相关研究。

Method: 提出LVDor双分支检测框架：1）构建多模态提示（MPr），为每个类别收集多种文本描述和图像样本；2）设计目标引导的提示动态加权（TPDW）模块，利用目标图像的先验信息动态生成与目标语义最对齐的文本和图像提示，缩小跨模态差异；3）提出提示随机掩码（PRM）训练机制，模拟测试时文本和/或图像提示的任意组合情况。

Result: 大量实验验证了问题设定的合理性和所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 语言-视觉互补开放集目标检测（LV-OSD）是一个具有实用价值的新问题，LVDor框架通过动态跨模态对齐和随机掩码训练有效实现了该设定下的检测任务。

Abstract: Object detection is an important task in computer vision, which aims to detect the objects of interest. through the given category list or query images. In this work, we propose a new problem of language-visual-complementary open-set object detection (LV-OSD), i.e., using the flexible text-based and/or image-based prompts to specify the desired object categories. This setting is more common and practical in real-world applications. For this purpose, we design a dual-branch detection framework, LVDor, which can simultaneously accept both text and image prompts. Specifically, we first build the Multi-modal Prompts (MPr) containing various text descriptions and image samples for each category. Subsequently, to bridge the semantic gap among the input image, text prompts, and image prompts, we design a Target-guided Prompt Dynamic Weighting (TPDW) module. Guided by the prior information of the target image, this module dynamically produces the text and image prompts that best align with the target semantics, achieving precise alignment and effectively reducing the discrepancy between the two modalities, thereby accommodating the LV-OSD setting. We also propose a simple Prompt Random Masking (PRM) mechanism during training to simulate the arbitrary combination of text and/or image prompts in testing. Extensive experimental results verify our problem formulation's reasonability and our method's effectiveness. Prompts and code will be released publicly.

</details>


### [76] [EchoAvatar: Real-time Generative Avatar Animation from Audio Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28272)
*Bohong Chen,Yumeng Li,Yinglin Xu,Youyi Zheng,Yanlin Weng,Kun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EchoAvatar，一个统一流式架构，能够从流式语音和音乐中实时生成连续、连贯的全身3D角色动画，支持跨域泛化（对话语音和节奏音乐），无需领域标签或模式切换，并通过强化学习优化在线生成质量，同时利用工具调用接口结合大语言模型实现显式语义控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法局限于离线处理完整音频序列，或仅适用于特定领域（如仅语音或仅音乐），缺乏能够同时处理语音和音乐、且支持流式低延迟实时生成的统一框架。

Method: 1) 统一流式架构，支持从增量音频输入连续合成运动；2) 鲁棒训练策略，强制强音频依赖，实现跨域泛化；3) 强化学习优化在线生成质量；4) 工具调用接口，连接大语言模型注入显式语义控制。

Result: 在运动质量和同步性上超越现有实时基线方法，同时保持实时部署所需的灵活性。

Conclusion: 该框架可作为即插即用解决方案，将语音代理转化为交互式人形化身，兼具反应式动画与意图驱动行为的能力。

Abstract: Real-time synthesis of high-fidelity 3D character motion from audio is a pivotal component for next-generation interactive avatars and virtual assistants. However, most existing approaches are limited to offline processing of complete audio sequences or are constrained to specific domains, rarely handling both speech and music effectively. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework designed to generate continuous, coherent full-body motion from streaming speech and music with low latency. Central to our approach is a unified streaming architecture capable of synthesizing continuous motion from incremental audio inputs. We employ a robust training strategy that enforces strong audio dependency, allowing the model to seamlessly generalize across conversational speech and rhythmic music without requiring explicit domain labels or mode switching. Additionally, we explored Reinforcement Learning to refine the quality of online generation. Furthermore, we bridge reactive animation with intent-driven behavior via a tool-call interface that allows upstream Large Language Models to inject explicit semantic control. By combining this controllability with stream audio-driven synthesis, our framework serves as a plug-and-play solution for transforming voice agents into interactive humanoid avatars. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art realtime baselines in motion quality and synchronization while maintaining the flexibility required for live deployment. Our code, pre-trained models, and videos are available at https://robinwitch.github.io/EchoAvatar-Page.

</details>


### [77] [Inpainting-Style Conditional Diffusion for Multivariable Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28324)
*Kourosh Kiani,S. M. Muyeen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于条件扩散模型的多元时间序列太阳功率预测框架，将光伏数据重构为2D图像表示，并将预测问题建模为图像修复（inpainting）任务，通过掩码条件扩散机制实现未来序列的生成式重建，在GEFCom2014数据集上取得优异短期预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有太阳功率预测方法难以同时捕获时空依赖关系，且传统模型在生成高质量、高保真的未来序列方面存在局限；扩散模型在图像生成领域表现优异，但其在时间序列预测特别是光伏预测中的应用尚未被充分探索。

Method: 1) 通过滑动窗口将多元时间序列构建为2D图像块表示；2) 将预测任务定义为时间序列修复问题，历史观测作为条件上下文，未来区域作为缺失区域；3) 采用掩码条件扩散机制，正向过程逐步加噪，反向过程基于U-Net与条件信息去噪重建；4) 引入零填充策略适配U-Net固定输入尺寸；5) 以监督去噪目标训练模型预测噪声。

Result: 在GEFCom2014基准光伏数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了较高的预测精度，尤其在短期预测任务中表现突出。

Conclusion: 将扩散生成模型与修复策略相结合，为鲁棒、灵活且高保真的太阳功率预测提供了一种有效方案，验证了生成式建模在时间序列预测中的潜力。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel conditional diffusion-based framework for multivariable time-series solar power forecasting. The proposed method reformulates temporal PV data as structured two-dimensional representations (images) using a sliding-window patch construction, enabling the application of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) within a unified spatiotemporal learning paradigm. A key contribution of this work is the formulation of solar forecasting as an inpainting problem, where future time steps are treated as missing regions to be reconstructed. This is achieved through a mask-based conditional diffusion mechanism, in which historical observations are preserved as conditioning context while the target (future) region is progressively corrupted and subsequently recovered via reverse diffusion. The model learns to generate coherent future sequences conditioned on observed data, effectively performing time-series inpainting. To fully utilize all available features and ensure compatibility with U-Net architectural constraints, a zero-padding strategy is introduced to construct fixed-size inputs. The model is trained using a supervised denoising objective to predict injected noise, enabling accurate iterative reconstruction during the reverse process. Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark PV dataset, including GEFCom2014, demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves high forecasting accuracy, particularly for short-term horizons. The results highlight the effectiveness of integrating diffusion-based generative modeling with an inpainting formulation for robust, flexible, and high-fidelity solar power forecasting.

</details>


### [78] [Transfer learning RGB models to hyperspectral images with trainable tensor decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28331)
*Mariette Schönfeld,Laurens Devos,Wannes Meert,Hendrik Blockeel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于部分可训练张量分解的方法，将预训练卷积滤波器分解为空间和光谱成分，用高通道维度的可训练光谱成分替换原有光谱成分，从而将预训练模型迁移至多/高光谱图像任务，在多个高光谱数据集上取得了比现有方法更优的精度和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迁移学习方法无法直接处理多/高光谱图像（输入通道数不匹配），而当前解决方案要么牺牲图像信息（如降维），要么牺牲模型信息（如修改模型结构），导致信息损失。本文旨在保留完整图像和模型空间信息的前提下实现跨光谱域的迁移学习。

Method: 基于部分可训练的张量分解，将预训练卷积滤波器分解为空间成分和光谱成分，然后用可训练的、更高通道维度的光谱成分替换原光谱成分，生成高光谱滤波器，在保留预训练滤波器空间模式的同时适应新数据集的光谱维度。

Result: 在多个高光谱数据集上的实验表明，该方法在精度和鲁棒性方面均优于其他高光谱迁移学习方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的部分可训练张量分解方法能有效解决预训练模型与高光谱图像之间的通道维度不匹配问题，同时保留完整的图像信息和模型空间信息，实现了更优的跨光谱域迁移性能。

Abstract: Transfer learning makes it possible to use large vision networks on a variety of domains, by specializing their models' general filters to new tasks. However, these networks assume the input images to have 3 input channels, making them incompatible with multi- or hyperspectral images. Current approaches that mitigate this incompatibility sacrifice information in either the image, or the model. This work proposes a novel approach that preserves the image and spatial information present in the model by using partially trainable tensor decompositions. We create such decompositions of pretrained convolutional filters, separating the filters into spatial and spectral components. The spectral components are then replaced with trainable components of higher channel dimensionality. This creates hyperspectral filters that can specialize to new datasets, while retaining the spatial patterns of the original filter. Experiments on a variety of hyperspectral datasets show that our approach is more accurate and robust than other hyperspectral transfer learning methods.

</details>


### [79] [Toward Semantic-Agnostic and Shape-Aware Vision-Language Segmentation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28348)
*Corentin Seutin,Mohamed Amine Ettaki,Michaël Clément,Pierrick Coupé,Rémi Giraud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出语义无关且形状感知（SANSA）分割范式，通过非语义文本描述（基于字典约束或示例引导）微调分割模型，使其能够推理形状、几何、纹理等固有视觉属性，在保持语义提示性能的同时，新任务上mIoU提升高达20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言分割模型依赖高级语义对象类别，缺乏对形状、几何、纹理等固有视觉属性的推理能力，限制了在真实场景中的泛化性和可控性。

Method: 提出SANSA分割范式，通过两种策略（字典约束和示例引导）生成语义无关的文本描述提示，并基于这些提示对分割模型进行语义无关监督的微调。

Result: 在SANSA新分割任务上，相比预训练SOTA模型，mIoU提升高达20%，同时保持语义提示的强性能。

Conclusion: 低层和中层视觉推理对提升视觉-语言分割模型的泛化性和可控性至关重要。

Abstract: Vision-language segmentation models have recently achieved strong performance by leveraging high-level semantic object categories expressed in natural language. However, this semantic dependence limits their ability to reason about intrinsic visual properties such as shape, geometry, or texture, which are essential in many real-world applications. In this work, we introduce Semantic-Agnostic aNd Shape-Aware (SANSA) segmentation, a new paradigm that requires segmentation models to operate solely from non-semantic textual descriptions. To this end, we propose two strategies to generate SANSA segmentation prompts based on either dictionary constraints or example guidance, both generating semantic-agnostic textual descriptions. These prompts are then used to finetune segmentation models under semantic-agnostic supervision. Experiments show that finetuning on SANSA prompts yields up to a 20% mIoU improvement on this new segmentation task, compared to pretrained state-of-the-art models, while maintaining strong performance on standard semantic prompts. These results highlight the importance of low- and mid-level visual reasoning for improving the generalization and controllability of vision-language segmentation models.

</details>


### [80] [CogVLA: Cognition-Aligned Vision-Language-Action Model via Instruction-Driven Routing & Sparsification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.21046)
*Wei Li,Renshan Zhang,Rui Shao,Jie He,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CogVLA提出了一种认知对齐的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过指令驱动的路由与稀疏化机制，在保持SOTA性能的同时大幅降低训练和推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型基于预训练VLM构建，需要大量后训练导致计算开销高，限制了可扩展性和部署。

Method: 提出三阶段渐进架构：1) EFA-Routing：通过Encoder-FiLM将指令信息注入视觉编码器，选择性聚合压缩双流视觉token；2) LFP-Routing：利用LLM-FiLM引入动作意图，剪枝与指令无关的视觉token实现token级稀疏化；3) CAtten：因果视觉-语言注意力结合双向动作并行解码，确保压缩感知输入仍能生成准确连贯动作。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上成功率97.4%，真实机器人任务成功率70.0%，训练成本降低2.5倍，推理延迟降低2.8倍，相比OpenVLA达到SOTA。

Conclusion: CogVLA通过认知对齐的指令驱动路由与稀疏化，有效解决了VLA模型计算效率与性能之间的权衡问题，具有较好的可扩展性和部署前景。

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models built on pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) require extensive post-training, resulting in high computational overhead that limits scalability and deployment.We propose CogVLA, a Cognition-Aligned Vision-Language-Action framework that leverages instruction-driven routing and sparsification to improve both efficiency and performance. CogVLA draws inspiration from human multimodal coordination and introduces a 3-stage progressive architecture. 1) Encoder-FiLM based Aggregation Routing (EFA-Routing) injects instruction information into the vision encoder to selectively aggregate and compress dual-stream visual tokens, forming a instruction-aware latent representation. 2) Building upon this compact visual encoding, LLM-FiLM based Pruning Routing (LFP-Routing) introduces action intent into the language model by pruning instruction-irrelevant visually grounded tokens, thereby achieving token-level sparsity. 3) To ensure that compressed perception inputs can still support accurate and coherent action generation, we introduce V-L-A Coupled Attention (CAtten), which combines causal vision-language attention with bidirectional action parallel decoding. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that CogVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with success rates of 97.4% and 70.0%, respectively, while reducing training costs by 2.5-fold and decreasing inference latency by 2.8-fold compared to OpenVLA. CogVLA is open-sourced and publicly available at https://github.com/JiuTian-VL/CogVLA.

</details>


### [81] [Bound-Constrained Sparse Representation for Electrical Impedance Tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28392)
*Chun Zhang,Dong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种边界约束稀疏表示（BC-SR）框架用于电阻抗成像（EIT），通过隐式复合参数化从低维潜变量生成电导率，无需显式正则化。该方法利用截断图拉普拉斯基嵌入结构先验，并通过保界非线性映射确保电导率在合理范围内。在2D/3D模拟、水箱实验和体内肺部数据上的验证表明，BC-SR在物理一致性和结构保真度方面优于传统方法，并能实现3D时间差分EIT重建，尤其适用于临床呼吸监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统EIT中电导率估计依赖于显式正则化，在噪声或不完整数据条件下鲁棒性不足，且难以兼顾物理一致性和结构保真度，尤其缺乏有效的3D重建能力。

Method: 提出BC-SR框架，采用表示驱动策略，通过低维潜变量经隐式复合参数化生成电导率；利用截断图拉普拉斯基嵌入结构先验；采用保界非线性映射强制电导率在合理范围内，并通过隐式梯度调制改善条件数。

Result: 在2D/3D模拟、水箱实验和体内肺部数据上，BC-SR相比传统方法在物理一致性和结构保真度方面表现更优；实现了3D时间差分EIT重建，空间分辨率提升，电导率分布表示更连贯。

Conclusion: BC-SR框架为EIT提供了一种无需显式正则化的高效重建方法，增强了鲁棒性和物理合理性，尤其在临床呼吸监测等应用中具有潜力。

Abstract: This study proposes a bound-constrained sparse representation (BC-SR) framework for electrical impedance tomography (EIT), aimed at improving conductivity estimation without explicit regularization. BC-SR adopts a representation-driven strategy, generating conductivity from low-dimensional latent variables via an implicit composite parameterization. Structural priors are embedded using a truncated graph-Laplacian basis, while a bound-preserving nonlinear mapping enforces admissible conductivity ranges and improves conditioning through implicit gradient modulation. The approach ensures robust convergence, even under noisy or incomplete data. Extensive validation on 2D/3D simulations, tank experiments, and in-vivo lung data shows that BC-SR improves physical consistency and structural fidelity, offering enhanced robustness compared to traditional methods. Additionally, BC-SR enables 3D time-difference EIT reconstruction, offering improved spatial resolution and a more coherent representation of 3D conductivity distributions, particularly for in-vivo lung data. This suggests potential for improved performance in EIT, particularly in clinical applications for respiratory monitoring.

</details>


### [82] [Sketch2Motion: Text-driven 2D Sketch to 3D Animation via Diffusion-guided Skeleton Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28394)
*Gaurav Rai,Ojaswa Sharma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Sketch2Motion框架，利用扩散模型引导的骨骼运动合成方法，将2D手绘草图转换为3D动画，通过运动感知分数蒸馏采样(MoSDS)和物理约束实现无需配对数据的文本对齐动画生成，支持双足、四足及非生命体角色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D手绘草图动画在遮挡处理和运动映射方面存在挑战，而现有3D动画方法主要针对特定运动类型（如双足运动、面部表情），缺乏通用且无需配对数据的解决方案。

Method: 采用骨骼变换表示运动，通过线性混合蒙皮传播到网格变形；集成文本到视频扩散模型，通过运动感知分数蒸馏采样(MoSDS)进行优化；应用物理启发的平滑性、拓扑和接触约束；集成弹簧-质量模拟器产生次级运动效果。

Result: 生成的动画在时间连贯性和文本对齐方面优于缺乏生成先验或显式物理约束的基线运动迁移方法。

Conclusion: 该框架具有通用性、完全可微、模块化特点，兼容双足、四足及非生命体铰接角色，代码和数据集将公开。

Abstract: Animation of 2D hand-drawn sketches provides an effective medium for visual communication. However, these sketches pose challenges, particularly in handling occlusions and accurately mapping motion. While 3D animation naturally addresses these challenges, estimating 3D motion remains a very complex task. Recent approaches to converting 2D sketches to 3D animations have mainly focused on specific types of motion, such as bipedal movements and facial expressions. We propose Sketch2Motion, a diffusion-guided framework for skeleton-based motion synthesis that combines classical character animation pipelines with deep generative priors. Our method represents motion using skeletal transformations, which are propagated to mesh deformations via linear blend skinning. To guide the resulting animation toward realistic and semantically meaningful motion, we integrate a text-to-video diffusion model via motion-aware score-distillation sampling (MoSDS), enabling optimization without paired motion data. Additionally, we apply physics-inspired smoothness, topological, and contact constraints to stabilize optimization and preserve motion plausibility. Further, we integrate a spring-mass simulator to introduce secondary motion effects. The proposed framework is generalized, fully differentiable, modular, and compatible with biped, quadruped, and non-living articulated characters. Experiments demonstrate that our approach produces temporally coherent, text-aligned animations that outperform baseline motion transfer methods that lack generative priors or explicit physical constraints. We will make our code and dataset publicly available.

</details>


### [83] [LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27365)
*Shihao Wang,Shilong Liu,Yuanguo Kuang,Xinyu Wei,Yangzhou Liu,Zhiqi Li,Yunze Man,Guo Chen,Andrew Tao,Guilin Liu,Jan Kautz,Lei Zhang,Zhiding Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LocateAnything提出并行框解码（PBD）方法，将边界框作为原子单元一步解码，替代传统序列化坐标token生成方式，配合1.38亿训练样本的数据引擎，在保持几何一致性的同时显著提升解码吞吐量和定位精度，实现了视觉定位与检测的统一高效框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM将视觉定位和检测视为坐标token序列生成问题，每个2D框被序列化为多个1D token独立学习与解码。这种逐token解码方式与框几何结构的耦合特性不匹配，且由于严格的顺序生成过程造成推理瓶颈，限制了速度和精度。

Method: 提出LocateAnything框架，核心是并行框解码（PBD），将边界框和点等几何元素作为原子单元在单步中解码，保持框内几何一致性并实现并行化。同时构建可扩展数据引擎，整理包含1.38亿训练样本的LocateAnything-Data数据集，增加数据多样性以支持高精度定位。

Result: PBD在多个基准上同时提升了解码吞吐量和定位精度（高IoU质量），显著推进了速度-精度前沿，验证了并行框解码与大规模训练数据在实现高效精确的统一视觉定位与检测中的互补优势。

Conclusion: 并行框解码能更好地保持框的几何结构一致性，结合大规模多样化训练数据，可以实现兼顾效率与精度的统一视觉定位与检测框架。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) commonly formulate visual grounding and detection as a coordinate-token generation problem, serializing each 2D box into multiple 1D tokens that are learned and decoded largely independently. This token-by-token decoding mismatches the coupled structure of box geometry and creates a practical inference bottleneck due to strictly sequential generation. We introduce LocateAnything, a unified generative grounding and detection framework based on Parallel Box Decoding (PBD). By decoding geometric elements such as bounding boxes and points as atomic units in a single step, LocateAnything preserves intra-box geometric coherence and unlocks substantial parallelism. We show that PBD improves both decoding throughput and localization accuracy. We further develop a scalable data engine and curate LocateAnything-Data, a large-scale dataset with more than 138 million training samples, substantially increasing data diversity for high-precision localization. Extensive evaluations show that LocateAnything advances the speed-accuracy frontier, achieving significantly higher decoding throughput while improving high-IoU localization quality across diverse benchmarks. The results highlight the complementary benefits of Parallel Box Decoding and large-scale training data in enabling efficient and precise unified visual grounding and detection.

</details>


### [84] [Adaptive Temporal Gating of Longitudinal Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Alzheimer's Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28397)
*Alireza Moayedikia,Sara Fin,Alicia Troncoso Lora,Uffe Kock Wiil*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TAF-Net，一种混合CNN-Transformer架构，通过自适应时间门控模块融合纵向3D MRI扫描，在MCI转AD预测中达到最优性能，仅用结构MRI即可接近多模态方法，预测方差降低48%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习范式主要依赖横断面结构MRI，忽略了患者特定解剖轨迹的预后价值，亟需利用纵向MRI信息提高MCI向AD转化预测的准确性。

Method: TAF-Net融合CNN与Transformer，核心是包含自适应时间门控的时间融合模块，该门控学习患者特定的权重，合成三种时空表征：显式结构变化、区域间时间交叉注意力、双侧特征拼接。

Result: 在ADNI队列三年期MCI转AD预测中，TAF-Net使用单一结构MRI的判别性能超越所有对比方法，显著强于最优基线，接近需PET/CSF/基因数据的多模态方法；数据效率极高；纵向融合将预测方差降低48%。

Conclusion: 纵向MRI融合比单时间点评估具有更低的方差和更高的判别力；注意力区域与内侧颞叶、脑室等已知AD病理区域一致；门控机制优先关注显性体积变化，且与转化风险呈强正相关。

Abstract: Predicting conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) to Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is critical for early intervention. Current deep learning paradigms predominantly rely on cross-sectional structural MRI, neglecting prognostic value in patient-specific anatomical trajectories. We introduce the Temporal Adaptive Fusion Network (TAF-Net), a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture that models paired longitudinal 3D MRI scans. Central to TAF-Net is a Temporal Fusion Module governed by an Adaptive Temporal Gate, which learns patient-specific weightings to synthesize three spatiotemporal representations: explicit structural change, region-to-region temporal cross-attention, and bilateral feature concatenation. Evaluated on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort for three-year MCI-to-AD conversion prediction, TAF-Net achieved the highest discriminative performance among all evaluated methods using only structural MRI, significantly outperforming the strongest baseline and approaching multimodal methods requiring PET, CSF, or genetic data. The architecture exhibited exceptional data efficiency, matching baseline performance with a fraction of training data. Ablation studies demonstrate that longitudinal fusion improves discrimination while reducing predictive variance by 48% compared to single-timepoint evaluation. Interpretability analyses reveal spatial attention aligned with established AD pathology in the medial temporal lobe and ventricles, while the gating mechanism prioritizes explicit volumetric change with strong positive correlation to conversion risk.

</details>


### [85] [EgoRelight: Egocentric Human Capture and Illumination Recovery for Relightable and Photoreal Avatar Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28401)
*Jianchun Chen,Yinda Zhang,Rohit Pandey,Thabo Beeler,Marc Habermann,Christian Theobalt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EgoRelight，一个从单个头戴显示器实现全身动作捕捉、可重光照外观合成和高动态范围环境图估计的端到端框架，在社交远程呈现应用中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将运动捕捉、外观建模和环境光照估计视为孤立问题，要么使用固定光照的虚拟化身，要么依赖专业影棚设备，无法在头戴显示器的受限视角下实现沉浸式混合现实远程呈现。

Method: 1) 基于立体下视相机的自我中心感知模块，提取密集深度图驱动网格化身；2) 分离视图相关镜面反射与视图无关漫反射的神经外观模型，采用专用光线采样策略泛化到未见光照；3) 测试时逆渲染过程，通过匹配预训练化身外观与实时自我中心观测来恢复HDR环境图。

Result: 通过社交远程呈现应用展示系统有效性，在几何精度、渲染质量和重光照保真度上显著优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: EgoRelight首次从单一HMD实现了同时的全身体动捕捉、可重光照外观合成和环境光照估计，为混合现实中的沉浸式远程呈现提供了整体解决方案。

Abstract: Mixed Reality (MR) headsets promise a future of immersive telepresence where virtual humans blend indistinguishably into real or virtual surroundings. Achieving this vision requires a method for capturing a user's motion, estimating appearance under novel lighting, and understanding the environment - all from the constrained viewpoint of a head-mounted display (HMD). Existing approaches treat these as isolated problems: they either focus on driving avatars with baked-in lighting or rely on studio setups for relighting. In this paper, we present EgoRelight, a holistic framework for egocentric telepresence that simultaneously captures full-body human performance, synthesizes photorealistic and relightable appearance, and estimates high dynamic range (HDR) environment maps from a single HMD. First, to ensure motion and surface reconstruction, we propose an egocentric perception module that leverages stereo down-facing cameras to extract dense depth maps, which serve as geometric control signals to drive a mesh-based avatar. Second, we introduce a novel neural appearance model that learns to synthesize view-dependent specular and view-independent diffuse shading separately. By employing a specialized ray-sampling strategy, our model generalizes to unseen illumination without relying on restrictive analytical BRDF priors. Third, we enable seamless avatar integration into the physical world via a test-time inverse rendering process, which recovers an HDR environment map by matching the pre-trained avatar's appearance to live egocentric camera observations. We demonstrate our system through a social telepresence application, where remote users are coherently relit according to their physical environment. Extensive experiments show that our components and the integrated system significantly outperform state-of-the-art baselines in geometric accuracy and rendering as well as relighting fidelity.

</details>


### [86] [VITAL: Visual-Semantic Dual Supervision for Enhanced and Interpretable Latent Reasoning in Medical MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28422)
*Qiaoru Li,Shaotian Liang,Jintao Chen,Haoran Sun,Yuxiang Cai,Jianwei Yin,Yankai Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VITAL是一个面向医学多模态大模型的潜在空间推理框架，通过视觉-语义双监督（辅助文本解码器重建推理链 + 视觉投影器回归ROI特征）解决模态坍塌和可解释性问题，在零推理开销下实现SOTA性能，并在7个基准上取得与万亿参数专有模型竞争的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在空间推理方法存在模态坍塌、视觉监督不足、训练-推理不匹配以及缺乏可解释性等问题，这些在临床应用中至关重要。

Method: 提出VITAL框架，包含双监督模块：(1) 辅助文本解码器从潜在状态重建推理链，提供语义监督；(2) 视觉投影器从冻结的独立医学视觉编码器回归ROI特征，提供视觉监督。推理时丢弃两个模块实现零开销，推理后可重新挂载实现双可解释性。同时构建了涵盖9种成像模态的61K数据集。

Result: 在7个基准测试上，VITAL一致且显著优于骨干模型、所有潜在推理基线以及使用更大数据训练的医学MLLM，达到与万亿参数专有模型竞争的SOTA结果。

Conclusion: 视觉-语义双监督策略能有效解决潜在空间推理的多种缺陷，在保持推理效率的同时提供可解释性，为医学MLLM的临床部署提供可行方案。

Abstract: Latent reasoning enables reasoning over continuous hidden states rather than explicit tokens, avoiding the language bottleneck and inference overhead of chain-of-thought for medical VQA. However, existing methods suffer from modality collapse, insufficient visual supervision, and train-inference mismatch. Moreover, their opaque latent states offer no interpretability, which is critical in clinical applications. We propose VITAL, a latent-space reasoning framework for medical MLLMs with visual-semantic dual supervision: an auxiliary text decoder reconstructs reasoning chains from latent states, while a visual projector regresses ROI features from a frozen, independent medical vision encoder. Both modules are discarded at inference with zero overhead, yet can be re-attached post-hoc for dual interpretability, providing textual and visual explanations of the reasoning process without sacrificing efficiency. We construct a 61K dataset spanning 9 imaging modalities, exceeding prior medical visual latent reasoning datasets by an order of magnitude. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that VITAL consistently and substantially outperforms the backbone, all latent reasoning baselines, and medical MLLMs trained on far larger data, achieving state-of-the-art results competitive with trillion-parameter proprietary models.

</details>


### [87] [Anomaly as Non-Conformity via Training-Free Graph Laplacian Energy Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28428)
*Jungwook Seo,Minjeong Kim,Younkwan Lee,Seungho Shin,Sungyong Baik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练参数的拉普拉斯图能量优化方法ANoCo，通过查询块与正常流形对齐所需的特征漂移量（而非相似度）来检测异常，无需可学习参数，计算复杂度仅相当于一次线性求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法仅通过查询块与正常样本记忆库的特征相似度来检测异常，但相似度本身无法反映查询块违背正常特征流形结构的程度，导致对细微异常的检测能力不足。

Method: 构建查询块到正常块的二分图（仅保留查询-正常边），通过余弦亲和度加权；将异常评分建模为带锚定正常节点的凸拉普拉斯能量优化问题，并给出闭式解；异常分数定义为满足正态性约束所需的特征更新幅度，将拉普拉斯算子重新解释为非一致性算子而非平滑先验。

Result: 在标准基准上取得强图像级AUROC、稳定的定位图，以及相比先前方法更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 优化诱导的特征漂移量可作为有效的异常度量指标，无需可学习参数、消息传递或采样，计算高效且性能优越。

Abstract: Detecting subtle visual anomalies in images remains challenging, particularly when only normal samples are available a priori. Such unsupervised anomaly detection is typically solved by measuring feature similarity of a query patch to a memory of normal patches. However, similarity alone does not reveal how strongly a query patch violates the structure of the normal feature manifold. We propose a training-free Laplacian graph energy optimization formulation, named ANoCo that scores Anomaly by the cost of Non-Conformity of a query patch to align with a fixed normal manifold. For each query patch, we construct a bipartite query to normal graph weighted by cosine affinity, explicitly removing query-query and normal-normal edges to prevent evidence dilution. We formulate anomaly scoring as a convex Laplacian energy with anchored normal nodes, and solve in closed form. In particular, we do not use the optimized features themselves-the anomaly score is the magnitude of the update required to satisfy normality constraints, reframing the graph Laplacian as a non-conformity operator rather than a smoothing prior. The proposed method introduces no learnable parameters, message passing, or sampling, and has complexity comparable to a single linear solve. Across standard benchmarks, it delivers strong image-level AUROC, stable localization maps, and improved robustness over prior methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of using optimization-induced feature drift as anomaly measure.

</details>


### [88] [Bayesian Gated Non-Negative Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28441)
*Peng Cui,Jiahao Zhang,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BayesNCL（贝叶斯门控非负对比学习），通过引入概率门控机制和稀疏伯努利先验的变分推断，解决对比学习中因确定性相似度度量导致的语义纠缠和优化冲突问题，在ImageNet-100上语义一致性提升142.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比学习的潜在表示高度纠缠且不透明，限制其在安全关键应用中的可解释性。根本原因是依赖确定性相似度度量，对所有特征维度一视同仁，导致在组合场景中背景特征（如"蓝天"）在正负对中同时被吸引和排斥，产生梯度振荡，阻碍精确语义解耦。

Method: 提出BayesNCL，引入概率门控机制动态过滤与任务无关的高频常见特征，选择性保留有判别力的语义信息。将特征选择形式化为带稀疏伯努利先验的变分推断问题，从而解决优化冲突。

Result: 在ImageNet-100数据集上，与最先进基线相比，BayesNCL实现142.1%的语义一致性提升，获得高度可解释的表示，且不损害下游任务性能。

Conclusion: BayesNCL通过贝叶斯概率门控机制有效解决了对比学习中的语义纠缠问题，在保持下游性能的同时大幅提升了表示的可解释性。

Abstract: While Contrastive Learning (CL) has revolutionized self-supervised representation learning, its latent representations remain highly entangled and opaque, limiting their interpretability in safety-critical applications. We identify that a fundamental cause of this entanglement is the reliance on deterministic similarity measures, which treat all feature dimensions equally. In compositional scenes, this creates an Optimization Conflict: common background features, such as, "blue sky", are encouraged to align in positive pairs but simultaneously repelled in negative pairs, causing gradient oscillations that hinder precise semantic disentanglement. To address this, we propose BayesNCL (Bayesian Gated Non-Negative Contrastive Learning). Unlike standard approaches, BayesNCL introduces a probabilistic gating mechanism that dynamically filters out task-irrelevant, high-frequency common features while selectively retaining discriminative semantics. By formalizing feature selection as a variational inference problem with a sparse Bernoulli prior, our method effectively resolves the optimization conflict. Empirical experimental results on Imagenet-100 demonstrate that BayesNCL achieves a remarkable 142.1% improvement in semantic consistency compared to state-of-the-art baselines, yielding highly interpretable representations without compromising downstream task performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Cui-Peng-624/BayesNCL.

</details>


### [89] [BiasEdit: A Training-Free Bias-Detect-and-Edit Framework for Learning Fair Visual Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28450)
*Jungwook Seo,Yoonsik Park,Changmin Lee,Sungyong Baik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BiasEdit提出了一种无需人工标注的模块化框架，通过统计依赖和互信息分析自动检测数据集中的未知偏差属性，并利用文本引导的图像编辑生成真实的偏差冲突样本，从而构建去偏数据集。该方法在完全偏斜的训练数据上实现了最先进的去偏性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络视觉数据常包含虚假相关性和社会偏见，而神经网络倾向于学习这些偏见，导致Web服务中的不公平性形成恶性循环。现有去偏方法要么假定已知偏差属性，要么依赖合成混合方式，无法有效处理真实Web场景中偏差未知且数据高度偏斜的问题。

Method: BiasEdit是一个模块化框架：1) 通过视觉-语言表征的统计依赖性和互信息分析自动检测未知偏差属性；2) 利用文本引导图像编辑显式编辑检测到的偏差属性，生成逼真的偏差冲突样本，从而构建去偏数据集。

Result: 无需人工标注即可自动检测和编辑偏差属性；在训练数据完全偏斜的情况下仍能达到最先进的去偏性能；超越了依赖已知偏差或合成混合的现有方法。

Conclusion: BiasEdit通过结合现成的视觉-语言模型和编辑模型，有效解决了Web来源视觉AI中的数据集诱导偏差问题，为构建更公平的Web服务提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Visual data from the Web power image classifiers, which often underpin many web services, such as recommendation and content moderation. However, the raw Web data often contain spurious correlations and social biases, and neural networks are known for their tendency to learn biases present in data. This can reinforce unfairness in web services and the web data, leading to a vicious cycle. In the context of image classification, networks learn bias attributes for a specific class when a majority of images contain the same attribute only for a given class. Hence, training a fair and debiased classifier from a biased dataset demands handling an imbalanced problem between a majority of images with bias attributes (bias-aligned samples) and a minority without (bias-conflict samples). In this work, we introduce BiasEdit, a modular framework that automatically detects bias attributes from the original dataset and edits them to construct a debiased dataset. Specifically, BiasEdit first detects unknown bias attributes via statistical dependence and mutual information analysis of visual-linguistic representations, and then explicitly edits those attributes using text-guided image editing to generate realistic bias-conflict samples. Unlike prior works that assume known bias attributes or relies on synthetic mixing, our method operates without manual annotations and can leverage off-the-shelf vision-language and editing models. BiasEdit addresses a fundamental challenge in Web-sourced visual AI, mitigating dataset-induced bias and achieving state-of-the-art debiasing performance even when training data are fully biased.

</details>


### [90] [REVEAL: Reference-Grounded Reasoning for Multimodal Manipulation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28459)
*Jun Zhou,Bingwen Hu,Yaxiong Wang,Zhedong Zheng,Yongzhen Wang,Yuchen Zhang,Ping Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REVEAL提出了一种基于参考证据对比的多模态篡改检测框架，通过构建17万对真实新闻图文库和差异感知融合机制，在实例级检测和细粒度定位上超越现有方法，并支持无训练域适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖记忆孤立伪影，难以应对细微篡改痕迹和域偏移问题；受人类比较推理启发，将多模态篡改检测重新定义为参考验证问题。

Method: 构建包含17万对真实图文（覆盖4万+公众人物）的参考库；提出差异感知融合机制捕捉查询与证据间的细粒度差异；引入任务解耦的MoE架构联合执行实例级检测和细粒度定位。

Result: 显著优于现有最先进方法；通过仅更新参考库即可实现无需训练的域适应。

Conclusion: 基于参考对比的范式为多模态篡改检测提供了鲁棒且实用的解决方案，尤其在应对演化中的 misinformation 时展现出良好泛化能力。

Abstract: Multimodal manipulation detection aims to simultaneously identify forged image--text pairs and localize tampered regions, yet existing methods typically rely on memorizing isolated artifacts and struggle with imperceptible manipulation traces or domain shifts. Inspired by human comparative reasoning, we reformulate this task as a reference-grounded verification problem, where authenticity is assessed by comparing a query against retrieved authentic evidence. We propose REVEAL Reference-Enabled Verification for Evidence Analysis and Localization), a framework explicitly designed for this comparative paradigm. To support this paradigm, we construct a large-scale reference library comprising 170K authentic news image--text pairs featuring over 40K public figures. Technically, REVEAL employs a difference-aware fusion mechanism to capture fine-grained discrepancies between the query and retrieved evidence. Furthermore, we introduce a task-decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to jointly execute instance-level detection and fine-grained grounding, effectively mitigating optimization conflicts between these heterogeneous objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REVEAL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and notably enables \emph{training-free domain adaptation} by simply updating the reference library, offering a robust and practical solution for detecting evolving misinformation. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/REVEAL-Reference-A006.

</details>


### [91] [SA4Depth: Consistent Pose-Depth Scale Alignment for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28477)
*Changxuan Li,Nadine Berner,Nassir Navab,Federico Tombari,Stefano Gasperini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SA4Depth提出一种无需改变推理时间的自监督单目深度估计方法，通过利用训练时的深度估计重投影可学习视觉特征并减少特征对齐残差，来对齐深度网络和位姿网络估计的场景尺度，从而提升深度预测精度和跨序列的尺度一致性。在KITTI、Cityscapes、NYUv2和KITTI Odometry上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督深度估计研究多聚焦于改进深度网络，而对位姿网络的关注有限。深度和位姿网络各自估计的场景尺度之间存在不一致，这限制了深度预测的精度和跨序列的尺度一致性。

Method: 在训练过程中，利用深度网络估计的深度图将可学习的视觉特征重投影到相邻帧，通过最小化特征对齐残差来优化位姿估计。该方法可微，能无缝集成到现有自监督框架中，且不改变推理时的计算量。

Result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes、NYUv2数据集上的深度估计实验以及KITTI Odometry上的位姿估计实验均取得了显著改进，证明了该方法在不同场景下的有效性。

Conclusion: 对齐深度和位姿网络的场景尺度估计是提升自监督深度估计性能的关键。SA4Depth通过可学习的特征对齐残差优化，在不增加推理开销的情况下显著提升了深度预测精度和尺度一致性。

Abstract: Self-supervised depth estimation from monocular sequences relies on the joint learning of a depth and a pose network. Despite abundant research done to improve the depth network, efforts on the pose remain limited. In this context, even when depth is estimated up to scale, we highlight the importance of the alignment between the scene scales estimated by the pose and depth nets. Then, we introduce SA4Depth, an approach to improve this alignment and boost the depth predictions while keeping the inference time unchanged. Our proposed method uses the depth estimated during training to reproject learnable visual features across consecutive frames and refine the pose estimates by reducing feature alignment residuals. With our method, the estimated scene scales by the separate depth and pose networks are aligned, and the prediction scale consistency is improved across different sequences. Our differentiable refinement integrates seamlessly into existing self-supervised pipelines and substantially improves their depth estimates. We demonstrate this with extensive experiments both outdoors and indoors on KITTI, Cityscapes, and NYUv2. Additionally, results on KITTI Odometry confirm the effectiveness of our pose refinement. Our code is available at https://github.com/Runningchauncey/SA4Depth .

</details>


### [92] [SSR3D-LLM: Structured Spatial Reasoning via Latent Steps for Fine-Grained Grounding in Unified 3D-LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28490)
*Jiawei Li,Ziyi Liu,Weijie Shi,Long Chen,Jiajie Xu,Xiaofang Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SSR3D-LLM，通过结构化空间推理步骤和几何感知评分器替代传统单指针式3D接地决策，显著提升统一3D-LLM在细粒度指代理解上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一实例中心3D-LLM使用单指针式接地决策，压缩关系型指令为单一选择，难以处理需要排除多个同类候选的细粒度查询。

Method: 基于Mask3D目标提议，LLM生成潜在空间推理步骤和记忆token，几何感知评分器按序读取并逐步精化候选排名（含步长掩码）；训练时结合标准基准目标和辅助指代线索监督，推理时仅需输入查询和提议。

Result: 在ReferIt3D、ScanRefer、Multi3DRef上均达到统一3D-LLM基线最强结果，较单指针QPG基线在细粒度接地上有显著提升。

Conclusion: 结构化空间推理接口能有效增强3D-LLM的细粒度指代理解能力，同时保持原有语言任务路径不变。

Abstract: 3D object grounding localizes referred objects in a 3D scene from natural language. Unified instance-centric 3D-LLMs aim to solve grounding together with dialog, QA, and captioning, yet many rely on a single pointer-style grounding decision that compresses a relational instruction into one selection. This is brittle for fine-grained queries where multiple same-class candidates must be ruled out by context objects and spatial relations. We propose Structured Spatial Reasoning 3D-LLM (SSR3D-LLM), a structured grounding interface for unified 3D-LLMs. Given fixed Mask3D object proposals, the LLM writes a sequence of latent spatial reasoning steps and memory tokens from the query, and a geometry-aware scorer reads these latent steps in order to refine candidate rankings step by step with step-length masking. The latent steps are learned from standard benchmark target supervision with auxiliary referential-cue supervision during training, while inference uses only the input query and Mask3D proposals. Across ReferIt3D, ScanRefer, and Multi3DRef, SSR3D-LLM achieves the strongest results among unified 3D-LLM baselines, with substantial gains over the single-pointer QPG baseline on fine-grained grounding and consistent improvements over prior unified 3D-LLMs, while preserving the default language-task route.

</details>


### [93] [DiscoForcing: A Unified Framework for Real-Time Audio-Driven Character Control with Diffusion Forcing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28491)
*Kaiyang Ji,Bingsheng Qian,Binghuan Wu,Kangyi Chen,Ye Shi,Jingya Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiscoForcing提出了一种流式音频驱动扩散框架，用于实时音频响应角色控制，在严格因果、有限延迟的流式场景下，比现有方法实现更稳定的长程运动和更锐利的音动对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音乐驱动运动系统主要针对离线生成优化，依赖全局上下文，在流式部署中因条件历史过时或不可靠而性能退化，无法应对音频条件突变（如节奏变化、断点或用户编辑）。

Method: 提出DiscoForcing框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 因果音乐编码器（捕捉节奏结构和相位动态）；2) 扩散强制序列模型（在时间维度上以异构噪声水平训练）；3) 混合时间调度与历史引导的流式采样器（权衡响应速度与长程一致性）。

Result: 在匹配因果性和延迟约束条件下，DiscoForcing比基线方法实现更稳定的长程推演和更锐利的音动对齐，同时保持实时吞吐量。

Conclusion: 通过端到端实时交互系统（含在线虚拟人回放和人形部署工作流）验证，DiscoForcing有效解决了流式音频驱动角色控制中因果性、低延迟与长程一致性之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: We study real-time audio-responsive character control as a deployment-faithful problem: strictly causal, bounded-latency streaming that must generate coherent full-body motion at interactive frame rates while the audio condition can change abruptly, including tempo shifts, drops, or user edits. Prior music-to-motion systems are largely optimized for offline generation with global context, and degrade in streaming rollouts where conditioning history becomes stale or unreliable. We introduce DiscoForcing, a streaming audio-driven diffusion framework that combines a causal music encoder that captures rhythmic structure and phase dynamics with a diffusion-forcing sequence model trained under heterogeneous noise levels across the temporal horizon. Building on this, we design a hybrid temporal schedule and a history-guided streaming sampler to explicitly trade off responsiveness against long-horizon consistency under non-stationary audio. Implemented in an end-to-end real-time interactive system with online avatar playback and humanoid deployment workflows, DiscoForcing delivers more stable long-horizon rollouts and sharper audio-motion alignment than prior baselines under matched causality and latency constraints while maintaining real-time throughput.

</details>


### [94] [Janus-LoRA: A Balanced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28495)
*Cheng Chen,Pengpeng Zeng,Yuyu Guo,Lianli Gao,Hengtao Shen,Jingkuan Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Janus-LoRA通过梯度矫正（保持参数正交性）和解耦边缘损失（增强特征分离）两个组件，解决了LoRA在持续学习中破坏正交性导致灾难性遗忘以及平衡稳定性-可塑性的问题，达到了新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA在持续学习中独立的低秩因子更新会系统性地违反与历史知识子空间的正交性约束，导致干扰和灾难性遗忘；而简单强制正交又会损害可塑性，破坏稳定性-可塑性平衡。

Method: 提出Janus-LoRA框架，包含两个组件：1) 梯度矫正（Gradient Rectification）：通过闭式解数学解耦LoRA的因子更新，结合在线估计高效识别历史知识子空间，强制正交性；2) 解耦边缘损失（Decoupled Margin Loss）：在新旧特征表示之间推离，创建低干扰区域以增强可塑性。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的持续学习基准上取得了新的SOTA性能，验证了参数级正交性与特征级分离的协同效果。

Conclusion: 通过调和参数级正交性与特征级分离，Janus-LoRA实现了更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡，为LoRA在持续学习中的应用提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a promising paradigm for Continual Learning. It independently updates its low-rank factors ($A$ and $B$), creating a composite update to the full weight matrix through their interaction. To prevent catastrophic forgetting, this update should remain orthogonal to the task-specific subspace that contains previously learned knowledge. However, we identify that this composite update systematically violates this orthogonality, reintroducing interference and undermining stability. Furthermore, naively enforcing this orthogonality compromises plasticity, disrupting the delicate stability-plasticity trade-off. To resolve these issues, we propose \textbf{Janus-LoRA}, a framework that restores this balance through two novel components. Specifically, we first introduce Gradient Rectification, a closed-form solution that mathematically decouples LoRA's factor updates, enforcing orthogonality against the historical knowledge subspace identified by an efficient Online Estimation. Next, to enhance plasticity, we introduce a Decoupled Margin Loss that promotes feature-level separation by pushing new feature representations away from old ones, thus creating distinct, low-interference regions for new learning. Comprehensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate that by harmonizing parameter-level orthogonality with feature-level separation, Janus-LoRA achieves a superior balance and establishes new state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [95] [DriveWAM: Video Generative Priors Enable Scalable World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28544)
*Chen Shi,Jinrui Xu,Shaoshuai Shi,Kehua Sheng,Bo Zhang,Li Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriveWAM是一种将预训练视频扩散Transformer改编为自回归视频-动作策略的驾驶世界-动作模型，通过统一视频和动作令牌序列、联合流匹配训练、场景演化驾驶引导和选择性KV记忆，在NAVSIM和PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles基准上取得了强规划性能，并展示了从4k到100k驾驶片段的数据扩展潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与主要在静态图像-文本对上的视觉-语言模型不同，视频生成模型捕获了天然适配驾驶任务的时间动态和运动先验，因此作者希望利用预训练视频扩散Transformer的大规模视频先验来增强端到端自动驾驶的动作生成能力。

Method: 1) 将视频和动作流组织为统一的时间令牌序列，在联合流匹配目标下训练；2) 引入场景演化驾驶引导，使用冻结的VLM生成块级语义意图指导视频-动作生成；3) 提出选择性KV记忆，通过相关性-冗余缓存选择在推理时维护有界模态感知的视频和动作记忆池。

Result: 在NAVSIM和PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles基准上取得了强规划性能；数据扩展研究（4k到100k驾驶片段）验证了世界-动作建模在端到端自动驾驶中的扩展潜力。

Conclusion: DriveWAM有效证明了将预训练视频生成先验迁移至自动驾驶动作生成是可行的，且具有良好的数据扩展潜力。

Abstract: Pretrained foundation models have become an important basis for end-to-end autonomous driving. In contrast to vision-language models pretrained primarily on static image-text pairs, video generative models capture temporal dynamics and motion priors that are naturally suited for driving. We present DriveWAM, a driving world-action model that adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer into an autoregressive video-action policy. DriveWAM organizes video and action streams into a unified temporal token sequence and trains them under a joint flow-matching objective, preserving the pretrained video-generation architecture while adapting its large-scale video priors to action generation. To incorporate high-level scene understanding, we introduce scene-evolving driving guidance, where a frozen VLM produces chunk-specific semantic intent to guide video-action generation. To keep long-horizon rollout bounded, we further introduce selective KV memory, which maintains bounded modality-aware video and action memory pools through relevance-redundancy cache selection at inference time. Experiments on NAVSIM and the PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles benchmark show that DriveWAM achieves strong planning performance, and a data-scaling study from 4k to 100k driving clips further confirms the scaling potential of world-action modeling for end-to-end autonomous driving.

</details>


### [96] [GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28548)
*Ruowen Zhao,Bangguo Li,Zuyan Liu,Yinan Liang,Junliang Ye,Fangfu Liu,Diankun Wu,Zhengyi Wang,Xumin Yu,Yongming Rao,Han Hu,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GEM通过将深度图生成任务集成到VLM预训练阶段，弥合了高层语义与低层空间物理知识之间的鸿沟，在具身智能任务上取得了SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在具身机器人应用中，标准文本引导预训练范式侧重于高层语义理解，而缺乏执行具身任务所需的关键低层空间和物理知识。

Method: 提出GEM模型，在VLM预训练阶段直接集成深度图生成任务，联合训练生成目标和主模型；同时构建大规模数据集GEM-4M，包含接地、推理、规划数据及高质量深度监督。

Result: 在多个具身基准上取得SOTA结果；部署的GEM-VLA动作模型在仿真环境和真实机器人评估中均表现出显著优越的任务执行能力。

Conclusion: 将深度生成任务融入VLM预训练能有效提升具身智能的语义理解与物理操作能力，为连接高层语义与低层空间知识提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance and generalization in robotics, particularly within Vision-Language-Action frameworks. However, a significant gap remains between the high-level semantic focus of standard text-guided pre-training paradigms and the low-level spatial and physical knowledge critical for execution in embodied environments. In this paper, we introduce GEM, a Generative-supervised Embodied vision-language Model designed to bridge this divide. We propose integrating a depth map generation task directly into the VLM pre-training phase. By training this generative objective jointly with the main model, we observe substantial improvements in embodied intelligence, significantly enhancing both semantic understanding and physical operation capabilities. To support this paradigm, we curate and release GEM-4M, a comprehensive large-scale dataset featuring a mixture of grounding, reasoning, and planning data paired with high-quality depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEM achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse embodied benchmarks. Furthermore, our deployed action model, GEM-VLA, exhibits vastly superior task execution abilities in both simulation environments and real-world evaluations. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://zhaorw02.github.io/GEM/

</details>


### [97] [Resolution-free neural surrogates for geometric parameterization and mapping with spatially varying fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28551)
*Yanwen Huang,Lok Ming Lui,Gary P. T. Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无分辨率依赖的神经代理模型，用于解决由空间变化参数场驱动的几何映射问题（如畸变校正、图像配准等）。模型以参数场采样点和查询位置为输入，直接预测映射后的坐标，通过多分辨率几何编码策略避免网格依赖，并利用变分能量、扩散密度均衡和拟共形理论等几何约束进行无监督训练。在拟共形映射和密度均衡映射任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统几何映射方法（变分模型、扩散过程、椭圆PDE）在参数场逐实例变化时，需要重复求解高分辨率系统，计算代价高昂。现有神经方法多依赖固定网格，缺乏灵活性和泛化能力。因此需要一种无分辨率依赖、可泛化到任意查询点集的神经替代方法。

Method: 1) 输入：空间变化参数场p的坐标增强采样点 + 查询位置{x_i}；2) 使用多分辨率几何编码策略对参数场进行编码，避免固定网格依赖；3) 网络预测映射位置{u(x_i)}，支持任意结构/非结构点集；4) 无监督训练，损失函数由几何约束构成：变分能量、扩散密度均衡、拟共形理论约束。

Result: 在拟共形映射和密度均衡映射两类问题上的实验验证了方法的有效性，表明模型能够准确预测几何映射且具备分辨率无关的特性。

Conclusion: 提出的无分辨率神经代理方法能够高效处理空间变化参数场驱动的几何映射问题，避免了传统数值方法的反复求解开销，且不依赖固定网格，具有良好的泛化能力。未来可推广到更多成像领域的几何映射任务。

Abstract: Many imaging problems require computing spatial transformations induced by spatially varying intensity, feature, or density fields. Canonical examples include distortion correction, deformable image registration, atlas-based segmentation, and deformation-driven image analysis. These tasks can be formulated as geometric mapping problems in which the transformation is constrained to preserve local structure, control boundary behavior, or regulate angular distortion. Such formulations typically lead to variational models, diffusion processes, or elliptic partial differential equations. However, repeatedly solving high-resolution systems becomes computationally expensive when the underlying parameter fields vary across instances. In this work, we propose a resolution-free neural surrogate for geometric parameterization and mapping problems. Given a spatially varying parameter field $p:Ω\to\mathbb{R}^m$ and query locations $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^N\subsetΩ$, the model predicts mapped locations $\{u(x_i)\}_{i=1}^N$ on arbitrary structured or unstructured point sets. To avoid dependence on a fixed grid, we use a multi-resolution geometric encoding strategy that conditions the network on coordinate-augmented samples of the parameter field. The model is trained without labeled solution data by enforcing geometry-aware constraints derived from variational energies, diffusion-based density equalization, and quasi-conformal theory. Experimental results on quasi-conformal mapping and density-equalizing mapping problems are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [98] [Deformable Gaussian Occupancy: Decoupling Rigid and Nonrigid Motion with Factorized Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28587)
*Yang Gao,Wuyang Li,Po-Chien Luan,Alexandre Alahi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeGO提出了一种可变形高斯占用框架，通过解耦刚体与非刚体运动、结合因子化4D基础模型蒸馏，在弱监督下实现了动态3D场景理解的最优性能，在人类中心实例上提升13.5%，整体提升10.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有弱监督占用预测框架主要假设刚体运动并依赖简单帧间偏移，无法捕捉细粒度形变和维持时间一致性，限制了在人类中心、非刚体动态环境中的表现。

Method: 提出DeGO框架，包含两个核心设计：1) 解耦高斯形变机制，将每个高斯基元的运动分解为形变和偏移更新，分别处理非刚体与刚体运动；2) 因子化4D蒸馏策略，从VGGT基础模型中迁移跨相机、跨帧知识，生成与基础模型对齐的特征以增强时间一致性。

Result: 在Occ3D-NuScenes基准上达到弱监督SOTA，人类中心实例提升13.5%，整体mIoU提升10.9%。

Conclusion: 形变感知和基础模型引导的占用建模对动态场景理解有效，代码已开源。

Abstract: Understanding dynamic 3D environments is essential for safe autonomous driving, particularly when reasoning about human-centric, nonrigid agents. However, existing weakly supervised occupancy prediction frameworks predominantly assume rigid-body motion and rely on simple frame-to-frame offsets, limiting their ability to capture fine-grained deformations and maintain temporal coherence. To address this issue, we propose DeGO, a deformable Gaussian occupancy framework that unifies decoupled Gaussian deformation with factorized 4D foundation-model distillation. DeGO disentangles rigid and nonrigid motion, enabling each Gaussian primitive to evolve through both deformation and offset-based updates. In parallel, a factorized 4D distillation strategy transfers cross-camera and cross-frame knowledge from the VGGT foundation model, producing foundation-aligned features that enhance temporal consistency. Experiments on the Occ3D-NuScenes benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under weak supervision, delivering 13.5% gains on human-centric instances and 10.9% overall improvements. These results highlight the effectiveness of deformation-aware and foundation-guided occupancy modeling for dynamic scene understanding. The code is publicly available: https://github.com/vita-epfl/DeGO

</details>


### [99] [Mining Multi-Modality Spatio-Temporal Cues for Video Important Person Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28604)
*Xiao Wang,Minglei Yang,Bin Yang,Wenke Huang,Zheng Wang,Xin Xu,Mang Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出视频重要人物（VIP）识别任务，构建了Temporal-VIP数据集（9,249个视频片段，11类，含重要性标注），并提出VIP-Net框架（含SCE、TIR模块）解决时序重要性偏移（TIS）问题，在准确率（67.3%）和理由相似度（0.63）上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注静态图像和即时视觉线索，忽略了视频中丰富的时空信息，导致出现时序重要性偏移（TIS）现象——早期帧中被认为重要的人物在考虑完整时序上下文后被降级。因此需要一种能利用时空信息自动识别视频中最有影响力个体的方法。

Method: 提出了VIP-Net框架，包含三个核心组件：1) Social Cue Encoder (SCE)：提取多模态时空线索；2) Temporal Importance Rectifier (TIR)：进行层次化线索融合和跨模态对齐，缓解TIS；3) VIP Inference：对人物进行重要性排序。同时构建了Temporal-VIP数据集，包含9,249个视频片段及对齐的重要性理由标注。

Result: VIP-Net在VIP识别任务上达到67.3%的准确率，显著优于SOTA模型（37.5%-53.9%）；通过特征引导的LLM精炼，理由相似度达到0.63。

Conclusion: 本文首次提出视频重要人物识别任务，通过构建标注数据集和设计VIP-Net框架有效缓解了时序重要性偏移问题，实验结果证明了方法的优越性。数据集和代码已公开。

Abstract: Identifying key individuals in video scenes is essential for applications such as automated video editing and intelligent surveillance. Current methods primarily focus on static images and immediate visual cues, overlooking the rich spatio-temporal information in videos. This leads to the phenomenon of Temporal Importance Shift (TIS), wherein individuals deemed significant in early frames may be demoted as the entire temporal context is considered. To address this, we introduce the Video Important Person (VIP) identification task, aimed at automatically identifying the most influential individuals in videos while providing textual rationales. We present Temporal-VIP, a large-scale rationale-annotated dataset consisting of 9,249 video segments across 11 categories with aligned importance rationales. To mitigate TIS, we develop the VIP-Net framework, which includes a Social Cue Encoder (SCE) for extracting multi-modal spatio-temporal cues, a Temporal Importance Rectifier (TIR) for hierarchical cue fusion and cross-modal alignment, and VIP Inference for ranking individuals. Experimental results show that VIP-Net achieves 67.3% accuracy, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art models (37.5%-53.9%) and yielding a mean rationale similarity of 0.63 to ground truth through feature-guided LLM refinement. The dataset and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yml2002/Temporal-VIP.

</details>


### [100] [Internally Referenced Low-Light Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28605)
*Peiyuan He,Hainuo Wang,Hengxing Liu,Mingjia Li,Xiaojie Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种内部参考的低光照图像增强框架（IRLE），通过从退化输入图像自身提取物理和结构参考，解决了自监督LLIE中光照解耦、纹理保留和噪声放大的难题，在去噪和纹理保真方面达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督低光照图像增强虽免于依赖外部配对数据，但由于缺乏外部参考，网络难以解耦纠缠的光照、精细纹理和放大噪声。

Method: (1) 局部曝光模拟方案提取低频伪真值作为内部物理参考，引导全局光照估计和颜色校正；(2) 双域保留策略（光照对齐感知损失+平移不变谱相关损失）构建内部结构参考；(3) 增益自适应特征调制（GAFM）机制将自估计光照图转为内部空间增益先验，动态引导盲点网络进行空间感知去噪。

Result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA性能，在噪声抑制和纹理保真度方面表现优异。

Conclusion: 通过从退化图像自身提取可靠内部参考，有效解决了自监督LLIE中光照、纹理和噪声的耦合难题。

Abstract: Self-supervised low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is highly appealing as it eliminates the reliance on external paired data. However, the lack of external references causes networks to struggle with decoupling entangled illumination, delicate textures, and amplified noise. To resolve this challenge, we propose an Internally Referenced LLIE framework that extracts reliable physical and structural references from the degraded input image itself. First, we introduce a local exposure-simulated scheme to extract a low-frequency pseudo ground-truth. This serves as an internal physical reference to guide global illumination estimation and correct color casts. Second, we propose a dual-domain preservation strategy with spatial and spectral constraints to construct internal structural references. Specifically, an Illumination-Aligned Perceptual loss preserves global structures under illumination shifts, while a Shift-Invariant Spectral Correlation loss captures fine-grained local structures and suppresses high-frequency noise. Finally, we propose a Gain-Adaptive Feature Modulation (GAFM) mechanism to address highly spatially-variant residual noise. By transforming the self-estimated illumination map into an internal spatial gain prior, GAFM dynamically guides a blind-spot network for spatially-aware denoising. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering superior noise suppression and textural fidelity. Code will be publicly released at https://visonj.github.io/IRLE/.

</details>


### [101] [JECA^2: Judgment-Explanation Consistent Adversarial Attack against Forensic Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28609)
*Jiachen Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出JECA^2，一种针对法医视觉语言模型（VLMs）的红队诊断方法，能够同时攻击模型的二值判断和自然语言解释，使得两者的输出保持一致（即判断错误且解释不泄露真实篡改线索）。实验表明该方法在白盒场景下攻击成功率和判断-解释一致性均优于基线，但黑盒迁移有限，揭示了基于解释的法医VLM中存在一致性失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击主要关注翻转法医VLM的二值判断，但模型生成的解释仍可能暴露篡改线索，导致判断与解释不一致。本文旨在研究判断-解释一致的对抗攻击，以揭示法医VLM在鲁棒性评估中被忽视的缺陷。

Method: 提出JECA^2，一种受控的白盒对抗攻击方法。视觉侧利用Grad-CAM引导的扰动将视觉注意力从篡改区域转移到良性区域；文本侧通过令牌邻近性约束优化提示嵌入，使其朝向真实性确认语义对齐。

Result: 在法医VLM基准上，JECA^2在白盒威胁设置下攻击成功率和判断-解释一致性均高于基线；闭源VLM上可迁移但效果有限。

Conclusion: 基于解释的法医VLM存在判断-解释一致性失效的漏洞，未来鲁棒性评估应超越二值检测准确率，关注更全面的攻击范式。

Abstract: Forensic vision-language models (VLMs) have recently been developed to detect image tampering and provide natural-language explanations. However, their robustness against adversarial manipulation remains underexplored. Existing adversarial attacks typically aim to flip the model's binary judgment, while the accompanying explanation may still reveal forensic cues and contradict the attacked judgment. In this paper, we study judgment-explanation consistent adversarial attacks against forensic VLMs and propose JECA^2, a controlled white-box red-team diagnostic that jointly redirects visual attribution and aligns textual explanations with the target judgment. On the visual side, JECA^2 uses Grad-CAM-guided perturbations to divert attribution from tampered regions toward benign regions. On the textual side, it optimizes prompt embeddings toward authenticity-affirming semantics under a token-proximity constraint. Experiments on forensic VLM benchmarks show that JECA^2 achieves higher attack success and automated judgment-explanation consistency than implemented baselines under white-box threat settings, while transfer to closed-source VLMs remains measurable but limited. Our results highlight a consistency failure mode in explanation-based forensic VLMs and motivate future robustness evaluation beyond binary detection accuracy.

</details>


### [102] [Compositional Text-to-Image Generation Via Region-aware Bimodal Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28615)
*Zhuohan Liu,Wujian Peng,Yitong Chen,Zuxuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BiDPO框架，通过构建大规模偏好数据集BiComp、扩展Diffusion DPO联合优化图文偏好以及区域级引导方法，显著提升文本到图像模型在属性绑定、对象关系和计数等复杂组合提示下的生成 fidelity。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I模型在处理复杂组合提示（属性绑定、对象关系、计数）时仍存在困难，生成结果难以准确反映复杂文本语义。

Method: (1) 设计严格质量控制的偏好数据集BiComp构建流水线；(2) 扩展Diffusion DPO以联合优化图像和文本偏好；(3) 采用区域级引导方法聚焦与组合概念相关的区域，实现细粒度对齐。

Result: BiDPO在多个基准上显著提升组合 fidelity，一致优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 基于偏好的微调方法在复杂文生图任务中具有潜力，提供了一种灵活可扩展的替代方案。

Abstract: Despite the rapid progress of text-to-image (T2I) models, generating images that accurately reflect complex compositional prompts (covering attribute bindings, object relationships, counting) still remains challenging. To address this, we propose BiDPO, a framework to enhance T2I model's capability of compositional text-to-image generation. We begin by introducing an carefully designed pipeline to construct a large-scale preference dataset, BiComp, with strictly quality control. Then, we extend Diffusion DPO to jointly optimize image and text preferences, which is shown to greatly effective in improving the models to follow complex text prompt in generation. To further enhance the models for fine-grained alignment, we employ a region-level guidance method to focus on regions relevant to compositional concepts. Experimental results demonstrate that our BiDPO substantially improves compositional fidelity, consistently outperforming prior methods across multiple benchmarks. Our approach highlights the potential of preference-based fine-tuning for complex text-to-image tasks, offering a flexible and scalable alternative to existing techniques.

</details>


### [103] [A Multiscale Kinetic Framework for Image Segmentation: From Particle Systems to Continuum Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28619)
*Horacio Tettamanti,Giulia Guicciardi,Mattia Zanella*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多尺度动力学框架的共识驱动图像分割方法，将图像视为相互作用粒子系统，通过位置与特征空间的耦合演化，结合传输、聚集和扩散效应，推导出动力学方程，并通过尺度化得到一阶宏观模型，最终利用粒子优化技术实现高效鲁棒的图像分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图像分割方法在处理噪声、复杂纹理和多尺度结构时存在局限性，缺乏从微观粒子动力学到宏观分割模型的统一理论框架。作者希望建立一种多尺度动力学视角，将图像分割问题转化为粒子系统的共识演化问题。

Method: 1) 将图像建模为相互作用粒子系统，每个像素由空间位置和颜色特征编码；2) 引入位置-特征空间耦合交互机制，推导粒子密度的动力学方程（含传输、聚集、扩散）；3) 通过合适的尺度化，得到一阶宏观模型，描述具有特定特征的像素分数演化；4) 基于简化模型，采用粒子优化技术进行数据驱动的图像分割。

Result: 数值实验表明该方法在多种噪声条件下均有效，且具有较好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该多尺度动力学框架为共识驱动的图像分割提供了统一的理论基础，简化后的宏观模型结合粒子优化方法在分割精度和噪声鲁棒性方面表现出色。

Abstract: In this work, we present a multiscale kinetic framework for consensus-based image segmentation. By interpreting an image as a system of interacting particles, each pixel is characterised by its spatial position and an internal feature encoding color information. We introduce a coupled interaction scheme governing the evolution of particles in both position and feature spaces, from which we derive a kinetic formulation for the particle density in the space-feature domain combining transport, aggregation, and diffusion effects. Furthermore, through a suitable scaling, we obtain a first-order macroscopic model describing the evolution of the fraction of pixels carrying information on the fraction of pixels having a certain feature. Based on this reduced-complexity model, we present a data-oriented approach where we make use of particle-based optimisation techniques for the accurate segmentation of images. Numerical tests show the effectiveness of the proposed framework and its robustness under different noise conditions.

</details>


### [104] [EntroAD: Structural Entropy-Guided Prompt Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28630)
*Xinyu Zhao,Qingyun Sun,Jiayi Luo,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EntroAD提出了一种结构熵引导的零样本异常检测框架，通过动态路由机制和置信度感知的双分支提示适配模块，在10个工业与医学基准上取得了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于CLIP的零样本异常检测方法大多依赖单一适配路径，难以应对不同领域中异质性异常模式（从显著的结构性断裂到细微的弥散性变化）的检测需求。

Method: 1) 利用自注意力引导的块关系估计局部结构熵，作为关系不确定性的代理指标；2) 基于结构熵设计动态路由机制，构建异常感知的路由令牌；3) 提出置信度感知的双分支提示适配模块，稳定视觉-文本对齐并保留CLIP的可迁移先验。

Result: 在10个工业与医学基准数据集上的跨数据集零样本异常检测设置中取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 结构熵引导的动态路由能够有效区分不同类型的异常模式，双分支提示适配策略在保持CLIP先验的同时提升了跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) aims to detect anomalies in unseen domains without target-domain adaptation. Recent CLIP-based methods have shown promising performance by leveraging prompt learning and visual-text alignment. However, most existing approaches rely on a single adaptation pathway, which may be insufficient for heterogeneous anomaly patterns across domains. In practice, anomalies exhibit vastly different characteristics, ranging from salient, localized structural disruptions to subtle, diffuse, and irregular variations. To address this challenge, we propose EntroAD, a structural entropy-guided zero-shot anomaly detection framework. Unlike previous methods, EntroAD introduces a dynamic routing mechanism to process different types of anomalies with specialized adaptation strategies. Specifically, we estimate patch-level structural entropy from self-attention-induced patch relations and use it as a proxy for relational uncertainty to guide anomaly-aware token routing. Based on this routing signal, we construct anomaly-aware routed tokens to better capture anomaly cues with different structural characteristics. We further introduce a confidence-aware dual-branch prompt adaptation module to stabilize visual-text alignment while preserving CLIP's transferable prior. Extensive experiments on 10 industrial and medical benchmarks show that EntroAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in challenging cross-dataset ZSAD settings.

</details>


### [105] [OSP-Next: Efficient High-Quality Video Generation with Sparse Sequence Parallelism, HiF8 Quantization, and Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28691)
*Yunyang Ge,Xianyi He,Zezhong Zhang,Bin Lin,Bin Zhu,Xinhua Cheng,Li Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OSP-Next 是一种高效文本到视频生成模型，通过混合全-稀疏注意力架构（Skiparse-2D Attention）、稀疏序列并行（SSP）、HiF8 量化与 Mix-GRPO 强化学习后训练，在保持视频质量的同时显著加速推理，在 NVIDIA H200 和 Ascend 950PR 上均实现大幅加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Diffusion Transformers 在视频生成中效果优异，但全注意力的二次复杂度导致效率瓶颈，需要更高效的稀疏化方案来降低计算和通信开销。

Method: ① 提出混合全-稀疏注意力架构，其中稀疏部分采用 Skiparse-2D Attention（固定模式的逐 token 和逐组空间稀疏注意力，兼容 FlashAttention）；② 基于 Skiparse-2D Attention 的局部等价性提出稀疏序列并行（SSP），通过一次 All-to-All 通信切换稀疏模式，相比 Ulysses SP 减少 75% 通信量；③ 引入 HiF8 量化实现 8-bit 联合训练与稀疏微调；④ 应用 Mix-GRPO 后训练提升稀疏模型性能。

Result: VBench 总分 83.73%，超越 Wan2.1 基线。5秒 720P/768P 下，NVIDIA H200 上单卡加速达 1.64×，八卡加速达 1.52×；Ascend 950PR 上 OSP-Next-HiF8 加速达 1.69×/2.27×，VBench 仅下降 0.4%。

Conclusion: OSP-Next 通过稀疏注意力、并行策略、量化和强化学习的系统级协同优化，在多种硬件平台上实现了视频生成效率与质量的良好平衡。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers achieve strong video generation quality, but the quadratic cost of full attention limits efficiency. We introduce OSP-Next, an efficient text-to-video generation model that integrates sparse attention, parallelism, quantization, and reinforcement learning. OSP-Next uses a hybrid full-sparse attention architecture, where the sparse component is implemented with Skiparse-2D Attention. This fixed-pattern mechanism applies token-wise and group-wise sparse attention along spatial dimensions, leveraging locality while maintaining native compatibility with FlashAttention kernels. Based on the local equivalence of rearrangement in Skiparse-2D Attention, we further propose Sparse Sequence Parallelism (SSP), which partitions subsequences across ranks and switches sparse patterns through a single All-to-All communication. Compared with Ulysses Sequence Parallelism (SP), SSP provides a native parallel strategy for sparse attention and reduces communication volume by 75%. OSP-Next also incorporates HiF8 quantization to enable stable joint training with 8-bit quantization and sparse fine-tuning, and applies Mix-GRPO post-training to improve the performance of the sparse model. Experiments show that OSP-Next achieves a VBench total score of 83.73%, surpassing the Wan2.1 baseline. Under the 5-second 720P and 5-second 768P settings, OSP-Next achieves up to 1.64$\times$ single-GPU speedup and over 1.52$\times$ eight-GPU speedup on NVIDIA H200 GPUs. In addition, with only a 0.4% drop in VBench total score, OSP-Next-HiF8 achieves 1.69$\times$ and 2.27$\times$ speedups under the two settings on a single Ascend 950PR, demonstrating the efficiency and performance of OSP-Next across hardware platforms.

</details>


### [106] [SeeGroup: Multi-Layer Depth Estimation of Transparent Surfaces via Self-Determined Grouping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28735)
*Hongyu Wen,Jia Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SeeGroup提出了一种无需预定义分层的多层深度估计方法，将每像素多层深度建模为点过程，通过置换不变性损失实现自适应分层，在LayeredDepth基准上将四元组相对深度精度从61.34%提升至70.09%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多层深度估计方法通常扩展单层预测，按3D点的前后顺序预定义分组策略，但分层几何结构允许多种有效的点分组方式，预定义分组具有内在局限性。

Method: 将每像素多层深度建模为点过程，将深度层视为沿相机光线的无序事件，设计置换不变的似然函数作为损失，让模型自适应地将表面分配到深度图中。

Result: 在LayeredDepth基准上，四元组相对深度精度从61.34%提升至70.09%，显著超越现有方法。

Conclusion: SeeGroup通过避免预定义分组、采用点过程建模多层深度，有效提升了透明物体场景中的多层深度估计性能。

Abstract: Transparent objects are common in daily life, and it is important to understand their multilayer depth, including the transparent surface and the objects behind it.
