At inference, we restrict extrinsic changes by reusing the original background and object mask, thereby ensuring that only the desired intrinsic attributes are altered; (ii) Visual Named Entities (VNEs) - fine-grained visual identity categories (e.g., ''Porsche 911 Carrera'') that group objects sharing identity-defining features while allowing variation in intrinsic attributes. We use a vision-language model to automatically extract VNE labels and intrinsic attribute descriptions from a large public image dataset, enabling scalable, identity-preserving supervision. Alterbute outperforms existing methods on identity-preserving object intrinsic attribute editing.

</details>


### [144] [Mahalanobis PatchCore: Covariance-Aware and Streaming-Compatible Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27748)
*Niccolò Ferrari,Oligert Osmani,Evelina Lamma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Mahalanobis PatchCore，一种协方差感知、流式兼容的工业视觉异常检测方法。通过白化变换实现马氏距离检索，并采用增量降维、在线协方差估计和流式聚合构建内存银行。在公开基准和三个工业数据集上，该方法在保持检测性能的同时将峰值内存从5.41GB降至2.78GB，工业平均AUC从0.981提升至0.986。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PatchCore使用欧氏距离检索忽略了特征相关性，且离线构建方式需要存储所有正常patch再子采样，内存开销大。为解决这些问题，作者引入协方差感知的马氏距离和流式兼容的训练流程。

Method: 1) 在降维特征空间中估计正则化协方差模型，通过白化变换使欧氏近邻搜索等价于马氏检索；2) 采用有界内存、可重复迭代的训练管道，包括增量主成分分析降维、在线协方差估计和流式聚合，避免存储所有正常patch。

Result: 在MVTec AD公开基准上保留大部分离线PatchCore的图像级性能；峰值内存从5.41GB降至2.78GB；在三个工业数据集上，平均AUC从0.981提升至0.986。

Conclusion: Mahalanobis PatchCore在工业异常检测中实现了精度与内存效率的更好权衡，协方差感知的流式方案适用于实际工业检测中的内存限制场景。

Abstract: Industrial visual anomaly detection is usually one-class: normal images are abundant, while defects are rare, heterogeneous, and often unavailable during system design. PatchCore-style retrieval suits this setting because it scores test images from a memory bank of normal patch features, but the standard Euclidean geometry ignores feature correlations and its offline construction materialises the full patch pool before subsampling.
  We introduce Mahalanobis PatchCore, a covariance-aware, streaming-compatible extension of PatchCore. Its artificial intelligence contribution is a retrieval detector that estimates a regularised covariance model in reduced feature space and whitens embeddings, so Euclidean nearest-neighbour search after transformation implements Mahalanobis retrieval. A bounded-memory, re-iterable training pipeline builds the memory bank without storing all normal patches at once, using incremental dimensionality reduction, online covariance estimation, and streaming aggregation.
  The engineering application is automated industrial inspection, where visual anomaly detection must remain accurate under practical memory limits. We evaluate the method on a public 15-category industrial anomaly-detection benchmark and three industrial datasets covering blow-fill-seal strip-ampoule meniscus inspection, amber-glass-ampoule bottom inspection, and lyophilised-cake vial inspection. Mahalanobis PatchCore preserves most offline PatchCore image-level performance on the public benchmark while reducing peak memory from 5.41 to 2.78 GB, and improves the selected industrial mean image area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.981 to 0.986.

</details>


### [145] [KG-ViP: Bridging Knowledge Grounding and Visual Perception in Multi-modal LLMs for Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11632)
*Zhiyang Li,Ao Ke,Yukun Cao,Xike Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出KG-ViP框架，通过融合场景图（捕获细粒度视觉细节）和常识图（提供丰富外部知识）来统一解决MLLMs在VQA任务中的知识幻觉和视觉感知不足问题，在FVQA 2.0+和MVQA基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs在VQA任务中同时面临知识幻觉和细粒度视觉感知不足的双重限制，而常识图和场景图分别针对这两类缺陷提供互补性解决方案，但现有工作孤立处理二者，忽略了其协同潜力。

Method: 提出KG-ViP统一框架，核心是一个新颖的检索-融合管道，利用查询作为语义桥逐步整合场景图和常识图，合成统一的结构化上下文以促进可靠的多模态推理。

Result: 在FVQA 2.0+和MVQA基准上的大量实验表明，KG-ViP显著优于现有VQA方法。

Conclusion: 融合场景图与常识图能够有效协同解决MLLMs在VQA中的知识幻觉和视觉感知不足问题，统一结构化上下文的引入提升了多模态推理的可靠性。

Abstract: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for Visual Question Answering (VQA) often suffer from dual limitations: knowledge hallucination and insufficient fine-grained visual perception. Crucially, we identify that commonsense graphs and scene graphs provide precisely complementary solutions to these respective deficiencies by providing rich external knowledge and capturing fine-grained visual details. However, prior works typically treat them in isolation, overlooking their synergistic potential. To bridge this gap, we propose KG-ViP, a unified framework that empowers MLLMs by fusing scene graphs and commonsense graphs. The core of the KG-ViP framework is a novel retrieval-and-fusion pipeline that utilizes the query as a semantic bridge to progressively integrate both graphs, synthesizing a unified structured context that facilitates reliable multi-modal reasoning. Extensive experiments on FVQA 2.0+ and MVQA benchmarks demonstrate that KG-ViP significantly outperforms existing VQA methods.

</details>


### [146] [PocketGS: On-Device Training of 3D Gaussian Splatting for High Perceptual Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.17354)
*Wenzhi Guo,Guangchi Fang,Shu Yang,Bing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PocketGS提出了一种在移动设备上实现3D高斯散点图训练的范式，通过三个协同设计的算子（几何先验构建、局部表面统计注入、以及带缓存中间结果的Alpha合成展开）解决了移动端训练效率、内存紧凑性和建模质量之间的根本矛盾，在有限的移动预算下实现了高质量重建和完整的端到端工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS训练需要工作站级的计算和内存资源，无法在移动设备上以分钟级时间预算和有限峰值内存完成训练，亟需一种能在移动端高效运行的3D场景建模范式。

Method: 提出三个协同设计的算子：G（几何保真的点云先验构建）、I（注入局部表面统计信息以初始化各向异性高斯，减少早期条件差距）、T（展开Alpha合成过程，通过缓存中间结果和索引映射梯度散射实现稳定的移动端反向传播）。

Result: 在移动端预算下，PocketGS的性能优于强大的工作站级3DGS基线，实现了高质量重建和完整的端到端移动端采集到渲染工作流。

Conclusion: PocketGS成功实现了移动设备上的实时3D场景建模，使基于3DGS的捕获到渲染工作流程完全在设备端成为可能。

Abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time rendering, its training demands workstation-level compute and memory, making mobile deployment impractical under minute-scale time budgets and limited peak memory. We present PocketGS, a mobile scene modeling paradigm that enables on-device 3DGS training under these tightly coupled constraints while preserving high-fidelity reconstruction. PocketGS resolves the fundamental tension between training efficiency, memory compactness, and modeling quality through three co-designed operators: $\mathcal{G}$ builds geometry-faithful point-cloud priors; $\mathcal{I}$ injects local surface statistics to seed anisotropic Gaussians, thereby reducing early conditioning gaps; and $\mathcal{T}$ unrolls alpha compositing with cached intermediates and index-mapped gradient scattering for stable mobile backpropagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PocketGS outperforms the powerful mainstream workstation 3DGS baseline under mobile budgets, delivering high-quality reconstructions and enabling a fully on-device, practical capture-to-rendering workflow.

</details>


### [147] [The Script is All You Need: An Agentic Framework for Long-Horizon Dialogue-to-Cinematic Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.17737)
*Chenyu Mu,Xin He,Qu Yang,Wanshun Chen,Jiadi Yao,Huang Liu,Zihao Yi,Bo Zhao,Xingyu Chen,Ruotian Ma,Fanghua Ye,Erkun Yang,Cheng Deng,Zhaopeng Tu,Xiaolong Li,Linus*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端智能体框架，用于将对话转化为连贯的电影级视频，通过ScripterAgent生成精细脚本、DirectorAgent跨场景连续生成策略以及CriticAgent评估，显著提升了脚本忠实度和时间一致性，并揭示了当前模型在视觉奇观与脚本遵循之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能根据文本提示生成惊艳的视觉内容，但难以从对话等高层概念生成连贯的长篇叙事，存在创意构思与电影执行之间的"语义鸿沟"。

Method: 提出端到端智能体框架：(1) ScripterAgent：将粗略对话转化为精细可执行的电影脚本，依赖新构建的大规模基准ScriptBench（经专家引导管线标注的多模态数据集）；(2) DirectorAgent：采用跨场景连续生成策略编排现有视频模型，保证长程连贯性；(3) CriticAgent + Visual-Script Alignment (VSA) 指标进行综合评估。

Result: 实验表明该框架在所有测试视频模型上均显著提升了脚本忠实度和时间一致性；同时发现当前最优模型在视觉奇观与严格脚本遵循之间存在关键权衡。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了对话到电影视频生成的语义鸿沟，为自动化电影制作提供了宝贵的见解和方向。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have produced models capable of synthesizing stunning visual content from simple text prompts. However, these models struggle to generate long-form, coherent narratives from high-level concepts like dialogue, revealing a ``semantic gap'' between a creative idea and its cinematic execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel, end-to-end agentic framework for dialogue-to-cinematic-video generation. Central to our framework is ScripterAgent, a model trained to translate coarse dialogue into a fine-grained, executable cinematic script. To enable this, we construct ScriptBench, a new large-scale benchmark with rich multimodal context, annotated via an expert-guided pipeline. The generated script then guides DirectorAgent, which orchestrates state-of-the-art video models using a cross-scene continuous generation strategy to ensure long-horizon coherence. Our comprehensive evaluation, featuring an AI-powered CriticAgent and a new Visual-Script Alignment (VSA) metric, shows our framework significantly improves script faithfulness and temporal fidelity across all tested video models. Furthermore, our analysis uncovers a crucial trade-off in current SOTA models between visual spectacle and strict script adherence, providing valuable insights for the future of automated filmmaking.

</details>


### [148] [Decoupling Skeleton and Flesh: Efficient Multimodal Table Reasoning with Disentangled Alignment and Structure-aware Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03491)
*Yingjie Zhu,Xuefeng Bai,Kehai Chen,Yang Xiang,Youcheng Pan,Xiaoqiang Zhou,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DiSCo框架，通过解耦结构-内容对齐方法高效适应LVLM进行表格推理，无需外部工具或大量标注；并在此基础上提出Table-GLS框架，通过全局到局部的结构引导推理提升表格理解与推理能力，在多个基准上取得良好泛化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM在表格图像推理中面临复杂布局和结构-内容耦合问题，现有方案依赖昂贵的监督训练、强化学习或外部工具，效率和可扩展性受限。核心问题是：如何以最少的标注且无需外部工具，使LVLM适应表格推理任务。

Method: 首先提出DiSCo（解耦结构-内容对齐框架），在多模态对齐阶段显式分离结构抽象与语义锚定，高效适配LVLM理解表格结构。在此基础上提出Table-GLS（全局到局部结构引导推理框架），通过结构化探索和基于证据的推理执行表格推理。

Result: 在多个不同基准上的大量实验表明，该框架有效提升了LVLM的表格理解与推理能力，尤其在未见过的表格结构上具有良好的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 本文提出的DiSCo和Table-GLS框架以高效、可扩展的方式解决了LVLM在表格图像推理中的挑战，无需外部工具和大规模标注即可实现良好的表格理解与泛化能力。

Abstract: Reasoning over table images remains challenging for Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) due to complex layouts and tightly coupled structure-content information. Existing solutions often depend on expensive supervised training, reinforcement learning, or external tools, limiting efficiency and scalability. This work addresses a key question: how to adapt LVLMs to table reasoning with minimal annotation and no external tools? Specifically, we first introduce DiSCo, a Disentangled Structure-Content alignment framework that explicitly separates structural abstraction from semantic grounding during multimodal alignment, efficiently adapting LVLMs to tables structures. Building on DiSCo, we further present Table-GLS, a Global-to-Local Structure-guided reasoning framework that performs table reasoning via structured exploration and evidence-grounded inference. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our framework efficiently enhances LVLM's table understanding and reasoning capabilities, particularly generalizing to unseen table structures. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/AAAndy-Zhu/TableVLM.

</details>


### [149] [ViCA: Efficient Multimodal LLMs with Vision-Only Cross-Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07574)
*Wenjie Liu,Hao Wu,Xin Qiu,Xudong Wang,Yingqi Fan,Yihan Zhang,Anhao Zhao,Yunpu Ma,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViCA提出了一种极简MLLM架构，通过让视觉token绕过所有自注意力和前馈层，仅在选定层通过稀疏交叉注意力与文本交互，将视觉侧计算量降至4%，同时保持98%的基线精度，实现单批推理3.5倍以上、多批推理10倍以上的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM采用统一的自注意力设计，在每个Transformer层都处理视觉和文本token，导致大量计算开销。作者质疑这种密集视觉处理的必要性，发现投影后的视觉嵌入已与语言空间良好对齐，而有效的视觉-语言交互只发生在少数层中。

Method: 提出ViCA (Vision-only Cross-Attention)架构：视觉token完全绕过所有自注意力和FFN层，仅在选定的少数层通过稀疏交叉注意力与文本交互；视觉部分仅需计算投影和交叉注意力，大幅减少计算量。

Result: 在三个MLLM骨干网络、九个多模态基准和26个剪枝基线中：保持98%基线精度，视觉侧计算降至4%；单批推理3.5倍以上加速，多批推理10倍以上加速；与token剪枝方法正交，可进一步结合提升效率。

Conclusion: ViCA证明了大多数Transformer层的密集视觉处理是不必要的，通过极简的交叉注意力设计即可实现高效的视觉-语言交互，是一个硬件友好的、可扩展的轻量级MLLM架构。

Abstract: Modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) adopt a unified self-attention design that processes visual and textual tokens at every Transformer layer, incurring substantial computational overhead. In this work, we revisit the necessity of such dense visual processing and show that projected visual embeddings are already well-aligned with the language space, while effective vision-language interaction occurs in only a small subset of layers. Based on these insights, we propose ViCA (Vision-only Cross-Attention), a minimal MLLM architecture in which visual tokens bypass all self-attention and feed-forward layers, interacting with text solely through sparse cross-attention at selected layers. Extensive evaluations across three MLLM backbones, nine multimodal benchmarks, and 26 pruning-based baselines show that ViCA preserves 98% of baseline accuracy while reducing visual-side computation to 4%, consistently achieving superior performance-efficiency trade-offs. Moreover, ViCA provides a regular, hardware-friendly inference pipeline that yields over 3.5x speedup in single-batch inference and over 10x speedup in multi-batch inference, reducing visual grounding to near-zero overhead compared with text-only LLMs. It is also orthogonal to token pruning methods and can be seamlessly combined for further efficiency gains. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ViCA.

</details>


### [150] [LUVE : Latent-Cascaded Ultra-High-Resolution Video Generation with Dual Frequency Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11564)
*Chen Zhao,Jiawei Chen,Hongyu Li,Zhuoliang Kang,Shilin Lu,Xiaoming Wei,Kai Zhang,Jian Yang,Ying Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LUVE，一种基于双频专家的潜级联超高清视频生成框架，通过三阶段架构（低分辨率运动生成、潜空间上采样、高低频专家联合精炼）解决超高清视频生成中的运动建模、语义规划和细节合成难题，实验证明了其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型虽然提升了视觉质量，但超高清视频生成仍面临运动建模、语义规划和细节合成三方面叠加的严峻挑战。

Method: 提出LUVE框架，包含三阶段：1) 低分辨率运动生成，用于运动一致的潜变量合成；2) 视频潜空间上采样，直接在潜空间进行分辨率提升以降低内存和计算开销；3) 高分辨率内容精炼，集成低频和高频专家分别增强语义连贯性与细粒度细节生成。

Result: 在超高清视频生成任务中取得了优越的照片真实感和内容保真度，消融实验验证了各组件的有效性。

Conclusion: LUVE框架有效解决了超高清视频生成中的关键挑战，为高质量视频生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion models have significantly improved visual quality, yet ultra-high-resolution (UHR) video generation remains a formidable challenge due to the compounded difficulties of motion modeling, semantic planning, and detail synthesis. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{LUVE}, a \textbf{L}atent-cascaded \textbf{U}HR \textbf{V}ideo generation framework built upon dual frequency \textbf{E}xperts. LUVE employs a three-stage architecture comprising low-resolution motion generation for motion-consistent latent synthesis, video latent upsampling that performs resolution upsampling directly in the latent space to mitigate memory and computational overhead, and high-resolution content refinement that integrates low-frequency and high-frequency experts to jointly enhance semantic coherence and fine-grained detail generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our LUVE achieves superior photorealism and content fidelity in UHR video generation, and comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component. The project is available at \href{https://unicornanrocinu.github.io/LUVE_web/}{https://github.io/LUVE/}.

</details>


### [151] [MMRad-22K: A Structured Multimodal Evidence Dataset for Chest X-ray Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12843)
*Yichen Zhao,Zelin Peng,Fenghe Tang,Piao Yang,Yu Huang,Wei Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了MMRad-22K数据集，将区域文本观察、解剖定位坐标、局部图像证据和报告目标组织为结构化多模态证据单元，用于胸部X光报告生成。实验表明，基于多模态证据的LVLM适配方法在语言和临床指标上优于纯文本或边界框证据方法，且性能可媲美多个开源LVLM模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胸部X光报告生成资源提供的监督信号是碎片化的，缺乏与放射科医生区域化临床工作流对齐的结构化多模态证据格式。

Method: 构建MMRad-22K数据集，将区域文本观察、解剖定位坐标、局部图像证据和报告目标组织为结构化多模态证据单元；基于统一LVLM主干进行适配训练。

Result: 多模态证据适配在语言指标和临床指标上均优于纯文本证据适配和端到端适配；在相同评估协议下性能与多个开源LVLM参考模型相当。

Conclusion: MMRad-22K可作为与临床阅片工作流对齐的结构化多模态资源，用于训练和评估胸部X光报告生成任务。

Abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) reporting follows a region-based clinical workflow in which radiologists inspect anatomical regions and integrate localized findings into a final report. However, existing resources for CXR report generation provide these supervision signals in fragmented forms. We introduce MMRad-22K, a dataset that organizes regional textual observations, anatomical grounding coordinates, localized image evidence, and report targets into structured multimodal evidence units for CXR report generation. To motivate this formulation, we first compare different evidence formats for report generation and find that structured multimodal evidence is generally more useful than text-only or bounding box-based evidence. We then adapt a unified LVLM backbone using MMRad-22K and show that adaptation with multimodal evidence outperforms both textual-evidence adaptation and end-to-end adaptation on language and clinically oriented metrics. Under the same evaluation protocol, the adapted model also reaches a performance level comparable to several open-source LVLM references. Together, these results support MMRad-22K as a practical structured multimodal resource for training and evaluating CXR report generation aligned with clinical reading workflows.

</details>


### [152] [DODO: Discrete OCR Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16872)
*Sean Man,Gilad Deutch,Roy Ganz,Roi Ronen,Shahar Tsiper,Shai Mazor,Niv Nayman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DODO，首个利用块离散扩散模型的VLM，在OCR任务中实现接近最先进水平的精度，同时推理速度相比自回归基线提升高达5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在OCR任务中依赖自回归解码，处理长文档时计算成本高、速度慢；而OCR作为确定性任务本可支持并行解码，但现有掩码扩散模型存在结构不稳定性，无法满足OCR严格精确匹配的要求。

Method: 提出DODO，首个利用块离散扩散（block discrete diffusion）的VLM，通过将生成过程分解为多个块来缓解全局扩散中的同步误差，实现高效并行解码。

Result: 在OCR任务上达到接近最先进的精度，同时推理速度相比自回归基线提升高达5倍。

Conclusion: 块离散扩散模型能够有效克服自回归解码在OCR任务中的速度瓶颈，在保持高精度的同时实现显著加速。

Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is a fundamental task for digitizing information, serving as a critical bridge between visual data and textual understanding. While modern Vision-Language Models (VLM) have achieved high accuracy in this domain, they predominantly rely on autoregressive decoding, which becomes computationally expensive and slow for long documents as it requires a sequential forward pass for every generated token. We identify a key opportunity to overcome this bottleneck: unlike open-ended generation, OCR is a highly deterministic task where the visual input strictly dictates a unique output sequence, theoretically enabling efficient, parallel decoding via diffusion models. However, we show that existing masked diffusion models fail to harness this potential; those introduce structural instabilities that are benign in flexible tasks, like captioning, but catastrophic for the rigid, exact-match requirements of OCR. To bridge this gap, we introduce DODO, the first VLM to utilize block discrete diffusion and unlock its speedup potential for OCR. By decomposing generation into blocks, DODO mitigates the synchronization errors of global diffusion. Empirically, our method achieves near state-of-the-art accuracy while enabling up to 5x faster inference compared to autoregressive baselines.

</details>


### [153] [LESA: Learnable Stage-Aware Predictors for Diffusion Model Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20497)
*Peiliang Cai,Jiacheng Liu,Haowen Xu,Xinyu Wang,Chang Zou,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LESA（可学习阶段感知预测器）框架，基于两阶段训练和KAN网络，通过多阶段多专家架构为扩散变换器（DiTs）提供特征缓存加速。该方法在FLUX.1-dev上实现5.00倍加速（质量仅下降1.0%），在Qwen-Image上实现6.25倍加速（质量提升20.2%），在HunyuanVideo上实现5.00倍加速（PSNR提升24.7%），在文生图和文生视频任务上均达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散变换器（DiTs）计算开销巨大，现有特征缓存方法（如简单复用或无训练预测）难以适应扩散过程中复杂的、阶段依赖的动态变化，导致质量下降且无法与标准去噪过程保持一致性。

Method: 提出基于两阶段训练的可学习阶段感知（LESA）预测器框架：1）利用KAN网络精确学习时间维度的特征映射；2）设计多阶段多专家架构，为不同噪声级别的阶段分配专门的预测器，实现更精准鲁棒的特征预测。

Result: FLUX.1-dev上5.00倍加速（质量下降1.0%），Qwen-Image上6.25倍加速（质量较SOTA提升20.2%），HunyuanVideo上5.00倍加速（PSNR较TaylorSeer提升24.7%）。

Conclusion: 基于训练的LESA框架在文生图和文生视频任务上均达到SOTA性能，验证了其有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image and video generation tasks. However, the high computational demands of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) pose a significant challenge to their practical deployment. While feature caching is a promising acceleration strategy, existing methods based on simple reusing or training-free forecasting struggle to adapt to the complex, stage-dependent dynamics of the diffusion process, often resulting in quality degradation and failing to maintain consistency with the standard denoising process. To address this, we propose a LEarnable Stage-Aware (LESA) predictor framework based on two-stage training. Our approach leverages a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) to accurately learn temporal feature mappings from data. We further introduce a multi-stage, multi-expert architecture that assigns specialized predictors to different noise-level stages, enabling more precise and robust feature forecasting. Extensive experiments show our method achieves significant acceleration while maintaining high-fidelity generation. Experiments demonstrate 5.00x acceleration on FLUX.1-dev with minimal quality degradation (1.0% drop), 6.25x speedup on Qwen-Image with a 20.2% quality improvement over the previous SOTA (TaylorSeer), and 5.00x acceleration on HunyuanVideo with a 24.7% PSNR improvement over TaylorSeer. State-of-the-art performance on both text-to-image and text-to-video synthesis validates the effectiveness and generalization capability of our training-based framework across different models. Our code is available at https://github.com/caipeiliang2004/LESA.

</details>


### [154] [WeatherCity: Urban Scene Reconstruction with Controllable Multi-Weather Transformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22096)
*Wenhua Wu,Huai Guan,Zhe Liu,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WeatherCity是一个用于4D城市场景重建和天气编辑的框架，通过文本引导的图像编辑、天气高斯表示、内容一致性优化和物理驱动模型，实现了多种天气条件下的高保真、时间一致的4D场景重建与灵活可控的天气编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D场景重建方法仅能复现观测场景，缺乏多样天气模拟能力；而图像级天气编辑方法易引入伪影且可控性差。为解决这些局限，提出WeatherCity框架。

Method: 1) 利用文本引导的图像编辑模型实现灵活的图像天气背景编辑；2) 提出基于共享场景特征和专用天气解码器的天气高斯表示；3) 引入内容一致性优化确保不同天气条件下的连贯建模；4) 设计物理驱动模型通过粒子和运动模式模拟动态天气效果。

Result: 在多个数据集和多种场景上的实验表明，WeatherCity在4D重建和天气编辑中实现了灵活可控性、高保真度和时间一致性，支持细粒度天气控制（如小雨、大雪）及场景内物体级操作。

Conclusion: WeatherCity有效解决了4D场景天气编辑的难题，为自动驾驶中的端到端训练和闭环仿真提供了可编辑的高保真4D场景支持。

Abstract: Editable high-fidelity 4D scenes are crucial for autonomous driving, as they can be applied to end-to-end training and closed-loop simulation. However, existing reconstruction methods are primarily limited to replicating observed scenes and lack the capability for diverse weather simulation. While image-level weather editing methods tend to introduce scene artifacts and offer poor controllability over the weather effects. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{WeatherCity}, a novel framework for 4D urban scene reconstruction and weather editing. Specifically, we leverage a text-guided image editing model to achieve flexible editing of image weather backgrounds. To tackle the challenge of multi-weather modeling, we introduce a novel weather Gaussian representation based on shared scene features and dedicated weather-specific decoders. This representation is further enhanced with a content consistency optimization, ensuring coherent modeling across different weather conditions. Additionally, we design a physics-driven model that simulates dynamic weather effects through particles and motion patterns. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets and various scenes demonstrate that WeatherCity achieves flexible controllability, high fidelity, and temporal consistency in 4D reconstruction and weather editing. Our framework not only enables fine-grained control over weather conditions (e.g., light rain and heavy snow) but also supports object-level manipulation within the scene. Codes are released at https://github.com/IRMVLab/WeatherCity.

</details>


### [155] [RelaxFlow: Text-Driven Amodal 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05425)
*Jiayin Zhu,Guoji Fu,Xiaolu Liu,Qiyuan He,Yicong Li,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RelaxFlow是一个无需训练的双分支框架，通过多先验共识模块和松弛机制解耦控制粒度，实现文本驱动的非模态3D生成——在严格保留输入观测的同时，利用文本提示引导未观测区域的几何结构生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像到3D生成在遮挡条件下存在语义歧义，仅凭部分观测难以确定物体类别。需要一种方法既能保留输入观测的刚性控制，又能通过文本提示灵活引导被遮挡区域的生成。

Method: 提出RelaxFlow，一个无需训练的双分支框架，包含多先验共识模块和松弛机制。松弛机制在理论上等价于对生成向量场施加低通滤波器，抑制高频实例细节以提取与观测兼容的几何结构。

Result: 在提出的ExtremeOcc-3D和AmbiSem-3D两个诊断基准上，RelaxFlow成功引导未观测区域的生成与文本提示意图匹配，同时不损害视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 文本驱动的非模态3D生成需要解耦观测和提示的不同控制粒度，RelaxFlow通过松弛机制实现这一目标，为图像到3D生成中的语义歧义问题提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Image-to-3D generation faces inherent semantic ambiguity under occlusion, where partial observation alone is often insufficient to determine object category. In this work, we formalize text-driven amodal 3D generation, where text prompts steer the completion of unseen regions while strictly preserving input observation. Crucially, we identify that these objectives demand distinct control granularities: rigid control for the observation versus relaxed structural control for the prompt. To this end, we propose RelaxFlow, a training-free dual-branch framework that decouples control granularity via a Multi-Prior Consensus Module and a Relaxation Mechanism. Theoretically, we prove that our relaxation is equivalent to applying a low-pass filter on the generative vector field, which suppresses high-frequency instance details to isolate geometric structure that accommodates the observation. To facilitate evaluation, we introduce two diagnostic benchmarks, ExtremeOcc-3D and AmbiSem-3D. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RelaxFlow successfully steers the generation of unseen regions to match the prompt intent without compromising visual fidelity.

</details>


### [156] [Event-based Motion & Appearance Fusion for 6D Object Pose Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08264)
*Zhichao Li,Chiara Bartolozzi,Lorenzo Natale,Arren Glover*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于事件相机的无学习6D物体位姿跟踪方法，通过事件光流估计速度进行位姿传播，并结合模板匹配进行位姿校正，在快速运动场景下达到或超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RGB-D相机在高速动态场景中存在运动模糊和帧率限制，而事件相机具有高时间分辨率和低延迟特性，但现有基于事件相机的6D位姿跟踪工作很少，因此探索利用事件相机进行高速位姿跟踪。

Method: 采用无学习方法：1）从事件数据中计算光流并估计6D物体速度，用于位姿传播；2）使用基于模板的局部位姿校正模块进行修正，将传播和校正步骤融合。

Result: 该方法在不使用深度学习的情况下，与最先进算法性能相当，在某些快速运动物体场景中甚至超越它们。

Conclusion: 事件相机在高速动态场景中具有潜力，尤其适用于深度网络因更新率低而受限的场合。

Abstract: Object pose tracking is a fundamental and essential task for robotics to perform tasks in the home and industrial settings. The most commonly used sensors to do so are RGB-D cameras, which can hit limitations in highly dynamic environments due to motion blur and frame-rate constraints. Event cameras have remarkable features such as high temporal resolution and low latency, which make them a potentially ideal vision sensors for object pose tracking at high speed. Even so, there are still only few works on 6D pose tracking with event cameras. In this work, we take advantage of the high temporal resolution and propose a method that uses both a propagation step fused with a pose correction strategy. Specifically, we use 6D object velocity obtained from event-based optical flow for pose propagation, after which, a template-based local pose correction module is utilized for pose correction. Our learning-free method has comparable performance to the state-of-the-art algorithms, and in some cases out performs them for fast-moving objects. The results indicate the potential for using event cameras in highly-dynamic scenarios where the use of deep network approaches are limited by low update rates.

</details>


### [157] [COTTA: Context-Aware Transfer Adaptation for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00402)
*Seohyoung Park,Jaeyeol Lim,Seoyoung Ju,Kyeonghun Kim,Nam-Joon Kim,Hyuk-Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究探究了基于美国数据训练的轨迹预测模型QCNet在韩国道路环境下的迁移适应性。通过对比零样本迁移、从头训练、全微调及编码器冻结四种策略，发现冻结编码器并微调解码器可在准确性与训练效率间取得最优平衡，相比于从头训练将预测误差降低66%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶轨迹预测数据集（如Waymo、Argoverse）多采集于西方道路环境，缺乏对韩国等地区独特交通模式、基础设施和驾驶行为的表征。这种领域差异导致西方数据训练的先进模型在部署到不同地理环境时性能显著下降，亟需研究有效的迁移学习策略。

Method: 以Query-Centric Trajectory Prediction (QCNet)为基准模型，利用韩国自动驾驶数据集，对比四种训练策略：零样本迁移（直接推理）、从头训练（随机初始化）、全微调（全部参数更新）、编码器冻结（仅微调解码器）。

Result: 冻结编码器并微调解码器策略表现最优，相比从头训练将预测误差降低超过66%，在准确性与训练效率之间取得最佳权衡。

Conclusion: 利用预训练知识能显著提升轨迹预测模型在新地理域的性能，选择性微调策略（冻结编码器、微调解码器）是跨域部署的有效实践方案，为轨迹预测模型的地理迁移提供了实用指导。

Abstract: Developing robust models to accurately predict the trajectories of surrounding agents is fundamental to autonomous driving safety. However, most public datasets, such as the Waymo Open Motion Dataset and Argoverse, are collected in Western road environments and do not reflect the unique traffic patterns, infrastructure, and driving behaviors of other regions, including South Korea. This domain discrepancy leads to performance degradation when state-of-the-art models trained on Western data are deployed in different geographic contexts. In this work, we investigate the adaptability of Query-Centric Trajectory Prediction (QCNet) when transferred from U.S.-based data to Korean road environments. Using a Korean autonomous driving dataset, we compare four training strategies: zero-shot transfer, training from scratch, full fine-tuning, and encoder freezing. Experimental results demonstrate that leveraging pretrained knowledge significantly improves prediction performance. Specifically, selectively fine-tuning the decoder while freezing the encoder yields the best trade-off between accuracy and training efficiency, reducing prediction error by over 66% compared to training from scratch. This study provides practical insights into effective transfer learning strategies for deploying trajectory prediction models in new geographic domains.

</details>


### [158] [Benchmarking and Mechanistic Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Cross-Depiction Assembly Instruction Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00913)
*Zhuchenyang Liu,Yao Zhang,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了IKEA-Bench基准测试（含1,623个问题、6种任务类型、29个IKEA产品），评估了19个VLM（2B-38B）在装配图与视频帧之间的跨媒介对齐能力，发现：指令理解可通过文本恢复但会损害图文对齐、架构族类比参数量更影响对齐性能、视频理解仍是瓶颈。通过三级机制分析揭示图表与视频占据不相交的ViT子空间，文本会促使模型从视觉驱动转向文本驱动推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D装配图抽象难懂，需要智能助手在混合现实中监控进度、检测错误并提供逐步指导。然而VLM在将装配图与视频帧对齐时面临显著的"描绘鸿沟"（depiction gap），因为两者共享的视觉特征极少。现有研究缺乏对此问题的系统性评估。

Method: 构建IKEA-Bench基准（29个IKEA产品、1,623个问题、6种任务类型），评估19个VLM（2B-38B）在三种对齐策略下的表现，并进行三级机制分析（ViT子空间分析、注意力模式分析、文本影响分析）。

Result: (1)装配指令理解可通过文本恢复，但文本同时损害图表到视频的对齐；(2)架构族类比参数量更能预测对齐准确率；(3)视频理解仍是难以通过策略改善的瓶颈。机制分析表明图表和视频占据不相交的ViT子空间，添加文本使模型从视觉驱动转向文本驱动推理。

Conclusion: 视觉编码是提升跨描绘鲁棒性的主要改进目标，即需要解决VLM对图表与视频视觉特征编码的不兼容问题。

Abstract: 2D assembly diagrams are often abstract and hard to follow, creating a need for intelligent assistants that can monitor progress, detect errors, and provide step-by-step guidance. In mixed reality settings, such systems must recognize completed and ongoing steps from the camera feed and align them with the diagram instructions. Vision Language Models (VLMs) show promise for this task, but face a depiction gap because assembly diagrams and video frames share few visual features. To systematically assess this gap, we construct IKEA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,623 questions across 6 task types on 29 IKEA furniture products, and evaluate 19 VLMs (2B-38B) under three alignment strategies. Our key findings: (1) assembly instruction understanding is recoverable via text, but text simultaneously degrades diagram-to-video alignment; (2) architecture family predicts alignment accuracy more strongly than parameter count; (3) video understanding remains a hard bottleneck unaffected by strategy. A three-level mechanistic analysis further reveals that diagrams and video occupy disjoint ViT subspaces, and that adding text shifts models from visual to text-driven reasoning. These results identify visual encoding as the primary target for improving cross-depiction robustness. Project page: https://ryenhails.github.io/IKEA-Bench/

</details>


### [159] [Next-Scale Autoregressive Models for Text-to-Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03799)
*Zhiwei Zheng,Shibo Jin,Lingjie Liu,Mingmin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoScale提出了一种next-scale自回归框架，从粗到细的时间分辨率分层生成人体运动，在文本到运动生成任务上达到SOTA，并具备高训练效率和零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自回归模型的next-token预测方式与文本条件运动生成所需的时间结构不一致，难以捕捉长程运动的时间层级关系。

Method: 提出MoScale框架，采用next-scale AR范式，从粗粒度到细粒度分层生成运动；引入跨尺度分层细化改进各尺度初始预测，以及尺度内时间细化实现选择性双向重预测。

Result: 在文本到运动生成任务上达到SOTA性能，训练效率高，模型规模可扩展，并零样本泛化到多种运动生成和编辑任务。

Conclusion: MoScale通过层级化的next-scale自回归机制有效解决了运动生成中的时间结构对齐问题，兼具性能与效率优势。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models offer stable and efficient training, but standard next-token prediction is not well aligned with the temporal structure required for text-conditioned motion generation. We introduce MoScale, a next-scale AR framework that generates motion hierarchically from coarse to fine temporal resolutions. By providing global semantics at the coarsest scale and refining them progressively, MoScale establishes a causal hierarchy better suited for long-range motion structure. To improve robustness under limited text-motion data, we further incorporate cross-scale hierarchical refinement for improving per-scale initial predictions and in-scale temporal refinement for selective bidirectional re-prediction. MoScale achieves SOTA text-to-motion performance with high training efficiency, scales effectively with model size, and generalizes zero-shot to diverse motion generation and editing tasks.

</details>


### [160] [EpiAgent: An Agent-Centric System for Ancient Inscription Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09367)
*Shipeng Zhu,Ang Chen,Na Nie,Pengfei Fang,Min-Ling Zhang,Hui Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EpiAgent，一种基于智能体协作的铭文修复系统，通过模仿人类金石学家的技能协调工作流程，将铭文修复建模为分层规划问题，采用观察-构思-执行-重新评估范式，由LLM驱动的中央规划器协调多模态分析、历史经验、专业修复工具和迭代自我优化，在真实退化铭文上实现了优于现有方法的修复质量和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古代铭文作为文化记忆的载体，长期遭受环境和人为退化，恢复其视觉与文本完整性是数字遗产保护中最具挑战性的任务之一。现有基于AI的方法依赖刚性流水线，难以泛化应对复杂多样的真实退化场景。

Method: 受人类金石学家技能协调工作流程启发，将铭文修复建模为分层规划问题。采用观察-构思-执行-重新评估（OCER）范式，以LLM驱动的中央规划器为核心，协调多模态分析、历史经验、专业修复工具及迭代自我优化，实现灵活自适应的修复流程。

Result: 在真实退化铭文上，EpiAgent实现了优于现有方法的修复质量和更强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该工作标志着向专家级智能体驱动的文化遗产修复迈出了重要一步，代码已开源。

Abstract: Ancient inscriptions, as repositories of cultural memory, have suffered from centuries of environmental and human-induced degradation. Restoring their intertwined visual and textual integrity poses one of the most demanding challenges in digital heritage preservation. However, existing AI-based approaches often rely on rigid pipelines, struggling to generalize across such complex and heterogeneous real-world degradations. Inspired by the skill-coordinated workflow of human epigraphers, we propose EpiAgent, an agent-centric system that formulates inscription restoration as a hierarchical planning problem. Following an Observe-Conceive-Execute-Reevaluate paradigm, an LLM-based central planner orchestrates collaboration among multimodal analysis, historical experience, specialized restoration tools, and iterative self-refinement. This agent-centric coordination enables a flexible and adaptive restoration process beyond conventional single-pass methods. Across real-world degraded inscriptions, EpiAgent achieves superior restoration quality and stronger generalization compared to existing methods. Our work marks an important step toward expert-level agent-driven restoration of cultural heritage. The code is available at https://github.com/blackprotoss/EpiAgent.

</details>


### [161] [PrecisionCUA: Iterative Visual Refinement for Pixel-Precise Cursor Grounding in Code Editors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13019)
*Himangi Mittal,Gaurav Mittal,Nelson Daniel Troncoso,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了编程环境中像素级光标定位问题，提出了一种基于迭代视觉反馈的闭环定位机制，替代传统的单次坐标预测方法。实验表明，在Claude、Qwen和GPT等模型上，多轮迭代精炼相比单次预测显著提升了点击精度和任务成功率。代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的计算机使用代理(Computer Use Agents, CUAs)在密集编码界面（如VS Code、Cursor）中的GUI grounding能力不足，传统单次坐标预测方法缺乏纠错机制，在高密度IDE元素交互中容易失败。子像素级精度的编辑层面定位问题尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 提出一种迭代精炼（iterative refinement）的闭环定位机制：代理不再执行单步预测，而是通过多次尝试，利用每次尝试后的视觉反馈（visual feedback）逐步自我修正位移误差，直到准确定位到目标元素，从而适应动态UI变化。

Result: 在Claude、Qwen和GPT上评估，多轮迭代精炼方法在点击精度和任务成功率上均显著优于最先进的单次预测模型。

Conclusion: 迭代视觉推理（iterative visual reasoning）是构建下一代可靠软件工程代理的关键组成部分。闭环grounding机制通过自我纠错有效提升了密集编码环境下的交互可靠性。

Abstract: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) fundamentally rely on graphical user interface (GUI) grounding to translate language instructions into executable screen actions, but editing-level grounding in dense coding interfaces (such as VS Code and Cursor), where sub-pixel accuracy is required to interact with dense IDE elements, remains underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on single-shot coordinate prediction, which lacks a mechanism for error correction and often fails in high-density interfaces. In this technical report, we conduct an empirical study of pixel-precise cursor localization in coding environments. Instead of a single-step execution, our agent engages in an iterative refinement process, utilizing visual feedback from previous attempts to reach the target element. This closed-loop grounding mechanism allows the agent to self-correct displacement errors and adapt to dynamic UI changes. We evaluate our approach across Claude, Qwen, and GPT on a suite of complex coding benchmarks, demonstrating that multi-turn refinement significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-shot models in both click precision and overall task success rate. Our results suggest that iterative visual reasoning is a critical component for the next generation of reliable software engineering agents. Code: https://github.com/microsoft/precision-cua-bench/tree/main.

</details>


### [162] [From Clinical Intent to Clinical Model: Autonomous Coding-Agents for Clinician-driven AI Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17110)
*Zihao Zhao,Frederik Hauke,Juliana De Castilhos,Mathis Bode,Jakob Nikolas Kather,Sven Nebelung,Daniel Truhn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种由编码智能体驱动的临床AI开发原型系统，允许临床医生用自然语言描述任务，系统自动将其转化为可执行的机器学习流水线，并通过与临床医生的迭代实验优化模型。在五项临床任务中，该系统生成的模型表现与医生需求一致且性能具有竞争力，尤其能显著减少模型对临床捷径（如气胸分类中的胸腔引流管）的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床医生与AI开发者之间的协作效率低下：反复沟通需求耗时且易产生理解偏差，双方专业知识难以完全对齐。现有开发模式需要临床医生通过AI团队间接传达需求，缺乏让领域专家直接驱动模型开发的有效途径。

Method: 构建一个编码智能体原型系统，临床医生用自然语言描述任务，系统自动生成代码流水线；通过迭代实验（模型训练-评估-反馈）与临床医生协作优化；系统内置医学与AI双重知识，可直接理解临床术语并转化为可执行代码。

Result: 在五项临床任务中，系统生成的模型均满足临床需求且性能有竞争力。在胸部X光片气胸分类任务中，模型对胸腔引流管（已知捷径特征）的依赖从60%降至31%（一个数据集）及从50%降至18%（另一个数据集）。

Conclusion: 编码智能体有望将临床AI开发从开发者驱动的模式转变为临床医生驱动的模式，使领域专家能够直接塑造模型，而无需通过专业AI团队中继需求。

Abstract: Developing AI models that are useful in clinical practice, requires efficient collaboration between clinicians and AI developers. This poses a practical challenge: clinicians must repeatedly communicate and refine their requirements with AI developers before those requirements can be translated into executable model development. This iterative process is time-consuming, and even after repeated discussion, misalignment may still exist because the two sides do not fully share each other's expertise. Coding agents may help close this gap. They can write and refine code on their own, and they carry working knowledge of both medicine and AI to understand commands formulated by both medical experts and developers. We present a prototype that lets clinicians drive AI development directly. A clinician describes the task in plain language, and the system turns the description into a working pipeline, refines it through repeated experiments together with the clinician, and returns a model that meets the stated clinical objective. Across five clinical tasks, the system reliably produces models that matched the clinician's request and reached competitive performance. Most notably, on chest radiographs the system sharply reduced the model's reliance on chest drains, a well-known shortcut for pneumothorax classification, from 60% to 31% on one dataset and from 50% to 18% on another. Our results suggest that coding agents can shift clinical AI development toward a more clinician-driven mode, allowing domain experts to shape models directly instead of relaying requirements through specialized AI teams.

</details>


### [163] [UDM-GRPO: Stable and Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization for Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18518)
*Jiaqi Wang,Haoge Deng,Ting Pan,Yang Liu,Chengyuan Wang,Fan Zhang,Yonggang Qi,Xinlong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对均匀离散扩散模型（UDM）与强化学习结合时训练不稳定、性能提升有限的问题，提出UDM-GRPO框架，通过将最终干净样本作为动作、利用前向过程重建轨迹，以及引入Reduced-Step和CFG-Free策略，在T2I任务上取得SOTA性能（GenEval 96%，PickScore 23.81），OCR准确率从8%提升至57%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀离散扩散模型（UDM）在离散生成建模中展现出潜力，但其与强化学习的结合尚属空白。直接将GRPO应用于UDM会导致训练不稳定且性能提升微弱，亟需设计专门的集成框架。

Method: 提出UDM-GRPO框架，包含两个核心洞察：(i) 将最终干净样本作为动作，提供更准确稳定的优化信号；(ii) 通过扩散前向过程重建轨迹，使概率路径与预训练分布更好对齐。还引入Reduced-Step（减少步数）和CFG-Free（无分类器引导）两种策略提升训练效率。

Result: 在多个T2I任务上显著提升基模型性能：GenEval准确率从69%提升至96%，PickScore从20.46提升至23.81，在连续和离散设置下均达SOTA；OCR基准准确率从8%提升至57%，验证了泛化能力。

Conclusion: UDM-GRPO是首个将UDM与RL成功集成的框架，通过动作定义和轨迹重建两大创新解决了训练不稳定的问题，在多项基准上取得了显著提升。

Abstract: Uniform Discrete Diffusion Model (UDM) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for discrete generative modeling; however, its integration with reinforcement learning remains largely unexplored. We observe that naively applying GRPO to UDM leads to training instability and marginal performance gains. To address this, we propose UDM-GRPO, the first framework to integrate UDM with RL. Our method is guided by two key insights: (i) treating the final clean sample as the action provides more accurate and stable optimization signals; and (ii) reconstructing trajectories via the diffusion forward process better aligns probability paths with the pretraining distribution. Additionally, we introduce two strategies, Reduced-Step and CFG-Free, to further improve training efficiency. UDM-GRPO significantly improves base model performance across multiple T2I tasks. Notably, GenEval accuracy improves from $69\%$ to $96\%$ and PickScore increases from $20.46$ to $23.81$, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both continuous and discrete settings. On the OCR benchmark, accuracy rises from $8\%$ to $57\%$, further validating the generalization ability of our method. Code is available at https://github.com/Yovecent/UDM-GRPO.

</details>


### [164] [Encoder-Free Human Motion Understanding via Structured Motion Descriptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21668)
*Yao Zhang,Zhuchenyang Liu,Thomas Ploetz,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结构化运动描述（SMD），一种基于规则的确定性方法，将关节位置序列转换为结构化自然语言描述，使LLM无需专用编码器即可直接进行运动推理，在运动问答和运动字幕任务上超越所有先前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的运动理解方法需要通过专用编码器学习运动-语言对齐，受限于跨模态表示和对齐的瓶颈，未能充分利用LLM预训练的世界知识和推理能力。

Method: 受生物力学分析启发，提出SMD方法，将关节位置序列通过规则确定性转换为关节角度、身体部位运动和全局轨迹的结构化自然语言描述，将运动表示为文本以利用LLM预训练知识。

Result: 在运动问答任务中，BABEL-QA达66.7%，HuMMan-QA达90.1%；在运动字幕任务中，HumanML3D上R@1为0.584，CIDEr为53.16，均超越所有先前方法。

Conclusion: SMD无需学习编码器或对齐模块即可实现最优性能，支持跨不同LLM的轻量级LoRA适配（8个LLM，6个模型家族），并提供可解释的注意力分析能力。

Abstract: The world knowledge and reasoning capabilities of text-based large language models (LLMs) are advancing rapidly, yet current approaches to human motion understanding, including motion question answering and captioning, have not fully exploited these capabilities. Existing LLM-based methods typically learn motion-language alignment through dedicated encoders that project motion features into the LLM's embedding space, remaining constrained by cross-modal representation and alignment. Inspired by biomechanical analysis, where joint angles and body-part kinematics have long served as a precise descriptive language for human movement, we propose \textbf{Structured Motion Description (SMD)}, a rule-based, deterministic approach that converts joint position sequences into structured natural language descriptions of joint angles, body part movements, and global trajectory. By representing motion as text, SMD enables LLMs to apply their pretrained knowledge of body parts, spatial directions, and movement semantics directly to motion reasoning, without requiring learned encoders or alignment modules. We show that this approach goes beyond state-of-the-art results on both motion question answering (66.7\% on BABEL-QA, 90.1\% on HuMMan-QA) and motion captioning (R@1 of 0.584, CIDEr of 53.16 on HumanML3D), surpassing all prior methods. SMD additionally offers practical benefits: the same text input works across different LLMs with only lightweight LoRA adaptation (validated on 8 LLMs from 6 model families), and its human-readable representation enables interpretable attention analysis over motion descriptions. Code, data, and pretrained LoRA adapters are available at https://yaozhang182.github.io/motion-smd/.

</details>


### [165] [Bridging the Pose-Semantic Gap: A Cascade Framework for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23282)
*Zequn Xie,Guijin Luo,Chuxin Wang,Sihang Cai,Tao Jin,Zhou Zhao,Yixuan Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结构-语义解耦级联框架(SSDC)，将文本行人异常搜索解耦为结构感知粗检索和侦探小队语义验证两个阶段，在PAB基准上达到最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有姿态感知方法存在姿态-语义鸿沟：语义不同的行为可能共享相似的骨骼几何结构。虽然多模态大语言模型能减少歧义，但用于大规模检索计算成本过高。

Method: 提出SSDC框架：第一阶段用轻量模型基于骨骼相似性快速筛选候选；第二阶段采用多智能体语义验证（Detective进行快速二分类过滤，Analyst提取证据，Writer进行语义合成），最后融合合成描述与结构先验进行重排序。

Result: 在PAB基准上达到最先进性能，在效率与语义推理之间取得平衡。

Conclusion: SSDC通过解耦结构感知与语义推理，有效解决了姿态-语义鸿沟问题，在不牺牲效率的前提下利用大语言模型的语义推理能力，为文本行人异常检索提供了一种高效且准确的方案。

Abstract: Text-based person anomaly search retrieves specific behavioral events from surveillance archives using natural-language queries. Although recent pose-aware methods align geometric structures well, they face a fundamental Pose-Semantic Gap: semantically different actions can share similar skeletal geometries. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can reduce this ambiguity, using them for large-scale retrieval is computationally prohibitive. We propose the Structure-Semantic Decoupled Cascade (SSDC) framework, which decouples retrieval into two stages: (1) Structure-Aware Coarse Retrieval, where a lightweight model quickly filters candidates by skeletal similarity ; and (2) Detective Squad Interaction, a multi-agent semantic verification module. The squad consists of a Detective for fast binary filtering, an Analyst for evidence extraction, and a Writer for semantic synthesis. Finally, we re-rank candidates by fusing the synthesized captions with structural priors. Experiments on the PAB benchmark show that SSDC achieves state-of-the-art performance by balancing efficiency and semantic reasoning.

</details>


### [166] [The Forensic Cost of Watermark Removal: From Dedicated Attacks to Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25491)
*Gautier Evennou,Ewa Kijak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有水印去除方法仅在攻击成功率和感知质量两个维度上评估，忽略了去除痕迹的 forensic 可检测性。本文提出水印去除检测（WRD）作为第三个评估轴，发现现有攻击方法均会在数据中留下可被检测的统计伪影，基于这些伪影训练的分类器在极低误报率下仍能高精度检测去除行为。实验表明，当前没有任何方法能在攻击成功率、感知质量和 forensic 隐蔽性三者间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水印去除方法仅在攻击成功率和感知质量两轴上评估，忽略了去除操作本身可能留下的 forensic 痕迹，导致评估维度不完整。

Method: 提出水印去除检测（WRD）作为第三评估轴，利用统计伪影训练现代分类器进行检测。

Result: 训练的分类器在 10^{-3} FPR 下对所有测试的去除方法均达到最先进的检测率，且现有攻击均未考虑 forensic 泄漏。

Conclusion: Forensic 隐蔽性应成为水印去除的必要条件，当前无方法能同时平衡攻击成功率、感知质量和 forensic 可检测性三轴。

Abstract: Current watermark removal methods are evaluated on two axes: attack success rate and perceptual quality. We show this is insufficient. While state-of-the-art attacks successfully degrade the watermark signal without visible distortion, they leave distinct statistical artifacts that betray the removal attempt. We name this overlooked axis Watermark Removal Detection (WRD) and demonstrate that a modern classifier trained on these artifacts achieves state-of-the-art detection rates at $10^{-3}$ FPR across every removal method tested. No existing attack accounts for this forensic leakage. We benchmark leading watermarking schemes against standard removal pipelines under the extended evaluation triple of attack success, perceptual quality, and forensic detectability, and find that no current method balances all three. Our results establish forensic stealthiness as a necessary requirement for watermark removal.

</details>


### [167] [DirectEdit: Step-Level Accurate Inversion for Flow-Based Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02417)
*Desong Yang,Mang Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DirectEdit，一种基于流Transformer的无训练图像编辑方法，通过直接对齐前向路径消除重建误差，无需额外NFE，并引入注意力特征注入与多分支掩码引导噪声混合机制平衡保真度与可编辑性，在多种场景下取得优于现有方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练免费图像编辑方法在逆过程中使用不匹配时间步的噪声潜变量近似重建路径，导致累积漂移，从根本上限制了重建保真度。本文旨在消除这一固有重建误差而不引入额外神经函数评估。

Method: 系统分析流Transformer中的逆过程，提出DirectEdit方法。核心思路是直接对齐前向路径而非修正逆路径，实现精确重建与可靠特征共享。引入基于注意力特征注入的保持机制和多分支掩码引导噪声混合，平衡保真度与可编辑性。

Result: 在多种场景下的广泛实验表明，DirectEdit实现了高效精准的图像编辑，性能优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: DirectEdit通过直接对齐前向路径消除了训练免费编辑方法中的固有重建误差，无需额外NFE即可实现高效、准确的图像编辑，为基于流Transformer的无训练图像编辑提供了新范式。

Abstract: With recent advancements in large-scale pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) models, training-free image editing methods have demonstrated remarkable success. Typically, these methods involve adding noise to a clean image via an inversion process, followed by separate denoising steps for the reconstruction and editing paths during the forward process. However, since the reconstruction path is approximated using noisy latents from mismatched timesteps, existing methods inevitably suffer from accumulated drift, which fundamentally limits reconstruction fidelity. To address this challenge, we systematically analyze the inversion process within the flow transformer and propose DirectEdit, a simple yet effective editing method that eliminates the inherent reconstruction error without introducing additional neural function evaluations (NFEs). Unlike most prior works that attempt to rectify the inversion path, DirectEdit focuses on directly aligning the forward paths, enabling precise reconstruction and reliable feature sharing. Furthermore, we introduce a preservation mechanism based on attention feature injection and multi-branch mask-guided noise blending, which effectively balances fidelity and editability. Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios demonstrate that DirectEdit achieves efficient and accurate image editing, delivering superior performance that outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code and examples are available at https://desongyang.github.io/Directedit.

</details>


### [168] [Polygon-mamba: Retinal vessel segmentation using polygon scanning mamba and space-frequency collaborative attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10581)
*Yuanyuan Peng,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合CNN-Mamba融合网络，结合多边形扫描Mamba（PS-VSS）和空间-频率协同注意力机制（SFCAM），用于视网膜小血管分割。PS-VSS通过多层反向扫描保持像素连通性，SFCAM在跳跃连接中融合空间与频率域特征。在DRIVE、STARE、CHASE_DB1三个公开数据集上取得了良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜小血管分割是眼科疾病诊断的关键任务，但由于小血管结构细微、拓扑完整性难以保持，传统方法（包括标准Mamba的水平-垂直扫描方式）会导致局部不连续和信息丢失，因此亟需设计能够更好保留小血管结构完整性的分割方法。

Method: 设计了一个混合CNN-Mamba融合网络：1) 提出多边形扫描视觉状态空间模型（PS-VSS），采用多层反向扫描方式替代传统水平-垂直扫描，以保持小血管的像素连通性；2) 在跳跃连接中引入空间-频率协同注意力机制（SFCAM），同时利用空间域的位置结构信息和频率域的全局感知与局部细节信息，动态增强关键特征并抑制杂波。

Result: 在DRIVE、STARE和CHASE_DB1三个数据集上，F1分数分别为0.8283、0.8282、0.8251；AUC值分别为0.9806、0.9840、0.9866；灵敏度（SE）分别为0.8268、0.8314、0.8484。

Conclusion: 通过视觉检查和定量分析验证了该模型在视网膜小血管分割任务上的有效性，所提出的PS-VSS和SFCAM模块能够有效提升小血管的分割精度。

Abstract: Retinal vessel segmentation is crucial for diagnosis and assessment of ocular diseases. Notably, segmentation of small retinal vessels has been consistently recognized as a challenging and complex task. To tackle this challenge, we design a hybrid CNN-Mamba fusion network that integrates polygon scanning mamba and space-frequency collaborative attention mechanism for the detection of small vessels. Considering that the traditional mamba architecture with horizontal-vertical scanning may compromise the topological integrity of target structures and result in local discontinuities in small retinal vessels, we present a polygon scanning visual state space model (PS-VSS) to identify small vessel structural features by multi-layer reverse scanning way. Which effectively preserves pixels connectivity, thereby substantially mitigating the loss of information pertaining to small vessels. Furthermore, as we all known that the spatial domain prioritizes positional and structural information, while the frequency domain emphasizes global perception and local detail components, a space-frequency collaborative attention mechanism (SFCAM) is introduced within the skip connection to extract efficient features from the spatial and frequency domains. This strategy empowers the model to dynamically enhance the key features while effectively suppressing clutters. To assess the efficacy of our model, it was tested on three publicly available datasets: DRIVE, STARE, and CHASE_DB1. Compared to manual annotations, our model demonstrated F1 scores of 0.8283, 0.8282, and 0.8251, Area Under Curve (AUC) values of 0.9806, 0.9840, and 0.9866, and Sensitivity (SE) values of of 0.8268, 0.8314, and 0.8484 across three datasets, respectively. The effectiveness of our model was validated through both visual inspection and quantitative analysis.

</details>


### [169] [FrequencyCT: Frequency Domain Self-supervised Low-dose CT Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10583)
*Guoquan Wei,Liu Shi,Chong Chen,Qiegen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FrequencyCT是首个在频域进行零样本自监督伪样本生成的低剂量CT去噪方法，通过区域低频锚定、相位保持噪声和高频掩膜扰动生成伪样本，并利用噪声方差与真实信号的指数相关性进行一致数据截断以稳定优化梯度，在多个数据集上验证了临床潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CT去噪研究很少利用投影域数据特性来缓解噪声相关性，缺乏在频域中有效利用噪声与信号分布差异的无监督去噪方法。

Method: 1) 区域低频锚定技术：利用噪声与真实信号在频域的分布差异；2) 对高频区域施加相位保持噪声和掩膜扰动生成伪样本用于自监督；3) 基于噪声投影方差与真实信号的指数相关性，对生成样本进行一致数据截断以稳定优化梯度。

Result: 在多个公开和真实数据集上的评估结果证实了该方法的临床应用潜力。

Conclusion: FrequencyCT为去噪领域提供了创新视角，是首个零样本自监督频域伪样本生成方法，具有临床转化前景。

Abstract: Despite extensive research on computed tomography (CT) denoising, few studies exploit projection-domain data characteristics to mitigate noise correlation. To bridge this gap, this work proposes FrequencyCT, the first zero-shot self-supervised method for pseudo-sample generation in the frequency domain for low-dose CT denoising. Specifically, by exploiting the distinct frequency-domain distributions of noise and true signal, a regional low-frequency anchoring technique is proposed. Applying phase-preserving noise and mask perturbations to the high-frequency region generates pseudo-samples for self-supervision. Driven by the exponential correlation between noise variance of noisy projections and the underlying true signal, consistent data truncation is applied to the generated samples to stabilize optimization gradients. Evaluation results on multiple public and real datasets confirm the clinical application potential of this research, which provides an innovative perspective for the field of denoising. The code is available at: https://github.com/yqx7150/FrequencyCT.

</details>


### [170] [Anatomy-Slot: Unsupervised Anatomical Factorization for Homologous Bilateral Reasoning in Retinal Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12929)
*Yingzhe Ma,Xiao Yang,Yuguo Yin,Zheyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Anatomy-Slot方法，通过无监督解剖瓶颈将双目光学图像中的斑块令牌分解为结构一致的解剖槽，并利用双向交叉注意力实现跨眼对齐。在ODIR-5K数据集上相比ViT-L基线AUC提升4.2点，并通过配对破坏实验、高斯噪声压力测试及REFUGE视盘定位分析验证了方法的鲁棒性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视网膜诊断本质上是双侧的：临床医生会比较双眼间的同源结构（如视盘不对称性），但现有深度模型大多基于单眼表示，忽略了这种结构对应关系。本文旨在探究显式的结构对应是否有助于诊断，并为此提出一个可操作的实现方案。

Method: 提出Anatomy-Slot方法：通过无监督方式将图像块令牌分解为一组涌现出的结构一致槽（对应解剖区域），再通过双向交叉注意力机制实现双眼间槽的对齐，从而构建显式的解剖瓶颈。

Result: 在ODIR-5K数据集上（n=10个随机种子），相比匹配的ViT-L基线，AUC提升4.2个百分点（95%置信区间；Wilcoxon符号秩检验，W=0，p=0.002）。通过配对破坏实验和高斯噪声压力测试验证了对应依赖性和鲁棒性。在REFUGE数据集上报告了定量视盘定位结果和交叉注意力定位分析。

Conclusion: 除了性能提升外，结果表明基于对象中心的解剖对应关系为构建与临床双侧比较对齐的可解释诊断系统提供了原则性路径。

Abstract: Retinal diagnosis is inherently bilateral: clinicians compare homologous structures across eyes (e.g., optic disc asymmetry), yet most deep models operate on monocular representations. We investigate whether explicit structural correspondence improves diagnosis, and propose Anatomy-Slot to operationalize this hypothesis. Anatomy-Slot introduces an unsupervised anatomical bottleneck by decomposing patch tokens into a set of emergent, structurally-coherent slots that correspond to anatomical regions, then aligning these slots across eyes via bidirectional cross-attention. On ODIR-5K with $n=10$ seeds, the method improves AUC by $4.2$ points over a matched ViT-L baseline (95% CIs; Wilcoxon signed-rank test, $W=0$, $p=0.002$). Pairing disruption and stress testing under Gaussian noise provide controlled tests of correspondence dependence and robustness under corruption. We further report quantitative optic disc grounding on REFUGE and cross-attention localization analysis. Beyond the reported gains, these results indicate that object-centric anatomical correspondence offers a principled path toward interpretable diagnostic systems aligned with clinical bilateral comparison.

</details>


### [171] [ArcVQ-VAE: A Spherical Vector Quantization Framework with ArcCosine Additive Margin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13517)
*Jaeyung Kim,YoungJoon Yoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ArcVQ-VAE，通过在传统VQ-VAE中引入球形角度边缘先验（SAMP），包括球界范数正则化和反余弦加性边缘损失，以提升离散表示的多样性和码本利用率，在图像重建与生成任务上取得竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统VQ-VAE使用有限码本向量对整张图像进行离散化，容量限制导致其难以捕获丰富多样的表示，码本利用率低。

Method: 提出球形角度边缘先验（SAMP），包含两个组件：(1) 球界范数正则化（Ball-Bounded Norm Regularization），将所有码本向量约束在随时间变化的欧几里得球内；(2) 反余弦加性边缘损失（ArcCosine Additive Margin Loss），鼓励潜在向量之间具有更大的角度可分性。

Result: 在标准图像重建与生成任务上，ArcVQ-VAE在重建精度、表示多样性和样本质量方面均达到了与基线模型竞争的性能。

Conclusion: 引入角度边缘先验能促进更具判别性和均匀分散的潜在表示，提升有效潜在空间覆盖率和码本利用率，为VQ-VAE类模型的表示能力提升提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE) has become a fundamental framework for learning discrete representations in image modeling. However, VQ-VAE models must tokenize entire images using a finite set of codebook vectors, and this capacity limitation restricts their ability to capture rich and diverse representations. In this paper, we propose ArcCosine Additive Margin VQ-VAE (ArcVQ-VAE), a novel vector quantization framework that introduces a spherical angular-margin prior (SAMP) for the codebook of a conventional VQ-VAE. The proposed SAMP consists of Ball-Bounded Norm Regularization, which constrains all codebook vectors within a time-dependent Euclidean ball, and ArcCosine Additive Margin Loss, which encourages greater angular separability among latent vectors. This formulation promotes more discriminative and uniformly dispersed latent representations within the constrained space, thereby improving effective latent-space coverage and leading to improved codebook utilization. Experimental results on standard image reconstruction and generation tasks show that ArcVQ-VAE achieves competitive performance against baseline models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, representation diversity, and sample quality. The code is available at: https://github.com/goals4292/ArcVQ-VAE

</details>


### [172] [Self-Prompting Diffusion Transformer for Open-Vocabulary Scene Text Editing via In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15523)
*Hongxi Li,Tong Wang,Chengjing Wu,Tianbao Liu,Jiangtao Yao,Xiaochao Qu,Xinxiao Wu,Luoqi Liu,Ting Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自提示场景文本编辑方法(MSTEdit)，通过直接从原图构建风格和字形提示，利用多模态扩散Transformer的两阶段训练策略，实现开放词汇、风格一致的文本编辑，在多种语言上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景文本编辑方法仅依赖图像背景信息，忽略目标区域的视觉细节（如原始文字的风格特征），退化为文本渲染问题；同时预训练字形编码器限制了可编辑文本的范围。

Method: 提出自提示方法，直接从原始图像构建风格和字形提示，无需额外编码器；采用两阶段训练策略：先在自监督大规模数据上训练扩散Transformer，再用小规模配对图像微调；利用多模态扩散Transformer(MM-DiT)的上下文学习能力。

Result: 在多种语言上，所提方法在文本准确性和风格一致性两方面均达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 通过自提示机制和两阶段训练，该方法成功解决了现有方法忽略文字风格特征和编辑范围受限的问题，实现了开放词汇、风格一致的场景文本编辑。

Abstract: Scene text editing aims to modify text in a target region of an image while preserving surrounding background style and texture. Existing methods rely solely on image background information while neglecting the visual details of target regions, which discards stylistic features in the original text and essentially degrades the task to text rendering. Moreover, the conditions imposed by pre-trained glyph encoder limit the scope of editable text. To address these issues, this paper proposes a self-prompting scene text editing method that constructs style and glyph prompts directly from the original image, without introducing additional style or glyph encoders. We employ a two-stage training strategy: the diffusion transformer is first trained on large-scale self-supervised data and then refined using a small set of paired images. By leveraging the in-context learning capability of the Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT), it achieves open-vocabulary and style-consistent text editing. Experimental results on various languages demonstrate that our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance in both text accuracy and style consistency. Our project page: hongxiii.github.io/mstedit.

</details>


### [173] [Are VLMs Seeing or Just Saying? Uncovering the Illusion of Visual Re-examination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15864)
*Chufan Shi,Cheng Yang,Yaokang Wu,Linghao Jin,Bo Shui,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Xuezhe Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VLMs在推理中产生的自我反思语句（如“让我再检查一下图片”）大多只是学习到的文本模式，而非真正的视觉重新检查。通过VisualSwap图像交换框架发现，模型在图像被替换后几乎无法察觉，准确率下降高达60%，且思维模型比指令模型脆弱3倍，扩展规模无法缓解。用户指令能恢复视觉基础，但自我反思语句不能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究VLMs在推理过程中产生的自我反思语句（如“让我再检查一下图片”）究竟是触发了真实的视觉重新检查，还是仅仅是模型学习到的文本模式。

Method: 提出VisualSwap图像交换探测框架：在模型对一张图像进行推理后，将其替换为视觉上相似但语义不同的图像，测试模型是否能察觉。构建了包含800对图像的VS-Bench基准，来自MathVista、MathVerse、MathVision和MMMU-Pro。在Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL和ERNIE-VL上进行实验，并进行注意力分析。

Result: 模型在图像交换后几乎无法察觉，准确率下降高达60%；思维模型的脆弱性是指令模型的近3倍；扩展模型规模无法缓解问题；多轮用户指令能恢复视觉基础，但模型自我生成的反思语句不能；注意力分析表明用户指令显著提升了对视觉标记的注意力，而自我反思则没有。

Conclusion: 当前VLMs在声称进行视觉重新检查时，往往是“说”而非真正地“看”——自我反思语句并未触发真实的视觉重新检查，只是学习到的文本模式。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often produce self-reflective statements like "let me check the figure again" during reasoning. Do such statements trigger genuine visual re-examination, or are they merely learned textual patterns? We investigate this via VisualSwap, an image-swap probing framework: after a model reasons over an image, we replace it with a visually similar but semantically different one and test whether the model notices. We introduce VS-Bench, 800 image pairs curated from MathVista, MathVerse, MathVision, and MMMU-Pro. Experiments on Qwen3-VL, Kimi-VL, and ERNIE-VL reveal a striking failure: models overwhelmingly miss the swap, with accuracy dropping by up to 60%. Counterintuitively, thinking models are nearly 3x more vulnerable than their instructed counterparts, and scaling offers no mitigation. Multi-turn user instructions restore visual grounding, but self-generated reflective statements during continuous generation do not. Attention analysis explains why: user instructions substantially elevate attention to visual tokens, whereas self-reflection does not. Current VLMs tend to say rather than actually see when claiming to perform visual re-examination. Our code and dataset are available at the project page: https://visualswap.github.io

</details>


### [174] [MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16716)
*Shuowei Li,Yuming Zhao,Parth Bhalerao,Oana Ignat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MAVEN框架，通过多智能体提示分解（人物、动作、地点）提升文生视频的文化保真度，并构建包含3种文化、243条提示和972个视频的评估基准，实验证明并行专业化的多智能体方法能显著改善文化相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生视频（T2V）模型在视觉保真度上进展迅速，但未能充分探索其忠实呈现多种文化的能力，尤其缺乏对单文化和跨文化场景中文化保真度的系统性研究。

Method: 提出MAVEN多智能体提示精炼框架，将提示分解为人物、动作、地点三个维度，由专门智能体以并行或串行方式处理；构建包含中国、美国、罗马尼亚三种文化、三类动作、243条文化提示及972个对应视频的基准数据集。

Result: 基于CLIP指标、VLM评判和视频质量评估的综合实验表明，多智能体精炼（尤其是并行专业化）在保持视觉质量和时间一致性的同时，显著提升了文化相关性。

Conclusion: 多智能体分解与专业化处理是提升文生视频文化保真度的有效途径，并行专业化策略优于串行方式，为跨文化生成任务提供了可行框架。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available athttps://github.com/AIM-SCU/CRAFT

</details>


### [175] [Xiaomi Auto World Model: A Joint World Model Integrating Reconstruction and Generation for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18137)
*Lijun Zhou,Hongcheng Luo,Zhenxin Zhu,Cheng Chi,Mingfei Tu,Kaixin Xiong,Lei Gong,Zhanqian Wu,Zehan Zhang,Fangzhen Li,Hao Li,Yingying Shen,Jiale He,Haohui Zhu,Shan Zhao,Kai Wang,Zhiwei Zhan,Yuechuan Pu,Kaiyuan Tan,Ruiling Yang,Xianqi Wang,Tianyi Yan,Jiawei Zhou,Lei Zhang,Jingyang Zhao,Xi Zhou,Chitian Sun,Chenming Wu,Jiong Deng,Hongwei Xie,Ming Lu,Kun Ma,Long Chen,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye,Bing Wang,Haiyang Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出统一技术系统JWM，包含用于世界表征的WorldRec（基于稀疏场景查询的前馈重建架构，输出紧凑高保真3D高斯场景表示）和用于世界生成的WorldGen（双向预训练+因果微调的三阶段框架，仅需4步去噪即可实现高质量在线因果视频生成），两者深度融合实现协同增益，为自动驾驶闭环仿真、数据合成和端到端训练提供基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶世界模型需要同时具备世界表征和世界生成两大核心能力，现有方法通常分别处理这两方面，缺乏统一且协同的技术体系。

Method: WorldRec采用前馈重建架构，在3D空间中初始化结构化查询，聚合跨视角、跨时间特征，生成紧凑的3D高斯场景表征。WorldGen采用两阶段训练框架：双向预训练+因果微调（包含Teacher Forcing、ODE蒸馏和DMD三个渐进阶段），仅需4步去噪。JWM深度整合两者实现协同增益。

Result: JWM在生成稳定性、跨帧一致性和视觉保真度上取得协同提升，支持闭环仿真、数据合成和端到端训练。

Conclusion: 提出的统一技术体系通过深度融合世界表征与生成模块，为自动驾驶世界模型提供了有效的闭环解决方案基础。

Abstract: This report presents a unified technical system addressing the two core capabilities of world models for autonomous driving: world representation and world generation. For world representation, we propose WorldRec, a feed-forward reconstruction architecture driven by sparse scene queries. WorldRec initializes structured queries in 3D space, leveraging them to aggregate cross-view, cross-temporal features, thereby naturally enforcing spatial consistency across frames and yielding compact yet high-fidelity 3D Gaussian scene representations. For world generation, we propose WorldGen, a two-stage training framework of bidirectional pretraining followed by causal fine-tuning through three progressive stages (Teacher Forcing, ODE distillation, and DMD), enabling high-quality online causal video generation in as few as 4 denoising steps. Building on both modules, we further introduce the JWM, which deeply integrates WorldRec and WorldGen to achieve synergistic gains in generation stability, cross-frame consistency, and visual fidelity, providing a solid foundation for closed-loop simulation, data synthesis, and end-to-end training in autonomous driving.

</details>


### [176] [Vision-OPD: Learning to See Fine Details for Multimodal LLMs via On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18740)
*Qianhao Yuan,Jie Lou,Xing Yu,Hongyu Lin,Le Sun,Xianpei Han,Yaojie Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Vision-OPD提出了一种区域到全局的自蒸馏框架，通过将MLLM在局部裁剪图像上的精细感知能力迁移到完整图像策略上，有效提升了模型在细粒度视觉理解任务中的表现，无需外部模型或标签即可实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉理解中表现不佳，问题往往源于模型难以聚焦图片中的关键证据区域，而非局部识别能力不足。作者观察到同一个MLLM在基于证据区域的裁剪图上回答细粒度问题比在全图上更准确，即存在区域-全局感知差距。

Method: 提出Vision-OPD（视觉在策略蒸馏）框架，采用区域到全局的自蒸馏策略：从同一MLLM中实例化两个条件策略——裁剪图条件下的教师策略和全图条件下的学生策略。学生生成在策略rollout，Vision-OPD沿这些rollout最小化教师与学生下一token分布之间的token级散度，无需外部教师模型、真实标签、奖励验证器或推理时工具。

Result: 在多个细粒度视觉理解基准上，Vision-OPD模型能够达到或超越更大规模的开源模型、闭源模型以及"Thinking-with-Images"智能体模型的性能。

Conclusion: 通过自蒸馏使模型内化视觉放大的益处，有效弥合了区域与全局感知之间的差距，显著提升细粒度视觉理解能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, where answers often depend on small but decisive evidence in the full image. We observe a regional-to-global perception gap: the same MLLM answers fine-grained questions more accurately when conditioned on evidence-centered crops than on the corresponding full images, suggesting that many failures stem from difficulty to focus on relevant evidence rather than insufficient local recognition ability. Motivated by this observation, we propose Vision-OPD (Vision On-Policy Distillation), a regional-to-global self-distillation framework that transfers the model's own privileged regional perception to its full-image policy. Vision-OPD instantiates two conditional policies from the same MLLM: a crop-conditioned teacher and a full-image-conditioned student. The student generates on-policy rollouts, and Vision-OPD minimizes token-level divergence between the teacher and student next-token distributions along these rollouts. This enables the model to internalize the benefit of visual zooming without external teacher models, ground-truth labels, reward verifiers, or inference-time tool use. Experiments on multiple fine-grained visual understanding benchmarks show that Vision-OPD models achieve competitive or superior performance against much larger open-source, closed-source, and "Thinking-with-Images" agentic models.

</details>


### [177] [Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19342)
*Tianrun Xu,Yue Sun,Qixun Wang,Jingyi Lu,Yuan Wang,Tianren Zhang,Longteng Guo,Fengyun Rao,Jing Lyu,Feng Chen,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SLVR框架，通过两阶段学习（语义 enriched 区域潜变量学习 + M-GRPO多查询对齐）和构建大规模数据集SLV-Set，将属性级视觉语义注入潜空间，显著提升了多模态潜空间推理的鲁棒性和语义一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜空间视觉推理方法依赖视觉监督，产生的潜表示语义丰富度不足，难以支持多样化的区域级推理任务。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段在细粒度属性监督下学习语义 enriched 的区域中心潜变量；第二阶段设计M-GRPO（多查询组相对策略优化）对齐同一区域上多个查询的潜表示。同时构建SLV-Set数据集（约40万属性标注+80万多查询问答样本）和SV-QA基准。

Result: 实验表明，SLVR在潜空间视觉推理的鲁棒性和语义一致性上优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过属性级语义注入和多查询对齐策略，SLVR有效提升了潜空间推理的语义丰富度与泛化能力，为区域级视觉推理提供了新范式。

Abstract: Multimodal latent-space reasoning aims to replace explicit thinking with images by performing visual reasoning directly in a compact latent space. However, existing approaches largely rely on visual supervision and produce latent representations that lack sufficient semantic richness, limiting their ability to support diverse region-level reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a two-stage learning framework that enriches latent representations with attribute-level visual semantics and aligns them with diverse reasoning objectives. In the first stage, SLVR learns semantically enriched region-centric latents under fine-grained attribute supervision. In the second stage, we design Multi-query Group Relative Policy Optimization (M-GRPO) to align latent representations across multiple queries grounded in the same region. To support this framework, we construct SLV-Set, comprising approximately 400K region-level attribute annotations and 800K multi-query question answering samples, and introduce SV-QA, a benchmark that evaluates latent reasoning under semantic variation. Experiments demonstrate that SLVR improves the robustness and semantic consistency of latent visual reasoning compared to existing baselines.

</details>


### [178] [LIFT and PLACE: A Simple, Stable, and Effective Knowledge Distillation Framework for Lightweight Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19729)
*Hyunsoo Han,Sangyeop Yeo,Jaejun Yoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种粗到细的蒸馏框架（LIFT+PLACE），有效解决了扩散模型中教师网络因容量过大导致学生难以模仿的问题，在极端压缩（学生参数量仅为教师1.6%）下仍能稳定训练并取得FID 15.73。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教师网络容量远大于学生网络，其高度复杂的去噪过程使学生难以忠实模仿，传统知识蒸馏在极端压缩下甚至无法提供稳定训练指导（FID退化至50-200+）。

Method: 提出LIFT（Linear Fitting-based Distillation）将目标分解为粗对齐与细精炼两个阶段，学生先进行粗对齐训练再进入困难精炼；提出PLACE（Piecewise Local Adaptive Coefficient Estimation）将输出按误差分组，提供局部自适应指导以处理空间非均匀误差。

Result: 在图像/潜空间、U-Net/DiT、有/无条件生成等多种设定下均有效，并扩展到流匹配模型（MMDiT/SD3）；在1.3M参数学生（仅教师1.6%）下FID 15.73，而传统KD失败（FID 50-200+）。

Conclusion: 提出的粗到细蒸馏框架能有效应对教师-学生容量差距导致的蒸馏困难，在极端压缩场景下仍保持稳定收敛，且具有跨架构、跨任务、跨模型类型的良好泛化性。

Abstract: We demonstrate that in knowledge distillation for diffusion models, the teacher network's highly complex denoising process - stemming from its substantially larger capacity - poses a significant challenge for the student model to faithfully mimic. To address this problem, we propose a coarse-to-fine distillation framework with LInear FiTtingbased distillation (LIFT) and Piecewise Local Adaptive Coefficient Estimation (PLACE). First, LIFT decomposes the objective into a "coarse" alignment and a "fine" refinement. The student is then trained on coarse alignment before proceeding to hard refinement. Second, PLACE extends LIFT to address spatially non-uniform errors by partitioning outputs into error-based groups, providing locally adaptive guidance. Our experiments show that LIFT and PLACE is effective across diffusion spaces (image/latent), backbones (U-Net/DiT), tasks (unconditional/conditional), datasets, and even extends to flow-based models such as MMDiT (SD3). Furthermore, under extreme compression with a 1.3M-parameter student (only 1.6% of the teacher), conventional KD fails to provide sufficient guidance for stable training, with FID scores often degrading to 50-200+, but our method remains stably convergent and achieves an FID of 15.73.

</details>


### [179] [TideGS: Scalable Training of Over One Billion 3D Gaussian Splatting Primitives via Out-of-Core Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20150)
*Chonghao Zhong,Linfeng Shi,Hua Chen,Tiecheng Sun,Hao Zhao,Binhang Yuan,Chaojian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TideGS是一种面向10亿级3D高斯溅射训练的外存框架，通过SSD-CPU-GPU三级存储层次和三种协同技术（块虚拟化几何、分层异步流水线、轨迹自适应差分流），在单张24GB GPU上实现了超10亿高斯的训练，远超此前外存方法约1亿和内存方法约1100万高斯的规模限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS训练在十亿基元尺度上面临严重的内存瓶颈：每个高斯原语携带大属性向量，参数表超出GPU显存容量，此前系统在单GPU上仅支持数千万高斯。

Method: 提出三种协同技术：1) 块虚拟化几何（SSD对齐的空间局部性）；2) 分层异步流水线（I/O与计算重叠）；3) 轨迹自适应差分流（迭代间仅传输增量工作集变化）。核心洞察：3DGS训练是稀疏且轨迹条件的，每次迭代仅激活当前相机批次可见的高斯，GPU内存可作为工作集缓存而非持久参数存储。

Result: 在单张24GB GPU上实现超10亿高斯的训练，在大规模场景中取得单GPU基线中最佳重建质量，规模远超此前外存基线（约1亿高斯）和标准内存训练（约1100万高斯）。

Conclusion: TideGS通过外存训练框架有效突破了3DGS的显存规模限制，验证了SSD-CPU-GPU层次化管理十亿级高斯参数的可行性。

Abstract: Training 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) at billion-primitive scale is fundamentally memory-bound: each Gaussian primitive carries a large attribute vector, and the aggregate parameter table quickly exceeds GPU capacity, limiting prior systems to tens of millions of Gaussians on commodity single-GPU hardware. We observe that 3DGS training is inherently sparse and trajectory-conditioned: each iteration activates only the Gaussians visible from the current camera batch, so GPU memory can serve as a working-set cache rather than a persistent parameter store. Building on this insight, we introduce TideGS, an out-of-core training framework that manages parameters across an SSD-CPU-GPU hierarchy via three synergistic techniques: block-virtualized geometry for SSD-aligned spatial locality, a hierarchical asynchronous pipeline to overlap I/O with computation, and trajectory-adaptive differential streaming that transfers only incremental working-set deltas between iterations. Experiments show that TideGS enables training with over one billion Gaussians on a single 24 GB GPU while achieving the best reconstruction quality among evaluated single-GPU baselines on large-scale scenes, scaling beyond prior out-of-core baselines (e.g., approximately 100M Gaussians) and standard in-memory training (e.g., approximately 11M Gaussians).

</details>


### [180] [Case-Aware Medical Image Classification with Multimodal Knowledge Graphs and Reliability-Guided Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22547)
*Yiming Xu,Yixuan Liu,Yuhang Zhang,Ling Zheng,Yihan Wang,Qi Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多模态知识图谱的案例感知推理框架（MKG-CARE），通过构建结构化的诊断记忆（包含疾病、图像、症状的层级组织），自适应检索相似历史案例，并利用图注意力网络和双向跨模态注意力机制进行知识传播与注入，同时设计置信度校准的决策修正方案以处理噪声检索，从而在医学图像分类中显式模拟循证诊断过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在医学图像分类中大多依赖孤立的视觉证据，无法有效利用相似案例或外部知识；而临床实践中诊断通常依赖于相似历史病例及其相关症状的支持。为显式建模这种循证诊断过程，本文提出案例感知推理框架。

Method: (1) 构建案例感知多模态知识图谱作为结构化诊断记忆，层级组织疾病、图像和症状；(2) 自适应检索相似案例并提取以案例为中心的子图；(3) 提出知识传播与注入机制：图像中心图注意力网络聚合异质语义为案例级特征，双向跨模态注意力将其注入视觉表示实现跨模态对齐；(4) 设计置信度校准的决策修正方案，联合评估预测置信度和样本相似度以估计检索案例的可靠性并重加权其贡献。

Result: 在多个医学图像数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法持续优于强基线方法；消融实验和定性分析验证了其有效性和可解释性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的案例感知推理框架通过显式建模基于历史案例的循证诊断过程，有效提升了医学图像分类性能，同时提供了可解释的案例级证据。

Abstract: Deep learning has brought significant progress to medical image classification, yet most existing methods still rely on isolated visual evidence and cannot effectively leverage similar cases or external knowledge. In clinical practice, diagnosis is typically supported by similar historical cases and their associated symptoms. To explicitly model this evidence-based diagnostic process, we propose a case-aware reasoning framework driven by multimodal knowledge graphs for medical image classification. Specifically, we construct a case-aware multimodal knowledge graph as a structured diagnostic memory, where diseases, images, and symptoms are hierarchically organized. Given an input image, our method adaptively retrieves similar cases from this memory and extracts their corresponding case-centered subgraphs. We further introduce a knowledge propagation and injection mechanism, in which an image-centric Graph Attention Network aggregates heterogeneous semantics into case-based features, followed by a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism that injects these features into visual representations for cross-modal alignment. To mitigate noisy retrieval, we design a confidence-calibrated decision refinement scheme that estimates the reliability of each retrieved case by jointly considering prediction confidence and sample similarity, and reweights its contribution to the final prediction, providing interpretable case-level evidence. Extensive experiments on multiple medical imaging datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms strong baselines, while ablation and qualitative analyses validate its effectiveness and interpretability. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MKG-CARE-8B7B.

</details>


### [181] [Occlusion-Aware Physics-Semantic Keyframe Selection for Robust Video Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23192)
*Lin Liu,Zhihan Xiao,Haohang Xu,Rong Cong,Zhibo Zhang,Xiaopeng Zhang,Qi Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种遮挡感知的物理-语义关键帧选择框架，通过自动识别最优锚定帧并双向传播生成密集时空掩码，实现鲁棒的视频编辑，克服了遮挡、视角变化和快速运动导致的定位不准确和时间闪烁问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的视频编辑方法在遮挡、视角变化和快速运动场景下表现不佳，根源在于缺乏可靠的视觉锚定点（visual anchors）。

Method: 提出遮挡感知的物理-语义关键帧选择框架，从结构完整性、循环一致性跟踪稳定性和视觉-语言属性可见性三个互补角度评估候选帧，选出最优锚定帧后通过双向跟踪生成密集时空掩码，作为扩散视频编辑骨干的辅助监督。

Result: 在具有挑战性的视频编辑基准上证明了方法的有效性和高质量性能。

Conclusion: 将遮挡处理从显式重建转变为可靠的锚定帧选择，无需人工标注即可实现精确且时间一致的视频编辑。

Abstract: Video editing has recently achieved remarkable progress with diffusion-based generative models, enabling diverse object-level manipulations from natural language instructions.
