However, existing methods often struggle under occlusion, viewpoint changes, and fast object motion, where unreliable visual observations lead to inaccurate localization, temporal flickering, and inconsistent edits. In this work, we identify the absence of reliable visual anchors as a fundamental bottleneck in occlusion-robust video editing. To address this issue, we propose an occlusion-aware physics-semantic keyframe selection framework that automatically identifies an optimal anchor frame for downstream editing. Specifically, our method evaluates candidate frames from three complementary perspectives: structural completeness for avoiding truncated observations, cycle-consistent tracking stability for measuring physical reliability, and vision-language-based attribute visibility for ensuring semantic clarity. The selected keyframe is then propagated through bidirectional tracking to generate dense spatiotemporal masks, which are used as auxiliary supervision for a diffusion-based video editing backbone. By transforming occlusion handling from explicit reconstruction into reliable anchor selection, our framework enables precise and temporally consistent editing without requiring manual annotations. Extensive experiments on challenging video editing benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and high-quality performance of our method.

</details>


### [182] [Cross-Modal Action Recognition in Egocentric Video Using Mamba: Integrating RGB and Hand Skeleton Streams via CLS Token Fusion Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24302)
*Juan Ignacio Bustos Gorostegui,Maria Elena Buemi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Mamba框架的跨模态架构，结合RGB视频和手部骨骼数据用于自我中心动作识别，设计并评估了四种CLS令牌混合策略，在H2O数据集上平均策略表现最佳，Top-1准确率在Tiny配置下提升超10%，Small配置下提升2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心动作识别因摄像机运动不稳定、手部频繁遮挡及难以保持一致的视觉表征而极具挑战性，现有方法难以有效融合RGB视频和手部骨骼信息。

Method: 提出跨模态Mamba架构，包含三个模块：VideoMamba模块提取视觉特征、基于Mamba块的骨骼编码器、以及融合模块。设计了四种CLS令牌混合策略（Naive、Average、Weighted、Context-based）用于多模态融合，利用预训练单模态CLS令牌初始化混合CLS令牌进行分类。

Result: 在H2O数据集上，Average策略表现最佳，Tiny配置下Top-1准确率提升超过10%，Small配置下提升2%。

Conclusion: 基于Mamba的跨模态融合框架能有效结合RGB视频和手部骨骼数据，提升自我中心动作识别性能，其中平均CLS令牌混合策略效果最优。

Abstract: Egocentric action recognition is a challenging task due to erratic camera motion, frequent hand occlusion, and the difficulty of maintaining consistent visual representations over time. In this work, we propose a cross-modal architecture that combines RGB video and temporal hand skeleton data within a unified Mamba-based framework, exploiting the linear time complexity of State Space Models (SSMs). Our architecture consists of three components: a VideoMamba module for visual feature extraction, a skeleton encoder built on a stack of Mamba blocks, and a fusion module that integrates both modalities into a single representation. A central contribution of this work is the design and evaluation of four Class (CLS) token mixing strategies for multimodal fusion: Naive, Average, Weighted and Context-based. These strategies differ in how the pretrained unimodal CLS tokens, which role is to act as information sinks concentrating learned representations, are leveraged to initialize the mixed CLS token used for final classification. We evaluate all strategies on the H2O dataset. Experimental results show that the Average strategy achieves the best performance, yielding gains of over 10% Top-1 accuracy in the Tiny configuration and 2% in the Small configuration over the VideoMamba baseline.

</details>


### [183] [OmniEgo-R$^2$: A Routed Reasoning Framework for the 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at CVPR 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24481)
*Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Wenbo Wang,Yupeng Hu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniEgo-R²，一种统一路由推理管线，用于跨域自我中心视频推理，在EgoCross挑战赛的两个赛道中均获得第二名，分别达到66.35%和66.77%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EgoCross挑战赛评估多模态大模型在手术、工业、极限运动和动物视角等跨域自我中心视频上的推理能力，现有方法难以处理时域边界模糊、跨域语义粒度不匹配以及相近选项下的决策不稳定等关键问题。

Method: 提出OmniEgo-R² (Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning)，一个统一路由推理管线，包含五个模块：时域证据归一化、领域无关能力路由、结构化感知-动态-决策推理、边界感知选项验证和防御性答案校准。以Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT为基础骨架，并封装轻量级测试时推理和解析程序。

Result: 在Source-Limited赛道取得66.35%整体准确率，Open-Source赛道取得66.77%整体准确率，两个赛道均排名第二。

Conclusion: 将EgoCross重新定义为鲁棒的跨域具身视频推理问题而非简单多项选择问答，所提方法有效应对了三个关键挑战，验证了路由推理在跨域自我中心视频理解中的有效性。

Abstract: The 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis, CVPR 2026 evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over egocentric videos across surgery, industry, extreme sports, and animal perspective. We achieved second place in both the Source-Limited and Open-Source tracks. In this report, we formulate EgoCross as a robust cross-domain embodied video reasoning problem rather than a simple multiple-choice visual question answering task. We identify three key challenges: (C1) temporal boundary ambiguity, where critical state transitions are sparsely sampled and often occur between frames; (C2) cross-domain semantic granularity mismatch, where the same capability requires different domain-specific visual grammar; and (C3) decision instability under close options, where long multimodal reasoning can select unsupported distractors or produce malformed outputs. To address them, we propose OmniEgo-R$^2$ (Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning), a unified routed reasoning pipeline consisting of temporal-evidence normalization, domain-agnostic capability routing, structured perception--dynamics--decision reasoning, boundary-aware option verification, and defensive answer calibration. OmniEgo-R$^2$ uses the Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT checkpoints on each EgoCross domain as the visual-language backbone, and wraps them with lightweight test-time reasoning and parsing programs. Our final submissions obtain 66.35% overall accuracy in the Source-Limited track and 66.77% in the Open-Source track, ranking second in both leaderboards. The codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/OmniEgo-R2

</details>


### [184] [Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24906)
*Zijie Cao,Weijie Tu,Yao Xiao,Weijian Deng,Liang Lin,Pengxu Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PROBE是一个利用检测器作为批评者引导生成器产生难以分类的样本，从而提升AI生成图像检测器泛化能力的框架，实验表明该方法能有效泛化到未见过的生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIGI检测器虽然在大量数据上训练，但在生成设置变化时性能下降，表明仅靠数据规模不足，训练过程中对生成变化的覆盖有限是关键因素。

Method: 提出PROBE框架，将检测器作为批评者来引导生成器进行流形级别的修改，主动探索生成过程中具有挑战性的区域，产生难以分类的逼真样本，用于精炼检测器。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，PROBE增强了对未见生成器的泛化能力，取得了更通用的AIGI检测性能。

Conclusion: 主动探索生成过程的变化性比单纯扩大数据规模更有效，PROBE通过对抗性样本生成的方式提升了检测器的鲁棒性和泛化性。

Abstract: Detecting AI-generated images (AIGI) remains challenging because detectors often fail to generalize to unseen generators. Although existing methods are trained on large datasets, their performance still degrades when generation settings change, indicating that data scale alone is insufficient and that limited coverage of generative variations during training is a key factor. Studies on generative model editing show that small changes in internal representations can produce diverse and meaningful image variations, many of which are not explored under standard sampling. Leveraging this insight, we propose PROBE (Probing Robustness via Boundary Exploration), a framework that improves detector generalization by actively exploring challenging regions of the generative process. Instead of treating the generator as a fixed data source, PROBE uses the detector as a critic to steer the generator through manifold-level modifications, producing realistic samples that are difficult to classify. These samples expose failure cases that are uncommon under standard data sampling strategies and are used to refine the detector. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks indicate that PROBE enhances generalization to unseen generators, resulting in more generalizable AIGI detection performance. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Amamiya-C/PROBE-AIGI-Detection

</details>


### [185] [VEOcc: Voxel-Centric Online Semantic Occupancy Prediction For Embodied Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25059)
*Ruoyu Wang,Yong Liu,Sheng Tao,Yuhang Lin,Yukai Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VEOcc 提出了一种基于体素的在线3D占用预测与建图框架，通过递归感知-同化范式和时空感知在线更新策略，无需场景先验即可高效构建稠密空间表示，在 Occ-ScanNet 等数据集上取得了 SOTA 性能，并展现了良好的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯中心化方法存在结构边界保真度不足、严重依赖预定义场景尺寸先验的问题，限制了自主探索中的操作效率。本文旨在消除对初始尺度估计的需求，实现高度精简、开放式的地图扩展。

Method: 提出体素中心化框架 VEOcc，采用递归感知-同化范式；针对离散体素空间中的噪声时序观测聚合问题，提出时空感知在线更新策略，包含跨时间逻辑聚合（TLA）、可靠性感知置信度调制（RCM）和置信度驱动的增量状态更新（CSU）三部分。

Result: 在 Occ-ScanNet 和 EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet 数据集上的局部与具身设置下均取得 SOTA 性能；在自采视频序列上的零样本评估进一步验证了其在完全未见真实环境中的鲁棒泛化能力。

Conclusion: VEOcc 为自主探索提供了一种准确且高效的解决方案，无需场景先验，具备良好的开放扩展性和跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: Crucial for autonomous exploration, online 3D occupancy prediction and mapping incrementally constructs dense spatial representations on the fly. However, recent Gaussian-centric methods struggle with structural boundary fidelity and rely heavily on predefined scene-size priors, fundamentally limiting their operational efficiency. In this work, we present VEOcc, a voxel-centric framework formulated as a recursive perception-and-assimilation paradigm. By eliminating the need for initial scale estimation, VEOcc enables highly streamlined, open-ended map expansion. Furthermore, to robustly aggregate noisy temporal observations within the discrete voxel space, we propose a Spatio-Temporal-Aware Online Update Strategy. It integrates Cross-Temporal Logit Aggregation (TLA) for temporal consistency, Reliability-Aware Confidence Modulation (RCM) for spatial uncertainty calibration, and Confidence-Driven Incremental State Update (CSU) for robust global state assimilation. % Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings, providing an accurate and efficient solution for real-world exploration. Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings. Notably, zero-shot evaluations on self-collected video sequences further confirm its robust out-of-distribution generalization capability in completely unseen real-world environments. Ultimately, our framework provides an accurate and highly efficient solution for autonomous exploration. Code and supplementary visualizations are available on our project page: https://wryzju.github.io/VEOcc/.

</details>


### [186] [CollectionLoRA: Collecting 50 Effects in 1 LoRA via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25378)
*Fangtai Wu,Hailong Guo,Shijie Huang,Jiayi Song,Yubo Huang,Mushui Liu,Zhao Wang,Yunlong Yu,Jiaming Liu,Ruihua Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CollectionLoRA提出多教师在线蒸馏框架，将多达50种不同效果的LoRA以及少步生成能力蒸馏到单个LoRA中，解决了参数干扰和部署开销问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有定制化图像编辑方法中，随着所需效果数量增加，存储和动态加载多个效果LoRA导致部署开销显著增大；同时级联效果LoRA与加速模块会引发参数干扰，导致概念泄露和风格退化。

Method: 提出三种策略：(i) 概率双流路由机制，训练时随机切换数据源增强泛化；(ii) 非对称正交提示策略，在提示空间实现概念隔离；(iii) 由粗到精蒸馏目标，缓解教师与学生模型之间的分布差异。

Result: CollectionLoRA将多达50种定制化效果和少步生成能力蒸馏到单个LoRA中，在降低部署开销的同时，实现了与独立训练的教师模型相当或更优的概念保真度。

Conclusion: 该方法从根本上解决了特征干扰问题，显著降低了部署成本，且能保持高质量的概念保真度。

Abstract: Customized image editing aims to equip pre-trained diffusion models with specific visual effects using limited paired data, typically via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). As the number of desired effects grows, storing and dynamically loading numerous these effect LoRAs significantly increases deployment overhead. Furthermore, current pipelines typically cascade these effect LoRAs with acceleration modules for fast generation, which triggers severe parameter interference and results in concept bleeding and style degradation. We propose CollectionLoRA, a multi-teacher on-policy distillation framework capable of distilling the concepts of up to 50 different effect LoRAs along with few-step generation capabilities into a single LoRA. This fundamentally resolves the feature interference issue and significantly reduces deployment costs. Specifically, the method introduces (i) a Probabilistic Dual-Stream Routing mechanism that enables the model to randomly switch between data sources during training, effectively enhancing its generalization in unseen scenarios; (ii) an Asymmetric Orthogonal Prompting strategy to achieve concept isolation within the prompt space; (iii) a Coarse-to-Fine Distillation Objective to mitigate the distribution gap between the teacher and student models. Extensive evaluations show that CollectionLoRA distills all customized effects and few-step generation into a single LoRA, reducing deployment overhead while achieving concept fidelity comparable to or better than independently trained teacher models. Code: https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/CollectionLoRA

</details>


### [187] [AI-T2I: Aggregating-and-Isolating Cross-Attention to Diffusion Models for Text-to-Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25763)
*Shipeng Cao,Biao Qian,Haipeng Liu,Yang Wang,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AI-T2I方法，通过聚合-分离交叉注意力机制解决扩散模型在文本到图像生成中存在的词内注意力分散和词间注意力重叠问题，在多个基准上超越现有方法，并具有良好的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在交叉注意力图中难以实现精确的文本-图像对齐，已有工作主要关注不同主题词之间注意力的重叠问题，却忽略了同一主题词内部注意力分散的问题。

Method: 提出AI-T2I方法：(1) 设计聚合损失（aggregation loss），识别并合并分散的同一token内部激活值，间接缓解潜在的重叠问题；(2) 引入隔离损失（isolation loss），将不同token之间的激活值推离彼此，从而实现精确的文本-图像对齐。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，AI-T2I优于当前最先进的文本到图像合成方法，并在可控布局生成和个性化生成等下游任务中展现出优异的泛化性能。

Conclusion: AI-T2I通过同时处理词内注意力分散和词间注意力重叠两个问题，显著提升了扩散模型的文本-图像对齐能力，且具有良好泛化性。

Abstract: Text-to-image synthesis has made significant progress, benefiting from the strong generative capabilities of diffusion models. However, these models struggle to achieve precise text-to-image alignment within cross-attention maps during the denoising process. Existing works primarily focus on inter-subject-token activations (i.e., cross-attention scores) overlap for different subjects, overlooking the intra-subject-token activations scattering issue for identical subjects. In this paper, we propose an Aggregating-and-Isolating cross-attention approach to diffusion models for Text-to-Image synthesis, dubbed AI-T2I. Technically, to address the scattering issue, we devise an aggregation loss to identify and consolidate the scattered intra-token activations, which implicitly helps mitigate the potential overlap issue. Upon that, an isolation loss is further introduced to push the inter-token activations apart, thus fulfilling precise text-to-image alignment. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of AI-T2I over the state-of-the-art works for text-to-image synthesis. Furthermore, our AI-T2I exhibits excellent generalization across other tasks, e.g., controllable layout generation and personalized generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hatter77/AI-T2I.

</details>


### [188] [SAFE-Diff: Scale-Aware Attention and Feature-Dispersive Diffusion with Uncertainty Estimation for Contrast-Enhanced Breast MRI Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25767)
*Tianyu Zhang,Xinglong Liang,Jarek van Dijk,Luyi Han,Chunyao Lu,Antonio Portaluri,Xinghe Xie,Yaofei Duan,Nika Rasoolzadeh,Xin Wang,Yuan Gao,Muzhen He,Yue Sun,Jonas Teuwen,Tao Tan,Ritse Mann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究合成高保真对比增强MRI的技术，以在乳腺癌筛查中实现更安全、更高效的成像，但面临病灶纹理复杂和增强模式异质性的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床需要更安全、高效的乳腺癌筛查方法，合成高保真对比增强MRI可以避免对比剂相关风险，但现有方法难以处理复杂的病灶纹理和异质性增强模式。

Method: 论文提出了一种合成高保真对比增强MRI的方法，以应对复杂病灶纹理和异质性增强模式带来的挑战。

Result: 合成的高保真对比增强MRI在乳腺癌筛查中具有临床应用价值，可提高安全性和效率。

Conclusion: 合成高保真对比增强MRI对于更安全、更高效的乳腺癌筛查具有临床价值，但技术上仍需解决病灶纹理复杂性和增强模式异质性的问题。

Abstract: Synthesizing high fidelity contrast enhanced MRI is clinically valuable for safer and more efficient breast cancer screening, yet remains challenging due to complex lesion textures and heterogeneous enhancement patterns.

</details>


### [189] [Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26064)
*Ali Rouzbayani,Bidhan Roy,Marcos Villagra,Zhiying Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Paris 2.0是首个通过去中心化计算预训练的视频生成模型，相比集中式训练的基线模型，在FVD指标上实现约2倍改进（从561.04降至279.01），并提升了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决去中心化训练下时序一致的视频生成这一开放问题，扩展Paris 1.0（去中心化图像生成模型）的能力至视频领域。

Method: 基于Paris 1.0的去中心化扩散模型（DDM）架构，将其从图像生成扩展到视频生成，在低分辨率文本到视频训练任务中，使用与集中式模型相同的总计算预算进行去中心化预训练。

Result: 在低分辨率文本到视频训练中，相比于相同数据量和计算预算的集中式模型，Paris 2.0将FVD从561.04降至279.01（约2倍改进），并提升了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分。

Conclusion: 去中心化计算可以有效训练视频生成模型，且性能优于同等条件下的集中式训练方案。

Abstract: We present Paris 2.0, the first video generation model pre-trained through decentralized computation. Its training recipe builds upon Paris 1.0 (arXiv:2510.03434), the first ever open-weight Decentralized Diffusion Model (DDM), which showed that image generation can be trained without a monolithic GPU cluster. However, temporally coherent video generation had remained an open problem under decentralized training, and Paris 2.0 closes it.
  In low-resolution text-to-video training, against a monolithic model trained on the same data under a matched total compute budget, Paris 2.0 cuts Frechet Video Distance (FVD) from 561.04 to 279.01, a ~2.0x improvement, and lifts CLIP text-video similarity and aesthetic score.

</details>


### [190] [VesselSim: learning 3D blood vessel segmentation without expert annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26277)
*Erin Rainville,Melissa Ananian,Tristan Mirolla,Hassan Rivaz,Yiming Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VesselSim框架，通过随机几何驱动的血管模拟生成16500个合成3D血管造影体积，仅用合成数据训练3D U-Net，并引入自监督掩码重构解码器进行测试时自适应，在零样本设置下实现与SOTA血管分割基础模型竞争的性能，减少对真实标注数据的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血管标注需要专家知识且成本高昂，成为深度学习血管分割技术发展的主要瓶颈，因此希望消除训练中对真实标注数据的依赖。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 随机几何驱动血管模拟（递归分支、曲率控制生长、碰撞感知拓扑）+ 域随机化强度合成，生成16500个3D血管造影体积；(2) 合成数据训练3D U-Net，推理时通过自监督掩码重构解码器进行测试时自适应，无需先验域知识。

Result: 在多个真实MR/CT数据集（脑部、肾脏等）的零样本评估中，仅用合成数据训练的VesselSim性能与SOTA血管分割基础模型相当。

Conclusion: 从合成管状结构中学习血管几何特征对于跨域泛化有效，能显著减少对真实医学影像数据及专家标注的依赖。

Abstract: Blood vessel segmentation is a core task in medical image analysis for the care of vascular diseases and surgical planning, yet the challenges of providing expert vascular annotations pose a major obstacle for the progress of related deep learning techniques. To address this, we propose VesselSim, a two-stage framework for universal 3D blood vessel segmentation that eliminates the need for real annotated data during training. First, we introduce a stochastic, geometry-driven vascular simulation framework that models recursive branching, curvature-controlled growth, and collision-aware topology, followed by domain-randomized intensity synthesis to generate 16,500 anatomically plausible 3D angiographic volumes. Second, a 3D U-Net is trained solely on this synthetic data. To bridge the domain gap from synthetic to real images at inference time, we introduce a test-time adaptation strategy via a self-supervised mask reconstruction decoder, enabling adaptation to unseen clinical scans without prior domain knowledge. We evaluate VesselSim in a zero-shot setting on multiple real-world datasets spanning MR and CT across several anatomical regions, including the brain and kidneys. Despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data, VesselSim achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art vascular segmentation foundation models. These findings suggest that learning vessel geometry from synthetic tubular structures is effective for robust cross-domain generalization, substantially reducing the reliance on acquired medical imaging data and more importantly, expert annotations.

</details>


### [191] [Unified Panoramic Geometry Estimation via Multi-View Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26368)
*Vukasin Bozic,Isidora Slavkovic,Dominik Narnhofer,Nando Metzger,Denis Rozumny,Konrad Schindler,Nikolai Kalischek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PaGeR框架，将针对透视图像的3D基础模型扩展至全景领域，实现从单张全景图像中一次性预测尺度不变深度、度量深度、表面法线和天空遮罩，在室内外场景中达到SOTA性能并具有优异零样本能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D基础模型主要针对透视图像设计，无法直接处理全景图像；而全景图像能提供360度完整场景信息，具有重要的应用价值，因此需要将成熟透视模型的能力迁移到全景领域。

Method: 基于预训练的3D重建Transformer，通过最小化架构修改，在训练中混合透视图像和全景图像，使模型在保留原有3D先验的同时学习从单张全景图像估计几何一致的360度场景（包括尺度不变深度、度量深度、表面法线和天空遮罩），以单次前向推理完成所有预测。

Result: 在室内外场景的广泛测试中，PaGeR取得了最先进的性能，并在多种场景下展现出优异的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: PaGeR成功将透视图像的3D基础模型扩展到全景领域，验证了通过最小架构变化和混合训练策略可以有效迁移3D先验知识，为全景几何重建提供了新的高效解决方案。

Abstract: Geometry estimation from perspective images has greatly advanced, maturing to the point where off-the-shelf foundation models are able to reconstruct 3D scene structure not only from multi-view imagery, but even from a single view. A natural extension is 3D reconstruction from panoramas, with the exciting prospect of recovering a full 360-degree scene from a single panoramic image. In this work, we introduce PaGeR (Panoramic Geometry Reconstruction), a framework to lift powerful 3D foundation models designed for perspective imagery to the panorama domain. Our strategy is to start from a pre-trained transformer for 3D reconstruction and turn it into a unified high-performance model that predicts scale-invariant depth, metric depth, surface normals, and sky masks from both perspective and omnidirectional images, in a single forward pass. By keeping architectural changes to a minimum and mixing perspective and panoramic images during training, PaGeR retains the rich 3D prior of the underlying foundation model while learning to also estimate geometrically consistent 360-degree scenes from single panoramas. We extensively test our method in both indoor and outdoor environments and find that it delivers state-of-the-art performance and excellent zero-shot performance across a wide range of scenes. Code, data and models are available $\href{https://github.com/prs-eth/PaGeR}{\text{here}}$.

</details>


### [192] [MSCGC-KAN: Multi-scale Causal Graph Convolution and Kolmogorov-Arnold Feature Mapping for EEG Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26624)
*Haoliang Gong,Qingshan She,Jiale Xu,Yunyan Gao,Xugang Xi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MSCGC-KAN方法，通过多尺度因果图卷积和Kolmogorov-Arnold特征映射构建结构化任务头，在预训练CBraMod模型基础上增强多尺度时间建模、通道连接建模和非线性判别映射，在FACED和SEED-VII数据集上分别提升平衡准确率5.91和2.03个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于EEG的情感识别在微调设置下存在三个主要局限：多尺度情感动态建模不足、通道间功能连接利用不充分、简单线性分类头表达能力有限。

Method: 提出MSCGC-KAN方法，在预训练CBraMod骨干网络上附加结构化任务头，包含多尺度因果图卷积（Multi-scale Causal Graph Convolution）用于建模多尺度时间动态和通道间功能连接，以及Kolmogorov-Arnold特征映射用于增强非线性判别能力。

Result: 在FACED数据集上达到60.66%的平衡准确率、0.5525的Cohen's Kappa和60.40%的加权F1分数；在SEED-VII数据集上达到33.27%、0.2223和33.64%。相比CBraMod+Linear基线，平衡准确率分别提升5.91和2.03个百分点。

Conclusion: 结构化任务头设计是在微调预训练EEG模型时提升情感识别效果的有效途径。

Abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition is an important affective computing task, and recent EEG foundation models provide useful generic representations for downstream adaptation. However, under the fine-tuning setting, three limitations remain prominent: insufficient modeling of multi-scale emotional dynamics, inadequate exploitation of inter-channel functional connectivity, and the limited expressive power of simple linear classification heads. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new EEG emotion recognition method, termed MSCGC-KAN, which introduces a structured task head composed of multi-scale causal graph convolution and Kolmogorov--Arnold feature mapping. Built on a pre-trained CBraMod backbone, MSCGC-KAN enhances downstream adaptation by jointly strengthening multi-scale temporal modeling, learnable inter-channel connectivity modeling, and nonlinear discriminative mapping within a compact task-specific head. This design preserves the representation advantage of the foundation model while making the classifier more sensitive to emotion-related spatiotemporal patterns. Extensive experiments are conducted on the public FACED and SEED-VII datasets. The proposed method achieves a balanced accuracy of 60.66\%, a Cohen's Kappa of 0.5525, and a weighted F1-score of 60.40\% on FACED, and obtains 33.27\%, 0.2223, and 33.64\%, respectively, on SEED-VII. Compared with the CBraMod+Linear baseline, the balanced accuracy is improved by 5.91 and 2.03 percentage points on the two datasets, respectively. These results indicate that structured task-head design is an effective way to improve EEG emotion recognition when fine-tuning pre-trained EEG models.

</details>


### [193] [JLT: Clean-Latent Prediction in Latent Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27102)
*Funing Fu,Tenghui Wang,Guanyu Zhou,Junyong Cen,Qichao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出JLT，一个130M参数的潜在扩散Transformer，研究在潜在空间中清洁点预测是否仍优于速度预测。通过理论和实验证明，清洁预测能更有效处理低方差潜在方向，在ImageNet 256×256上JLT-B/1以FID-50K 2.50显著优于速度预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索流匹配中清洁数据预测的优势在潜在空间（经VAE压缩后）是否仍然成立，以及不同预测目标（清洁潜在、速度、噪声）在潜在扩散模型中的几何意义。

Method: 构建JLT（130M潜在扩散Transformer），使用冻结的FLUX.2 VAE编码，对比清洁潜在预测与速度预测DiT，采用相同骨干网络和训练设置；通过局部高斯分析揭示速度回归的等周目标协方差下限和低方差潜在方向放大效应。

Result: JLT-B/1在ImageNet 256×256上获得FID-50K 2.50（带无分类器引导），与速度预测相比存在显著的匹配目标差距。

Conclusion: 潜在扩散中的预测目标是依赖于表示的几何选择，而非可互换的代数参数化；清洁预测在潜在空间中仍保持优势。

Abstract: Flow matching with clean-data prediction has shown that regressing the clean point can exploit low-dimensional structure more effectively than predicting an ambient noised quantity. We ask whether this principle remains useful after images are mapped into a learned latent space, where compression has already removed much of the raw pixel variability. We introduce JLT, a 130M latent diffusion Transformer over frozen FLUX.2 VAE codes, and compare clean-latent prediction with a matched velocity-prediction DiT under the same representation, backbone, and training settings. Although the three variables x, epsilon, and v are linearly convertible for a fixed corruption time, a local Gaussian analysis shows that velocity regression inherits an isotropic target-covariance floor and amplifies low-variance latent directions, while clean prediction damps them. On ImageNet 256 x 256, JLT-B/1 obtains FID-50K 2.50 with classifier-free guidance, with a large matched-target gap over velocity prediction. These results suggest that prediction targets in latent diffusion are representation-dependent geometric choices, rather than interchangeable algebraic parameterizations.

</details>


### [194] [Semantic Robustness Probing via Inpainting: An Interactive Tool for Safety-Critical Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27155)
*Nico Steckhan,Krutarth Prajapati,Weija Shao,Silvia Vock*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemProbe是一个用于语义鲁棒性探测的工具，通过扩散模型驱动的内容修补技术，在安全关键领域（如工业设备手部检测）中生成语义有意义的测试样本，并支持批量处理、结构化日志记录和性能对比分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键领域中的目标检测器测试需要超越像素级损坏的语义上有意义的探测方法，现有工具缺乏对语义级鲁棒性评估的支持。

Method: 用户上传部署图像，手动或自动创建掩码，选择操作设计域导出因素（或自定义提示），利用扩散模型进行受控内容修补，支持批量作业、并行种子/工作流变体及可配置生成参数，并在每次输出后自动运行模型推理，显示带性能差异的注释前后对比。

Result: 所有探测结果作为结构化工件记录，实现可追溯的鲁棒性证据；在圆锯手部检测任务上针对保险导向测试标准中的因素进行了演示验证。

Conclusion: SemProbe提供了与安全评估工作流对齐的可追溯鲁棒性证据，能够有效支持安全关键领域目标检测器的语义级鲁棒性测试。

Abstract: Testing object detectors in safety-critical domains requires semantically meaningful probes beyond pixel-level corruptions. We present SemProbe, a tool for semantic robustness probing: users upload deployment images, create masks manually or automatically, select operational design domain-derived factors (or custom prompts), and run diffusion-based controlled inpainting. The system supports batch jobs, parallel seed/workflow variations, and configurable generation parameters. After each output, model inference runs automatically and displays annotated before/after comparisons with performance deltas. All probes are logged as structured artifacts, enabling traceable robustness evidence aligned with safety evaluation workflows. We demonstrate \textsc{SemProbe} on hand detection for dimension saws, targeting factors from insurance-oriented test criteria.

</details>


### [195] [When Eyes Betray AI: Social Gaze Consistency as a Semantic Cue for AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27348)
*Jihyeon Kim,Sohee Kim,Soosan Lee,Souhwan Jung,James Matthew Rehg,Hyesong Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出社会凝视一致性（Social Gaze Consistency）作为高阶语义线索用于检测人像生成图像，通过构建诊断数据集、块组合描述监督和跨架构验证，证明该线索可有效提升深度伪造检测性能，且具有跨生成器迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型已大幅缩小低级伪影（像素指纹、频域异常等），尤其在人物中心和部分编辑场景中，检测难度显著增加。为此，本文探索利用高阶语义线索——社交凝视一致性作为正交于现有低级范式的检测新维度。

Method: (i) 构建受控诊断数据集，采用严格配对分组防止生成器指纹记忆；(ii) 提出Block-Compositional Caption Supervision，固定5块推理骨架在1250个宏观组合描述中保持不变，解耦推理一致性与表面多样性；(iii) 跨架构验证：在FakeVLM（视觉语言骨干）和Effort（纯视觉骨干）上测试，并给出四步机制解释（配对编辑捷径阻断、难到易难度迁移、CLIP先验保持、扩散模型在眼周结构的频谱弱点）。

Result: FakeVLM在COCOAI Interaction子集上平衡准确率从67.8提升至71.5（+3.7 pp），在Person子集上从83.0提升至84.3（+1.3 pp）；Effort骨干上同样获得一致增益。真实类和伪造类召回率同步提升，排除了"全预测为假"的人为伪影。

Conclusion: 社会凝视一致性是有效的检测线索，具有跨骨干、跨生成器的泛化能力，代码将开源以促进可复现性。

Abstract: Recent generative models have largely closed the gap on low-level artifacts - pixel fingerprints, frequency anomalies, upsampling traces - particularly in person-centric and partial-edit settings where the manipulated region is small and surrounded by photometrically authentic content. We introduce Social Gaze Consistency, a high-level semantic cue defined as the mutual coherence of gaze direction, head-eye alignment, and pupil placement between interacting individuals, and show that it constitutes a previously underutilized detection axis orthogonal to existing low-level paradigms. We instantiate this insight through three coupled mechanisms: (i) a controlled diagnostic dataset with region-specific perturbations of gaze-consistent imagery, where strict pair-level grouping forecloses generator-fingerprint memorization as an optimization-time shortcut rather than relying on augmentation; (ii) Block-Compositional Caption Supervision, which holds a single 5-block reasoning skeleton invariant across 1,250 macro-combined captions, decoupling reasoning consistency from surface diversity; (iii) Cross-architecture validation showing the same supervision improves a vision-language backbone (FakeVLM) by +3.7 pp on the COCOAI Interaction subset (balanced accuracy 67.8 -> 71.5) and +1.3 pp on the COCOAI Person subset (83.0 -> 84.3), with consistent gains on a vision-only backbone (Effort), evidencing a backbone-agnostic cue. Real- and fake-class recalls rise simultaneously, ruling out a "predict-all-fake" artifact. A four-step mechanistic account - paired-edit shortcut blocking, hard-to-easy difficulty transfer, CLIP prior preservation, and diffusion-family shared spectral weakness in periocular structure - explains why training on a single inpainter (FLUX.1-Fill) transfers to multi-generator suites. We will release the code upon acceptance to facilitate reproducibility.

</details>


### [196] [Feedforward 3D Editing Learns from Semantic-Part Transformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27351)
*Jiawei Weng,Saining Zhang,Zhenxin Diao,Peishuo Li,Henghaofan Zhang,Junhao Chen,Hao Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于语义部件变换的大规模前馈3D编辑方法，构建了包含10万+编辑对的Pxform数据集和PartFlow前馈编辑网络，在几何与外观编辑上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D编辑缺乏高质量配对监督数据，导致定位不准、保留性差、编辑边界模糊和语义一致性有限。作者认为可扩展的前馈3D编辑应从语义部件变换中学习。

Method: 构建Pxform数据集（10万+编辑对，7种编辑类型，基于语义3D部件）；提出PartFlow前馈编辑网络，将源感知隐式控制注入预训练3D生成先验，引入掩码感知速度保持和渲染空间一致性监督。

Result: PartFlow在几何编辑和外观编辑基准上均达到SOTA性能，无需推理时3D编辑掩码。

Conclusion: 高质量的语义部件监督能显著提升可扩展3D编辑性能，语义部件变换是训练前馈3D编辑的有效范式。

Abstract: 3D editing is a fundamental capability for scalable 3D content creation. While image editing has rapidly evolved toward large-scale feedforward generative paradigms, 3D AI generation remains dominated by training-free editing pipelines. A central challenge of feedforward 3D editing lies in the lack of high-quality paired supervision. Editable 3D assets require simultaneous preservation of geometry, multi-view consistency, structural coherence, and localized edit controllability. Existing 3D editing datasets often rely on independently generated assets, image-mediated reconstruction or narrow edit taxonomies, leading to inaccurate localization, weak preservation, blurred edit boundaries, and limited semantic consistency. In this work, we introduce a new perspective: scalable feedforward 3D editing should be learned from semantic-part transformations. Based on this insight, we propose Pxform, a high-quality 3D editing dataset with over 100K consistent before/after editing pairs across seven edit types. Instead of treating objects as unstructured shapes, our pipeline grounds edits directly in semantic 3D parts. Built upon Pxform, we further propose PartFlow, a feedforward 3D editing network that injects source-aware latent control into pretrained 3D generative priors. PartFlow introduces mask-aware velocity preservation and render-space consistency supervision to jointly improve edit fidelity and source preservation, while requiring no 3D edit mask during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that high-quality semantic-part supervision substantially improves scalable 3D editing, enabling PartFlow to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both geometric and appearance editing benchmarks.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [197] [Human-AI Collaboration for Estimating Scientific Replicability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27394)
*Tatiana Chakravorti,Robert Fraleigh,Timothy Fritton,Christopher Griffin,Vaibhav Singh,Sai Koneru,C. Lee Giles,David Pennock,Anthony Kwasnica,Sarah Rajtmajer*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合预测市场方法，让算法代理与人类参与者共同交易，以预测科学发现能否被成功复制。实验表明，除少数情况外，混合市场在复制预测的准确性和可靠性上优于纯人工或纯算法基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有复制性评估方法（纯人工判断或纯机器学习）各有局限：人工判断受认知偏差和文献接触面限制，自动评估难以捕捉上下文线索和细微的可信度信号。因此需要一种能结合两者优势的混合方法。

Method: 引入混合预测市场，算法代理（基于数百项先前复制研究结果训练）与人类参与者实时交易，共同估计科学发现被复制研究证实（阳性结果）的概率。通过多个涉及不同学科的实验，与纯人工和纯算法基线进行比较。

Result: 除少数情况外，混合预测市场在复制预测的准确性和可靠性上匹配或优于纯人工市场和纯算法市场。

Conclusion: 混合预测市场是一种有效且可靠的复制性评估方法，能够结合算法的一致性与人类的领域知识，优于各自的单独表现。

Abstract: Determining whether published scientific findings can successfully be replicated is a long-standing challenge in the empirical sciences. Existing approaches for replicability assessment typically rely either on human judgment, i.e., creative assembly of human experts, or on machine learning models trained on paper content metadata. While both approaches have demonstrated value, each also has important limitations. Human forecasts can be influenced by cognitive biases and narrow exposure to the research literature, while automated assessments often struggle to capture contextual cues and subtle signals of credibility. In this paper, we examine a hybrid approach. Specifically, we introduce a hybrid prediction market in which algorithmic agents trade alongside human participants to jointly estimate the likelihood that a published scientific finding will be corroborated via the outcome of a controlled replication study. Agents are trained on outcomes from hundreds of prior replication studies while human participants contribute domain knowledge through real-time trading. We evaluate this hybrid approach through multiple live experiments involving participants from different academic disciplines and compare its performance to artificial-only and human-only baselines. Our results show that, except for a few cases, hybrid markets match or outperform artificial prediction markets, producing more accurate and reliable replication forecasts.

</details>


### [198] [Informing AI Policy Assessment using Large-Scale Simulation of Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27395)
*Julia Barnett,Kimon Kieslich,Natali Helberger,Nicholas Diakopoulos*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合参与式评估、专家评估和LLM评估的混合方法，利用遗传算法探索AI治理政策组合的最优解，帮助政策制定者在成本、公众意见和危害缓解之间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统快速普及引发的危害推动了全球AI治理，但政策制定者在众多竞争性政策选项中确定优先级的挑战日益严峻，亟需系统化的方法论来识别可行的政策选项。

Method: 采用参与式政策评估、专家实施成本评估和LLM-based危害缓解评估三结合的方法；利用遗传算法模拟探索庞大的政策组合解空间，分析不同权重下成本、参与式输入和危害缓解效果的变化。

Result: 该方法能够探索参与式与专家成分之间的不同平衡，允许政策制定者根据实际情况调整各因素的权重；遗传算法发现的多样化可行政策组合可作为政策审议的有用起点。

Conclusion: 该方法将参与式AI的现有研究成果操作化，直接集成到实际政策开发流程中，为AI治理政策优先级的确定提供了实用的工具支持。

Abstract: As the rapid proliferation of AI systems and harms spurs efforts in AI governance around the world, prioritizing among competing policy options has become increasingly challenging for policymakers and researchers. We introduce a methodology for identifying viable policy options to mitigate specified AI harms, helping policymakers and researchers target areas that warrant greater time and resource investment. This method combines participatory evaluation of policies, expert assessment of implementation costs, and an LLM-based assessment of perceived harm mitigation under each policy option. We leverage a genetic algorithm-based simulation study to explore a vast solution space of potential policy combinations, and examine how outcomes change under different weightings of cost, participatory input, and harm mitigation. We find that this method enables exploration of different balances between participatory and expert components, allowing policymakers and researchers to assess how much weight to assign to each. We argue that the diversity of viable policy combinations found by the genetic algorithm could be a useful starting point for deliberation. This method operationalizes existing work on participatory AI by integrating it directly into practical policy development pipelines.

</details>


### [199] [Agentic Literacy Debt: A Structural Problem the AI Literacy Field Has Not Yet Named](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27396)
*Rohith Nama*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"代理素养债务"概念，指当自主AI代理系统大规模部署而缺乏相应素养基础设施时，社会积累的赤字。该债务通过三个渠道（不透明委托常态化、多代理生态系统复杂性、制度路径依赖）复合增长，由部署组织造成但由用户、患者和公民承担。证据显示医疗、金融欺诈和全球公平领域已出现严重后果。这是结构性而非暂时性问题，需将AI素养从评估能力重新框架为治理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架仅适用于人类评估AI输出并决定是否行动的场景，无法描述已将决策权委托给不可观察、不可逆、不可控代理的用户。当自主AI代理大规模部署时，社会缺乏相应的素养基础设施，导致日益严重的结构性赤字。

Method: 通过命名"代理素养债务"概念，识别三个复合增长渠道（不透明委托常态化、多代理生态系统复杂性、制度路径依赖），并援引医疗、金融欺诈和全球公平领域的证据来论证问题的存在与紧迫性。

Result: 揭示了代理素养债务是一个结构性、复合增长的社会问题，而非通过课程改革就能弥补的暂时性滞后。三个渠道相互强化，且成本由用户而非部署组织承担。

Conclusion: 需要将AI素养从评估能力重新框架为治理能力，以应对自主代理时代的结构性挑战。这是一个治理问题，而非教育问题。

Abstract: Autonomous AI agents now plan, decide, and act on behalf of users across healthcare, financial services, and workplace contexts, often without step-by-step human approval. Existing AI literacy frameworks were built for a world in which humans evaluate AI outputs and decide whether to act; they have no vocabulary for the user who has delegated decision-making authority to an agent whose actions may not be observable, reversible, or controllable. This paper names the resulting problem agentic literacy debt: the accumulating societal deficit that grows when agentic AI systems are deployed at scale without corresponding literacy infrastructure. The debt compounds through three reinforcing channels (normalization of opaque delegation, multi-agent ecosystem complexity, and institutional path dependence), and it is incurred by the organizations that deploy agents but paid by the users, patients, and citizens on whose behalf the agents act. Evidence from healthcare, financial fraud, and global equity contexts suggests the gap is already consequential. The problem is structural, not a temporary lag that curriculum reform will close. It demands a reframing of AI literacy as a governance capability, not an evaluative one.

</details>


### [200] [Democratizing Generative AI for Sustainable Competitive Advantage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27398)
*Carlos J. Costa,Joao Tiago Aparício,Manuela Aparício*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个跨层次概念框架，将企业层面的生成式AI投资与治理同员工层面的AI民主化（即员工在工作中有意义、负责任且有效地使用GenAI的程度）联系起来。基于技术接受模型、资源基础理论及AI生产力效应的实证证据，提出六个命题，认为个体层面的AI民主化（以AI有用性、易用性和AI素养为微观基础）中介了组织GenAI投资与可持续竞争优势之间的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI在各行业扩散并变得广泛可及，可持续竞争优势的焦点从技术所有权转向员工层面的采纳与使用质量。本文旨在提供一个理论框架，解释组织层面的GenAI投资如何通过个体层面的AI民主化过程影响可持续竞争优势。

Method: 采用跨层次概念框架构建方法，整合技术接受模型（TAM）、资源基础理论（RBV）及AI生产力效应的新兴实证证据，提出六个研究命题，涵盖感知有用性、易用性、AI素养、负责任使用及创新成果对组织转型和持续相对绩效的影响。

Result: 构建了一个包含三层结构的概念框架：（1）组织层面：GenAI投资与治理；（2）个体层面：AI民主化（AI有用性、易用性、AI素养三个微观基础）；（3）结果层面：可持续竞争优势。提出了六个命题并提供了测量支架。

Conclusion: 结论强调应将GenAI视为增强型基础设施而非纯粹的自动化工具，为实证研究提供测量框架和管理指导，并指出未来研究方向包括纵向研究和跨文化研究，重点关注素养、治理与转型动态。

Abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) diffuses across industries and becomes broadly accessible, the locus of sustainable competitive advantage shifts from technology ownership toward the quality of employee-level adoption and use. This paper develops a cross-level conceptual framework linking firm-level GenAI investment and governance to individual-level AI democratization, defined as the extent to which employees meaningfully, responsibly, and effectively use GenAI in their daily work. We argue that individual-level AI democratization, grounded in three micro foundations (AI usefulness, ease of use, and AI literacy), mediates the relationship between organizational GenAI investments and sustainable competitive advantage. Drawing on the technology acceptance model, resource-based theory, and emerging empirical evidence on AI productivity effects, we advance six propositions linking perceived usefulness, ease of use, AI literacy, responsible use, and innovation outcomes to organizational transformation and sustained relative performance. The framework provides a measurement scaffold for empirical research and offers managerial guidance on treating GenAI as augmentation infrastructure rather than solely as automation. We conclude by outlining future research directions, including longitudinal and cross-cultural investigations of literacy, governance, and transformation dynamics.

</details>


### [201] [Short-Term Gain, Long-Term Fragility: AI Labor Substitution and the Erosion of Sustainable Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27399)
*Wolfgang Rohde*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"能力遮蔽与能力侵蚀"机制，揭示AI替代人类劳动表面上提升效率，实则通过消耗难以快速重建的人力能力，将短期收益建立在长期脆弱性之上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 批判当前将AI替代人类劳动简单视为技术进步的理性选择这一主流叙事，指出该视角存在结构性短视，忽视了短期效率提升背后的人力能力损耗和长期系统脆弱性。

Method: 构建"能力遮蔽与能力侵蚀"理论机制，结合AI辅助编程的正反两面证据、劳动力市场分析、政治经济学视角以及产业战略证据进行多维度论证。

Result: AI生成输出仍需大量人工验证，在正确性、可维护性和安全性方面表现不均；仓库级研究显示AI在处理更大代码库上下文方面存在局限；替代压力由管理层的成本激励和国家竞争驱动，同时增加了行业集中度和平台控制风险。

Conclusion: 当前AI替代劳动的系统在短期内看似更高效，但长期而言变得更加脆弱，实质是将当前负担悄悄转移至未来。

Abstract: What looks like acceleration can be a quiet transfer of burden from the present to the future. Attempts to replace human labor with AI systems are often presented as rational responses to technological progress, but that view is often structurally short-sighted. Across software development and adjacent knowledge industries, AI is increasingly attractive because it appears to reduce labor costs, speed output, and improve short-term metrics. Yet those gains may be achieved by drawing down human capabilities that are slow to build and difficult to restore. This paper develops a mechanism of capability masking and capability erosion under AI labor substitution. AI-generated output can create the appearance that organizational capability has been replaced, even when dependence on skilled human labor remains. That appearance can support hiring restraint while slower costs accumulate in the background. Evidence from AI-assisted coding shows that generated output still requires substantial human verification and remains uneven in correctness, maintainability, and security. Repository-level studies also suggest limits in handling broader codebase context. More broadly, labor-market, political-economy, and industrial-strategy evidence suggests that substitution pressures are being driven by managerial cost incentives and national competition while increasing risks of concentration and platform control. The result is a system that may look more efficient in the short term while becoming more fragile over time.

</details>


### [202] [Mathematical Modelling of Ethical AI Use in Higher Education: A Coordination Game Framework for Future-Facing Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27400)
*Ndidi Bianca Ogbo,Zhao Song,Shatha Ghareeb,The Anh Han*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过演化博弈论框架，将学生AI使用重新定义为由同伴期望和评估设计塑造的协调问题，发现反思性评估激励的小幅调整可引发学生AI使用行为的非线性转变，为高等教育提供了基于分析工具的、以教学为导向的AI治理方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高等教育中生成式AI的快速普及加剧了学术诚信、公平性和学习质量的担忧，现有机构应对措施多侧重于政策指导和伦理原则，但缺乏对学生群体中负责任的AI使用规范如何形成和稳定的正式理解。

Method: 开发了一个基于协调的演化博弈论框架，建模学习价值、努力、感知公平性和透明度四个变量，通过分析解和有限种群模拟分析反思性评估激励对学生AI使用行为的影响。

Result: 发现学生AI使用存在阈值驱动的行为转变：反思性评估激励的小幅校准可引发向负责任、学习导向的AI使用规范的快速转变，而薄弱或错位的激励则使机会主义行为持续存在。这些非线性动态解释了政策声明常无法改变行为而适度评估重新设计可产生不成比例效应的原因。

Conclusion: 为高等教育机构提供了一个机制层面的分析工具，支持比例性、教学主导的AI治理，无需依赖监控或惩罚性措施。

Abstract: The rapid uptake of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in higher education is reshaping assessment practices and intensifying concerns around academic integrity, fairness, and learning quality. While institutional responses increasingly emphasise policy guidance and ethical principles, there remains limited formal understanding of how collective norms of responsible or opportunistic AI use emerge and stabilise within student cohorts. This paper reframes student AI use in assessment as a coordination problem shaped by peer expectations and assessment design rather than individual compliance alone. We develop a coordination-based evolutionary game-theoretic framework that captures learning value, effort, perceived fairness, and transparency, with institutional AI governance modelled implicitly through reflective assessment incentives.
  We use analytical results and finite-population simulations to reveal threshold-driven behavioural transitions in student AI use: small, well-calibrated changes in reflective assessment incentives can trigger rapid shifts towards responsible, learning-oriented AI-use norms, whereas weak or misaligned incentives allow opportunistic practices to persist. These non-linear dynamics explain why policy statements alone often fail to change behaviour, while modest assessment redesigns can have disproportionate effects. By providing a mechanism-level account of how assessment structures shape collective AI-use practices, this work offers higher education institutions an analytically grounded tool for Future Facing Learning, supporting proportionate, pedagogy-led AI governance without reliance on surveillance or punitive enforcement.

</details>


### [203] [Using Zero-Shot LLM-Generated Survey Data for Geographically Explicit Population Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27401)
*Taylor Anderson,Sara Von Hoene,Orhan Yagizer Cinar,Emma Von Hoene,Amira Roess,Andrew Crooks,Hamdi Kavak*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评估了零样本大语言模型（GPT-4.1和Gemini-2.5-Pro）生成的健康调查数据能否作为传统迭代比例拟合（IPF）工作流程的输入用于地理显式人口合成。基于2023年BRFSS数据对科罗拉多州和密西西比州进行实验，结果显示LLM能捕捉州级差异但变量依赖性强烈，下游人口合成效果喜忧参半，空间验证显示LLM生成数据可作为补充输入但尚不能替代真实调查数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用合成人口满足多样化应用需求增长迅速，同时AI技术快速发展，探索能否用零样本LLM生成调查数据替代传统真实调查数据以降低成本、提高效率。

Method: 使用GPT-4.1和Gemini-2.5-Pro零样本生成2023年BRFSS健康调查数据（针对科罗拉多州和密西西比州），将生成数据输入IPF人口合成流程，并与外部基准进行普查区层面验证评估。

Result: LLM能捕捉州级人口健康特征差异，但不同变量表现差异显著；IPF过程有时放大有时缩小生成数据的误差；空间验证显示LLM生成人群在普查区层面模式复现尚可，与真实数据一致性高的变量表现更好。

Conclusion: 零样本LLM生成调查数据作为IPF人口合成的补充输入有潜力，但目前尚不能完全替代真实调查数据。

Abstract: There is a growing interest in utilizing synthetic populations for a diverse range of applications. At the same time, we are witnessing a tremendous growth in artificial intelligence in all walks of life. This paper evaluates whether zero-shot large language model (LLM)-generated health survey data can serve as inputs to a conventional iterative proportional fitting (IPF) workflow for geographically explicit population synthesis. Using the 2023 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), we generate synthetic survey records for the U.S. states of Colorado and Mississippi with GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5-Pro. We use the generated data in an IPF-based synthesis pipeline and evaluate the resulting census tract-level synthetic populations against external benchmarks. Results show both LLMs capture several major state-level contrasts, indicating zero-shot generation produces geographically differentiated survey data. However, performance is strongly variable-dependent. Downstream effects in population synthesis are mixed, as IPF sometimes amplifies or reduces errors in the generated data. Spatial validation shows that LLM-based populations reproduce census tract-level patterns reasonably well, especially for variables that were more aligned with the ground truth data. Overall, the LLM-generated survey data shows promise as supplementary input, but not yet as a replacement for real survey data.

</details>


### [204] [REC-CBM: Rubric-Aware Error-Correction Concept Bottleneck Models for Trustworthy Open-Ended Grading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27402)
*Chengshuai Zhao,Fan Zhang,Kumar Satvik Chaudhary,Yiwen Li,Lo Pang-Yun Ting,Ying-Chih Chen,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出REC-CBM，一种面向开放式评分任务的、基于概念瓶颈模型的可解释自动评分方法，通过引入rubric感知的概念编码器、序数成对校准目标和潜在概念纠错模块，在保持可解释性的同时提升了评分性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动评分系统（神经网络和LLM）虽表现优异但为黑盒模型，难以被教育者验证和信任；标准概念瓶颈模型不适用于开放式评分，未能显式建模细粒度评分维度、未充分捕捉评分量表的序数语义、且忽略了人工概念标注中固有的可靠性问题。

Method: REC-CBM包含三个核心组件：(1) rubric感知概念编码器，学习针对每个评分维度的概念表示；(2) 序数成对校准目标，保持评分维度间的排序结构；(3) 潜在概念纠错模块，在最终评分预测前对概念预测进行去噪处理，同时保持可解释性。

Result: 在公开数据集上的综合实验表明，REC-CBM在评分性能上持续优于最先进基线，并产生了更忠实的概念级推理。进一步分析验证了各组成部分的贡献及在真实教育场景中的适用性。

Conclusion: REC-CBM提供了一种实用的、可解释的评分解决方案，使教育者能够检查、干预并信任自动化决策，推动了更透明和可信赖的教育评估。

Abstract: Open-ended grading is central to equitable and personalized education, yet manual grading remains time-consuming and costly, underscoring the need for automated grading systems. Although recent neural and large language model (LLM) based systems have demonstrated superior performance, they are typically black-box models whose scoring processes and rationales are difficult for educators to verify and trust. Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) have emerged as a promising approach by routing predictions through human-interpretable concepts, providing a mechanistic guarantee of transparency. However, standard CBMs are not tailored to open-ended grading: they do not explicitly model fine-grained rubric dimensions, inadequately capture the ordinal semantics of scoring scales, and neglect inherent reliability issues in human concept annotations. To address these limitations, we propose REC-CBM, a rubric-aware error-correction concept bottleneck model for trustworthy open-ended grading. REC-CBM introduces a rubric-aware concept encoder that learns concept-specific representations over responses and an ordinal pairwise calibration objective that preserves ranking structure among rubric dimensions. It further incorporates a latent concept error-correction module that denoises concept predictions before final grade prediction while preserving interpretability. Comprehensive experiments on publicly available datasets show that REC-CBM consistently improves grading performance and produces more faithful concept-level reasoning than both state-of-the-art baselines. Further analyses validate the contribution of each component and demonstrate the applicability in realistic educational settings. Overall, this work provides a practical, interpretable grading solution that enables educators to inspect, intervene in, and trust automated decisions, advancing more transparent and trustworthy education.

</details>


### [205] [LLM-assisted sentiment analysis for integrated computational and qualitative mixed methods education research: A case study of students' written reflection assignments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27403)
*Xiomara Gonzalez,Gabriella Coloyan Fleming,Andrew Katz,Maya Denton,Jessica Deters*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型（LLM）辅助情感分析与统计检验、质性分析的混合方法工作流，用于高效分析学生书面反思文本中的多变量群体差异。以151份留学项目学生反思为案例，发现仅“先前海外生活经历”显著影响学生对语言沟通行为的情感倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质性反思数据虽富含教育研究价值，但分析耗时；跨群体比较通常局限于单一变量（如二元性别），难以高效处理多变量比较。

Method: 采用纵向案例（n=151留学反思），先用LLM辅助情感分析提取情感倾向，通过统计检验比较7个学生身份/生活经历变量的情感差异，再以质性分析探究差异原因。

Result: 仅“先前海外生活经历”是影响学生对语言沟通行为情感的唯一显著个人变量。

Conclusion: 该工作流使质性研究者能够更便捷地探测多个变量在群体比较中的影响，为混合方法研究提供了可扩展的分析范式。

Abstract: Written reflection assignments give students valuable opportunities for critical self-assessment, meaning making, and learning processing. Additionally, such reflections provide rich data for qualitative education research. However, qualitative data can be time-consuming to analyze. It is even more time-intensive to qualitatively compare findings between different groups of participants, usually limiting comparison to, at most, one variable (e.g., binary gender). Large language models (LLMs) have recently begun to be critically evaluated for use as qualitative research assistants. Using a longitudinal case of written student reflections (n=151) from a study abroad program, we investigate how LLM-assisted sentiment analysis can enable longitudinal mixed-methods research combining computational and thematic analyses. First, statistical testing is used to quantitatively compare sentiment differences according to seven different student identity/lived experience variables. Then, these results inform qualitative data analysis to investigate the reasons underlying these differences. For the case of undergraduate students studying abroad, we found that prior experience living abroad was the only personal variable impacting students' sentiments of their verbal language and communication behaviors. This workflow has implications for how qualitative researchers can more easily probe multiple variables when comparing participants from different demographic groups.

</details>


### [206] [Smaller, Younger, and More Impactful: How AI-Assisted Writing Transforms Research Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27404)
*Haoyang Wang,Mingze Zhang,Yi Bu,Star Xing Zhao,Meijun Liu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 基于PLoS和Nature系列期刊2020年后的147,074篇全文，研究发现使用AI辅助写作的研究团队更年轻、规模更小，且这一转变并未降低科学影响力，反而增加了产出高影响力论文的概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究人工智能（特别是大语言模型）是否以及如何影响研究团队结构和团队成果，挑战长期以来科研团队规模不断扩大的趋势。

Method: 收集PLoS和Nature系列期刊2020年后的147,074篇全文，采用普通最小二乘法、分位数回归、泊松回归、逻辑回归和倾向得分匹配等多种方法进行分析。

Result: 使用AI辅助写作的研究团队倾向于更年轻、更小型化，且这种向紧凑型、年轻化团队的转变并未牺牲科学影响力，反而增加了产出高影响力论文的概率。

Conclusion: AI辅助写作在重塑研究生产方式的同时，也在重塑团队形成与组建方式。研究呼吁在研究评估、资助和培训方面进行政策改进以应对这一新兴趋势。

Abstract: The era of Big Science has long been defined by increasingly large and specialized research teams pushing the frontiers of knowledge. However, recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), are beginning to reshape academic writing and scientific research, potentially disrupting the longstanding trend toward ever-larger teams and transforming other dimensions of research team structure. Drawing on 147,074 full-text publications from the PLoS family and the Nature portfolio since 2020, we examined whether and how AI-assisted writing influences team structure and team outcomes in science. Using multiple methods, including ordinary least square, quantile regression, Poisson regression, logistic regression and propensity score matching, we found that research teams using AI-assisted writing tend to be younger and smaller. Importantly, this shift toward more compact, junior-leaning teams does not come at the expense of scientific impact. On the contrary, we observed a higher probability of research teams that employed AI-assisted writing producing highly impactful publications. These results highlight the significant role of AI-assisted writing in reshaping not only how research is produced, but also how research teams are formed and assembled. Our findings call for policy improvements in research evaluation, funding, and training to address this emerging trend.

</details>


### [207] [Local Privacy Laws in a Globalized World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27801)
*Shantanu Sharma,Ethan Myers,Lorenzo De Carli,Ritwik Banerjee,Indrakshi Ray*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文指出当前数字隐私研究过度聚焦于欧盟GDPR等少数西方监管框架，忽略了其他地区的隐私问题，形成研究盲点。作者通过将多国数据保护法律统一定义为基于数据生命周期的抽象模型，并分析其对用户、组织和政府等利益相关者的影响，旨在拓宽数字隐私研究的视角，为跨国的技术隐私解决方案提供指导原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前数字隐私研究主要围绕欧盟GDPR等西方监管框架展开，忽视了其他地区用户的隐私关注、态度和问题，造成了显著的研究盲点。

Method: 将多个数据保护法律的异构法律要求系统性地规范化，统一抽象为基于数据生命周期的统一模型，并分析这些法律对不同利益相关者的影响。

Result: 形成了基于数据生命周期的统一抽象模型，该模型可作为跨多国数据保护法规实施的基础，并阐明了不同利益相关者的影响。

Conclusion: 该工作旨在拓宽数字隐私研究社区的视野，并为开发跨越多个国家的技术隐私解决方案提供指导原则。

Abstract: Personal data has emerged as a highly valuable yet sensitive asset that drives business decisions, enables targeted advertising, and generates substantial revenue for companies, while simultaneously facilitating invasive monitoring of users. In recent years, research on digital privacy violations, including undue access, collection, and sharing of user data, has grown significantly. Much of this research adopts the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) as the primary reference framework. This is reasonable, as GDPR was a pioneering legislation, and many of its stipulations are clear and unambiguous. However, we argue that focusing solely on GDPR (and a small set of other Western regulatory frameworks) ignores privacy-related concerns, attitudes, and problems faced by users from other locales, creating a significant research blind spot. This work systematically normalizes the heterogeneous legal requirements of multiple data protection laws into a unified abstraction aligned with the data lifecycle, which forms the foundation for the implementation of such regulations. We further investigate the implications of these laws on different stakeholders, including users, organizations, and governments. Overall, this work aims to broaden the digital privacy research community's perspective and to serve as a set of guiding principles for developing technological privacy solutions spanning multiple countries.

</details>


### [208] [Execution and assessment of agentic influence operations in simulated social networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28725)
*Alejandro Buitrago López,David Montoro Aguilera,Javier Pastor-Galindo,José A. Ruipérez-Valiente*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过合成社交网络的受控仿真，评估了AI赋能的影响力操作，包括叙事发布、放大和反信息传播，测量了暴露量和信念变化，发现放大策略最大化覆盖范围，反信息传播最有效地改变观点，而叙事发布需要更大的攻击者足迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估AI赋能的影响力操作在合成社交网络中的效果，理解叙事发布、放大和反信息传播三种策略对受众暴露和信念变化的影响。

Method: 通过受控仿真实验，在合成社交网络中模拟AI赋能的叙事发布、放大和反信息传播操作，测量代理受众的暴露量和信念变化。

Result: 放大策略最大化覆盖范围，反信息传播最有效地改变观点，叙事发布需要更大的攻击者足迹。

Conclusion: 不同类型的AI赋能影响力操作在合成社交网络中具有不同的效果特征，反信息传播在改变观点方面最有效，而放大策略在扩大覆盖范围方面最优。

Abstract: This article evaluates AI-enabled influence operations in synthetic social networks through controlled simulations of narrative release, amplification, and counter-messaging. We measure exposure and belief change in agentic audiences, showing that amplification maximizes reach, counter-messaging shifts opinions most, and narrative release requires larger attacker footprints.

</details>


### [209] [Self-directed online information search can affect policy support: a randomized encouragement design with digital behavioral data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03097)
*Celina Kacperski,Roberto Ulloa,Peter Selb,Andreas Spitz,Denis Bonnay,Juhi Kulshrestha*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过三波田野实验（n=791）结合数字追踪数据，研究发现自我导向的在线信息搜索在金钱激励条件下能显著改变公民对儿童抚养金和大麻合法化的政策支持，但对能源转型议题无效，验证了动机激活是数字环境中政策支持改变的关键条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数字环境中公民越来越多地接触政治信息，但自我导向的信息搜索是否以及如何影响政策观点尚不明确。作者基于双过程说服理论，认为动机激活是促成政策支持改变的关键条件，旨在检验不同激励方式（口头鼓励与金钱激励）对在线信息搜索行为及政策态度变化的影响。

Method: 采用三波田野实验设计，对791名德国参与者就三个政策议题（基本儿童抚养金、可再生能源转型、大麻合法化）进行随机分组：对照组、口头鼓励组和金钱激励组（与知识测试挂钩）。通过数字追踪数据被动记录参与者20小时内的浏览行为，比较不同条件下政策支持的变化。

Result: 自我导向的在线信息搜索在儿童抚养金和大麻合法化两个议题上产生了显著的政策支持变化，但在能源转型议题上未见显著效果。金钱激励条件产生了显著效应，而口头提示则未产生显著影响。

Conclusion: 动机显著性、议题可塑性以及搜索环境质量是政治信息参与能够产生可检测的政策支持变化的三项联合条件。金钱激励比口头鼓励更有效地激活动机，从而促使政策态度改变。

Abstract: As citizens increasingly encounter political information in digital environments, understanding whether this engagement shapes their policy views has become a central concern. Drawing on dual-process theories of persuasion, we argue that motivational activation is an enabling condition for policy support change in high-choice online environments. We test this in a three-wave field experiment with German participants (n = 791) across three policy topics (basic child support, renewable energy transition, cannabis legalization), in which participants were randomly assigned to a control group, and two encouragement conditions: a verbal encouragement, or a monetary incentive tied to a knowledge test. Browsing behavior was passively tracked via digital trace data over a 20-hour window. We find that self-directed online information search produced changes in policy support for child support and cannabis legalization but not for the energy transition, with monetary incentives producing significant effects rather than verbal prompts. We discuss motivational salience, issue malleability, and search-environment quality as joint conditions under which political information engagement can produce detectable changes in policy support.

</details>


### [210] [Evaluating Chinese Large Language Models: The Influence of Persona Assignment on Stereotypes and Safeguards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.04975)
*Geng Liu,Li Feng,Carlo Alberto Bono,Songbo Yang,Mengxiao Zhu,Francesco Pierri*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对四个中文大语言模型进行大规模跨模型分析（超140万生成文本），揭示了角色设定驱动的毒性放大现象，包括系统性性别差异，并通过回归分析量化了角色类别、目标社会群体和提示模板对拒绝行为与输出毒性的独立及联合影响，最后探索了一种基于外部评估器引导的迭代缓解策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究聚焦于角色设定对LLM有害内容生成的放大效应，但缺乏非西方语境（尤其是中文LLM）下的系统分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 对四个中文LLM进行大规模跨模型分析，构建超140万文本数据集；采用模型特定回归分析，量化角色类别、目标社会群体和提示模板对拒绝行为与输出毒性的独立及联合影响；并探索基于外部LLM评估器引导的迭代缓解策略。

Result: 发现中文LLM中存在显著的角色驱动拒绝行为差异，包括系统性性别差异；提供角色驱动毒性放大的定量证据，且放大程度在不同模型间差异显著；该放大由角色条件、提示策略、目标社会群体和模型安全机制的交互作用驱动。

Conclusion: 强调了中文LLM需进行文化语境化的安全评估，并提供了一个评估角色诱导风险及探索性缓解策略的结构化框架。

Abstract: Recent research has highlighted that assigning specific personas to large language models (LLMs) can significantly increase harmful content generation. However, limited attention has been given to persona-driven toxicity in non-Western contexts, particularly in Chinese-based LLMs. In this paper, we perform a large-scale, cross-model analysis of refusal behavior and persona-driven toxicity amplification across four Chinese LLMs, leveraging a comprehensive dataset of over 1,400,000 generated texts. We identify significant disparities in persona-driven refusal behavior, including systematic gender differences in refusal triggering across the evaluated Chinese LLMs. Furthermore, we provide quantitative evidence of persona-driven toxicity amplification with respect to model default baselines. We show that this amplification--whose magnitude varies substantially across models--is driven by interactions across several factors, involving persona conditioning, prompting strategy, target social group, and model-specific safety mechanisms. Leveraging model-specific regression analyses, we systematically characterize how persona categories, target social groups, and prompt templates independently and jointly shape both refusal behavior and output toxicity. As a complementary case study, we further explore an iterative, evaluator-guided mitigation strategy based on model feedback with an external LLM evaluator, demonstrating that highly toxic outputs can be substantially reduced without costly model retraining. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of culturally contextualized safety evaluations for Chinese-language LLMs and provide a structured framework for assessing persona-induced risks and exploratory mitigation strategies in LLM-generated content.

</details>


### [211] [Evaluation of AI Ethics Tools in Language Models: A Developers' Perspective Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15791)
*Jhessica Silva,Diego A. B. Moreira,Gabriel O. dos Santos,Alef Ferreira,Helena Maia,Sandra Avila,Helio Pedrini*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种评估人工智能伦理工具（AIETs）在语言模型中应用的方法。通过对213个AIETs进行文献调查，筛选出4个工具（Model Cards、ALTAI、FactSheets、Harms Modeling），并将其应用于葡萄牙语语言模型的开发中，通过35小时开发者访谈进行评估。结果表明这些工具能指导一般性伦理考量，但未能解决语言模型的独特方面（如惯用表达），也未能帮助识别葡萄牙语模型的潜在负面影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI伦理工具（AIETs）的出版物数量近年来快速增长，旨在帮助相关方建立可信、透明、负责任的技术，但许多AIETs缺乏良好的文档、使用示例和实际有效性证明。因此，需要一种系统的方法来评估这些工具在语言模型中的实际效果。

Method: 首先对213个AIETs进行广泛文献调查，经过纳入和排除标准筛选出4个工具（Model Cards, ALTAI, FactSheets, Harms Modeling）。然后将这些工具应用于葡萄牙语语言模型，通过35小时的开发者访谈收集他们对工具使用体验和质量的反馈。

Result: 所选AIETs能够作为制定语言模型一般性伦理考量的指南，但它们未能涵盖语言模型的独特方面（如惯用表达），且未能帮助识别葡萄牙语模型的潜在负面影响。

Conclusion: 现有AI伦理工具虽有一定指导价值，但在处理语言模型独特特征和特定语言（如葡萄牙语）的潜在负面影响方面存在明显不足，需要进一步改进或开发更具针对性的工具。

Abstract: In Artificial Intelligence (AI), language models have gained significant importance due to the widespread adoption of systems capable of simulating realistic conversations with humans through text generation. Because of their impact on society, developing and deploying these language models must be done responsibly, with attention to their negative impacts and possible harms. In this scenario, the number of AI Ethics Tools (AIETs) publications has recently increased. These AIETs are designed to help developers, companies, governments, and other stakeholders establish trust, transparency, and responsibility with their technologies by bringing accepted values to guide AI's design, development, and use stages. However, many AIETs lack good documentation, examples of use, and proof of their effectiveness in practice. This paper presents a methodology for evaluating AIETs in language models. Our approach involved an extensive literature survey on 213 AIETs, and after applying inclusion and exclusion criteria, we selected four AIETs: Model Cards, ALTAI, FactSheets, and Harms Modeling. For evaluation, we applied AIETs to language models developed for the Portuguese language, conducting 35 hours of interviews with their developers. The evaluation considered the developers' perspective on the AIETs' use and quality in helping to identify ethical considerations about their model. The results suggest that the applied AIETs serve as a guide for formulating general ethical considerations about language models. However, we note that they do not address unique aspects of these models, such as idiomatic expressions. Additionally, these AIETs did not help to identify potential negative impacts of models for the Portuguese language.

</details>


### [212] [A Methodological Guide on Using Large Language Models for Reproducible Text Annotation in the Social Sciences and Humanities with Python and R](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09638)
*Qixiang Fang,Javier Garcia Bernardo,Erik-Jan van Kesteren*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文为社会科学与人文学科研究者提供了一份使用大语言模型进行文本标注的逐步方法论指南，涵盖从项目设置、提示设计、统计集成到可重复性管理的全流程，并配有Python和R的实践示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LLMs在社会科学与人文学科的文本分析中被越来越多地用于自动化标注，但许多研究者仍面临采用LLMs、应对其局限性以及生成可重复工作流与结果的挑战，例如标注误差即使在准确率较高时也会使下游统计分析产生偏差。

Method: 本文采用方法论指南的形式，系统性地阐述了：LLMs的工作原理、研究项目设置方法、程序化调用（开源）LLMs的方式、提示设计与评估而不过拟合的策略、将LLM标注结果纳入统计分析并校正标注误差的方法，以及大规模管理成本、效率和可重复性的最佳实践，并配有Python和R的实践示例。

Result: 提供了一套完整的、面向社会科学与人文学科的LLM文本标注方法论框架，强调了方法论推理、具体示例和最佳实践，帮助研究者将基于LLM的标注纳入可重复的科学工作流。

Conclusion: 通过该指南，研究者能够更有效地使用LLM进行文本标注，同时理解并应对标注误差对统计推断的影响，提升研究工作的可重复性和科学性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by researchers in the social sciences and humanities (SSH) for text analysis, particularly to automate text annotation. However, many researchers still face challenges in adopting LLMs, addressing their limitations, and producing reproducible workflows and results. For example, annotation errors can bias downstream statistical analyses even when apparent accuracy is high. This paper provides a step-by-step methodological guide to using LLMs for text annotation in SSH research, with practical Python and R examples. We explain how LLMs work, how to set up research projects, how to interact with (open-source) LLMs programmatically, how to design and evaluate prompts without overfitting, how to integrate LLM annotations into statistical analyses while accounting for annotation error, and how to manage cost, efficiency, and reproducibility at scale. Throughout, we emphasize intuitive methodological reasoning, concrete examples, and best practices to help researchers incorporate LLM-based annotation into reproducible scientific workflows.

</details>


### [213] [Inside Baseball: The Automated Ball-Strike System as an Object Lesson in Technological Rule Enforcement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16237)
*Andrea Wen-Yi Wang,Waki Kamino,David Mimno,Karen Levy,Malte F. Jung*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过研究美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）长达七年的自动好球-坏球系统（ABS）实验，揭示了即使是规则书明确定义的规则，在技术化实现过程中也需要复杂的转化过程，挑战了"清晰规则易于自动化"的常规假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"清晰定义的规则可以直接自动化"的假设，通过MLB的ABS系统案例展示规则的技术化实现并非简单直接的过程。

Method: 对MLB的ABS系统七年的设计决策进行追踪，运用科学与技术研究（STS）的分析框架进行案例研究。

Result: 发现"清晰规则"与"技术实现"之间存在距离，原因在于：(1)历史上好球带的"地面实况"存在争议，实际规则一直反映规则书定义与裁判执法决策的混合；(2)技术执行系统的嵌入需要在现有生态系统中平衡多方利益相关者的价值。

Conclusion: 挑战以规则形式化与其技术实现之间距离为中心的传统评估范式，主张评估此类系统在实践中的体验，这需要深入的社会科学方法。

Abstract: Clearly-defined rules are often assumed to be straightforward to automate and evaluate. We challenge this assumption through an in-depth study of Major League Baseball's (MLB) seven-year experimentation with the Automated Ball-Strike System (ABS). ABS is envisioned to call balls and strikes accurately: a seemingly straightforward use of technology to objectively determine the distance between a pitch and the strike zone. Although the strike zone is an area clearly defined in the rulebook, it took MLB seven years to figure out how to automate calling balls and strikes with ABS, showing how even seemingly straightforward rules require a complex translation process to operationalize via technological systems. In this paper, we trace the design decisions that led to the current implementation of ABS. Our case study reveals that "distance" exists even between a clear rule and its technological implementation. Using analytic frameworks from Science and Technology Studies (STS), we show that such distance exists because (1) historically, the "ground truth" of the strike zone is contested: the rule in practice has always reflected a hybrid between the rulebook definition and umpires' enforcement decisions; and (2) the use of ABS is embedded in an existing eco-system, where the implementation of a technological enforcement system needs to balance multiple stakeholder values. This perspective challenges conventional evaluation paradigms that center on the distance between a formalized rule and its technological implementation, and instead calls for evaluating how such systems are experienced in practice. Addressing this question requires in-depth social science approaches, contributing to ongoing conversations in FAccT about the implementation and evaluation of sociotechnical systems.

</details>


### [214] [From Prediction to Intervention: The Evolution of AI in Biomedicine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16293)
*Andrew Feinberg,Aleksandr Sarachakov,Viktor Svekolkin,Alexander Bagaev,Ferran Prat,Michael Feinberg*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出生物医学AI正从基于历史数据的观察性推理转向能够模拟干预效果的工具性智能，并定义了疾病级模型作为实现这一转变的核心框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI系统本质上是观察性的，只能从历史数据中学习统计关联，无法泛化到新疗法或未观测的干预场景，而生物医学决策本质上是关于干预的推理，因此现有预测架构在结构上不足以支持临床决策。

Method: 提出了区分观察性智能与干预性智能的概念框架，定义了疾病级模型——能够显式表征生物过程的状态、动力学和对干预响应的系统，实现从推理到模拟的转变。

Result: 论证了价值创造将从数据处理和预测转向支持并定义干预决策的系统；无法建模干预的系统将从结构上被排除在决策之外。

Conclusion: 生物医学AI正经历结构性转型，从观察性学习转向干预性模拟，疾病级模型将成为下一阶段AI在医学中应用的核心范式。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced rapidly in biomedicine through large-scale multimodal data integration, enabling increasingly accurate prediction of clinical outcomes and patient stratification. These systems, however, remain fundamentally observational: they learn statistical associations from historical data and operate within previously observed biological and clinical states, limiting their ability to generalize to novel therapies or unobserved interventions.
  We argue that AI in biomedicine is undergoing a structural transition. As biomedical decision-making increasingly depends on reasoning about intervention rather than extrapolation from past observations, predictive architectures become structurally insufficient. Systems that learn from historical data cannot, by construction, represent how biological systems evolve under perturbation, and therefore cannot reliably support decision-making in the presence of novel interventions.
  We introduce a conceptual framework distinguishing observational and interventional intelligence and define disease-level models as systems that explicitly represent the state, dynamics, and intervention response of biological processes. These models enable a shift from inference to simulation -- reasoning about what will happen under intervention rather than what is likely based on the past.
  This transition also implies a shift in where value is created: from data processing and prediction toward systems that support and define decision-making under intervention. It follows directly from the structure of biomedical decision-making and defines the next stage of AI in medicine. Systems that cannot model intervention will be structurally excluded from decision-making.

</details>


### [215] [KT4EQG: Personalized Exercise Question Generation via Knowledge Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23933)
*Xinyi Gao,Qiucheng Wu,Lu Ding,Q. Vera Liao,Kaizhi Qian,Ying Xu,Shiyu Chang,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出KT4EQG框架，利用知识追踪（KT）模型指导个性化教育题目生成，通过KT选择最合适学生练习的知识概念，再训练LLM生成基于该概念的题目，实验证明该方法优于缺乏个性化或个性化有限的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有教育题目生成（EQG）方法大多缺乏细粒度的个性化能力，无法针对每个学生的知识状态生成最有利于学习的题目。作者希望利用知识追踪（KT）模型来指导EQG，实现真正的个性化题目生成。

Method: 提出KT4EQG框架：首先利用KT模型根据学生历史表现建模知识状态并预测未来表现，通过KT模型选择能最大化学生整体知识掌握提升的最优知识概念；然后训练基于LLM的题目生成器，生成严格基于所选知识概念的问题。

Result: 在XES3G5M和MOOCRadar两个数据集上的实验结果表明，KT4EQG生成的题目 consistently 比缺乏个性化或个性化有限的方法更有效。

Conclusion: 知识追踪可以有效指导教育题目生成，实现细粒度的个性化；基于KT选择知识概念+LLM生成题目的框架能够提升学生的学习效果。

Abstract: Educational Question Generation (EQG) aims to synthesize customized exercise questions that enhance student learning. An effective EQG system should ideally personalize questions for each student by modeling the student's knowledge state and generating questions that provide the greatest learning benefit. However, few existing EQG approaches are able to achieve such fine-grained personalization. In this paper, we explore how EQG can benefit from knowledge tracing (KT), which models students' knowledge states based on historical performance and predicts future performance. We propose KT4EQG, a personalized EQG framework that generates effective questions for individual students under the guidance of a KT model. Specifically, KT4EQG seeks to maximize a student's potential improvement in overall knowledge mastery by leveraging the KT model to select the most suitable knowledge concept for the student to practice. An LLM-based question generator is then trained to produce a question faithfully grounded in the selected concept. Experimental results on XES3G5M and MOOCRadar show that KT4EQG consistently generates more effective questions than methods with limited or no personalization.

</details>


### [216] [Habermolt: Delegating Deliberation to AI Representatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24413)
*Joseph Low,Oscar Duys,Claude Formanek,Michiel Bakker,Lewis Hammond*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了AI代理 deliberation（AI-delegated deliberation）范式，即AI代理代替人类进行 deliberative democracy，并通过Habermolt平台实证研究了这一范式在代表性、聚合和修订三个维度上的效果，揭示了未来AI代理 deliberation 平台面临的设计与对齐挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 deliberative democracy 受限于人类的注意力和带宽，虽已有AI辅助 deliberation 扩大参与规模，但仍对个体用户耗时。随着AI能力提升，AI不仅可 mediate deliberation，还可直接代表人类参与 deliberation，这带来了新的设计与对齐挑战，目前缺乏充分理解和理论化。

Method: 提出AI-delegated deliberation 范式定义与三个评估维度（代表性、聚合、修订）；部署名为Habermolt的公开平台进行实证研究。

Result: 通过Habermolt平台的实证观察，揭示了AI-delegated deliberation 在 representation、aggregation、revision 三个维度上的实际效果和设计挑战。

Conclusion: AI-delegated deliberation 有望实现前所未有规模的民主参与，但面临新的设计与对齐问题；本文的发现为构建可扩展且可信的AI代表系统提供了研究方向。

Abstract: Deliberative democracy arguably leads to better collective decisions, but is fundamentally constrained by human attention and bandwidth. While recent AI-mediated deliberations scale participation by synthesizing inputs from many humans, they remain time-intensive for individual users. As AI models become increasingly capable, AI systems are being deployed not only to mediate deliberation between humans, but to represent humans in it: where AI agents deliberate on behalf of human users. We call this paradigm AI-delegated deliberation. While it promises unprecedented scale for democratic participation, it introduces qualitatively new design and alignment challenges that are poorly understood and under-theorized. To study these dynamics empirically, we deploy Habermolt, a public platform for AI-delegated deliberation. We evaluate its effectiveness along three dimensions that we use to organize any deliberative system: representation, aggregation, and revision. We use these observations to illuminate the design decisions future AI-delegated deliberation platforms must confront, contributing to the broader research agenda for scalable yet trustworthy AI representatives.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [217] [GE-Sim 2.0: A Roadmap Towards Comprehensive Closed-loop Video World Simulators for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27491)
*Boxiang Qiu,Liliang Chen,Yue Liao,Nan Wang,Lintao Wang,Jiayi Luo,Wenzhi Zhao,Shengcong Chen,Di Chen,Ye Li,Chen Gao,Shuicheng Yan,Si Liu,Maoqing Yao,Guanghui Ren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GE-Sim 2.0 是一个用于机器人操作的闭环视频世界模拟器，在真实机器人数据上重新训练，改进了动作跟随保真度和轨迹覆盖，并引入状态专家、世界裁判和加速框架三个新模块，实现从视频模拟到策略学习的闭环，以2B参数在WorldArena排行榜上位居首位，并带来真实世界的策略性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人世界模型存在动作跟随保真度不足、轨迹覆盖有限、缺乏闭环评估与策略学习机制等问题，亟需一个可扩展、可验证的闭环视频模拟平台来支持操作策略的学习与评估。

Method: 1) 在Genie Envisioner的动作条件视频生成框架基础上，使用数千小时的真实机器人数据（遥操作、接触丰富交互、策略部署）重新训练模型；2) 引入状态专家模块，从视频潜变量中解码本体感觉状态以支持VLA策略的下一块预测；3) 引入世界裁判模块，根据任务指令对生成的展开视频进行评分，提供可机器验证的成功信号和奖励；4) 加速框架实现单H100上2.3秒生成25帧，推理时可进行最多4倍跳帧以支持长程评估。

Result: 仅2B参数即在公开WorldArena排行榜上排名第一，超越专用机器人世界模型和闭源通用视频生成器；基于其展开和奖励训练的策略在真实世界中取得可衡量的性能提升。

Conclusion: GE-Sim 2.0 作为一个实用的闭环视频模拟平台，能够有效支持机器人操作策略的可扩展评估与闭环学习。

Abstract: We introduce GE-Sim 2.0 (Genie Envisioner World Simulator 2.0), a closed-loop video world simulator for robotic manipulation. Building on the action-conditioned video generation framework of Genie Envisioner, GE-Sim 2.0 is re-trained on thousands of hours of real-world robot data spanning teleoperation, contact-rich interaction, and on-robot policy deployment, substantially improving action-following fidelity and trajectory coverage. On top of this foundation, three new modules close the loop from video simulation to policy learning: a state expert that decodes proprioceptive state from video latents to support next-chunk prediction by downstream VLA policies; a world judge that scores generated rollouts against task instructions, yielding machine-verifiable success signals and rewards in place of manual inspection; and an acceleration framework that delivers a 25-frame rollout in 2.3 seconds on a single H100, with up to 4* frame skipping at inference for long-horizon evaluation.
