Existing approaches either rely on handcrafted proprioceptive traversability scores, limiting robot-agnosticism, or cluster prior data, preventing online learning. Moreover, many continual learning methods incur substantial memory and computational costs, hindering onboard deployment. We introduce COTRATE, an online learning framework for continuous traversability estimation from multimodal, unlabeled robot experience. Our method first infers robust traversability scores using a robot-agnostic, learning-based online terrain assessment module operating on proprioceptiveand inertial signals. These scores then supervise a visual traversability network through a novel alignment loss that associates visual embeddings with online terrain assessments.To mitigate forgetting during continual learning with minimal overhead, we propose a diversity-aware feature selection strategythat preserves performance using a compact replay memory. We further show that the learned traversability representation supports knowledge transfer across different robot platforms with different locomotion kinematics. We evaluate COTRATE on a dataset of \approx 50,000 images collected with two robotic platforms across 11 outdoor terrains, and benchmark it on navigation tasks in three representative outdoor environments. We make the dataset, code, and trained models publicly available.

</details>


### [255] [A Digital Twin Framework for Virtual Visuo-Haptic Teleoperation of Complex-Shaped Optical Microrobots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28448)
*Zongcai Tan,Lan Wei,Dandan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向复杂形状光镊驱动微机器人的数字孪生框架，集成虚拟视觉-触觉遥操作，通过多球分布式操控模型和光力工具箱实现力觉渲染。模拟细胞输送任务中，触觉反馈使接触力标准差降低53.2%，机器人-光阱距离标准差降低55.2%，任务成功率从30%提升至80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-触觉遥操作框架在复杂形状光学微机器人及多光阱操控场景中发展不足，缺乏有效的力反馈和稳定性信息传递机制。

Method: 构建数字孪生环境，集成基于图像的位姿与深度估计、微机器人运动仿真、基于模型的触觉渲染；采用多球分布式操控模型结合光学工具箱进行光力估算，并在ROS连接的双臂遥操作系统中实现仿真驱动的视觉-触觉反馈。

Result: 触觉反馈使接触力标准差降低53.2%，微机器人-光阱中心距离标准差降低55.2%，任务成功率从30%提升至80%。

Conclusion: 该框架能够有效评估复杂形状光学微机器人的视觉-触觉遥操作策略，具有提升操作精度和任务成功率的潜力。

Abstract: Optical tweezers (OT) provide piconewton-scale manipulation for delicate biomedical tasks, where visuo-haptic feedback can improve operator awareness by conveying interaction-force cues and trap-stability information. However, visuo-haptic teleoperation frameworks for complex-shaped optical microrobots remain underdeveloped, particularly in multi-trap manipulation scenarios. This paper presents a digital twin framework for virtual visuo-haptic teleoperation of complex-shaped OT-driven microrobots. The framework integrates a digital twin environment, image-based pose and depth estimation, microrobot motion simulation, and model-based haptic rendering within a Robot Operating System (ROS)-connected bimanual teleoperation system. For force modeling, we combine a Multi-Sphere Distributed Manipulation (MSDM) model with optical-force estimation from the Optical Tweezers Toolbox, enabling simulator-driven visuo-haptic feedback. The framework reproduces representative microrobot motion trends and provides haptic force rendering that is numerically consistent with the fitted optical-force model. In simulated cell-delivery tasks, haptic feedback reduced the standard deviations of the contact-force metric and the microrobot-to-trap-center distance metric by 53.2% and 55.2%, respectively, and improved task success from 30% to 80%. These results demonstrate the framework's effectiveness for evaluating visuo-haptic teleoperation strategies for complex-shaped optical microrobots.

</details>


### [256] [Learning a Kinodynamic Trajectory Manifold for Impact-Aware Compliant Catching of Fast-Moving Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28462)
*Guorui Pei,Mengshi Zhang,Xi Chen,Jinsong Wu,Jiaming Qi,Peng Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的自由飞行物体快速抓取方法，通过仿真学习低维运动动力学轨迹流形，实现无需在线非线性优化的实时轨迹生成，并采用柔顺控制提高抓取稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由飞行物体快速抓取面临反应时间短、碰撞不确定性大以及运动动力学约束严格等挑战，现有方法难以兼顾实时性和鲁棒性。

Method: 在仿真环境中使用强化学习收集成功抓取轨迹，学习低维运动动力学轨迹流形；运行时直接将估计的物体初始状态映射到参考抓取轨迹（无需在线非线性优化）；在接近接触时采用柔顺控制跟踪轨迹，以改善碰撞吸收和抓取稳定性。

Result: 所提方法能够在无需在线优化的情况下快速生成抓取轨迹，并通过柔顺控制有效吸收碰撞冲击，提升抓取成功率。

Conclusion: 结合强化学习轨迹流形学习与柔顺控制，能够有效解决自由飞行物体快速抓取中的实时性与鲁棒性问题。

Abstract: Fast catching of free-flying objects is difficult because of short reaction time, impact uncertainty, and kinodynamic constraints. We use reinforcement learning in simulation to collect successful catching trajectories and learn a low-dimensional kinodynamic trajectory manifold. At run time, the estimated object initial state is mapped directly to a reference catching trajectory without online nonlinear optimization. The trajectory is tracked with compliant control near contact for improved impact absorption and capture stability.

</details>


### [257] [EIT-Pneumatic Hybrid Robotic Skin for Practical and Accurate Force Map Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28468)
*Junhwi Cho,Sunggyu Bae,Junghyeon Ma,Hyosang Lee,Jung Kim,Kyungseo Park*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合电阻抗成像（EIT）与气动触觉感知的混合机器人皮肤，通过3D打印和喷涂工艺制造，利用Tikhonov正则化反演与气动校准实现大面积力重构，实验证明其相比纯EIT基线将灵敏度变异系数从0.31降至0.14，并在人形机器人胸部集成中展示了多触点可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯EIT触觉感知存在灵敏度非均匀性（不同位置力重构一致性差）这一长期未解决的问题，因此需要一种改进方案以提升大面积触觉传感的力重构准确性。

Method: 将EIT与气动触觉感知混合，采用3D打印和喷涂涂层制造；使用Tikhonov正则化反演算法配合每个传感垫的气动校准，实现简单测量方案下的大面积精确触觉感知。

Result: 负载传感器压痕实验显示垫内各位置力重构一致；相比纯EIT基线，灵敏度变异系数从0.31降至0.14；人形机器人胸部集成实验表明气动信号在多触点场景下保持可靠。

Conclusion: 该方法为真实机器人系统中实现精确、可扩展的全身触觉感知提供了一条实用路径，有效解决了EIT长期存在的灵敏度非均匀性问题。

Abstract: We present a hybrid robotic skin that combines electrical impedance tomography (EIT) with pneumatic tactile sensing to improve force reconstruction capability. The developed robotic skin is fabricated entirely by 3D printing and spray coating, making it affordable and easy to build. A Tikhonov-regularized inverse reconstruction, paired with per-pad pneumatic calibration, enables accurate large-area tactile sensing with a simple measurement scheme. For validation, we conducted load-cell indentation experiments; the results showed consistent force reconstruction across locations within a pad. Compared with an EIT-only baseline, sensitivity non-uniformity was also reduced, with the coefficient of variation decreasing from 0.31 to 0.14, indicating that the proposed approach addresses a longstanding limitation of EIT. We further demonstrated chest-mounted integration on a humanoid robot and found that the pneumatic signals remained reliable across diverse contact scenarios, including multiple simultaneous contacts on the same sensing pad. These results indicate a practical path toward accurate, scalable whole-body tactile sensing in real robotic systems.

</details>


### [258] [Mag-VLA: Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Magnetically Actuated Microrobot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28486)
*Yongchen Wang,Kangyi Lu,Lan Wei,Dandan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Mag-VLA，一种基于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的磁驱微型机器人灵巧操控框架，利用双臂机器人协同构建动态磁场，通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调Qwen2.5-VL-7B骨干网络，结合运动感知相位分类器和相位条件化的动作分块Transformer（ACT）解码器，实现多步连贯控制。在真实机器人实验中，该方法在任务难度递增下达到90%接近成功率及80%、70%、50%的运输成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁驱微型机器人在微创应用中具有前景，但其控制因间接驱动、传感受限和非线性磁交互而极具挑战性。现有方法多局限于单臂操控，难以实现微型机器人的重新定向等灵巧操作，亟需一种能协调双臂协同控制的方法。

Method: 采用Qwen2.5-VL-7B作为骨干网络，通过LoRA进行高效微调；引入运动感知相位分类器感知任务进展状态；设计相位条件化的动作分块Transformer（ACT）解码器生成时序连贯的多步控制动作；构建基于遥操作的三类任务配置数据集进行训练。

Result: 消融实验表明ACT解码器显著优于其他生成式动作头；真实机器人实验中，Mag-VLA在三种任务配置下均达到90%接近成功率，运输成功率随任务难度递增分别为80%、70%和50%。

Conclusion: 层次化VLA建模为磁驱微型机器人操控提供了有前景的框架，验证了双臂协同动态磁场构建与VLA模型结合的有效性。

Abstract: Magnetically actuated microrobots have been used as wireless, non-contact manipulation tools at microscales, making them promising for minimally invasive applications. However, their control remains challenging due to indirect actuation, limited sensing, and nonlinear magnetic interactions. In this work, we propose Mag-VLA, a vision-language-action (VLA) model for dexterous magnetic microrobot manipulation using two robotic arms with mounted magnets for dynamic magnetic-field construction. Bimanual coordination enables capabilities such as microrobot reorientation that are difficult or infeasible with a single arm, but it also introduces coupled control challenges, as the policy must generate coordinated trajectories for both actuators within a shared workspace. Our framework adapts a Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to process visual observations and language instructions for action prediction. To capture task progression, we introduce a motion-aware phase classifier and a phase-conditioned Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) decoder for temporally coherent multi-step control. We further construct a teleoperated magnetic microrobot manipulation dataset covering three task configurations. Ablation studies show that the ACT-based decoder substantially outperforms alternative generative action heads. In real-robot experiments, Mag-VLA achieves a 90% approach success rate across all tasks and transport success rates of 80%, 70%, and 50% as task difficulty increases. These results demonstrate that hierarchical VLA modeling provides a promising framework for magnetic microrobot manipulation.

</details>


### [259] [What Frozen VLAs Already Know About Success: A Probing Study of Value-Like Structure in Foundation Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28527)
*Jiachen Zhang,Junnan Nie,Junyi Lao,Wei Cheng,Chenghao Liu,Jiaxin Jiang,Songfang Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发现，仅通过模仿动作训练的VLA策略（如OpenVLA、Pi0.5），其冻结的视觉-语言表征中已隐式编码了任务成功/失败信息。通过轻量线性探针可从这些表征中解码出蒙特卡洛结果目标，且该信息可用于测试时选择动作前缀，提升成功率（如从26.7%到44.3%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究仅通过模仿学习（无显式奖励信号）训练的VLA策略，其冻结表征是否隐式编码了任务成功/失败等价值相关信息。

Method: 从LIBERO-Goal数据集中混合成功/失败的操控轨迹，利用轻量线性探针在冻结的VLA特征（OpenVLA、Pi0.5、DINOv2、CLIP）上解码蒙特卡洛结果目标。通过同任务、同时间步的配对比较消除任务和时序捷径，并用标签打乱作为对照。将探针作为测试时选择器，在Pi0.5采样的动作前缀上进行筛选。

Result: Pi0.5探针在配对排序准确率上达到约92%（标签打乱对照为随机水平）。测试时选择使push-plate成功率从26.7%提升至44.3%，wine-rack也有正向提升。但并非所有任务都有效，且需要额外推理计算。

Conclusion: 冻结的VLA策略隐式编码了模仿学习目标从未显式要求的成功/失败信息，该信息可被解码并用于改善动作选择行为。

Abstract: Vision--language--action (VLA) policies are trained to imitate actions; their loss never asks them to estimate reward, progress, or future success. Their frozen representations nevertheless carry such information, and it can be read out and used to guide action choice without retraining the policy. From mixed successful and failed manipulation trajectories on LIBERO-Goal, we recover Monte-Carlo outcome targets using lightweight linear probes on frozen features. The targets are consistently predictable from OpenVLA, Pi0.5, DINOv2, and CLIP features, and substantially less so from baselines built on progress, time-to-go, task identity, or proprioception. To rule out task and temporal shortcuts, we evaluate the probes under same-task, same-timestep matched comparisons: Pi0.5 probes still reach roughly 92% pairwise ordering accuracy, while label-shuffled controls stay at chance. Used as a test-time selector over sampled Pi0.5 action prefixes, the same probe turns this offline finding into behavior: on push-plate, success rises from 26.7% under greedy decoding to 44.3%, with a second positive case on wine-rack. The gains are not universal and require additional inference compute, but the underlying finding is clean: frozen VLAs already encode information about success that their imitation objective never explicitly demands.

</details>


### [260] [SPRINT: Efficient Spectral Priors for Humanoid Athletic Sprints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28549)
*Yantong Wei,Kaihong Huang,Hainan Pan,Jiawei Luo,Jiawei Zhou,Ziyan Mai,Zhiwen Zeng,Yaonan Wang,Huimin Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SPRINT框架，利用频率自适应频谱先验，仅凭5个运动序列的参考库生成高速动力学可行关节轨迹，在Unitree G1平台实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，峰值冲刺速度达6m/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿人运动冲刺面临两大瓶颈：缺乏适用于人形机器人的运动学参考数据，以及现有框架无法在冲刺过程中维持稳定性。

Method: 通过频域表征人类运动的基础周期性，利用5个离散运动序列的参考库生成频率自适应频谱先验，从而在宽速度范围内生成运动学可行的关节轨迹，并外推至超越参考分布的速度。

Result: 在Unitree G1平台上实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，峰值冲刺速度达6m/s，并展示无缝步态转换与仿生自然性。

Conclusion: 频率自适应频谱先验可作为数据高效的基础设施，用于实现仿人运动冲刺。

Abstract: The pursuit of humanoid athletic sprints is hindered by a scarcity of humanoid-viable kinematic reference data and the inability of existing frameworks to maintain stability during sprints. To overcome these limitations, we introduce SPRINT, a novel framework driven by efficient, frequency-adaptive spectral priors. By characterizing the fundamental periodicity of human locomotion in the frequency domain using a reference library of five discrete motion sequences, these priors generate kinematically feasible joint trajectories across a broad velocity spectrum, successfully extrapolating to speeds that exceed the reference distribution. Guided by these pretrained priors, the SPRINT policy achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in field experiments on the Unitree G1 platform, reaching a peak sprinting velocity of 6 m/s and demonstrating seamless gait transitions while preserving biomimetic naturalness. Ultimately, this work establishes frequency-adaptive spectral priors as a highly data-efficient foundation for humanoid athletic sprints. The project page is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/SPRINT-138A/.

</details>


### [261] [SARAD: LLM-Based Safety-Aware Hybrid Reinforcement Learning with Collision Prediction for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28583)
*Kangyu Wu,Peng Cui,Guoxi Chen,Ya Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SARAD安全感知混合框架，融合大语言模型与深度强化学习，通过RAG增强的LLM引导决策替代随机探索，结合注意力鉴别器和碰撞预测器，在高速公路仿真中显著提升自动驾驶的安全与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DRL存在不安全随机探索和收敛慢的问题，而LLM在实时推理中存在固有延迟，现有方法难以同时保证自动驾驶决策的安全性与效率。

Method: 构建SARAD混合框架：(1) 用RAG增强的LLM引导决策替代DRL的随机探索，从动态专家知识库中检索；(2) 提出注意力鉴别器将LLM先验知识融入DRL策略优化；(3) 设计基于历史碰撞数据微调的碰撞预测器提升安全性。

Result: 在Highway-Env仿真器上的大量实验表明SARAD取得了显著的性能提升，验证了该模型在自动驾驶中的有效性。

Conclusion: SARAD通过LLM与DRL的协同混合框架，有效解决了自动驾驶中安全与效率的权衡问题，为自动驾驶决策提供了可行的新范式。

Abstract: Ensuring both safety and efficiency in decision-making for autonomous driving systems remains a fundamental challenge. Traditional Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) suffers from unsafe random exploration and slow convergence, while Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate inherent latency in real-time inference operations. To address these limitations, this paper proposes SARAD, a novel safety-aware hybrid framework that synergizes LLMs and DRL for autonomous driving. SARAD substitutes the random exploration of DRL with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-enhanced, LLM-guided decisions sourced from a dynamic expert knowledge repository. An attention discriminator is proposed to integrate the prior knowledge of LLMs into DRL policy optimization. A collision predictor module, fine-tuned with historical collision data, is further designed to improve vehicle safety. Extensive experiments show that SARAD achieves significant performance improvements in the Highway-Env simulator, validating the effectiveness of the proposed model in autonomous driving.

</details>


### [262] [PrimitiveVLA: Learning Reusable Motion Primitives for Efficient and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28634)
*Yutai Li,Shaohui Peng,Jiaming Guo,Di Huang,Zihao Zhang,Yuxuan Guo,Yunkai Gao,Siming Lan,Ling Li,Xing Hu,Yunji Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PrimitiveVLA通过将指令到控制的直接映射范式转变为以基础动作为中心的“拆解-组装”范式，结合多模态规范表征和自动化解构管道，显著提升了VLA模型的数据效率和零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在适应新任务时存在数据效率低和泛化能力差的问题，根本原因在于采用“直接指令到控制映射”范式，迫使模型记忆整体轨迹而非可复用的运动模式（基础动作）。

Method: 提出PrimitiveVLA框架，包含两个阶段：（1）微调阶段拆解：利用自动化管道将演示数据解构为可复用的基础动作，并由共享的多模态规范表征（MCR）统一表示；（2）推理阶段组装：基于VLM的规划器和LLM生成的切换模块，实现鲁棒的闭环执行。

Result: 实验表明，PrimitiveVLA在数据效率和零样本泛化方面显著提升，能够泛化至未见任务和长序列任务。

Conclusion: 通过将任务拆解为可复用的基础动作，VLA模型学习到不变的运动模式而非特定任务的轨迹，从而突破数据瓶颈和泛化限制。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for generalist robotic policies, yet their adaptation is hindered by data inefficiency and poor generalization. We argue that these bottlenecks stem from the prevailing Direct Instruction-to-Control Mapping, which forces models to memorize monolithic trajectories rather than reusable motion patterns, i.e., primitives. We propose PrimitiveVLA, a framework that shifts this paradigm toward a Primitive-Centric Disassemble & Assemble paradigm. Supported by a shared Multimodal Canonical Representation (MCR), PrimitiveVLA unifies two phases: (1) Fine-tuning-phase Disassembly, which uses an automated pipeline to disassemble demonstrations into reusable primitives; and (2) Inference-phase Assembly, which employs a VLM-based planner and an LLM-generated switch module for robust closed-loop execution. By disassembling tasks into reusable primitives, PrimitiveVLA enables VLA models to learn invariant motion patterns instead of task-specific trajectories. Extensive experiments show that our framework improves data efficiency and achieves superior zero-shot generalization across unseen and long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [263] [Integrated Exploration-Aware UAV Route Optimization and Path Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28654)
*Jimin Choi,Grant Stagg,Cameron K. Peterson,Max Z. Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向不确定和动态变化先验信息的无人机探索感知路径规划框架，通过空间风险地图建模、ROI路径优化、伪节点增强覆盖、B样条轨迹规划与在线重规划，在灾害监测任务中实现了比离线规划和直线飞行更好的信息获取效果（平均KL散度降低分别提升15.9%和48.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机在危险环境（灾区、污染区、火灾区等）中执行探索驱动监测时，飞行续航有限，需要在访问已报告位置和探索新信息之间分配资源。然而，关于危险的先验信息往往不完整、空间不精确，且在任务执行过程中可能发生变化，现有方法无法有效处理这种不确定性和动态性。

Method: 1）将环境建模为空间风险地图，每个位置关联危险信念；2）将报告危险建模为不确定的兴趣区域（ROI），而非确认目标位置；3）求解ROI的车辆路径问题，并引入辅助伪节点改善空间覆盖；4）将剩余飞行距离预算分配到路径段上，优化B样条轨迹进行局部探索；5）执行期间更新网格信念地图，当新信息和剩余预算允许时进行在线重规划。

Result: 在48种场景配置下，在线重规划方法平均KL散度降低比离线优化规划器提升15.9%，比直线遍历提升48.6%。

Conclusion: 所提出的探索感知路径规划框架能有效处理不确定和动态变化的先验信息，显著提升无人机在危险环境中的监测信息获取效率。

Abstract: Uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly used for exploration-driven monitoring in hazardous environments such as disaster zones, contaminated sites, wildfire areas, and damaged infrastructure, where limited flight endurance must be allocated between visiting reported locations and gathering new information. In these settings, prior information regarding hazards is often incomplete, spatially imprecise, and subject to change during execution. For example, initial reports may identify a region where a hazard is likely to exist, but the actual hazard may be displaced, partially observed, or entirely unreported. We present an integrated exploration-aware UAV route optimization and path planning framework for hazard monitoring under uncertain and evolving prior information. The environment is represented as a spatial risk map, where each location has an associated belief of hazardous conditions. Reported hazards are modeled as uncertain regions of interest (ROIs) rather than confirmed target locations, requiring the UAV to inspect reported areas while also using its limited flight endurance to explore informative regions. The proposed method solves a vehicle routing problem over reported ROIs, augments the route with auxiliary pseudo-nodes to improve spatial coverage, allocates the remaining flight distance budget across route segments, and optimizes dynamically feasible B-spline trajectories for local exploration. During execution, UAV measurements update a grid-based belief map, and the remaining trajectory is replanned when new information and the remaining budget justify adaptation. Across 48 scenario configurations, online replanning improves average KL reduction by 15.9% over the offline optimized planner and 48.6% over straight-line traversal.

</details>


### [264] [How VLAs Fail Differently: Black-Box Action Monitoring Reveals Architecture-Specific Failure Signatures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28726)
*Krishnam Gupta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发现VLA架构在电机指令层面的失败模式具有架构特异性：方向反转率是普适性失败预测指标，而抖动监测仅对离散token架构有效，速度违规在所有架构中均非有效预测指标，但却是VLA部署中最常用的安全机制。由此提出架构匹配的监测器选择必要性，并开发了SafeContract工具包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA安全机制缺乏对架构特异性失败模式的系统理解，尤其是广泛使用的速度检查在实证中几乎无预测能力，需要量化不同VLA架构的失败特征并设计匹配的监测方案。

Method: 在PushT和ALOHA 14自由度双臂操作任务上，对VQ-BeT、Diffusion Policy和ACT三种典型VLA架构执行统一评估（n=450 episodes），通过方向反转率、抖动监测、速度违规等指标计算AUROC和p值进行统计比较。

Result: 方向反转率是通用预测指标（AUROC 0.79-0.93，p<0.001）；抖动监测对离散token架构有效（AUROC 0.88）但对连续架构无效（0.41-0.69）；速度违规在所有架构中均无效（AUROC 0.41-0.69）但却是部署中最常见的安全机制；连续架构中速度监测近乎随机（AUROC 0.52/0.41）。

Conclusion: 离散与连续VLA架构产生性质不同的失败模式，需要架构匹配的监测器选择，不存在通用监测器。SafeContract提供训练无关的黑盒动作监测方案。

Abstract: We discover that VLA architectures fail in fundamentally different, predictable ways at the motor-command level. Running VQ-BeT, Diffusion Policy, and ACT on identical evaluation protocols (n=450 episodes across PushT and ALOHA 14-DOF bimanual manipulation), we find: (1) direction reversal rate is a universal failure predictor across all three architectures (AUROC=0.93, 0.79, 0.91; p<0.001); (2) jerk monitoring is predictive only for discrete-token architectures, following a discrete-to-continuous gradient (0.88, 0.69, 0.41); (3) velocity violations alone are non-predictive everywhere (AUROC 0.41-0.69), yet velocity checking is the most common safety mechanism in VLA deployment code; and (4) for continuous-family VLAs, velocity monitoring provides effectively zero predictive signal (AUROC=0.52 on ACT, 0.41 on Diffusion), proving that architecture-matched monitor selection is essential. These results quantify a monitoring consequence of the well-known discrete/continuous VLA distinction: the two families produce qualitatively different failure signatures that require different monitors. No single monitor works universally; architecture-matched selection is required. This finding was enabled by SafeContract, a training-free, black-box action monitoring toolkit with conformal calibration. Code: https://github.com/krishnam94/vla-edge

</details>


### [265] [Imitation Learning for Robot Assistance in Open Surgery: A Multi-Policy Evaluation on Suture Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28736)
*Xucheng Wang,Zhizhou Yang,Xiaoman Zhang,Sung Eun Kim,Romain Hardy,Pranav Rajpurkar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次评估了通用模仿学习在开放手术中用于外科医生-机器人协作辅助的性能，重点关注缝合跟随任务。研究基于160次遥操作演示（32,374帧）在开源机械臂上收集数据，对比了四种模仿学习策略（ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA、π₀），在28个训练模型、32种配置下进行评估。结果表明，理想条件下四种策略达到50-75%任务成功率，深度误差是主要失败模式；π₀凭借预训练视觉-语言骨干网络表现最佳，数据效率更高、对背景变化鲁棒性更强、轨迹更平滑；在外科医生-机器人缝合试验中，π₀实现92%的缝合完成率。研究证实开放手术中的协作机器人辅助是模仿学习的可行目标，并指出深度感知和末端执行器设计是临床转化的关键优先事项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放手术中，外科医生与机器人之间的协作辅助目前缺乏有效的模仿学习方法评估，特别是针对缝合跟随这一关键重复性操作（抓取-拉动-释放动作），需要系统性地验证通用模仿学习在该场景下的可行性和性能边界。

Method: 收集160次遥操作演示数据（32,374帧），使用开源机械臂；选取四种架构各异的模仿学习策略（ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA、π₀）；训练28个模型，在32种配置下沿三个临床相关维度（数据集大小、摄像头视角、背景变化）进行评估；部署最佳模型进行外科医生-机器人缝合试验。

Result: 理想条件下四种策略成功率50-75%，深度误差是主要失败模式；π₀表现最佳，数据效率更高、对背景变化更鲁棒、轨迹更平滑；在医生-机器人缝合试验中，π₀实现92%的缝合完成率。

Conclusion: 开放手术中的协作机器人辅助是模仿学习的可行目标；深度感知和末端执行器设计是临床转化的关键优先事项。

Abstract: This study presents the first evaluation of general-purpose imitation learning for surgeon-robot collaborative assistance in open surgery, targeting suture following: the grab-pull-release motion an assistant performs at every stitch. We collect 160 teleoperated demonstrations (32,374 frames) on an open-source robot arm, benchmark four architecturally diverse imitation learning policies (ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA, $π_0$) across 28 trained models evaluated in 32 configurations along three clinically motivated dimensions: dataset size, camera viewpoint, and background variation. Our results demonstrate that under ideal conditions, the four policies achieve $50$-$75\%$ task success, with depth error as the dominant failure mode across all architectures. Among all policies, $π_0$ achieves the strongest results with a pretrained vision-language backbone, demonstrating superior data efficiency, greater robustness to background variation, and smoother trajectories compatible with surgical workflow. When deployed in a surgeon-robot suturing trial, $π_0$ yields a $92\%$ stitch completion rate. These findings establish collaborative robotic assistance in open surgery as a feasible target for imitation learning and highlight depth perception and end-effector design as key priorities for clinical translation.

</details>


### [266] [Beyond Binary: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Manipulation with Physics-Grounded Contact Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28812)
*Jiahe Pan,Stelian Coros,Jitendra Malik,Toru Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于物理原理的触觉表示——压力中心（CoP），结合可微动力学的传感器标定方案，实现接触丰富操作的零样本仿真到现实迁移，在多指手上的插销入孔和球平衡任务中均优于粗粒度二值接触和原始触元基线，并且学习到的策略能自发编码物体质量等物理属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富操作的主要瓶颈是真实数据难以收集，仿真到现实的强化学习虽可扩展，但仿真-现实差距阻碍了触觉等密集信息模态的有效使用。现有方法通常将触觉数据简化为粗粒度的低维特征，牺牲了复杂操作所需的信息丰富度。

Method: 1）提出基于物理原理的CoP触觉表示，在保留密集接触信息的同时对仿真-现实迁移具有鲁棒性；2）提出基于可微动力学的传感器标定方案，无需真实力测量即可估计触元方向；3）在多指手上执行盲式插销入孔和球平衡两项挑战性任务进行验证。

Result: CoP策略在两项任务上均实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，性能优于二值接触和原始触元基线。策略状态分析表明CoP条件化策略能自发编码物体质量等任务相关物理属性。

Conclusion: 基于物理原理的CoP触觉表示能有效弥合仿真-现实差距，在接触丰富操作中保持信息密度同时具备迁移鲁棒性，并且学习到的表示可作为控制的有益副产品编码物理属性。

Abstract: A primary bottleneck in contact-rich manipulation is the difficulty of collecting real-world data. Sim-to-real reinforcement learning offers a scalable alternative, but the simulation-reality gap prevents information-dense modalities like touch from being effectively used. Existing sim-to-real methods often mitigate this gap by simplifying tactile data into coarse low-dimensional features -- sacrificing the richness required for complex manipulation. In this work, we introduce Center-of-Pressure (CoP), an effective tactile representation grounded in physical principles that preserves dense contact information while maintaining robustness for sim-to-real transfer. To support this representation, we propose a sensor calibration scheme based on differentiable dynamics, enabling the estimation of taxel orientations without requiring ground-truth force measurements. We evaluate CoP on two blind, challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks: peg-in-hole insertion and ball balancing. Across both tasks, policies conditioned on CoP achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a multi-fingered hand, and outperform both coarse binary-contact and raw-taxel baselines. Analysis of learned policy states further suggests that CoP-conditioned policies encode task-relevant physical properties, such as object mass, as an emergent byproduct of control.

</details>


### [267] [Imitating and Finetuning Model Predictive Control for Robust and Symmetric Quadrupedal Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.02304)
*Donghoon Youm,Hyunyoung Jung,Hyeongjun Kim,Jemin Hwangbo,Hae-Won Park,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种模仿与微调模型预测控制（IFM）框架，结合模型预测控制与模仿学习及深度强化学习，显著提升了四足机器人在复杂地形上的运动性能，产生更对称、周期性和节能的步态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腿式机器人控制中，基于模型的方法和基于学习的方法各有优劣，现有方法难以兼顾两者的优势，尤其是在粗糙、湿滑和传送带等需要精细协调脚步的复杂地形上表现不佳。

Method: 1) 使用微分动态规划和Raibert启发式构建传统MPC作为专家策略；2) 通过模仿学习训练MPC的克隆，使控制器可学习；3) 利用有限探索的深度强化学习在更具挑战性的地形上微调策略。

Result: 在粗糙、湿滑和传送带地形上，IFM显著提升了MPC控制器的性能；相比普通强化学习，IFM能更高效地产生更对称、周期性且节能的步态，且奖励塑造成本极低。

Conclusion: IFM框架成功融合了模型预测控制与强化学习的优势，为腿式机器人提供了一种高效、鲁棒的控制方案，在保持MPC稳定性的同时通过学习提升了复杂地形的适应能力。

Abstract: Control of legged robots is a challenging problem that has been investigated by different approaches, such as model-based control and learning algorithms. This work proposes a novel Imitating and Finetuning Model Predictive Control (IFM) framework to take the strengths of both approaches. Our framework first develops a conventional model predictive controller (MPC) using Differential Dynamic Programming and Raibert heuristic, which serves as an expert policy. Then we train a clone of the MPC using imitation learning to make the controller learnable. Finally, we leverage deep reinforcement learning with limited exploration for further finetuning the policy on more challenging terrains. By conducting comprehensive simulation and hardware experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed IFM framework can significantly improve the performance of the given MPC controller on rough, slippery, and conveyor terrains that require careful coordination of footsteps. We also showcase that IFM can efficiently produce more symmetric, periodic, and energy-efficient gaits compared to Vanilla RL with a minimal burden of reward shaping.

</details>


### [268] [Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Highway On-Ramp Merging under Stochastic Communication Latency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11852)
*Amin Tabrizian,Zhitong Huang,Arsyi Aziz,Peng Wei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出DAROM框架，通过随机延迟马尔可夫决策过程建模和延迟感知编码器，解决了智能网联环境下V2I通信随机延迟对高速公路匝道合流控制的影响，在SUMO仿真中实现了超过99%的高密度交通合流成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际自动驾驶中，V2I通信的随机延迟破坏了马尔可夫性，导致标准强化学习方法性能严重下降，亟需一种对随机延迟鲁棒的合流控制框架。

Method: 将问题建模为随机延迟马尔可夫决策过程（RDMDP），提出延迟感知编码器（基于GRU）利用延迟观测、掩码动作历史和观测延迟量推断当前潜状态，集成物理安全控制器降低碰撞风险，实现纵横向联合控制。

Result: 在SUMO仿真中基于NGSIM真实交通数据，DAROM在所有交通密度下均优于标准RL基线，GRU编码器在2.0秒随机延迟的高密度交通中达到99%以上合流成功率。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模通信延迟并设计延迟感知编码器，可有效恢复马尔可夫状态表征，使RL在存在随机V2I延迟的实际部署场景中保持高性能，并验证了安全控制器对降低碰撞风险的有效性。

Abstract: Delayed and partially observable state information poses significant challenges for reinforcement learning (RL)-based control in real-world autonomous driving. In highway on-ramp merging, a roadside unit (RSU) can sense nearby traffic, perform edge perception, and transmit state estimates to the ego vehicle over vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) links. With recent advancements in intelligent transportation infrastructure and edge computing, such RSU-assisted perception is increasingly realistic and already deployed in modern connected roadway systems. However, edge processing time and wireless transmission can introduce stochastic V2I communication delays, violating the Markov assumption and substantially degrading control performance. In this work, we propose DAROM, a Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning framework for On-ramp Merging that is robust to stochastic delays. We model the problem as a random delay Markov decision process (RDMDP) and develop a unified RL agent for joint longitudinal and lateral control. To recover a Markovian representation under delayed observations, we introduce a Delay-Aware Encoder that conditions on delayed observations, masked action histories, and observed delay magnitude to infer the current latent state. We further integrate a physics-based safety controller to reduce collision risk during merging. Experiments in the Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) simulator using real-world traffic data from the Next Generation Simulation (NGSIM) dataset demonstrate that DAROM consistently outperforms standard RL baselines across traffic densities. In particular, the gated recurrent unit (GRU)-based encoder achieves over 99% success in high-density traffic with random V2I delays of up to 2.0 seconds.

</details>


### [269] [A Survey on Event-based Optical Marker Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.20736)
*Nafiseh Jabbari Tofighi,Maxime Robic,Fabio Morbidi,Pascal Vasseur*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文综述了基于事件相机与光学标记（如AprilTags、LED阵列）结合形成的Event-Based Optical Marker Systems (EBOMS)，分析了其异步工作机制与强光照鲁棒性，并介绍了在目标检测、位姿估计和光学通信等方面的应用，最后展望了未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有低延迟、高动态范围和低功耗等优势，将其与广泛可用的被动或主动光学标记相结合，开辟了机器感知和机器人视觉领域的新机遇，因此有必要对该新兴交叉领域进行系统综述。

Method: 本文采用综述性研究方法，系统梳理了EBOMS所依赖的基础原理与技术，重点分析了异步操作机制和挑战性光照条件下的鲁棒性，并归纳了主要应用场景。

Result: 总结了EBOMS在目标检测与跟踪、位姿估计以及光学通信等关键应用中的技术现状与发展脉络。

Conclusion: EBOMS是一个快速兴起的多学科交叉领域，未来具有广阔的研究前景，文章指出了若干值得探索的研究方向。

Abstract: The advent of event-based cameras, with their low latency, high dynamic range, and reduced power consumption, marked a turning point in machine perception and robotic vision. In~particular, the combination of these neuromorphic sensors with widely-available passive or active optical markers (e.g. AprilTags, arrays of blinking LEDs), has recently opened up a new field of opportunities. This survey paper provides a comprehensive review of Event-Based Optical Marker Systems (EBOMS). We~analyze the underlying principles and technologies on which these systems are based, with a special focus on their asynchronous operation and robustness against challenging lighting conditions. We also describe the most relevant applications of EBOMS, including object detection and tracking, pose estimation, and optical communication. The article concludes with a discussion of possible future research directions in this rapidly-emerging and multidisciplinary area.

</details>


### [270] [Realizing Robotic Swimming with Unified Fluid-Robot Multiphysics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.05012)
*Jeong Hun Lee,Junzhe Hu,Sofia Kwok,Carmel Majidi,Zachary Manchester*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可微分的流固耦合多物理场仿真框架，将机器人-流体耦合动力学统一为优化问题，采用离散变分力学推导出稳定、良态且物理精确的联合仿真方案，并利用隐函数定理计算全耦合动力学的梯度，成功应用于仿生鳗鱼机器人的游动步态优化与C-start逃逸机动，并在物理硬件上验证了仿真到现实的迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下机器人难以匹敌鱼类的游泳效率和机动性，而模拟流固耦合动力学的难度远高于传统刚体机器人，亟需一种高效、可微分的仿真框架来优化水下机器人运动。

Method: 将机械臂动力学与不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程从单一拉格朗日量出发，利用最小作用量原理联合推导；采用离散变分力学得到稳定、良态、物理精确的耦合仿真方案；借助隐函数定理计算全耦合动力学的梯度，从而实现可微分仿真。

Result: 成功实现了仿生鳗鱼机器人的波状游动步态和高动态C-start逃逸机动的优化，并在物理硬件上验证了仿真到现实的迁移成功。

Conclusion: 该可微分流固耦合框架能够有效优化水下机器人运动策略并成功迁移到真实硬件，为水下仿生机器人设计提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Matching the swimming efficiency and agility of fish has remained an elusive goal in underwater robotics. Such locomotion capabilities rely on complex vortex interactions between the robot's body and the surrounding fluid. However, simulating these dynamics, which are governed by coupled ordinary and partial differential equations, is significantly more difficult than the multi-body dynamics of classical rigid robotic systems. We present a differentiable framework for simulating strongly coupled fluid-robot multiphysics as a unified optimization problem. The coupled manipulator and incompressible Navier-Stokes equations are derived together from a single Lagrangian using the principle of least action. We employ discrete variational mechanics to derive a stable, well-conditioned, and physically accurate scheme for jointly simulating articulated bodies and the surrounding fluid. We leverage the implicit function theorem to compute derivatives of the fully coupled dynamics. Using this simulator and its gradients, we realize undulating swimming gaits and optimize a highly dynamic C-start escape maneuver for a bioinspired eel robot. We validate both gaits on physical hardware, demonstrating successful sim-to-real transfer. Simulation code, hardware data, and schematics for the eel robot can be found here: https://unified-fluid-robot-multiphysics.github.io/

</details>


### [271] [ROOM: A Physics-Based Continuum Robot Simulator for Photorealistic Medical Datasets Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.13177)
*Salvatore Esposito,Matías Mattamala,Daniel Rebain,Francis Xiatian Zhang,Kevin Dhaliwal,Mohsen Khadem,Subramanian Ramamoorthy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ROOM是一个基于CT扫描生成逼真支气管镜训练数据的仿真框架，支持RGB图像、深度图、表面法线、光流和点云等多模态数据生成，并在多视角位姿估计和单目深度估计任务中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续体机器人在支气管镜检查中具有巨大潜力，但缺乏逼真的训练和测试环境：真实数据因伦理和患者安全问题难以采集，开发自主算法需要真实的成像和物理反馈。

Method: 利用患者CT扫描构建仿真管线，渲染包含真实噪声和镜面高光的RGB图像、度量深度图、表面法线、光流及点云等多模态传感器数据。

Result: 在医学机器人领域的两个经典任务（多视图位姿估计和单目深度估计）上验证了数据有效性，并展示了现有方法迁移到医疗场景需克服的挑战；通过ROOM生成的数据微调深度估计模型可应对这些挑战，并支持导航等下流应用。

Conclusion: ROOM能够在不同患者解剖结构和临床难以捕获的手术场景中实现大规模数据生成，推动连续体机器人支气管镜技术的发展。

Abstract: Continuum robots are advancing bronchoscopy procedures by accessing complex lung airways and enabling targeted interventions. However, their development is limited by the lack of realistic training and test environments: Real data is difficult to collect due to ethical constraints and patient safety concerns, and developing autonomy algorithms requires realistic imaging and physical feedback. We present ROOM (Realistic Optical Observation in Medicine), a comprehensive simulation framework designed for generating photorealistic bronchoscopy training data. By leveraging patient CT scans, our pipeline renders multi-modal sensor data including RGB images with realistic noise and light specularities, metric depth maps, surface normals, optical flow and point clouds at medically relevant scales. We validate the data generated by ROOM in two canonical tasks for medical robotics: multi-view pose estimation and monocular depth estimation, demonstrating diverse challenges that state-of-the-art methods must overcome to transfer to these medical settings. Furthermore, we show that the data produced by ROOM can be used to fine-tune existing depth estimation models to overcome these challenges, also enabling other downstream applications such as navigation. We expect that ROOM will enable large-scale data generation across diverse patient anatomies and procedural scenarios that are challenging to capture in clinical settings. Code and data: https://github.com/iamsalvatore/room.

</details>


### [272] [RCM Constraint-Consistent Dynamic Control in Surgical Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14075)
*Yu Li,Hamid Sadeghian,Zewen Yang,Valentin Le Mesle,Sami Haddadin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将远程运动中心（RCM）约束建模为流变完整约束，并融入基于投影的逆动力学控制器中，在力矩层面统一实现RCM约束保持与任务空间跟踪，相比基线方法获得了更低的RCM残差和更平滑的力矩分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚拟RCM控制器通常在运动学层面或任务空间目标中构建，难以在穿刺孔移动和物理交互场景下一致地实现力矩层面的约束保持。

Method: 将RCM建模为流变完整约束（rheonomic holonomic constraint），将其融入基于投影的逆动力学控制器，实现显式的约束/自由运动力矩分解，统一运动学RCM约束与任务空间跟踪，并保留约束一致结构用于残差调节和零空间柔顺性。

Result: 在螺旋轨迹跟踪、变插入深度、移动穿刺孔及人工交互等多种场景下，与基于投影和约束动力学的基线方法相比，所提方法实现了更低的RCM残差和更平滑的力矩分布，同时保持精确的工具末端跟踪。

Conclusion: 约束一致的力矩控制能够有效实现手术机器人中的虚拟RCM约束保持，为可靠的远程运动中心控制提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS) requires accurate enforcement of the remote center of motion (RCM) constraint to ensure safe tool motion through a trocar. Existing virtual RCM controllers are commonly formulated either at the kinematic level or as task-space objectives, which makes torque-level enforcement under trocar motion and physical interaction difficult to formulate consistently. This paper models the RCM as a rheonomic holonomic constraint and incorporates it into a projection-based inverse-dynamics controller with explicit constrained/free-motion torque decomposition. The resulting formulation unifies kinematic RCM enforcement and task-space tracking at the torque level, while preserving a constraint-consistent structure for residual regulation and null-space compliance. The proposed controller is validated in simulation and on a RAMIS training platform against representative projection-based and constrained-dynamics baselines. Across spiral tracking, varying insertion depth, moving trocar conditions, and human interaction, the method achieves lower RCM residuals and smoother torque profiles while maintaining accurate tool-tip tracking. These results support the use of constraint-consistent torque control for reliable virtual RCM enforcement in surgical robotics. The project page is available at https://rcmpc-cube.github.io

</details>


### [273] [Degradation-Aware Cooperative Multi-Modal GNSS-Denied Localization Leveraging LiDAR-Based Robot Detections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20480)
*Václav Pritzl,Xianjia Yu,Tomi Westerlund,Petr Štěpán,Martin Saska*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于因子图的自适应多模态多机器人协同定位方法，通过融合异步的VIO、LIO和3D机器人间检测数据，在传感器退化环境下显著提升定位精度，并在UGV与UAV异构平台上进行了实测验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在GNSS拒绝环境下，单个机器人携带全部传感器会导致体积、重量和功耗过大；而将传感器分布在多个机器人上虽提升了部署灵活性，却面临异步多模态数据融合的挑战。现有方法缺乏对传感器退化条件的自适应处理能力。

Method: 采用因子图框架，松耦合融合来自不同机器人的异步VIO、LIO和3D机器人间检测数据。提出基于插值的因子处理非同步测量；基于近似扫描匹配Hessian评估LIO退化；基于VIO连续输出之间的Wasserstein距离对里程计数据进行加权；并提供了传感器退化条件下协同定位问题的理论分析。

Result: 在包含UGV和UAV的异构机器人团队的实测数据上进行了充分评估，结果表明该方法在多种传感器退化情况下显著提升了定位精度。

Conclusion: 所提出的自适应多模态多机器人协同定位方法能够有效利用可靠数据辅助受传感器退化的机器人，在实际异构机器人平台上验证了其优越的定位性能。

Abstract: Accurate long-term localization using onboard sensors is crucial for robots operating in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied environments. While complementary sensors mitigate individual degradations, carrying all the available sensor types on a single robot significantly increases the size, weight, and power demands. Distributing sensors across multiple robots enhances the deployability but introduces challenges in fusing asynchronous, multi-modal data from independently moving platforms. We propose a novel adaptive multi-modal multi-robot cooperative localization approach using a factor-graph formulation to fuse asynchronous Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO), LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (LIO), and 3D inter-robot detections from distinct robots in a loosely-coupled fashion. The approach adapts to changing conditions, leveraging reliable data to assist robots affected by sensory degradations. A novel interpolation-based factor enables fusion of the unsynchronized measurements. LIO degradations are evaluated based on the approximate scan-matching Hessian. A novel approach of weighting odometry data proportionally to the Wasserstein distance between the consecutive VIO outputs is proposed. A theoretical analysis is provided, investigating the cooperative localization problem under various conditions, mainly in the presence of sensory degradations. The proposed method has been extensively evaluated on real-world data gathered with heterogeneous teams of an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), showing that the approach provides significant improvements in localization accuracy in the presence of various sensory degradations.

</details>


### [274] [Bayesian Optimization Parameter Tuning Framework for a Lyapunov Based Path Following Controller](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12649)
*Zhewen Zheng,Wenjing Cao,Hongkang Yu,Mo Chen,Takashi Suzuki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出使用贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，在有限评估预算下对非线性几何路径跟踪控制器进行参数调优，并在本田AI-Formula三轮机器人上通过全圈实验验证，结果表明BO能在32次试验（含15次预热）内有效找到高性能参数区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际实验中的参数调优受限于硬件上的有限评估预算，而路径跟踪控制器的多个增益通过耦合非线性项相互影响，手动调优效率低下且难以在有限试验次数内获得满意性能。

Method: 提出贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，将闭环系统视为黑箱，使用高斯过程代理模型选择控制器增益；采用模型无关的探索方式，量化不确定性，实现数据高效的参数搜索。

Result: 在Honda AI-Formula三轮机器人的固定测试跑道上进行全圈实验，BO在32次试验（包括15次预热初始评估）内显著提升了控制器性能。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯优化为真实机器人平台上的非线性路径跟踪控制器提供了一种实用、可靠且数据高效的调优方法。

Abstract: Parameter tuning in real-world experiments is constrained by the limited evaluation budget available on hardware. The path-following controller studied in this paper reflects a typical situation in nonlinear geometric controller, where multiple gains influence the dynamics through coupled nonlinear terms. Such interdependence makes manual tuning inefficient and unlikely to yield satisfactory performance within a practical number of trials. To address this challenge, we propose a Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that treats the closed-loop system as a black box and selects controller gains using a Gaussian-process surrogate. BO offers model-free exploration, quantified uncertainty, and data-efficient search, making it well suited for tuning tasks where each evaluation is costly. The framework is implemented on Honda's AI-Formula three-wheeled robot and assessed through repeated full-lap experiments on a fixed test track. The results show that BO improves controller performance within 32 trials, including 15 warm-start initial evaluations, indicating that it can efficiently locate high-performing regions of the parameter space under real-world conditions. These findings demonstrate that BO provides a practical, reliable, and data-efficient tuning approach for nonlinear path-following controllers on real robotic platforms.

</details>


### [275] [Field evaluation and optimization of a lightweight autonomous lidar-based UAV system based on a rigorous experimental setup in boreal forest environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.14340)
*Aleksi Karhunen,Teemu Hakala,Väinö Karjalainen,Eija Honkavaara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种标准化的实验设置框架，用于评估自主无人机在森林冠层下的飞行性能，并通过93次真实飞行实验验证了其有效性，优化后的系统在中等难度森林中成功率最高达15/15（2 m/s），在困难森林中达12/15（1 m/s）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自主无人机林下遥感算法日益增多，但由于实验设置差异大、报告不完整，难以基于文献进行可靠的性能比较，亟需标准化的评估框架来填补这一空白。

Method: 提出标准化实验设置，要求定量报告森林复杂度、可视化测试环境、多次重复飞行、报告成功率与定性结果、多目标速度飞行、报告实际飞行速度、任务完成时间和点对点飞行距离。使用基于激光雷达的四旋翼无人机，在两种天然北方森林环境中进行93次真实飞行实验验证。

Result: 优化后的系统在中等难度森林中，1 m/s和2 m/s目标速度下成功率分别为12/15和15/15；在困难森林中分别为12/15和5/15。

Conclusion: 该标准化实验设置能够促进基于文献的林下自主飞行系统性能比较，支持未来无人机森林机器人解决方案的系统性性能改进。

Abstract: Interest in utilizing autonomous uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) for under-canopy forest remote sensing has increased in recent years, resulting in the publication of numerous autonomous flight algorithms in the scientific literature. To support the selection and development of such algorithms, a reliable comparison of existing approaches based on published studies is essential. However, reliable comparisons are currently challenging due to widely varying experimental setups and incomplete reporting practices. This study proposes a standardized experimental setup for evaluating autonomous under-canopy UAV systems to fill this gap. The proposed setup emphasizes quantitative reporting of forest complexity, visual representation of test environments, execution of multiple repeated flights, and reporting of flight success rates alongside qualitative flight results. In addition, flights at multiple target speeds are encouraged, with reporting of realized flight speed, mission completion time, and point-to-point flight distance. The proposed setup is demonstrated using a lightweight lidar-based quadrotor employing state-of-the-art open-source algorithms, evaluated through extensive experiments in two natural boreal forest environments. Based on a systematic evaluation of the original system, several improvements were introduced. The same experimental protocol was then repeated with the optimized system, resulting in a total of 93 real-world flights. The optimized system achieved success rates of 12/15 and 15/15 at target flight speeds of 1 m/s and 2 m/s, respectively, in a medium-difficulty forest, and 12/15 and 5/15 in a difficult forest. Adoption of the proposed experimental setup would facilitate the literature-based comparison of autonomous under-canopy flight systems and support systematic performance improvement of future UAV-based forest robotics solutions.

</details>


### [276] [MVP-LAM: Learning Action-Centric Latent Action via Cross-Viewpoint Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03668)
*Jung Min Lee,Dohyeok Lee,Seokhun Ju,Taehyun Cho,Jin Woo Koo,Li Zhao,Sangwoo Hong,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MVP-LAM通过学习多视角视频中的潜在动作表征，使潜在动作与真实动作的互信息最大化，从而提升VLA预训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从人类视频中学习的潜在动作作为VLA预训练的伪标签，其有效性取决于能否充分包含真实动作信息；当潜在动作包含的关于真实动作的信息不足时，监督信号会退化。

Method: 提出MVP-LAM，采用跨视角重建目标训练潜在动作：一个视角的潜在动作必须能解释另一视角的未来帧，从而减少对视角特有线索的依赖，增强动作中心性。

Result: 在Bridge V2上，MVP-LAM的潜在动作与真实动作的互信息更高，动作预测更准（包括分布外评估）；用其预训练VLA在多个下游操作基准上表现更优。

Conclusion: MVP-LAM通过多视角一致性约束学习到更具动作信息量的潜在表征，有效提升了VLA预训练的效果与下游操作性能。

Abstract: Latent actions learned from diverse human videos serve as pseudo-labels for vision-language-action (VLA) pretraining, but provide effective supervision only if they remain informative about the underlying ground-truth actions. For effective supervision, latent actions should contain information about the underlying actions even though they are inaccessible. We propose Multi-ViewPoint Latent Action Moel (MVP-LAM), which learns latent actions that are highly informative about ground-truth actions from multi-view videos. MVP-LAM trains latent actions with a cross-viewpoint reconstruction objective, so that a latent action from one view must explain the future in another view, reducing reliance on viewpoint-specific cues. On Bridge V2, MVP-LAM produces more action-centric latent actions, achieving higher mutual information with ground-truth actions and improved action prediction, including under out-of-distribution evaluation. Finally, pretraining VLAs with MVP-LAM latent actions improves downstream manipulation performance on various benchmarks. The code and trained checkpoints are available at https://jmsnu.github.io.

</details>


### [277] [Informative Path Planning with Guaranteed Estimation Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05198)
*Kalvik Jakkala,Saurav Agarwal,Jason O'Kane,Srinivas Akella*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三阶段方法，将信息性路径规划与高斯过程后验方差保证相结合，在复杂环境中以最短路径实现用户指定的不确定性阈值，并通过真实机器人实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统boustrophedon式割草机路径提供了几何覆盖保证但存在过度采样问题，而信息性路径规划方法虽能减少过度采样却缺乏估计质量保证。本文旨在弥合两者差距，在保证估计不确定性的前提下规划最短路径。

Method: 三阶段方法：(i) 从先验信息学习GP模型；(ii) 将GP核转化为二值覆盖图，识别能将不确定性降低到目标阈值以下的位置；(iii) 规划近最短路径以满足全局不确定性约束。支持非平稳核和非凸障碍环境，并提供近最优近似保证。

Result: 在真实地形数据上，该方法比代表性基线使用更少的感知位置和更短的行驶距离达到不确定性目标。自主水面和水下机器人的实地实验验证了实际可行性。

Conclusion: 本文成功桥接了覆盖保证与信息性路径规划，为资源受限的环境监测机器人提供了既有理论保证又实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Environmental monitoring robots often need to estimate data fields (e.g., salinity, temperature, bathymetry) under tight resource constraints. Classical boustrophedon lawnmower surveys provide geometric coverage guarantees but can waste effort by oversampling predictable regions. In contrast, informative path planning (IPP) methods leverage spatial correlations to reduce oversampling, yet typically offer no guarantees on estimation quality. This paper bridges these approaches by addressing IPP with guaranteed estimation uncertainty in complex environments: computing the shortest path whose measurements ensure that the Gaussian process (GP) posterior variance -- an intrinsic uncertainty measure that lower-bounds the mean-squared prediction error under the GP model -- is upper bounded by a user-specified threshold over the monitoring region.
  We propose a three-stage approach for efficient environmental monitoring: (i) learning a GP model from prior information; (ii) transforming the GP kernel into binary coverage maps that identify locations where uncertainty can be reduced below a target threshold; and (iii) planning a near-shortest route to satisfy the global uncertainty constraint. Our approach incorporates non-stationary kernels to capture spatially varying correlations in heterogeneous phenomena and accommodates non-convex environments with obstacles. We provide near-optimal approximation guarantees for both sensing-location selection and the joint selection-and-routing problem under a travel budget. Experiments on real-world topographic data demonstrate that our planners achieve uncertainty targets with fewer sensing locations and shorter travel distances than representative baselines. Furthermore, field experiments with autonomous surface and underwater vehicles validate the real-world feasibility of the approach. Our code is available at: www.sgp-tools.com

</details>


### [278] [Neural Implicit Action Fields: From Discrete Waypoints to Continuous Functions for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01766)
*Haoyun Liu,Jianzhuang Zhao,Xinyuan Chang,Tianle Shi,Chuanzhang Meng,Jiayuan Tan,Feng Xiong,Tong Lin,Dongjie Huo,Mu Xu,SongLin Dong,Zhiheng Ma,Yihong Gong,Sheng Zhong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出神经隐式动作场（NIAF），将离散动作序列重构为连续动作函数，实现任意时间分辨率下的动作生成、解析求导与高阶正则化，在仿真和真实机器人任务中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型将动作预测为离散航路点，与物理运动的本质连续性存在结构失配：离散化受限于固定采样率、无法支持解析一致的导数、引入量化伪影，阻碍精确且柔顺的交互。

Method: 以视觉-语言模型作为层次化谱调制器，作用于可学习的运动先验之上，合成连续时间动作流形；支持任意时间分辨率下的动作查询，并通过解析求导对速度和更高阶导数信号进行显式监督与正则化。

Result: 在CALVIN和LIBERO基准上跨多种骨干网络取得强结果；真实实验验证NIAF支持稳定阻抗控制，弥合策略端动作生成与执行端平滑控制之间的鸿沟。

Conclusion: 将动作从离散点重构为连续函数是提升VLA模型物理一致性、控制平滑度及跨平台泛化能力的有效范式。

Abstract: Despite the rapid progress of vision-language-action (VLA) models, the prevailing practice of predicting action chunks as discrete waypoints remains structurally misaligned with the intrinsic continuity of physical motion. This discretization arises naturally from fixed-rate robot data collection and the token-by-token prediction paradigm of large language models, but ties actions to rigid sampling rates, does not naturally support analytically consistent higher-order derivatives, and introduces quantization artifacts that hinder precise, compliant interaction. We propose Neural Implicit Action Fields (NIAF), which reformulates chunk-level action representation from discrete waypoints to continuous action functions. Using a vision-language model as a hierarchical spectral modulator over a learnable motion prior, NIAF synthesizes continuous-time action manifolds with arbitrary temporal resolution. This formulation enables analytical differentiation, allowing explicit supervision of velocity and regularization of higher-order derivative signals to promote mathematical consistency, physical plausibility, and control smoothness. Our approach achieves strong results on CALVIN and LIBERO across diverse backbones. Real-world experiments further confirm that NIAF supports stable impedance control, bridging policy-side action generation and execution-side smooth control.

</details>


### [279] [SPARC: Spatial-Aware Path Planning via Attentive Agent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02845)
*Sayang Mu,Xiangyu Wu,Bo An*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为关系增强多头注意力（RMHA）的通信机制，通过将成对曼哈顿距离显式嵌入注意力权重计算，使机器人能够动态优先处理空间相关邻居的消息，结合距离约束注意力掩码和GRU门控消息融合，在零样本泛化场景（从8训练到128测试机器人，40x40网格，30%障碍密度）中达到约75%成功率，比最佳基线高出25个百分点以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型通信方法对所有邻居机器人一视同仁，忽略了空间邻近性差异，导致在需要协调的拥挤区域注意力被稀释，影响多机器人路径规划效率。

Method: 提出RMHA机制：(1)将成对曼哈顿距离嵌入多头注意力权重计算；(2)引入距离约束注意力掩码；(3)采用GRU门控消息融合。无缝集成至MAPPO框架进行端到端训练。

Result: 零样本泛化从8机器人到128机器人（40x40网格，30%障碍密度），RMHA达到约75%成功率，超过最佳基线25个百分点以上；消融实验证实距离关系编码是高密度环境下成功率提升的关键因素。

Conclusion: 距离关系编码是提升高密度拥挤环境下多机器人路径规划通信效率的关键，RMHA有效解决了现有方法中注意力稀释问题。

Abstract: Efficient communication is critical for decentralized Multi-Robot Path Planning (MRPP), yet existing learned communication methods treat all neighboring robots equally regardless of their spatial proximity, leading to diluted attention in congested regions where coordination matters most. We propose Relation enhanced Multi Head Attention (RMHA), a communication mechanism that explicitly embeds pairwise Manhattan distances into the attention weight computation, enabling each robot to dynamically prioritize messages from spatially relevant neighbors. Combined with a distance-constrained attention mask and GRU gated message fusion, RMHA integrates seamlessly with MAPPO for stable end-to-end training. In zero-shot generalization from 8 training robots to 128 test robots on 40x40 grids, RMHA achieves approximately 75 percent success rate at 30 percent obstacle density outperforming the best baseline by over 25 percentage points. Ablation studies confirm that distance-relation encoding is the key contributor to success rate improvement in high-density environments. Index Terms-Multi-robot path planning, graph attention mechanism, multi-head attention, communication optimization, cooperative decision-making

</details>


### [280] [Relational Semantic Reasoning on 3D Scene Graphs for Open World Interactive Object Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05642)
*Imen Mahdi,Matteo Cassinelli,Fabien Despinoy,Tim Welschehold,Abhinav Valada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SCOUT是一种基于3D场景图进行开放世界交互式物体搜索的方法，通过离线程序化蒸馏框架将LLM的结构化关系知识提取到轻量级模型中，实现与LLM相当的性能但计算效率更高，并在符号、仿真和真实环境中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖视觉-语言嵌入相似度（无法可靠捕获任务相关的语义关系），要么使用大语言模型（LLM，速度慢且成本高，不适合实时部署），缺乏一种既高效又能捕获结构化关系语义的开放世界物体搜索方法。

Method: 提出SCOUT方法，直接在3D场景图上进行搜索，使用关系探索启发式（如房间-物体包含关系和物体-物体共现关系）为房间、前沿区域和物体分配效用分数；提出离线程序化蒸馏框架，将LLM的结构化关系知识提取到轻量级模型中用于机器人端推理；同时提出SymSearch符号基准用于评估语义推理能力。

Result: 在符号和仿真环境的广泛评估中，SCOUT优于基于嵌入相似度的方法，并达到与LLM方法相当的性能，同时保持计算高效。真实世界实验验证了其在物理环境中的有效迁移能力。

Conclusion: SCOUT通过场景图结构化和LLM知识蒸馏，在开放世界交互式物体搜索任务中实现了效率与性能的良好平衡，能够适应真实世界的传感和导航约束。

Abstract: Open-world interactive object search in household environments requires understanding semantic relationships between objects and their surrounding context to guide exploration efficiently. Prior methods either rely on vision-language embeddings similarity, which does not reliably capture task-relevant relational semantics, or large language models (LLMs), which are too slow and costly for real-time deployment. We introduce SCOUT: Scene Graph-Based Exploration with Learned Utility for Open-World Interactive Object Search, a novel method that searches directly over 3D scene graphs by assigning utility scores to rooms, frontiers, and objects using relational exploration heuristics such as room-object containment and object-object co-occurrence. To make this practical without sacrificing open-vocabulary generalization, we propose an offline procedural distillation framework that extracts structured relational knowledge from LLMs into lightweight models for on-robot inference. Furthermore, we present SymSearch, a scalable symbolic benchmark for evaluating semantic reasoning in interactive object search tasks. Extensive evaluations across symbolic and simulation environments show that SCOUT outperforms embedding similarity-based methods and matches LLM-level performance while remaining computationally efficient. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate effective transfer to physical environments, enabling open-world interactive object search under realistic sensing and navigation constraints.

</details>


### [281] [Emerging Extrinsic Dexterity in Cluttered Scenes via Dynamics-aware Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09882)
*Yixin Zheng,Jiangran Lyu,Yifan Zhang,Jiayi Chen,Mi Yan,Yuntian Deng,Xuesong Shi,Xiaoguang Zhao,Yizhou Wang,Zhizheng Zhang,He Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出动力学感知策略学习（DAPL）框架，通过学习杂乱环境中接触诱导的物体动力学隐式表示来指导强化学习，使外在灵巧性（利用环境接触实现非抓取操作）得以涌现，在仿真和真实场景中均显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏对杂乱场景中多物体接触耦合动力学的显式建模，导致非抓取操作能力不足，限制了外在灵巧性在真实杂乱环境中的实际应用。

Method: DAPL框架：通过显式世界建模学习接触诱导物体动力学的隐式表示，并用该表示来条件化（condition）强化学习策略，无需手工设计的接触启发式或复杂的奖励塑形。

Result: 在仿真杂乱场景中，成功率比抓取操作、人类遥操作及基于表征的策略提升超25%；真实场景10种杂乱设置下成功率约50%，杂货部署任务进一步验证了鲁棒的sim-to-real迁移能力。

Conclusion: DAPL通过显式动力学建模有效提升了杂乱场景中外在灵巧性策略的学习效率和泛化能力，具有较好的实际应用前景。

Abstract: Extrinsic dexterity leverages environmental contact to overcome the limitations of prehensile manipulation. However, achieving such dexterity in cluttered scenes remains challenging and underexplored, as it requires selectively exploiting contact among multiple interacting objects with inherently coupled dynamics. Existing approaches lack explicit modeling of such complex dynamics and therefore fall short in non-prehensile manipulation in cluttered environments, which in turn limits their practical applicability in real-world environments. In this paper, we introduce a Dynamics-Aware Policy Learning (DAPL) framework that can facilitate policy learning with a learned representation of contact-induced object dynamics in cluttered environments. This representation is learned through explicit world modeling and used to condition reinforcement learning, enabling extrinsic dexterity to emerge without hand-crafted contact heuristics or complex reward shaping. We evaluate our approach in both simulation and the real world. Our method outperforms prehensile manipulation, human teleoperation, and prior representation-based policies by over 25% in success rate on unseen simulated cluttered scenes with varying densities. The real-world success rate reaches around 50% across 10 cluttered scenes, while a practical grocery deployment further demonstrates robust sim-to-real transfer and applicability.

</details>


### [282] [From Passive Monitoring to Active Defence: Resilient Control of Manipulators Under Cyberattacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13003)
*Gabriele Gualandi,Alessandro V. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对冗余机械臂系统，提出了一种从被动监控升级为主动防御的架构，通过基于异常分数的控制输入衰减机制抵御隐蔽虚假数据注入攻击，并给出了攻击者最优攻击策略的凸QCQP求解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信息物理机器人系统易受隐蔽虚假数据注入攻击，攻击者可在规避残差检测器（如卡方检验）的同时诱导显著的末端执行器偏差，现有被动检测手段无法有效防御此类威胁。

Method: 构建了包含反馈线性化机械臂、稳态卡尔曼滤波器和卡方异常检测器的闭环模型；提出基于新型驱动投影无测量状态预测器生成的异常分数，通过单调函数衰减控制输入的主动防御策略；从攻击者角度推导了单步最优隐蔽攻击的凸QCQP问题。

Result: 在6自由度平面机械臂上的仿真表明，所提主动防御显著降低了攻击导致的末端执行器偏差，同时在无攻击情况下保持了标称任务性能。

Conclusion: 该主动防御方法在标称操作损失上提供概率保证并保持闭环稳定性，有效提升了冗余机械臂对隐蔽虚假数据注入攻击的韧性。

Abstract: Cyber-physical robotic systems are vulnerable to false data injection attacks (FDIAs), in which an adversary corrupts sensor signals while evading residual-based passive anomaly detectors such as the chi-squared test. Such stealthy attacks can induce substantial end-effector deviations without triggering alarms. This paper studies the resilience of redundant manipulators to stealthy FDIAs and advances the architecture from passive monitoring to active defence. We formulate a closed-loop model comprising a feedback-linearized manipulator, a steady-state Kalman filter, and a chi-squared-based anomaly detector. Building on this passive monitoring layer, we propose an active control-level defence that attenuates the control input through a monotone function of an anomaly score generated by a novel actuation-projected, measurement-free state predictor. The proposed design provides probabilistic guarantees on nominal actuation loss and preserves closed-loop stability. From the attacker perspective, we derive a convex QCQP for computing one-step optimal stealthy attacks. Simulations on a 6-DOF planar manipulator show that the proposed defence significantly reduces attack-induced end-effector deviation while preserving nominal task performance in the absence of attacks.

</details>


### [283] [Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Few-Step Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05673)
*Wuyang Luan,Junhui Li,Weiguang Zhao,Wenjian Zhang,Tieru Wu,Rui Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching (RSBM)，通过利用速度场结构不变性定理，在仅3个积分步数内实现与标准桥方法10步以上相当的性能，从而弥合高保真生成策略与低延迟具身AI需求之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散模型和Schrödinger Bridges的生成式策略需要数十个积分步数才能收敛，高方差随机传输成为实时机器人控制的关键障碍。

Method: RSBM框架利用标准Schrödinger Bridges（最大熵传输）与确定性最优传输（条件流匹配）之间共享的速度场结构，通过单一熵正则化参数ε控制。证明速度场函数形式在整个ε谱上不变（速度结构不变性），且降低ε可线性减小条件速度方差，从而支持更稳定的粗步长ODE积分。

Result: 标准桥方法需要≥10步收敛，而RSBM在仅3个积分步数内达到94%以上的余弦相似度和92%的成功率，无需蒸馏或多阶段训练。

Conclusion: RSBM显著缩小了高保真生成式策略与具身AI低延迟需求之间的差距，为实时机器人控制中的视觉导航提供高效解决方案。

Abstract: Visual navigation is a core challenge in Embodied AI, requiring autonomous agents to translate high-dimensional sensory observations into continuous, long-horizon action trajectories. While generative policies based on diffusion models and Schrödinger Bridges (SB) effectively capture multimodal action distributions, they require dozens of integration steps due to high-variance stochastic transport, posing a critical barrier for real-time robotic control. We propose Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching (RSBM), a framework that exploits a shared velocity-field structure between standard Schrödinger Bridges ($\varepsilon=1$, maximum-entropy transport) and deterministic Optimal Transport ($\varepsilon\to 0$, as in Conditional Flow Matching), controlled by a single entropic regularization parameter $\varepsilon$. We prove two key results: (1) the conditional velocity field's functional form is invariant across the entire $\varepsilon$-spectrum (Velocity Structure Invariance), enabling a single network to serve all regularization strengths; and (2) reducing $\varepsilon$ linearly decreases the conditional velocity variance, enabling more stable coarse-step ODE integration. Anchored to a learned conditional prior that shortens transport distance, RSBM operates at an intermediate $\varepsilon$ that balances multimodal coverage and path straightness. Empirically, while standard bridges require $\geq 10$ steps to converge, RSBM achieves over 94% cosine similarity and 92% success rate in merely 3 integration steps -- without distillation or multi-stage training -- substantially narrowing the gap between high-fidelity generative policies and the low-latency demands of Embodied AI.

</details>


### [284] [TacSE3: Equivariant SE(3) Motion Estimation from Low-Texture Visuotactile Images for In-Gripper Tracking and Compensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17929)
*Zhongyuan Liao,Junzhe Wang,Qingyang Liu,Zhenmin Huang,Jun Ma,Yi Cai,Fei Meng,Haobo Liang,Michael Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TacSE3，一种将低纹理视触觉观测转化为解耦三维力场并估计SE(3)上增量刚体运动的方法，通过双传感器感知减少平移-旋转歧义，为下游操作任务提供轻量级补偿信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人手内操作需要在频繁视觉遮挡下可靠跟踪物体运动，但低纹理视触觉图像为传统图像或几何匹配方法提供的稳定对应点很少，现有方法难以处理此类场景下的运动估计。

Method: 将低纹理视触觉观测转化为解耦的三维力场，在SE(3)上估计增量刚体运动：平面平移通过接触质心运动推导，旋转主要通过剪切相关的触觉响应估计，并采用双DM-Tac指尖传感器减少平移-旋转歧义。

Result: 双传感器感知有效减少了平移-旋转歧义，支持跨轴和跨物体几何形状的旋转跟踪，提供的轻量级补偿信号无需重新训练基础策略即可提升下游操作任务中的扰动容错能力。

Conclusion: TacSE3提供了一种物理可解释的抓取内跟踪与补偿信号，通过双触觉传感器协同解决了单传感器下的运动歧义问题，并展示了在无需重新训练策略的情况下提升操作鲁棒性的实用价值。

Abstract: Robotic in-hand manipulation requires reliable object-motion tracking under frequent visual occlusion, yet low-texture visuotactile images provide few stable correspondences for conventional image- or geometry-matching methods. This paper presents TacSE3, a tactile motion-estimation pipeline that converts low-texture visuotactile observations into a decoupled three-dimensional force field and estimates incremental rigid-body motion on SE(3). The method derives planar translation from contact-centroid motion and estimates rotation primarily from shear-related tactile responses, yielding a physically interpretable signal for in-gripper tracking and compensation. Experiments with paired DM-Tac fingertip sensors show that dual-sensor sensing reduces translation-rotation ambiguity, supports rotation tracking across axes and object geometries, and provides a lightweight compensation signal that improves disturbance tolerance in downstream manipulation tasks without retraining the base policy.

</details>


### [285] [PRISM-SLAM: Probabilistic Ray-Grounded Inference for Scale-aware Metric SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19257)
*Eunsoo Im,Gyeonggwan Lee,Junghun Suh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PRISM-SLAM是一个实时单目SLAM框架，通过将视觉基础模型（VFM）的先验知识严格整合到贝叶斯因子图中，实现了尺度感知和度量一致的定位与建图。它引入Plücker射线-距离因子解决尺度漂移问题，并提出动态场景不确定性门控（DSUG）机制处理环境动态，在仅使用RGB输入的情况下以30 FPS输出可靠的度量轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目SLAM长期受困于尺度模糊性和动态环境中的跟踪失败问题。现有的视觉基础模型虽能提供出色的零样本深度先验，但直接整合这些确定性预测忽略了预测不确定性和帧间尺度不一致性。

Method: 1) 提出Plücker射线-距离因子（Plücker Ray-Distance Factor），将单目观测锚定在全局一致的度量坐标系中，从数学上使度量尺度成为Fisher可辨识的，从而解决尺度漂移；2) 推导基于时间深度一致性的认知不确定性代理，提出动态场景不确定性门控（DSUG）机制，通过软门控概率性地降低动态干扰物的权重，避免传统语义分割掩码的高计算开销；3) 采用多进程架构异步处理VFM推理和几何跟踪，实现30 FPS的度量输出。

Result: 在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes基准上，PRISM-SLAM的度量SE(3)绝对轨迹误差（ATE）与对齐后的Sim(3)误差几乎相同，表明系统能直接生成可直接部署的度量轨迹，无需任何后处理尺度校正。

Conclusion: PRISM-SLAM成功弥合了基础模型与现实机器人应用之间的差距，提供了鲁棒的、无需后处理的单目度量SLAM解决方案。

Abstract: Monocular SLAM historically suffers from scale ambiguity and tracking failure in dynamic environments. While recent vision foundation models (VFMs) provide remarkable zero-shot depth priors, naively integrating these deterministic predictions ignores predictive uncertainty and frame-to-frame scale inconsistencies. We propose PRISM-SLAM, a real-time framework that rigorously integrates VFM priors into a structured Bayesian factor graph to achieve scale-aware, metric-consistent localization and mapping. Specifically, we introduce a Plücker Ray-Distance Factor to anchor monocular observations in absolute space within a globally consistent metric coordinate system, mathematically resolving scale drift by making the metric scale Fisher-identifiable. To handle environmental dynamics, we derive an epistemic uncertainty proxy from temporal depth consistency and formulate a Dynamic Scene Uncertainty Gating (DSUG) mechanism. This soft-gating approach probabilistically down-weights dynamic distractors without incurring the heavy computational overhead associated with traditional semantic segmentation masks. By employing a multi-process architecture that asynchronously processes VFM inference and geometric tracking, PRISM-SLAM provides verified metric output at 30 FPS using solely RGB input, bridging the gap between foundation models and real-world robotic applications. Evaluated on the TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes benchmarks, PRISM-SLAM achieves a metric $SE(3)$ Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) nearly identical to its oracle-aligned $Sim(3)$ error. This demonstrates that our system can produce deployment-ready metric trajectories by delivering robust metric SLAM solutions without any post-hoc scale correction. Project page: https://prismslam-cmd.github.io/prismslam_pr/

</details>


### [286] [Implicit Null-space Manifold Generation for Redundant Robotic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25770)
*Taiki Ishigaki,Teresa Vidal-Calleja,Ko Ayusawa,Eiichi Yoshida*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于隐式标量场表示的方法，用于估计冗余机器人系统中由任务映射诱导的解流形的几何结构。通过Jacobian引导的探索策略在解流形邻域生成样本，构建定义在配置空间上的隐式距离场，其零水平集对应解流形。在平面三连杆机器人和七自由度Franka机械臂上的实验验证了该方法的有效性，并展示了其能够对连续变化的任务族进行一致性建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常通过Jacobian技术利用冗余度计算单个解或轨迹，但未能保留解集本身的几何结构表示，缺乏对流形全局形状的认知。

Method: 采用表示为中心的思路，通过Jacobian引导的探索策略在解流形邻域高效采样，构建配置空间上的隐式标量场，其零水平集即为解流形；该表示自然诱导出编码到解流形距离的连续距离场。

Result: 在平面三连杆机器人和七自由度Franka机械臂上验证了所提表示的有效性，并证明该框架能够对连续变化的任务族进行一致建模。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种保留解流形几何结构的隐式表示，相比仅计算单个解的传统Jacobian方法，更能捕捉解空间的全局与局部结构。

Abstract: Robotic systems with redundant degrees of freedom can achieve the same task outcome using multiple configurations, resulting in solution sets that form manifolds in the configuration space. Existing approaches typically exploit such redundancy locally through Jacobian-based techniques to compute individual solutions or trajectories. While effective for solution computation, these methods do not retain a representation of the geometry of the solution set itself. In this work, we adopt a representation-centric approach to estimate the geometric structure of the solution space. We consider solution manifolds induced by general task-defining maps and construct an implicit scalar field over the configuration space, whose zero-level set corresponds to the solution manifold. To this end, we generate samples in the neighborhood of the solution manifold using a Jacobian-guided exploration strategy, which efficiently captures its local and global structure. The resulting implicit representation is defined over the configuration space and naturally induces a continuous, distance field that encodes proximity to the solution manifold. Experiments on a planar three-link robot and a seven-degree-of-freedom Franka manipulator demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed representation. Furthermore, the framework enables consistent modeling of solution spaces across families of tasks with continuous variation.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [287] [Personalized Observation Normalization for Federated Reinforcement Learning in Simulation Environments with Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27385)
*Yiran Pang,Zhen Ni,Xiangnan Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对联邦强化学习在异构环境中的挑战，本文提出个性化观测归一化（PON）方法，通过本地维护动态均值和方差实现各智能体的个性化状态归一化，实验证明该方法能加速训练并取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FedRL在异构环境中面临不同状态转移动态导致的输入分布不一致和参数更新不平衡的问题，现有方法难以有效解决。

Method: 提出个性化观测归一化（PON）方法，每个智能体使用本地持续更新的运行均值和方差对原始状态输入进行归一化，实现局部特征的尺度一致化而不在聚合时相互掩盖。

Result: 在异构MuJoCo任务上，PON加速了训练过程，且性能优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 共享归一化参数在异构环境下无效，个性化统计量有其必要性；PON是应对FedRL异构性的有效方案。

Abstract: Federated reinforcement learning (FedRL) enables multiple agents to collaboratively train a global policy without sharing raw data, making it ideal for privacy-sensitive applications. However, FedRL faces challenges in heterogeneous environments where differing state-transition dynamics lead to non-identical input distributions and imbalanced parameter updates during aggregation. Therefore, this paper develops a personalized observation normalization (PON) method, allowing each agent to locally normalize raw state inputs using a continuously updated running mean and variance. This design ensures consistent scaling of local feature without overshadowing across agents during aggregation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that sharing normalization parameters across agents is ineffective due to the diverse local input distributions, which highlights the necessity of personalized statistics. Experiments on heterogeneous MuJoCo tasks show that our developed PON accelerates training and achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods.

</details>


### [288] [EEG-FM-Audit: A Systematic Evaluation and Analysis Pipeline for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26910)
*Xianheng Wang,Yige Yang,Damien Coyle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EEG-FM-Audit，一个系统化评估和分析EEG基础模型的流程，包含ASHA驱动的基准测试、范式级别消融研究和神经生理探测（NPP）三部分。通过对四个SOTA EEG-FM和五个监督模型在三个数据集上的评估，发现：适当调优的监督基线能以更少参数匹配或超越先进FM；FM学习范式的有效性高度依赖数据集规模和架构；NPP分析揭示了FM依赖特定的生理特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型存在三个关键局限：不透明的监督基线调优、未验证复杂学习范式的贡献、以及模型决策缺乏透明度。因此需要一套系统化的评估和分析流程来解决这些问题。

Method: 提出了EEG-FM-Audit流程，包含三个主要组件：(1) ASHA驱动的基准测试协议，通过透明优化监督基线确保公平比较；(2) 范式级别消融研究，评估FM中学习范式的有效性；(3) 神经生理探测（NPP）框架，探索FM是否利用了有效的时域、空域和频域EEG特性。

Result: (1) 适当调优的监督基线能以显著更少的参数匹配或超越先进FM；(2) FM学习范式的有效性高度依赖于数据集规模和架构；(3) NPP分析展示了FM如何依赖特定的生理特征，为更可解释的神经解码建立了框架。

Conclusion: EEG-FM-Audit为EEG基础模型提供了系统化的评估和分析方法，揭示了当前FM在参数效率和范式有效性方面的局限，并为更可解释的神经解码提供了方向。

Abstract: Large EEG Foundation Models (FMs) have shown great potential for decoding EEG signals across diverse cognitive tasks. However, existing EEG-FM studies exhibit three critical limitations: opaque supervised baseline tuning, unverified contributions of complex learning paradigms, and a lack of transparency in model decision-making. To address these, we propose EEG-FM-Audit, a comprehensive evaluation and analysis pipeline designed to systematize the assessment of EEG-FMs. EEG-FM-Audit consists of three primary components: (1) an ASHA-driven benchmarking protocol that ensures fair comparisons by transparently optimizing supervised baselines; (2) paradigm-level ablation studies to evaluate the effectiveness of learning paradigms in FMs; and (3) a neurophysiological probing (NPP) framework, which explores whether FMs leverage valid temporal, spatial, and spectral EEG properties. We apply EEG-FM-Audit to four state-of-the-art EEG-FMs and five representative supervised models across three public datasets. Our results reveal that properly tuned supervised baselines can match or outperform advanced FMs, despite requiring significantly fewer parameters. Furthermore, we find that the effectiveness of learning paradigms of FMs is highly dependent on dataset scale and architecture. Finally, NPP analysis demonstrates how FMs rely on specific physiological features, establishing a framework for more interpretable neural decoding.

</details>


### [289] [IGADA-IoT: IoT Sensor Energy Optimization in Wireless Sensor Networks Driven by Automatic Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27397)
*Mingchun Sun,Rongqiang Zhao,Muhammad Abdul Munnaf,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种信息间隙引导的物联网传感器自动数据增强框架（IGADA-IoT），通过分层多生成器协作与调度、信息间隙-模型性能联合评估与闭环方法，解决了现有方法中单生成器依赖、样本分配针对性差、增强不足或过度的风险问题，在多个下游模型上平均准确率提升7.27%~8.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WSN数据增强方法依赖单一生成器和经验确定数量，无法建立动态信息间隙与多生成器之间的映射，忽视生成样本的异质性，且缺乏联合考虑信息间隙与模型性能的评估与闭环机制。

Method: 提出IGADA-IoT框架，包含分层多生成器协作与调度策略（HMGCS）以增强样本分配的针对性与合理性，以及信息间隙-模型性能联合评估与闭环方法（IGMP-EC）以提升增强决策准确性，缓解欠增强和过增强风险。

Result: IGADA-IoT使多个下游模型平均准确率提升7.27%；相比先进数据增强方法平均准确率提升8.67%；相比单一生成器平均准确率提升7.24%；在UCR Archive和真实部署数据集上验证了准确性和泛化性。

Conclusion: 所提方法通过多生成器协作与闭环评估机制有效优化了物联网传感器的数据增强决策，提升了模型性能并具备良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), data augmentation is a novel method to improve sampling-frequency decision performance, thereby enabling energy optimization for IoT (Internet of Things) sensors. However, existing methods rely on a single generator and empirically determined quantities, failing to establish a mapping between dynamic information gaps and multiple generators, and overlooking the heterogeneity of generated samples. Moreover, an evaluation and a closed-loop method that jointly considers the information gap and the model performance are lacking. To address these issues, we propose an information gap-guided IoT sensor automatic data augmentation framework (IGADA-IoT) with hierarchical multi-generator collaboration and scheduling over multiple rounds. Capabilities of different generators are jointly utilized to reduce the information gaps. In the IGADA-IoT, a hierarchical multi-generator collaboration and scheduling strategy (HMGCS) is proposed to enhance the targetedness and rationality of generated sample allocation. An information gap-model performance joint evaluation and closed-loop method (IGMP-EC) is proposed to enhance the accuracy of augmentation decisions, and to mitigate the risks of under-augmentation and over-augmentation. Experimental results show that the IGADA-IoT improves the average accuracy of multiple downstream models by 7.27%. Compared with advanced data augmentation methods, the average accuracy is improved by 8.67%. Compared with the individual generators, the average accuracy is improved by 7.24%. Furthermore, public IoT sensor datasets from the UCR Archive and real-world deployments demonstrate the accuracy and generalizability of the proposed method.

</details>


### [290] [A Simple State Space Model Excels at Multivariate Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27406)
*Hassan Saadatmand,Geoffrey I. Webb,Hamid Rezatofighi,Mahsa Salehi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了状态空间模型（SSMs）在时间序列分类（TSC）中的应用，发现轻量级对角SSM（S4D）在准确率和效率上均优于复杂的Mamba系列模型，并提出了改进版本MS4和MS4N，在59个数据集上验证了其高效性，挑战了TSC中“越复杂越好”的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSC研究过度集中于复杂的Mamba架构，忽视了对角SSM等更广泛的设计空间，作者希望系统探索并回答：在TSC任务中，是否真的需要如此高的模型复杂度才能取得最佳性能。

Method: 首先系统比较了S4D（对角SSM）与Mamba系列（输入依赖SSM）在TSC任务上的表现；然后提出MS4（在S4D基础上加入线性输入投影和通道混合机制）和MS4N（加入归一化机制稳定状态动力学）两种轻量级改进。

Result: 在59个数据集（包括MONSTER和UEA基准）上，MS4和MS4N在准确率和效率上均一致优于Mamba模型；MS4N达到或超越了参数量大2倍和10倍的深度学习模型，且S4D本身即优于Mamba变体。

Conclusion: 轻量级结构化SSM是TSC领域相比追求复杂性的更具竞争力的替代方案，挑战了“增加复杂度带来有意义提升”的普遍假设。

Abstract: Structured state space models (SSMs) have recently emerged as a promising foundation for sequence modeling, with Mamba-based architectures demonstrating strong performance through input-dependent state transitions, albeit at considerable complexity. However, their application to time-series classification (TSC) has been largely limited to Mamba-style architectures, leaving the broader SSM design space underexplored. We present the first systematic study spanning diagonal SSMs (S4D) and input-dependent SSMs (Mamba family) on large-scale TSC benchmarks, asking whether such complexity is necessary for top performance. Our results reveal a surprising finding: S4D consistently outperforms Mamba-based variants in both accuracy and efficiency, challenging the assumption that increased complexity translates to meaningful gains in TSC. Building on this, we introduce MS4, lightweight modifications to S4D via a linear input projection and channel-mixing mechanism, and MS4N, a normalized variant that stabilizes state dynamics with negligible overhead. Evaluated on 59 datasets across MONSTER (up to 60 million samples, 50K timesteps, 82 classes) and the UEA benchmark, against 15 baselines, MS4 and MS4N consistently outperform Mamba-based models while remaining more efficient, and MS4N matches or surpasses competing deep learning models that are roughly 2x and 10x larger in parameters. These results position lightweight structured SSMs as a compelling alternative to scaling complexity for TSC.

</details>


### [291] [$E^3$-Agent: An Executable and Evolving Agent for Resource Management of Edge Generative Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27428)
*Rui Bao,Yaping Sun,Zhiyong Chen,Feng Yang,Meixia Tao,Nan Li,Wenjun Zhang*
