Further, we review data-modality-specific applications in computer vision, natural language processing, and graph representation learning. Finally, we provide an overview of causal benchmarks and a critical discussion of the state of this nascent field, including recommendations for future work.

</details>


### [441] [Adversarial Fine-tuning of Compressed Neural Networks for Joint Improvement of Robustness and Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.09441)
*Hallgrimur Thorsteinsson,Valdemar J Henriksen,Daniel I R Cruz,Raghavendra Selvan,Tong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络压缩对对抗鲁棒性的影响，发现对压缩模型进行对抗微调可以在保持计算效率的同时，获得与对抗训练相当的鲁棒性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型容易受到对抗性攻击，而对抗训练虽然能提升鲁棒性但计算成本高昂。对抗鲁棒性与计算效率这两个目标看似矛盾，因此需要探索在保持计算效率的同时提升鲁棒性的方法。

Method: 研究神经网络压缩对对抗鲁棒性的影响，对比标准微调与对抗微调在压缩模型上的效果差异，在多个基准数据集上进行实验验证。

Result: 对压缩模型进行对抗微调能够显著提升其鲁棒性性能，且可以达到与对抗训练模型相当的鲁棒性水平，同时提高计算效率。

Conclusion: 对抗微调压缩模型是一种有效的策略，能够在对抗鲁棒性与计算效率之间取得更好的平衡。

Abstract: As deep learning (DL) models are increasingly being integrated into our everyday lives, ensuring their safety by making them robust against adversarial attacks has become increasingly critical. DL models have been found to be susceptible to adversarial attacks by introducing small, targeted perturbations to disrupt the input data. Adversarial training has been presented as a mitigation strategy that can result in more robust models. This adversarial robustness comes with additional computational costs required to design adversarial attacks during training. The two objectives -- adversarial robustness and computational efficiency -- then appear to be in conflict with each other. In this work, we explore the effects of neural network compression on adversarial robustness. We specifically explore the effects of fine-tuning on compressed models, and present the trade-off between standard fine-tuning and adversarial fine-tuning. Our results show that adversarial fine-tuning of compressed models can yield large improvements to their robustness performance. We present experiments on several benchmark datasets showing that adversarial fine-tuning of compressed models can achieve robustness performance comparable to adversarially trained models, while also improving computational efficiency. Source code is available here: https://github.com/saintslab/Adver-Fine.

</details>


### [442] [Weak Convergence Analysis of Online Neural Actor-Critic Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.16825)
*Samuel Chun-Hei Lam,Justin Sirignano,Ziheng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在线Actor-Critic算法训练的单层神经网络，在隐藏单元数和训练步数趋于无穷时，其分布收敛到一个随机常微分方程（ODE）。通过泊松方程和弱收敛技术，证明了Actor和Critic网络的收敛性，并指出极限Critic网络能无偏估计策略梯度，Actor网络收敛到稳定点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线Actor-Critic算法中，数据样本分布随模型更新动态变化，这为收敛性分析带来了关键挑战。本文旨在解决这一动态环境下的收敛性问题。

Method: 建立了固定Actor策略下数据样本的几何遍历性；利用泊松方程证明随机数据样本导致的模型更新波动在参数更新次数趋于无穷时消失；采用弱收敛技术，证明Actor和Critic神经网络收敛到具有随机初始条件的ODE系统解。

Result: 证明了在线Actor-Critic算法训练的单层神经网络收敛到随机ODE；极限Critic网络收敛到真实价值函数，为Actor提供渐近无偏的策略梯度估计；极限Actor网络收敛到稳定点。

Conclusion: 在线Actor-Critic算法在无限隐藏单元和无限训练步数极限下具有理论收敛保证，验证了该算法的统计一致性和渐近性质。

Abstract: We prove that a single-layer neural network trained with the online actor critic algorithm converges in distribution to a random ordinary differential equation (ODE) as the number of hidden units and the number of training steps $\rightarrow \infty$. In the online actor-critic algorithm, the distribution of the data samples dynamically changes as the model is updated, which is a key challenge for any convergence analysis. We establish the geometric ergodicity of the data samples under a fixed actor policy. Then, using a Poisson equation, we prove that the fluctuations of the model updates around the limit distribution due to the randomly-arriving data samples vanish as the number of parameter updates $\rightarrow \infty$. Using the Poisson equation and weak convergence techniques, we prove that the actor neural network and critic neural network converge to the solutions of a system of ODEs with random initial conditions. Analysis of the limit ODE shows that the limit critic network will converge to the true value function, which will provide the actor an asymptotically unbiased estimate of the policy gradient. We then prove that the limit actor network will converge to a stationary point.

</details>


### [443] [Unifying Low Dimensional Spectra in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.06106)
*Connall Garrod,Jonathan P. Keating*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用无约束特征模型（UFMs）证明深度神经网络中的低维谱结构（如Hessian、梯度、权重矩阵的bulk+outlier谱）源于深度神经坍缩（DNC），并提供了特征值和特征向量的统一解析解释，适用于线性网络和ReLU网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习分类网络在过参数化条件下，其矩阵（Hessian、梯度、权重）的谱普遍呈现低维结构（bulk+outlier），但现有理论只能解释部分现象或依赖不切实际的假设，缺乏统一且可解析的解释。

Method: 采用无约束特征模型（UFMs）这一研究深度神经坍缩（DNC）的标准工具，从特征均值（DNC的表征对象）出发，解析构建多种深度学习矩阵的特征值和特征向量，并在线性网络和ReLU网络上进行理论证明与数值验证。

Result: 证明了DNC是多种深度学习矩阵（Hessian、梯度、权重）低维谱结构的共同来源；特征值和特征向量均可由特征均值解析构造；超越以往仅关注特征值的经验研究，首次提供了特征向量的详细分析；结果在线性网络和ReLU网络以及标准数据集上均成立。

Conclusion: 该工作为深度学习中广泛的谱现象提供了统一的解析解释，揭示了DNC作为谱结构根源的理论地位，并拓展了谱分析从特征值到特征向量的理论深度。

Abstract: Low dimensional structures appear ubiquitously in the eigenspectra of deep learning matrices in classification networks trained in the overparameterized regime. While theoretical advances have aimed to explain this phenomenology, they typically succeed only in capturing subsets of the full behavior or rely on assumptions that cannot hold in practice. In this work, we provide an analytic explanation for the bulk plus outlier structure of several canonical deep learning matrices, including the Hessian, gradients, and weights. We achieve this using unconstrained feature models (UFMs), a now-common tool for studying the emergence of deep neural collapse (DNC). We show that DNC is the source of these low dimensional eigenspectra, in each case, the eigenvalues and eigenvectors can be constructed from feature means, the characterizing objects of DNC. This provides a unifying analytic explanation for a wide range of spectral phenomena in deep learning and goes beyond empirical characterizations, which typically focus on eigenvalues, by providing a detailed analysis of eigenvectors. We prove that our results hold for both linear and ReLU networks and provide numerical validation in both the modeling context and standard deep-network architectures on canonical datasets.

</details>


### [444] [Generalized Holographic Reduced Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.09689)
*Calvin Yeung,Zhuowen Zou,SungHeon Jeong,Wenjun Huang,Nathaniel D Bastian,Mohsen Imani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出广义全息简化表示（GHRR），一种扩展的傅里叶全息简化表示（FHRR）框架，通过引入灵活的非交换绑定操作，改进了超维计算（HDC）对复杂组合结构的编码能力，并在语言建模任务中通过替代Transformer的注意力机制取得了优于原始模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HDC作为一种计算和数据高效的范式，其简单性导致编码复杂组合结构时存在挑战，尤其是在绑定操作方面，因此需要一种更灵活的绑定机制来扩展其表达能力。

Method: 提出GHRR框架，引入灵活的非交换绑定操作；证明其理论性质及对HDC属性的遵循；探索其核函数和绑定特性；通过实验展示其非交换性和对组合结构的解码准确率提升；证明GHRR的绑定可实现一种注意力机制，并在Transformer中替换注意力机制进行语言建模任务验证。

Result: GHRR在解码组合结构的准确率上优于其他HDC变体；其绑定操作可等效实现注意力机制；在语言建模任务中，用GHRR等效注意力替换原始Transformer的注意力机制后，性能得到提升。

Conclusion: GHRR通过非交换绑定扩展了HDC的表达能力，同时保持了HDC的鲁棒性和透明性，并在实际任务中展示了优于标准Transformer的潜力。

Abstract: Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) is a computationally and data-efficient paradigm that acts as a bridge between connectionist and symbolic approaches to artificial intelligence (AI). However, HDC's simplicity poses challenges for encoding complex compositional structures, especially in its binding operation. To address this, we propose Generalized Holographic Reduced Representations (GHRR), an extension of Fourier Holographic Reduced Representations (FHRR), a specific HDC implementation. GHRR introduces a flexible, non-commutative binding operation, enabling improved encoding of complex data structures while preserving HDC's desirable properties of robustness and transparency. In this work, we introduce the GHRR framework, prove its theoretical properties and its adherence to HDC properties, explore its kernel and binding characteristics, and perform empirical experiments showcasing its flexible non-commutativity, enhanced decoding accuracy for compositional structures. We also demonstrate that binding in GHRR is more expressive than that in other HDC variants; in particular, we show that binding in GHRR can implement a kind of attention mechanism. We verify this by replacing the attention mechanism in a transformer with its GHRR-equivalent and testing it on a language modeling task, showing improved performance compared to a vanilla transformer.

</details>


### [445] [Sinc Kolmogorov-Arnold network and its application for solving PDEs with singularities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.04096)
*Tianchi Yu,Jingwei Qiu,Jiang Yang,Ivan Oseledets*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在Kolmogorov-Arnold网络中使用Sinc插值作为可学习激活函数，实验表明SincKAN在函数逼近和物理信息神经网络求解偏微分方程中效果优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN网络作为MLP的替代方案已尝试多种函数表示，但缺乏既能有效逼近光滑函数又能处理奇异函数的统一方案，Sinc插值在数值分析中恰好具备这一特性。

Method: 将Sinc插值引入KAN网络作为可学习激活函数，替代已有的函数表示方法，构建SincKAN架构。

Result: 在几乎所有的实验案例中，SincKAN均取得了比现有方法更好的结果。

Conclusion: Sinc插值是KAN网络中一个可行且有效的激活函数表示方案，尤其适用于函数逼近和PINN求解偏微分方程任务。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose to use Sinc interpolation in the context of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, neural networks with learnable activation functions, which recently gained attention as alternatives to Multilayer Perceptron. Many different function representations have already been tried, but we show that Sinc interpolation proposes a viable alternative, since it is known in numerical analysis to effectively represent both smooth functions and functions with singularities. This is important not only for function approximation but also for solving the partial differential equations with physics-informed neural networks. Through a series of experiments, we show that SincKANs provide better results in almost all of the examples we have considered.

</details>


### [446] [AdaMemento: Adaptive Memory-Assisted Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.04498)
*Renye Yan,Yaozhong Gan,You Wu,Junliang Xing,Ling Liangn,Yeshang Zhu,Yimao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaMemento是一种自适应记忆增强的强化学习框架，通过记忆反思模块同时利用正负经验，结合细粒度内在激励与集成学习，在稀疏奖励场景中显著优于先前方法。在59项实验中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆增强强化学习方法仅简单存储和复用的高价值策略，缺乏对多样化过去经验的深度精炼与筛选，限制了记忆在稀疏奖励场景下的能力。

Method: 1) 记忆反思模块：学习基于实时状态预测已知局部最优策略，同时利用正负经验；2) 细粒度内在激励范式：精确区分相似状态间的细微差异以引导探索；3) 集成学习机制：自适应协调经验利用与新策略探索，趋近全局最优。

Result: 通过59项定量与可视化实验，AdaMemento能够区分细微状态以进行更好的探索，并有效利用记忆中的过去经验，显著优于先前方法。

Conclusion: AdaMemento通过自适应记忆增强框架，在理论（证明了内在激励与集成机制的优越性）和实验两方面均验证了其有效性，为稀疏奖励场景下的强化学习提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: In sparse reward scenarios of reinforcement learning (RL), the memory mechanism provides promising shortcuts to policy optimization by reflecting on past experiences like humans. However, current memory-based RL methods simply store and reuse high-value policies, lacking a deeper refining and filtering of diverse past experiences and hence limiting the capability of memory. In this paper, we propose AdaMemento, an adaptive memory-enhanced RL framework. Instead of just memorizing positive past experiences, we design a memory-reflection module that exploits both positive and negative experiences by learning to predict known local optimal policies based on real-time states. To effectively gather informative trajectories for the memory, we further introduce a fine-grained intrinsic motivation paradigm, where nuances in similar states can be precisely distinguished to guide exploration. The exploitation of past experiences and exploration of new policies are then adaptively coordinated by ensemble learning to approach the global optimum. Furthermore, we theoretically prove the superiority of our new intrinsic motivation and ensemble mechanism. From 59 quantitative and visualization experiments, we confirm that AdaMemento can distinguish subtle states for better exploration and effectively exploiting past experiences in memory, achieving significant improvement over previous methods.

</details>


### [447] [Revisiting Graph Autoencoders as Implicit Contrastive Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10241)
*Jintang Li,Ruofan Wu,Yuchang Zhu,Huizhe Zhang,Zulun Zhu,Liang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视图自编码器（GAEs），通过对比学习的视角将GAEs视为隐式图对比学习器，并揭示其差异主要在于对比视图的构建方式。作者提出统一框架，特别强调非对称子图视图这一被忽视的设计维度，并通过实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GAEs和GCL两种自监督图表示学习范式长期被孤立研究，缺乏统一的理论视角来理解它们之间的内在联系。

Method: 通过对比学习视角重新解释结构型和特征型GAEs，提出统一框架将GAEs视为隐式对比学习器，并识别非对称子图视图作为关键设计维度。

Result: 实验表明将GAEs理解为隐式对比学习器有助于更清晰地理解现有模型，并为设计高效可扩展的图自编码器提供实践指导。

Conclusion: GAEs本质上可被看作图对比学习器，其核心差异在于对比视图的设计（尤其是非对称子图视图），这为统一两种范式提供了理论桥梁。

Abstract: Graph autoencoders (GAEs) and graph contrastive learning (GCL) are two major paradigms for self-supervised representation learning on graphs, yet they are often studied in isolation and treated as fundamentally different approaches. In this work, we revisit GAEs through the lens of contrastive learning and show that both structure-based and feature-based GAEs can be conceptualized as implicitly graph contrastive learners. This perspective reveals that many existing GAEs differ primarily in how contrastive views are constructed, rather than in their learning objectives or architectures. Building on this insight, we introduce a unified formulation that highlights contrastive view design as a central and previously less explored dimension in GAEs. In particular, we identify asymmetric contrastive views, arising from mismatches in subgraph views, as an important yet underexplored design axis in prior GAE research. We formalize this insight within a unified framework and conduct systematic experiments on representative graph learning tasks to examine its impact on performance and efficiency. Our results show that interpreting GAEs as implicit contrastive learners offers a clearer understanding of existing models and provides practical guidance for designing effective and scalable graph autoencoders.

</details>


### [448] [CANDOR: Counterfactual ANnotated DOubly Robust Off-Policy Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.08052)
*Aishwarya Mandyam,Shengpu Tang,Jiayu Yao,Jenna Wiens,Barbara E. Engelhardt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一类基于双重鲁棒框架的离策略评估方法，通过将不完美的人工标注反事实样本仅用于奖励模型（DM）组件，在理论上证明了该方法具有最优的统计性质，并在多个医疗健康任务（包括真实电子健康记录数据）上验证了其对模型误设定和标注错误的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离策略评估（OPE）在高风险决策场景（如医疗健康）中至关重要，但现有OPE技术受限于数据覆盖范围。近期工作尝试通过添加专家标注的反事实样本来改善数据覆盖，然而这些标注往往不完美，可能导致比不使用标注更差的估计性能。

Method: 提出一系列基于双重鲁棒（DR）框架的OPE估计器，该框架结合重要性采样（IS）和奖励模型（直接方法，DM）。研究了三种将反事实标注纳入估计的方式，并在温和假设下证明了仅将标注用于DM组件能获得最优理论结果。

Result: 在多个医疗健康任务（包括真实EHR数据）上的实验表明，仅将标注用于DM组件的策略在奖励模型误设定和标注不准确的情况下最为鲁棒。

Conclusion: 通过解决不完美标注带来的挑战，该工作拓宽了OPE方法的应用范围，促进了医疗健康领域决策策略的更安全部署。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) is critical for applying contextual bandit algorithms to high-stakes decision-making settings such as healthcare, where new treatment policies must be evaluated prior to deployment. Unfortunately, OPE techniques are inherently limited by the breadth of the available data, which may not be sufficient to evaluate the performance of a new policy. Recent work attempts to improve dataset coverage by adding expert-annotated counterfactual samples. However, such annotations are often imperfect and can lead to worse estimator performance than using no annotations at all. To better leverage imperfect annotations, we propose a family of OPE estimators grounded in the doubly robust (DR) framework, which combines importance sampling (IS) with a reward model (direct method, DM) for better statistical guarantees. We study three ways of incorporating counterfactual annotations. Under mild assumptions, we prove that using annotations within just the DM component yields the most desirable theoretical results. Experiments on multiple healthcare tasks, including real-world electronic health records (EHR) data, show that this strategy is most robust under misspecified reward models and inaccurate annotations. By addressing the challenges posed by imperfect annotations, this work broadens the applicability of OPE methods and facilitates safer deployment of decision-making policies in healthcare.

</details>


### [449] [HEART: Achieving Timely Multi-Model Training for Vehicle-Edge-Cloud-Integrated Hierarchical Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09934)
*Xiaohong Yang,Minghui Liwang,Xianbin Wang,Zhipeng Cheng,Seyyedali Hosseinalipour,Huaiyu Dai,Zhenzhen Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HEART框架，通过混合同步-异步聚合规则、改进的粒子群优化与遗传算法结合的任务调度以及低复杂度的贪心训练优先级排序，解决了动态VEC-HFL中多模型训练的模型过时、数据利用低效和资源分配不平衡等关键挑战，最小化全局训练延迟并实现多任务平衡训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VEC-HFL中车辆需要同时执行多个ML任务，现有文献对这一多模型训练环境研究不足，存在三个关键挑战：不当聚合规则导致模型过时和训练时间延长；车辆移动性导致模型无法返回边缘、数据利用低效；跨任务资源分配不平衡严重影响协同训练效果。

Method: 提出HEART框架，包含两阶段：第一阶段通过混合启发式方法（改进的PSO和GA结合）实现平衡的任务调度；第二阶段采用低复杂度贪心算法确定车辆上已分配任务的训练优先级。同时引入混合同步-异步聚合规则以促进及时模型训练。

Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，HEART框架在最小化全局训练延迟和实现多任务平衡训练方面优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统性地解决了VEC-HFL中多模型训练的挑战，验证了混合同步-异步聚合结合启发式任务调度与贪心优先级排序方法的有效性，为动态车联网环境下的多任务联邦学习提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: The rapid growth of AI-enabled Internet of Vehicles (IoV) calls for efficient Machine Learning (ML) solutions that can handle high vehicular mobility and decentralized data. This has motivated the emergence of Hierarchical Federated Learning over vehicle-edge-cloud architectures (VEC-HFL). Nevertheless, one aspect which is underexplored in the literature on VEC-HFL is that vehicles often need to execute multiple ML tasks simultaneously, where this multi-model training environment introduces crucial challenges. First, improper aggregation rules can lead to model obsolescence and prolonged training times. Second, vehicular mobility may result in inefficient data utilization by preventing the vehicles from returning their models to the network edge. Third, achieving a balanced resource allocation across diverse tasks becomes of paramount importance as it majorly affects the effectiveness of collaborative training. We take one of the first steps towards addressing these challenges via proposing a framework for multi-model training in dynamic VEC-HFL with the goal of minimizing global training latency while ensuring balanced training across various tasks, a problem that turns out to be NP-hard. To facilitate timely model training, we introduce a hybrid synchronous-asynchronous aggregation rule. Building on this, we present a novel method called Hybrid Evolutionary And gReedy allocaTion (HEART). The framework operates in two stages: first, it achieves balanced task scheduling through a hybrid heuristic approach that combines improved Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Genetic Algorithms (GA); second, it employs a low-complexity greedy algorithm to determine the training priority of assigned tasks on vehicles. Experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of HEART over existing methods.

</details>


### [450] [Reevaluating Policy Gradient Methods for Imperfect-Information Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.08938)
*Max Rudolph,Nathan Lichtle,Sobhan Mohammadpour,Alexandre Bayen,J. Zico Kolter,Amy Zhang,Gabriele Farina,Eugene Vinitsky,Samuel Sokota*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验（7000+训练运行）发现，在非完美信息博弈中，基于虚构博弈（FP）、双 oracle（DO）和反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）的深度强化学习算法未能超越通用策略梯度方法（如PPO），并开源了首个广泛可用的精确可开发性计算工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于磁镜像下降算法的最新成果，研究者假设通用策略梯度方法（如PPO）能够与FP、DO、CFR等专门为不完美信息博弈设计的DRL算法竞争甚至超越它们，旨在验证这一假设。

Method: 实现了五个大型博弈的精确可开发性计算并开源；在7000+次训练运行中，系统对比了FP、DO、CFR类方法与通用策略梯度方法（如PPO）的性能。

Result: 基于FP、DO和CFR的方法未能超越通用策略梯度方法。

Conclusion: 在不完美信息博弈中，简单的通用策略梯度方法（如PPO）与专门设计的FP/DO/CFR类方法相比具有竞争力或更优，挑战了此前领域内的主流认知。

Abstract: In the past decade, motivated by the putative failure of naive self-play deep reinforcement learning (DRL) in adversarial imperfect-information games, researchers have developed numerous DRL algorithms based on fictitious play (FP), double oracle (DO), and counterfactual regret minimization (CFR). In light of recent results of the magnetic mirror descent algorithm, we hypothesize that simpler generic policy gradient methods like PPO are competitive with or superior to these FP-, DO-, and CFR-based DRL approaches. To facilitate the resolution of this hypothesis, we implement and release the first broadly accessible exact exploitability computations for five large games. Using these games, we conduct the largest-ever exploitability comparison of DRL algorithms for imperfect-information games. Over 7000 training runs, we find that FP-, DO-, and CFR-based approaches fail to outperform generic policy gradient methods. Code is available at https://github.com/nathanlct/IIG-RL-Benchmark and https://github.com/gabrfarina/exp-a-spiel .

</details>


### [451] [MCTS-Judge: Test-Time Scaling in LLM-as-a-Judge for Code Correctness Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.12468)
*Yutong Wang,Pengliang Ji,Chaoqun Yang,Kaixin Li,Ming Hu,Jiaoyang Li,Guillaume Sartoretti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MCTS-Judge，一种将蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）融入LLM-as-a-Judge范式的框架，用于代码正确性评估。通过测试时计算、节点选择策略和单元测试级奖励机制，在三个基准和五个LLM上将准确率从41%提升至80%，超越o1系列模型且仅使用其1/3的token消耗，同时验证了该范式的测试时缩放定律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge范式在推理密集型场景（如编程）中可靠性不足，受近期推理模型进展和缩放定律转变的启发，将测试时计算引入该范式以提升评估可靠性。

Method: 提出MCTS-Judge框架：1）利用MCTS将复杂问题分解为多视角简单评估；2）设计结合自评估（基于当前轨迹历史动作）和UCT（基于先前回滚）的节点选择策略，平衡全局优化与当前轨迹精炼；3）设计高精度单元测试级奖励机制，鼓励逐行代码分析。

Result: 在三个基准和五个LLM上的实验表明，MCTS-Judge将基础模型准确率从41%提升至80%，超越o1系列模型且仅消耗1/3的token；进一步验证了其推理轨迹在逻辑性、分析性、全面性和整体质量上的优势，并揭示了LLM-as-a-Judge范式的测试时缩放定律。

Conclusion: MCTS-Judge通过将测试时计算与MCTS搜索引入代码评估，显著提升了LLM-as-a-Judge的可靠性，验证了推理轨迹质量的提升和测试时缩放定律的存在，为资源高效的System-2评估范式提供了新方向。

Abstract: The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm shows promise for evaluating generative content but lacks reliability in reasoning-intensive scenarios, such as programming. Inspired by recent advances in reasoning models and shifts in scaling laws, we pioneer bringing test-time computation into LLM-as-a-Judge, proposing MCTS-Judge, a resource-efficient, System-2 thinking framework for code correctness evaluation. MCTS-Judge leverages Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to decompose problems into simpler, multi-perspective evaluations. Through a node-selection strategy that combines self-assessment based on historical actions in the current trajectory and the Upper Confidence Bound for Trees based on prior rollouts, MCTS-Judge balances global optimization and refinement of the current trajectory. We further designed a high-precision, unit-test-level reward mechanism to encourage the Large Language Model (LLM) to perform line-by-line analysis. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks and five LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of MCTS-Judge, which improves the base model's accuracy from 41% to 80%, surpassing the o1-series models with 3x fewer tokens. Further evaluations validate the superiority of its reasoning trajectory in logic, analytics, thoroughness, and overall quality, while revealing the test-time scaling law of the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm.

</details>


### [452] [GradientStabilizer:Fix the Norm, Not the Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17055)
*Tianjin Huang,Zhangyang Wang,Haotian Hu,Zhenyu Zhang,Gaojie Jin,Xiang Li,Li Shen,Jiaxing Shang,Tianlong Chen,Ke Li,Lu Liu,Qingsong Wen,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出GradientStabilizer，一种通过统计估计梯度范数来替代瞬时更新幅度的轻量级梯度变换方法，在不改变梯度方向的前提下稳定训练过程，在多种深度学习任务中优于传统梯度裁剪方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习系统中，罕见但极端的梯度范数尖峰会引发训练不稳定，导致参数更新过大、优化器状态损坏、收敛缓慢或发散。现有梯度裁剪方法虽可缓解问题，但需调整阈值且会不加区分地截断大更新。

Method: 提出GradientStabilizer，一种轻量级即插即用梯度变换：保持瞬时梯度方向不变，利用运行中的梯度范数统计信息生成统计稳定的估计值来替代更新幅度。理论证明稳定幅度在尖峰步上均匀有界，且该有界性控制自适应方法中的优化器状态演化。

Result: 在LLM预训练(FP16)、量化感知预训练(FP4)、ImageNet分类、强化学习、时间序列预测等任务中，GradientStabilizer consistently 提升训练稳定性，扩大稳定学习率区间，降低发散率，甚至显著降低Adam对权重衰减强度的敏感性。

Conclusion: GradientStabilizer作为一种无需阈值调参的梯度稳定方法，在多种深度学习场景下优于基于裁剪的基线方法，为训练不稳定问题提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Training instability in modern deep learning systems is frequently triggered by rare but extreme gradient-norm spikes, which can induce oversized parameter updates, corrupt optimizer state, and lead to slow recovery or divergence. Widely used safeguards such as gradient clipping mitigate these failures but require threshold tuning and indiscriminately truncate large updates. We propose GradientStabilizer, a lightweight, drop-in gradient transform that preserves the instantaneous gradient direction while replacing the update magnitude with a statistically stabilized estimate derived from running gradient-norm statistics. We prove that the resulting stabilized magnitude is uniformly bounded on spike steps, independent of the spike size, and show how this boundedness controls optimizer state evolution in adaptive methods. Across LLM pre-training (FP16), quantization-aware pre-training (FP4), ImageNet classification, reinforcement learning, and time-series forecasting, GradientStabilizer consistently improves training stability, widens stable learning-rate regions, and reduces divergence relative to clipping-based baselines, even substantially reducing Adam's sensitivity to weight-decay strength. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [453] [MM-PoisonRAG: Disrupting Multimodal RAG with Local and Global Poisoning Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17832)
*Hyeonjeong Ha,Qiusi Zhan,Jeonghwan Kim,Dimitrios Bralios,Saikrishna Sanniboina,Nanyun Peng,Kai-Wei Chang,Daniel Kang,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MM-PoisonRAG框架，系统性研究多模态RAG在知识投毒攻击下的脆弱性。设计了两种攻击策略：局部投毒攻击（LPA）植入特定多模态虚假信息操控输出，全局投毒攻击（GPA）通过单次投毒全面破坏生成质量。实验显示LPA攻击成功率高达56%且跨检索器迁移，GPA单次投毒使准确率降至0%，两者均可绕过现有防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态RAG虽能增强事实基础并减少幻觉，但其对外部知识库的依赖使其面临知识投毒攻击的风险，攻击者可注入恶意多模态内容引导模型生成错误甚至有害响应。目前对该漏洞的系统性研究尚属空白。

Method: 提出了MM-PoisonRAG框架，设计了两种攻击策略：1) 局部投毒攻击(LPA)：针对具体查询植入多模态虚假信息，实现攻击者控制的定向输出操控；2) 全局投毒攻击(GPA)：通过单次非定向的对抗性注入，广泛破坏所有查询的推理能力与生成质量。在多种任务、多模态RAG组件和不同攻击者访问权限下进行实验评估。

Result: LPA在受限访问下达到56%的攻击成功率，且无需重新优化即可有效跨四种不同检索器迁移；GPA仅需一次投毒即完全破坏模型生成，准确率降至0%；两种攻击均能绕过现有防御机制。

Conclusion: 多模态RAG在知识投毒攻击下表现出严重脆弱性，现有防御手段难以抵御，表明亟需针对多模态知识投毒的安全防护研究。MM-PoisonRAG为后续研究奠定了基准框架。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a common practice in multimodal large language models (MLLM) to enhance factual grounding and reduce hallucination. Yet, its reliance on retrieval exposes MLLMs to knowledge poisoning attacks, in which adversaries deliberately inject malicious multimodal content into external knowledge bases to steer models toward generating incorrect or even harmful responses. We present MM-PoisonRAG, a framework to systematically study the vulnerability of multimodal RAG under knowledge poisoning. Specifically, we design two novel attack strategies: Localized Poisoning Attack (LPA), which implants targeted, query-specific multimodal misinformation to manipulate outputs toward attacker-controlled responses, and Globalized Poisoning Attack (GPA), which uses a single, untargeted adversarial injection to broadly corrupt reasoning and collapse generation quality across all queries. Extensive experiments on diverse tasks, multimodal RAG components, and attacker access levels reveal severe vulnerabilities: LPA achieves up to 56% attack success rate even under restricted access, and transfers effectively across four different retrievers without re-optimizing the adversaries. GPA completely disrupts model generation to 0% accuracy with just one poisoned content. Moreover, both LPA and GPA bypass existing defenses, underscoring the fragility of multimodal RAG and establishing MM-PoisonRAG as a foundation for future research on securing RAG frameworks against multimodal knowledge poisoning.

</details>


### [454] [LiDDA: Data Driven Attribution at LinkedIn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09861)
*John Bencina,Erkut Aykutlug,Yue Chen,Zerui Zhang,Stephanie Sorenson,Shao Tang,Changshuai Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于Transformer的统一归因方法，能够处理会员级数据、聚合级数据和外部宏观因素，并在LinkedIn大规模实施，取得了显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动归因是现代营销智能的基础，但现有方法难以同时处理多层级数据和外部宏观因素，亟需一个统一框架来提升归因效果。

Method: 提出基于Transformer的统一归因方法，支持会员级数据、聚合级数据和外部宏观因素集成，并在LinkedIn进行大规模实现。

Result: 在LinkedIn大规模实施后，该方法展现了显著的业务影响效果。

Conclusion: 该方法统一了多层级数据归因，对营销和广告技术领域具有广泛适用性和重要参考价值。

Abstract: Data Driven Attribution, which assigns conversion credits to marketing interactions based on causal patterns learned from data, is the foundation of modern marketing intelligence and vital to any marketing business and advertising platform. In this paper, we introduce a unified transformer-based attribution approach that can handle member-level data, aggregate-level data, and integration of external macro factors. We detail the large scale implementation of the approach at LinkedIn, showcasing significant impact. We also share learnings and insights which are broadly applicable to the marketing and ad tech fields.

</details>


### [455] [Structured Agent Distillation for Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13820)
*Jun Liu,Zhenglun Kong,Peiyan Dong,Changdi Yang,Tianqi Li,Hao Tang,Geng Yuan,Wei Niu,Wenbin Zhang,Pu Zhao,Xue Lin,Dong Huang,Yanzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结构化智能体蒸馏框架，通过将轨迹分割为[REASON]和[ACT]片段并施加片段级损失，将大型LLM智能体压缩为小型学生模型，在保持推理保真度和动作一致性的同时显著降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型作为决策智能体时推理成本高、模型体积大，限制了实际部署应用。

Method: 将ReAct风格轨迹分割为[REASON]和[ACT]两个语义片段，分别施加针对性的蒸馏损失，实现结构感知的监督对齐。

Result: 在ALFWorld、HotPotQA-ReAct和WebShop三个基准上，该方法优于token级蒸馏和模仿学习基线，实现了显著的模型压缩且性能损失极小。

Conclusion: 片段级对齐对于构建高效、可部署的紧凑型智能体至关重要，消融实验进一步验证了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong capabilities as decision-making agents by interleaving reasoning and actions, as seen in ReAct-style frameworks. Yet, their practical deployment is constrained by high inference costs and large model sizes. We propose Structured Agent Distillation, a framework that compresses large LLM-based agents into smaller student models while preserving both reasoning fidelity and action consistency. Unlike standard token-level distillation, our method segments trajectories into [REASON] and [ACT] spans, applying segment-specific losses to align each component with the teacher's behavior. This structure-aware supervision enables compact agents to better replicate the teacher's decision process. Experiments on ALFWorld, HotPotQA-ReAct, and WebShop show that our approach consistently outperforms token-level and imitation learning baselines, achieving significant compression with minimal performance drop. Scaling and ablation results further highlight the importance of span-level alignment for efficient and deployable agents.

</details>


### [456] [Semantic-Aware Interpretable Multimodal Music Auto-Tagging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17233)
*Andreas Patakis,Vassilis Lyberatos,Spyridon Kantarelis,Edmund Dervakos,Giorgos Stamou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可解释的音乐自动标注框架，通过聚类多模态特征并利用期望最大化算法分配权重，在保持竞争性能的同时提高了模型决策过程的透明度和可理解性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音乐自动标注的基础模型虽性能优异，但输出缺乏可解释性，限制了研究人员和终端用户的信任与可用性。

Method: 利用信号处理、深度学习、本体工程和自然语言处理等多模态特征，对特征进行语义聚类，并采用期望最大化算法为每组特征分配不同的权重。

Result: 在保持竞争性标注性能的同时，提供了对决策过程的更深入理解。

Conclusion: 该方法为构建更透明、更以用户为中心的音乐标注系统铺平了道路。

Abstract: Music auto-tagging is essential for organizing and discovering music in extensive digital libraries. While foundation models achieve exceptional performance in this domain, their outputs often lack interpretability, limiting trust and usability for researchers and end-users alike. In this work, we present an interpretable framework for music auto-tagging that leverages groups of musically meaningful multimodal features, derived from signal processing, deep learning, ontology engineering, and natural language processing. To enhance interpretability, we cluster features semantically and employ an expectation maximization algorithm, assigning distinct weights to each group based on its contribution to the tagging process. Our method achieves competitive tagging performance while offering a deeper understanding of the decision-making process, paving the way for more transparent and user-centric music tagging systems.

</details>


### [457] [PEAR: Equal Area Weather Forecasting on the Sphere](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17720)
*Hampus Linander,Tage Tykesson,Pietro Rosso,Christoffer Petersson,Daniel Persson,Jan E. Gerken*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PEAR，一种基于HEALPix网格的Transformer天气预报模型，解决了传统等角网格在极地分辨率过高的问题，在无额外计算开销下超越等角网格模型和其他基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动天气预报模型多依赖等角网格，该网格在极点处分辨率过高，导致非物理偏差。HEALPix网格每个像素覆盖等面积，消除此偏差，且气象与气候领域对该网格的支持日益增长。

Method: 提出Pangu Equal ARea (PEAR)，一种原生运行于HEALPix网格上的Transformer架构天气预报模型，直接对HEALPix特征进行操作。

Result: PEAR在HEALPix网格上优于对应的等角网格模型及其他基线方法，且无额外计算开销；验证了设置的等变性；在气候模型仿真中表现良好。

Conclusion: HEALPix网格替代传统等角网格在深度学习天气预报中具有显著优势，PEAR模型为AI4Science在气象领域的应用提供了更物理合理且高效的技术路径。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping the natural sciences, with weather forecasting emerging as a flagship AI4Science application where machine learning models can now rival and even surpass traditional numerical simulations. Following the success of the landmark models Pangu Weather and Graphcast, outperforming traditional numerical methods for global medium-range forecasting, many novel data-driven methods have emerged. A common limitation shared by many of these models is their reliance on an equiangular discretization of the sphere which suffers from a much finer grid at the poles than around the equator. In contrast, in the Hierarchical Equal Area iso-Latitude Pixelization (HEALPix) of the sphere, each pixel covers the same surface area, removing unphysical biases. Motivated by a growing support for this grid in meteorology and climate sciences, we propose to perform weather forecasting with deep learning models which natively operate on the HEALPix grid. To this end, we introduce Pangu Equal ARea (PEAR), a transformer-based weather forecasting model which operates directly on HEALPix-features and outperforms the corresponding model on an equiangular grid, and other baselines, without any computational overhead. Furthermore, we perform numerical experiments on the equivariance properties of our setup and verify the performance of PEAR on climate model emulation.

</details>


### [458] [STFlow: Data-Coupled Flow Matching for Geometric Trajectory Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18647)
*Kiet Bennema ten Brinke,Koen Minartz,Vlado Menkovski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STFlow是一种基于图神经网络和层次卷积的生成模型，通过Flow Matching框架结合数据相关耦合与条件随机游走先验，高效模拟N体系统、分子动力学和人类轨迹预测，在更少模拟步数下实现最低预测误差和更好可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动力系统轨迹模拟在分子动力学、生物化学等领域至关重要，但N体系统轨迹对扰动高度敏感、存在分岔及多尺度时空关联，现有深度生成模型虽结合了几何深度学习与置换/时间平移对称性，但仍难以有效处理这些挑战。

Method: 提出STFlow，基于图神经网络和层次卷积的生成模型；在Flow Matching框架中引入数据相关耦合，使用条件随机游走（而非高斯噪声）作为先验分布进行去噪，通过降低传输代价简化学习任务。

Result: 在N体系统、分子动力学和人类轨迹预测基准上，STFlow以更少的模拟步数实现了最低的预测误差，并展现出更好的可扩展性。

Conclusion: STFlow通过数据相关先验替代高斯噪声，有效降低了Flow Matching中的传输代价，显著提升了训练与推理效率，为复杂动力系统轨迹模拟提供了一种高效且可扩展的生成式解决方案。

Abstract: Simulating trajectories of dynamical systems is a fundamental problem in a wide range of fields such as molecular dynamics, biochemistry, and pedestrian dynamics. Machine learning has become an invaluable tool for scaling physics-based simulators and developing models directly from experimental data. In particular, recent advances in deep generative modeling and geometric deep learning enable probabilistic simulation by learning complex trajectory distributions while respecting intrinsic permutation and time-shift symmetries. However, trajectories of N-body systems are commonly characterized by high sensitivity to perturbations leading to bifurcations, as well as multi-scale temporal and spatial correlations. To address these challenges, we introduce STFlow (Spatio-Temporal Flow), a generative model based on graph neural networks and hierarchical convolutions. By incorporating data-dependent couplings within the Flow Matching framework, STFlow denoises starting from conditioned random-walks instead of Gaussian noise. This novel informed prior simplifies the learning task by reducing transport cost, increasing training and inference efficiency. We validate our approach on N-body systems, molecular dynamics, and human trajectory forecasting. Across these benchmarks, STFlow achieves the lowest prediction errors with fewer simulation steps and improved scalability.

</details>


### [459] [ASTRA: Communication-Efficient Acceleration for Multi-Device Transformer Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.19342)
*Xiao Liu,Lijun Zhang,Deepak Ganesan,Hui Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ASTRA是一种通信高效的多设备推理框架，通过序列并行与混合精度注意力机制，在低带宽（低至10 Mbps）条件下实现了高达2.64倍于单设备推理和15.25倍于现有方法的加速，并在ViT、GPT2和Llama-3-8B等模型上保持鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer多设备推理方法依赖高设备间带宽，在带宽受限环境中难以实际部署。

Method: 将序列并行与混合精度注意力相结合：非局部token嵌入以低比特向量量化码传输，局部注意力保持全精度；并引入噪声增强量化和分布式类别令牌以保持压缩下的精度。

Result: 在视觉和语言模型上，ASTRA在低至10 Mbps带宽下实现最高2.64倍于单设备推理的加速，以及最高15.25倍于现有多设备方法的加速；在Llama-3-8B上对丢包和动态网络等非理想条件表现鲁棒。

Conclusion: ASTRA证明了在带宽受限环境下实现高效多设备Transformer推理的可行性，兼顾了加速比与精度保持。

Abstract: Multi-device inference can reduce Transformer latency by parallelizing computation. However, existing methods require high inter-device bandwidth, making them impractical for bandwidth-constrained environments. We present ASTRA, a communication-efficient framework that integrates sequence parallelism with mixed-precision attention, where non-local token embeddings are transmitted as low-bit vector-quantized codes while local attention remains full precision. To preserve accuracy under aggressive compression, ASTRA introduces Noise-Augmented Quantization and Distributed Class Tokens. Across vision and language models (e.g., ViT and GPT2), ASTRA achieves up to 2.64$\times$ speedup over single-device inference and up to 15.25$\times$ over prior multi-device baselines while operating at bandwidths as low as 10 Mbps. ASTRA remains robust on large models (e.g., Llama-3-8B) even under non-ideal network conditions such as packet loss and dynamic networks.

</details>


### [460] [Local MDI+: Local Feature Importances for Tree-Based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08928)
*Zhongyuan Liang,Zachary T. Rewolinski,Abhineet Agarwal,Tiffany M. Tang,Bin Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LMDI+，一种将全局特征重要性方法MDI+扩展到局部（每样本）解释的框架。LMDI+利用决策树与最小二乘法在变换节点基上的等价性，为每个样本计算特征重要性。在12个真实数据集上，LMDI+在识别实例特定预测特征方面优于现有基线方法（平均性能提升10%），且具有更好的稳定性。消融实验验证了各组件贡献，并表明该方法可扩展到梯度提升模型。LMDI+还能用于发现反事实样本和识别同质子群等局部可解释性应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的局部特征重要性方法（如LIME、TreeSHAP）依赖近似和可能不稳定的扰动，忽略了模型内部结构。虽然全局方法MDI+通过树与最小二乘的等价性解决了这些问题，但无法解释具有异质性个体特征的预测。因此需要一种既能利用模型内部结构、又能提供局部（每样本）解释的特征重要性方法。

Method: LMDI+将MDI+框架从全局扩展到局部。核心思想是利用决策树与最小二乘法在变换节点基上的等价性，将每个决策树视为对节点基的线性组合，从而为每个样本计算局部特征重要性分数。该方法不依赖外部近似或扰动，而是直接利用模型内部结构。

Result: 在12个真实世界基准数据集上，LMDI+在识别实例特定预测特征方面平均优于基线10%（仅使用所选特征的预测性能）。具有更好的稳定性：在不同随机种子的重复模型拟合中，能一致产生相似的实例级特征重要性排名。消融实验表明每个组件均有贡献，且方法可扩展到梯度提升模型。

Conclusion: LMDI+有效弥合了全局与局部特征重要性之间的差距，提供了一种基于模型内部结构、稳定且准确的局部解释方法。可用于识别反事实样本和发现同质子群等实际应用场景，为高 stakes 领域的可信预测提供了重要的可解释性工具。

Abstract: Tree-based ensembles such as random forests remain the go-to for tabular data over deep learning models due to their prediction performance and computational efficiency. These advantages have led to their widespread deployment in high-stakes domains, where interpretability is essential for ensuring trustworthy predictions. This has motivated the development of popular local feature importance methods such as LIME and TreeSHAP. However, these approaches rely on approximations that ignore the model's internal structure and instead depend on potentially unstable perturbations. These issues are addressed in the global setting by MDI+, a global feature importance method which combines tree-based and linear feature importances by exploiting an equivalence between decision trees and least squares on a transformed node basis. However, the global MDI+ scores are not able to explain predictions when faced with heterogeneous individual characteristics. To address this gap, we propose Local MDI+ (LMDI+), a novel extension of the MDI+ framework that quantifies feature importances for each particular sample. Across twelve real-world benchmark datasets, LMDI+ outperforms existing baselines at identifying instance-specific predictive features, yielding an average 10% improvement in predictive performance when using only the selected features. It further demonstrates greater stability by consistently producing similar instance-level feature importance rankings across repeated model fits with different random seeds. Ablation experiments show that each component of LMDI+ contributes to these gains, and that the improvements extend beyond random forests to gradient boosting models. Finally, we show that LMDI+ enables local interpretability use cases by identifying closely matched counterfactuals for each classification benchmark and discovering homogeneous subgroups in a housing dataset case study.

</details>


### [461] [Path Channels and Plan Extension Kernels: a Mechanistic Description of Planning in a Sokoban RNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.10138)
*Mohammad Taufeeque,Aaron David Tucker,Adam Gleave,Adrià Garriga-Alonso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过部分逆向工程，揭示了训练于Sokoban游戏的卷积循环神经网络在隐藏状态中使用特定通道（路径通道）存储未来移动计划，并通过前向/反向传播机制实现类双向规划的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解无模型强化学习训练下的循环神经网络内部表征与规划机制，将黑箱模型的行为转化为可解释的算法描述。

Method: 对卷积循环神经网络进行逆向工程分析，识别隐藏状态中的路径通道，分析卷积核编码的动作位置变化，以及前向（从箱子到目标）和反向（从目标到箱子）的激活传播机制，包括负值在障碍物处的回溯剪枝。

Result: 发现模型在路径通道中存储未来动作计划；卷积核编码了状态转移模型；规划从箱子和目标双向传播；负值激活在障碍物处反向传播实现回溯剪枝，从而让替代计划浮现。

Conclusion: 无模型训练可以自发学习出可解释的双向规划算法，逆向工程能够将神经网络的内部机制转化为熟悉的规划术语。

Abstract: We partially reverse-engineer a convolutional recurrent neural network (RNN) trained with model-free reinforcement learning to play the box-pushing game Sokoban. We find that the RNN stores future moves (plans) as activations in particular channels of the hidden state, which we call path channels. A high activation in a particular location means that, when a box is in that location, it will get pushed in the channel's assigned direction. We examine the convolutional kernels between path channels and find that they encode the change in position resulting from each possible action, thus representing part of a learned transition model. The RNN constructs plans by starting at the boxes and goals. These kernels extend activations in path channels forwards from boxes and backwards from the goal. Negative values are placed in channels at obstacles. This causes the extension kernels to propagate the negative value in reverse, thus pruning the last few steps and letting an alternative plan emerge; a form of backtracking. Our work shows that, a precise understanding of the plan representation allows us to directly understand the bidirectional planning-like algorithm learned by model-free training in more familiar terms.

</details>


### [462] [La-Proteina: Atomistic Protein Generation via Partially Latent Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09466)
*Tomas Geffner,Kieran Didi,Zhonglin Cao,Danny Reidenbach,Zuobai Zhang,Christian Dallago,Emine Kucukbenli,Karsten Kreis,Arash Vahdat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: La-Proteina提出了一种基于部分潜在表示的新方法，将粗粒主干结构显式建模，通过固定维度的残基潜在变量捕获序列和全原子细节，利用流匹配实现全原子蛋白质的联合设计，在共设计性、多样性、结构有效性及原子级基序支架等任务上达到SOTA，并支持长达800残基的蛋白质生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型大多难以直接生成全原子蛋白质结构及其氨基酸序列，主要挑战在于生成过程中侧链长度会动态变化，模型需要对此进行有效推理。

Method: 提出部分潜在蛋白质表示：主干结构显式建模，序列和原子细节通过每个残基的固定维度潜在变量捕获，从而规避显式侧链表示的困难；在该部分潜在空间中使用流匹配建模序列与全原子结构的联合分布。

Result: 在多项基准测试中达到SOTA，包括全原子共设计性、多样性和结构有效性；在原子级基序支架任务上超越先前模型；能够生成最多800残基的共设计蛋白质，而多数基线方法在此规模下失效。

Conclusion: La-Proteina通过部分潜在表示与流匹配的结合，有效解决了全原子蛋白质设计中的侧链推理难题，实现了可扩展且鲁棒的蛋白质从头设计。

Abstract: Recently, many generative models for de novo protein structure design have emerged. Yet, only few tackle the difficult task of directly generating fully atomistic structures jointly with the underlying amino acid sequence. This is challenging, for instance, because the model must reason over side chains that change in length during generation. We introduce La-Proteina for atomistic protein design based on a novel partially latent protein representation: coarse backbone structure is modeled explicitly, while sequence and atomistic details are captured via per-residue latent variables of fixed dimensionality, thereby effectively side-stepping challenges of explicit side-chain representations. Flow matching in this partially latent space then models the joint distribution over sequences and full-atom structures. La-Proteina achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple generation benchmarks, including all-atom co-designability, diversity, and structural validity, as confirmed through detailed structural analyses and evaluations. Notably, La-Proteina also surpasses previous models in atomistic motif scaffolding performance, unlocking critical atomistic structure-conditioned protein design tasks. Moreover, La-Proteina is able to generate co-designable proteins of up to 800 residues, a regime where most baselines collapse and fail to produce valid samples, demonstrating La-Proteina's scalability and robustness.

</details>


### [463] [DeepC4: Deep Conditional Census-Constrained Clustering for Large-scale Multitask Spatial Disaggregation of Urban Morphology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.22554)
*Joshua Dimasaka,Christian Geiß,Emily So*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Deep Conditional Census-Constrained Clustering (DeepC4)，一种基于深度学习的新型空间降尺度方法，通过将人口普查统计数据作为聚类级别约束，并结合多任务学习卫星影像模式，有效解决了粗粒度到细粒度映射中的局部不一致和模型不确定性传播问题。在卢旺达城市形态应用中，DeepC4在屋顶、墙壁和高度预测上分别达到0.63、0.78和0.45的macro-F1分数和0.57、0.71和0.42的macro-mIoU，全国住宅和居住人口估计误差仅为1.13%和1.11%，优于GEM（2.03%和3.29%），并在各省份中比METEOR多覆盖32%-49%的500米网格像素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于空间降尺度技术（如GEM和METEOR项目）生成的大尺度城市形态地图存在局部与已验证人口普查统计数据不一致以及模型不确定性传播的问题，特别是在弱标签和条件标签监督下粗到细粒度映射的挑战，亟需一种能够显式编码普查统计和专家信念系统的可解释映射方法。

Method: 提出Deep Conditional Census-Constrained Clustering (DeepC4)，一种将局部人口普查统计作为聚类级别约束的深度学习方法，在联合多任务学习中考虑多种条件标签关系，通过卫星影像模式分析实现空间降尺度映射。

Result: DeepC4在卢旺达城市形态预测中，屋顶、墙壁和高度预测的macro-F1分数分别为0.63、0.78和0.45，macro-mIoU分别为0.57、0.71和0.42；全国住宅和居住人口估计误差为1.13%和1.11%，优于GEM（2.03%和3.29%）；各省份中比METEOR多覆盖32%-49%的500米网格像素。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种新的基于深度学习的映射技术，通过显式编码已验证的人口普查和专家信念系统，实现了对现有大尺度粗粒度信息的可解释和可审计评估，为2030年全球可持续发展框架的评估提供技术支持。

Abstract: To understand our global progress for sustainable development and disaster risk reduction in many developing economies, two recent major initiatives - the Uniform African Exposure Dataset of the Global Earthquake Model (GEM) Foundation and the Modelling Exposure through Earth Observation Routines (METEOR) Project - implemented classical spatial disaggregation techniques to generate large-scale mapping of urban morphology using the information from various satellite imagery and its derivatives, geospatial datasets of the built environment, and subnational census statistics. However, the local discrepancy with well-validated census statistics and the propagated model uncertainties remain a challenge in such coarse-to-fine-grained mapping problems, specifically constrained by weak and conditional label supervision. Therefore, we present Deep Conditional Census-Constrained Clustering (DeepC4), a novel deep learning-based spatial disaggregation approach that incorporates local census statistics as cluster-level constraints while considering multiple conditional label relationships in a joint multitask learning of the patterns of satellite imagery. As a demonstration using Rwandan urban morphology, DeepC4 achieves macro-F1 scores of 0.63, 0.78, and 0.45 and macro-mIoU of 0.57, 0.71, and 0.42 for roof, wall, and height prediction respectively, estimates national dwelling and occupant counts within 1.13% and 1.11% error compared to census records, outperforming GEM (2.03% and 3.29%), and occupies 32%-49% more 500-meter grid pixels than METEOR across provinces. As the world approaches the conclusion of many global frameworks in 2030, our work offers a new deep learning-based mapping technique that explicitly encodes well-validated census and experts' belief systems to achieve an explainable and interpretable auditing of existing coarse-grained derived information at large scales.

</details>


### [464] [Toward Robust Semi-supervised Regression via Dual-stream Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.14082)
*Ye Su,Hezhe Qiao,Wei Huang,Lin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种专用于半监督回归的双流知识蒸馏框架（DKD），通过同时蒸馏连续值知识和分布信息，并引入解耦分布对齐模块（DDA）自适应降低不确定教师预测的权重，从而提升学生模型利用伪标签的鲁棒性和回归性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有半监督回归方法未能充分利用未标记样本，且一致性驱动的伪标签方法对伪标签质量和噪声预测高度敏感，性能受限。

Method: 提出DKD双流知识蒸馏框架：教师仅用真实标签优化进行标签分布估计，学生从真实标签和教师生成的伪目标混合学习；提出DDA解耦分布对齐模块，分别对齐目标和目标间分布，通过方差引导的非目标分布对齐策略自适应降低不确定教师预测的权重。

Result: DKD框架更好地保留了回归幅度信息，提升了样本效率；DDA模块增强了学生缓解伪标签噪声的能力，学习到更校准的回归预测器。

Conclusion: 所提DKD框架通过双流蒸馏和分布对齐有效解决了半监督回归中未标记数据利用不足和伪标签噪声问题，在多个应用场景中具有潜力。

Abstract: Semi-supervised regression (SSR), which aims to predict continuous scores for samples while reducing the reliance on large-scale labeled data, has recently attracted considerable attention across various applications, including computer vision, natural language processing, audio analysis, and medical analysis. Existing SSR methods typically train models with scarce labeled data by introducing constraint-based regularization or ordinal ranking to mitigate overfitting. However, these approaches often fail to fully exploit the abundance of unlabeled samples. Although consistency-driven pseudo-labeling methods attempt to incorporate unlabeled data, their performance is highly sensitive to pseudo-label quality and noisy predictions. To address these challenges, we propose a Dual-stream Knowledge Distillation framework (DKD), which is specifically designed for SSR to distill both continuous-valued knowledge and distributional information. This design better preserves regression magnitude information and improves sample efficiency. Specifically, in DKD, the teacher is optimized solely with ground-truth labels for label distribution estimation, while the student learns from a mixture of real labels and teacher-generated pseudo targets on unlabeled data. The distillation process enables effective supervision transfer, allowing the student to leverage pseudo labels more robustly. Furthermore, we introduce a Decoupled Distribution Alignment (DDA) module, which separately aligns the target and non-target distributions between the teacher and student. To improve the reliability of non-target knowledge transfer, DDA incorporates a variance-guided non-target distribution alignment strategy that adaptively downweights uncertain teacher predictions, thereby enhancing the student's ability to mitigate noise in pseudo-label supervision and learn a better-calibrated regression predictor.

</details>


### [465] [Rethinking Calibration for Early-Exit Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.21495)
*Piotr Kubaty,Filip Szatkowski,Grzegorz Choczyński,Eric Nalisnick,Bartosz Wójcik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑了“校准可提升早期退出神经网络性能”的普遍假设，指出现有校准方法不足以支持自适应计算，并提出早期退出失败预测（EEFP）方法来改善计算成本与准确率的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战并纠正学术界普遍认为的“改善分类器校准能够提升早期退出神经网络性能”这一假设，指出现有校准方法的不足。

Method: 提出早期退出失败预测（EEFP），同时考虑预测正确性和进一步计算的成本；并基于EEFP设计了一种轻量级改进中间分类器的流程，可直接替代原有校准方法。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在校准方法上实现了更优的成本-准确率权衡，且EEFP能更可靠地反映整体EENN性能。

Conclusion: 仅靠校准不足以让EENN充分利用自适应计算，EEFP能够更有效地指导早期退出决策，提升整体效率。

Abstract: Early-exit neural networks (EENNs) accelerate inference by allowing intermediate classifiers to stop computation once predictions are confident enough. Most methods rely on confidence thresholds for exiting, and consequently, improving classifier calibration is widely assumed to improve performance. In this work, we challenge this assumption and show that calibration alone is not sufficient for EENNs to exploit adaptive computation. To address this insufficiency, we introduce Early-Exit Failure Prediction (EEFP), which accounts for both prediction correctness and the cost of further computation. We also propose a lightweight, EEFP-motivated procedure to improve the intermediate classifiers, which can directly replace calibration in EENNs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves superior cost-accuracy trade-offs compared to calibration, and EEFP more reliably reflects overall EENN performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/gmum/rethinking-calibration-for-eenns.

</details>


### [466] [Beyond Model Ranking: Predictability-Aligned Evaluation for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23074)
*Wanjin Feng,Yuan Yuan,Jingtao Ding,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于谱相干性的可预测性对齐诊断框架，包含SCP（量化任务固有难度）和LUR（测量模型对线性可预测信息的利用效率）两个核心指标，揭示了“可预测性漂移”现象及模型架构权衡：复杂模型适合低可预测性数据，线性模型在高可预测性任务上更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准评估指标无法区分模型性能与数据内在不可预测性，导致模型比较不公平且无法深入理解模型行为。

Method: 提出Spectral Coherence Predictability (SCP) 和 Linear Utilization Ratio (LUR) 两个指标，基于谱相干性分析，计算复杂度为O(N log N)。

Result: 验证了框架有效性，揭示了“可预测性漂移”（任务难度随时间剧烈变化），以及模型架构权衡：复杂模型在低可预测性数据上占优，线性模型在高可预测性任务上更有效。

Conclusion: 呼吁业界转向可预测性感知的评估范式，以促进更公平的模型比较和对模型行为的深入理解。

Abstract: In the era of increasingly complex AI models for time series forecasting, progress is often measured by marginal improvements on benchmark leaderboards. However, this approach suffers from a fundamental flaw: standard evaluation metrics conflate a model's performance with the data's intrinsic unpredictability. To address this pressing challenge, we introduce a novel, predictability-aligned diagnostic framework grounded in spectral coherence. Our framework makes two primary contributions: the Spectral Coherence Predictability (SCP), a computationally efficient ($O(N\log N)$) and task-aligned score that quantifies the inherent difficulty of a given forecasting instance, and the Linear Utilization Ratio (LUR), a frequency-resolved diagnostic tool that precisely measures how effectively a model exploits the linearly predictable information within the data. We validate our framework's effectiveness and leverage it to reveal two core insights. First, we provide the first systematic evidence of "predictability drift", demonstrating that a task's forecasting difficulty varies sharply over time. Second, our evaluation reveals a key architectural trade-off: complex models are superior for low-predictability data, whereas linear models are highly effective on more predictable tasks. We advocate for a paradigm shift, moving beyond simplistic aggregate scores toward a more insightful, predictability-aware evaluation that fosters fairer model comparisons and a deeper understanding of model behavior.

</details>


### [467] [Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25582)
*Amir Moeini,Minjae Kwon,Alper Kamil Bozkurt,Yuichi Motai,Rohan Chandra,Lu Feng,Shangtong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCARED方法，首次在上下文强化学习（ICRL）中引入安全约束，使智能体在不更新参数的情况下，通过扩展交互历史实现安全自适应，在遵循安全预算的同时最大化奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的ICRL方法在测试阶段展现出了强大的泛化能力，但缺乏对适应过程中安全性的保障，限制了其在真实场景中的部署。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）框架，采用精确对偶惩罚方法（exact-penalty dual），在无需参数更新的适应过程中同时最大化奖励并控制累积成本在用户指定的安全预算内。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中，SCARED持续实现了安全且鲁棒的上下文自适应，优于现有的ICRL和安全元强化学习基线。智能体能够根据安全预算主动调整行为：高预算时更激进，低预算时更保守。

Conclusion: SCARED首次实现了ICRL在测试阶段的安全自适应，为ICRL在安全关键领域的实际部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) is an emerging RL paradigm where an agent, after pretraining, can adapt to out-of-distribution test tasks without any parameter updates, instead relying on an expanding context of interaction history. While ICRL has shown impressive generalization, safety during this adaptation process remains unexplored, limiting its applicability in real-world deployments where test-time behavior is expected to be safe. In this work, we propose SCARED: Safe Contextual Adaptive Reinforcement via Exact-penalty Dual, the first method that promotes safe adaptation of ICRL under the constrained Markov decision process framework. During the parameter-update-free adaptation process, our agent not only maximizes the reward but also keeps the accumulated cost within a user-specified safety budget. We also demonstrate that the agent actively reacts to the safety budget; with a higher safety budget, the agent behaves more aggressively, and with a lower safety budget the agent behaves more conservatively. Across challenging benchmarks, SCARED consistently enables safe and robust in-context adaptation, outperforming existing ICRL and safe meta-RL baselines.

</details>


### [468] [Extensions of Robbins-Siegmund Theorem with Applications in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26442)
*Xinyu Liu,Zixuan Xie,Shangtong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文扩展了Robbins-Siegmund定理，将零阶项的可求和条件放宽为平方可求和，并引入增量上的温和假设，从而保证几乎必然收敛到有界集，同时给出了收敛率、高概率浓度界和L^p收敛率。将该结果应用于随机逼近和强化学习，首次获得了线性函数逼近Q-学习的几乎必然收敛率、高概率浓度界和L^p收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始Robbins-Siegmund定理要求零阶项可求和，但这一条件在许多强化学习应用中无法满足，限制了其在随机迭代算法分析中的适用性。

Method: 将零阶项条件从可求和放宽为平方可求和，并引入对随机过程增量的新型温和假设，证明几乎必然收敛到有界集，进一步推导收敛率、高概率浓度界和L^p收敛率。

Result: 获得了扩展的Robbins-Siegmund型收敛定理；首次给出了线性函数逼近Q-学习的几乎必然收敛率、高概率浓度界和L^p收敛率。

Conclusion: 所提出的扩展定理有效克服了原定理在RL应用中的局限，为分析更广泛的随机迭代算法提供了新工具。

Abstract: The Robbins-Siegmund theorem establishes the convergence of stochastic processes that are almost supermartingales and is one of the most commonly used approaches for analyzing stochastic iterative algorithms in stochastic approximation and reinforcement learning (RL). However, its original form has a significant limitation as it requires the zero-order term to be summable. In many important RL applications, this summable condition, however, cannot be met. This limitation motivates us to extend the Robbins-Siegmund theorem for almost supermartingales where the zero-order term is not summable, but only square-summable. In particular, we introduce a novel and mild assumption on the increments of the stochastic processes. This together with the square-summable condition enables an almost sure convergence to a bounded set. Additionally, we further provide almost sure convergence rates, high probability concentration bounds, and $L^p$ convergence rates. We then apply the new results to stochastic approximation and RL. Notably, we obtain the first almost sure convergence rate, the first high probability concentration bound, and the first $L^p$ convergence rate for $Q$-learning with linear function approximation.

</details>


### [469] [Flatness-Aware Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.02174)
*Stefano Bruno,Youngsik Hwang,Jaehyeon An,Sotirios Sabanis,Dong-Young Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出fSGLD，一种将SGD/SGLD的计算效率与平坦区域偏置相结合的一阶优化方法，通过理论规定的β-σ耦合实现平坦吉布斯分布采样，并在多种任务中展示出优秀性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 损失景观的平坦性被广泛认为是理解深度学习行为与泛化的重要视角，现有方法在利用平坦性指导优化时缺乏理论保证或计算效率不足。

Method: 提出Flatness-Aware SGLD (fSGLD)，将噪声尺度σ与逆温度β进行理论耦合，使动力学偏向平坦盆地，并提供非渐近理论分析及显式过剩风险界。

Result: 在标准优化器基准、贝叶斯图像分类、不确定性量化及OOD检测中表现一致优异，且理论规定的β-σ耦合优于解耦选择。

Conclusion: fSGLD在保持SGD/SGLD计算与内存效率的同时，通过理论指导的平坦性偏置有效提升了模型泛化与不确定性估计能力。

Abstract: Flatness of the loss landscape has been widely studied as an important perspective for understanding the behavior and generalization of deep learning algorithms. Motivated by this view, we propose Flatness-Aware Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (fSGLD), a first-order optimization method that biases learning its dynamics toward flat basins while retaining the computational and memory efficiency of SGD and SGLD. We provide a non-asymptotic theoretical analysis showing that fSGLD targets a flatness-biased Gibbs distribution under a theoretically prescribed coupling between the noise scale $σ$ and the inverse temperature $β$, together with explicit excess risk guarantees. We empirically evaluate fSGLD across standard optimizer benchmarks, Bayesian image classification, uncertainty quantification, and out-of-distribution detection, demonstrating consistently strong performance and reliable uncertainty estimates. Additional experiments confirm the effectiveness of the theoretically prescribed $β$-$σ$ coupling compared to decoupled choices.

</details>


### [470] [A Broader View of Thompson Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07208)
*Yanlin Qu,Hongseok Namkoong,Assaf Zeevi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将Thompson Sampling重新诠释为在线优化算法，引入时间不变的遗憾概念和平稳化bandit问题，揭示了Thompson Sampling平衡探索与利用的核心机制，并展示了其与Bellman最优策略的结构相似性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管Thompson Sampling被广泛使用且理论性能优异，但其通过后验采样实现探索与利用平衡的内在机制一直未被充分理解，这与其他bandit算法形成鲜明对比。

Method: （1）引入时间不变的遗憾概念，构建平稳化bandit问题和平稳Bellman最优策略；（2）将Thompson Sampling重新形式化为在线优化算法；（3）证明Thompson Sampling的结构模仿了Bellman最优策略，其中"贪心"行为被剩余不确定性度量所正则化。

Result: 揭示了Thompson Sampling与Bellman最优策略之间的结构对应关系，证明了Thompson Sampling本质上是一种被不确定性正则化的在线优化算法。

Conclusion: 该在线优化视角不仅加深了对Thompson Sampling动态过程的理解，还为以Bellman最优基准为目标的策略改进提供了原则性方法。

Abstract: Thompson Sampling is one of the most widely used and studied bandit algorithms, known for its simple structure, low regret performance, and solid theoretical guarantees. Yet, in stark contrast to most other families of bandit algorithms, the exact mechanism through which posterior sampling (as introduced by Thompson) is able to "properly" balance exploration and exploitation, remains a mystery. In this paper, we show that the core insight to address this question stems from recasting Thompson Sampling as an online optimization algorithm. To distill this, we introduce a suitable time invariant notion of regret that leads to a stationarized bandit problem, and a stationary Bellman-optimal policy. We then show that Thompson Sampling admits an online optimization form that mimics the structure of the aforementioned Bellman-optimal policy, where "greediness" is regularized by a measure of residual uncertainty. This new lens of online optimization allows both a better understanding of Thompson Sampling dynamics, as well as a principled manner for policy improvement that mimics the Bellman-optimal benchmark.

</details>


### [471] [EAGer: Entropy-Aware GEneRation for Adaptive Inference-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11170)
*Daniel Scalena,Leonidas Zotos,Elisabetta Fersini,Malvina Nissim,Ahmet Üstün*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EAGer方法，通过令牌级熵分布建模模型不确定性，在测试时无需训练即可动态分配计算资源：仅在高熵令牌处进行多路径分支，将节省的计算预算重分配给更需探索的实例。在AIME 2025等复杂推理基准上，相比全并行采样，Pass@k提升最高37%（有标签）/12%（无标签），同时减少59%-64%的令牌生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法对每个提示分配相同计算预算，忽略了不同提示具有不同复杂度的事实，导致计算资源浪费。为此，希望根据提示的实际复杂度动态分配计算预算，减少冗余计算并提升整体性能。

Method: 提出EAGer，一种免训练生成方法。通过令牌级熵分布衡量模型不确定性，仅在高熵令牌处进行多路径分支（即只在模型不确定性高的位置探索多种推理路径），将节省的计算预算重新分配到更需要探索的实例上。

Result: 在多个开源模型和复杂推理基准上验证，特别是在AIME 2025上。有标签设置（如RLVR训练管道中）Pass@k提升最高+37%，令牌减少59%；无标签测试时设置中Pass@k提升+12%，令牌减少64%。

Conclusion: EAGer通过基于不确定性的动态计算分配，在不进行训练的情况下有效降低了冗余计算，同时提升了推理性能，验证了不同提示需要不同计算预算的假设。

Abstract: With the rise of reasoning language models and test-time scaling methods as a paradigm for improving model performance, substantial computation is often required to generate multiple candidate sequences from the same prompt. This enables exploration of different reasoning paths toward the correct solution, however, allocates the same compute budget for each prompt. Grounded on the assumption that different prompts carry different degrees of complexity, and thus different computation needs, we propose EAGer, a training-free generation method that leverages model uncertainty through token-wise entropy distribution to reduce redundant computation and concurrently improve overall performance. EAGer allows branching to multiple reasoning paths only in the presence of high-entropy tokens, and reallocates the saved compute budget to instances where exploration of alternative paths is most needed. We validate EAGer across multiple open-source models on complex reasoning benchmarks, with gains specifically demonstrated on AIME 2025. When target labels are accessible -- as in RLVR training pipelines -- EAGer achieves up to +37% in Pass@k and 59% fewer tokens; in test-time settings it still yields +12% in Pass@k and 64% fewer tokens compared to Full Parallel Sampling.

</details>


### [472] [Neural Weight Compression for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11234)
*Jegwang Ryu,Minkyu Kim,Seungjun Shin,Hee Min Choi,Dokwan Oh,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出神经权重压缩（NWC）框架，将权重压缩视为神经编解码器学习任务，通过训练编解码器在预训练权重数据集上实现高效压缩，在4-6比特区间取得优异精度-压缩权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有权重压缩方法依赖手工设计的变换和启发式规则，对权重作为数据模态的理解有限，缺乏系统性的学习框架。

Method: 将权重压缩形式化为神经编解码器学习问题，提出NWC框架，在预训练权重数据集上训练神经编解码器，处理张量异质性和重构损失与下游性能不匹配等挑战。

Result: 在4-6比特区间取得极具竞争力的精度-压缩权衡，无需依赖硬编码的手工组件（如Hadamard变换），且泛化到多种架构（包括视觉编码器）。

Conclusion: 熵约束量化和学习的变换在自适应权重压缩和下游任务中起关键作用，NWC框架成功将权重压缩从手工范式转向学习范式。

Abstract: Efficient compression of language model weights is increasingly critical as model scale and deployment grow. Yet, most existing methods rely on handcrafted transforms and heuristics, reflecting the limited understanding of weights as a data modality. To move beyond this paradigm, we formulate weight compression as neural codec learning and propose Neural Weight Compression (NWC), a framework for training neural codecs on pretrained weight datasets. NWC addresses challenges intrinsic to weight compression, including tensor heterogeneity and the mismatch between reconstruction losses and downstream performance. Experiments show that NWC achieves highly competitive accuracy-compression tradeoffs, with particularly strong results in the 4-6 bit regime, without relying on rigid handcrafted components such as the Hadamard transform. These gains extend to across diverse architectures, e.g., vision encoders. Our analysis highlights the roles of entropy-constrained quantization and learned transforms in adapting compression to weight data and downstream tasks.

</details>


### [473] [An Empirical Study on Variance-based MC Dropout Uncertainty-Error Correlation in 2D Brain Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15541)
*Saumya B*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过实验发现，在2D脑肿瘤MRI分割中，基于方差的MC Dropout不确定性（像素级方差）与分割误差之间的全局相关性较弱（r~0.30-0.38），边界相关性几乎可忽略（|r|<0.05），表明该方法难以有效定位分割错误，尤其是肿瘤边界处的错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管MC Dropout被广泛用于估计模型不确定性，但基于方差的 uncertainty 在识别分割错误（尤其是肿瘤边界处错误）方面的有效性尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 使用U-Net在四种数据增强设置（无增强、水平翻转、旋转、缩放）下进行2D脑肿瘤MRI分割，通过50次随机前向传播计算像素级方差作为不确定性估计，并与像素级误差计算Pearson和Spearman相关系数。

Result: 全局相关系数较弱（r~0.30-0.38），边界相关系数可忽略（|r|<0.05）；不同增强设置间差异虽统计显著（p<0.001），但缺乏实际意义。

Conclusion: 基于方差的MC Dropout不确定性在全局和边界错误定位方面提供的线索有限，不确定性表示方式的选择对MC Dropout在医学图像分割中的效用至关重要，预测熵或互信息等替代表示可能更好地捕捉分割错误，尤其是边界处。

Abstract: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from MRI is vital for diagnosis and treatment planning. Although Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout is widely used to estimate model uncertainty, the effectiveness of variance-based uncertainty - computed as pixel-wise variance across stochastic forward passes - in identifying segmentation errors, particularly near tumor boundaries, remains insufficiently studied. This study empirically examines the relationship between variance-based MC Dropout uncertainty and segmentation error in 2D brain tumor MRI segmentation using a U-Net trained under four augmentation settings: none, horizontal flip, rotation, and scaling. Uncertainty was estimated as the pixel-wise variance across 50 stochastic forward passes and correlated with pixel-wise errors using Pearson and Spearman coefficients. Results show weak global correlations (r ~ 0.30-0.38) and negligible boundary correlations (|r| < 0.05). Although differences across augmentations were statistically significant (p < 0.001), they lacked practical relevance. These findings suggest that variance-based MC Dropout uncertainty provides limited cues for global and boundary error localization, and that the choice of uncertainty representation critically affects the utility of MC Dropout in medical image segmentation. Alternative representations such as predictive entropy or mutual information may better capture segmentation errors, particularly at boundaries.

</details>


### [474] [Learning Correlated Reward Models: Statistical Barriers and Opportunities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15839)
*Yeshwanth Cherapanamjeri,Constantinos Daskalakis,Gabriele Farina,Sobhan Mohammadpour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了避免IIA假设的关联probit模型在人类偏好学习中的统计与计算挑战，证明成对偏好数据本质上不足以学习关联信息，而"三选一"偏好数据可克服这一缺陷，并提出了近最优的高效估计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RUM（如RLHF中的奖励建模）普遍使用IIA假设，将所有人类偏好坍缩为单一效用函数，无法捕捉人类偏好的多样性；而避免IIA假设的模型缺乏统计和计算保证。

Method: 理论分析证明成对偏好数据无法学习关联信息；提出使用"三选一"（best-of-three）偏好数据克服该缺陷，并设计统计与计算高效的估计量。

Result: 成对偏好数据对学习关联信息本质上不充分；三选一偏好数据可实现近最优的统计效率；在真实数据集上验证了改进的个性化效果。

Conclusion: 高阶偏好数据（如三选一）对学习关联效用模型至关重要，能够更精细地建模人类偏好，提升个性化表现。

Abstract: Random Utility Models (RUMs) are a classical framework for modeling user preferences and play a key role in reward modeling for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). However, a crucial shortcoming of many of these techniques is the Independence of Irrelevant Alternatives (IIA) assumption, which collapses \emph{all} human preferences to a universal underlying utility function, yielding a coarse approximation of the range of human preferences. On the other hand, statistical and computational guarantees for models avoiding this assumption are scarce. In this paper, we investigate the statistical and computational challenges of learning a \emph{correlated} probit model, a fundamental RUM that avoids the IIA assumption. First, we establish that the classical data collection paradigm of pairwise preference data is \emph{fundamentally insufficient} to learn correlational information, explaining the lack of statistical and computational guarantees in this setting. Next, we demonstrate that \emph{best-of-three} preference data provably overcomes these shortcomings, and devise a statistically and computationally efficient estimator with near-optimal performance. These results highlight the benefits of higher-order preference data in learning correlated utilities, allowing for more fine-grained modeling of human preferences. Finally, we validate these theoretical guarantees on several real-world datasets, demonstrating improved personalization of human preferences.

</details>


### [475] [Prototyping an End-to-End Multi-Modal Tiny-CNN for Cardiovascular Sensor Patches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.18668)
*Mustafa Fuad Rifet Ibrahim,Tunc Alkanat,Felix Manthey,Maurice Meijer,Alexander Schlaefer,Peer Stelldinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于资源受限医疗边缘设备的轻量化卷积神经网络，通过对同步心电（ECG）和心音（PCG）信号进行早期融合，实现心血管疾病的二分类。该方法在保持竞争性精度的同时，将内存占用和计算成本降低约三个数量级，并在集成神经处理单元（NPU）的微控制器上验证了其能效优于持续数据流传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心血管疾病早期检测至关重要，但现有深度学习方法计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限的可穿戴边缘设备上，亟需一种兼顾精度与效率的轻量化方案。

Method: 提出早期融合的卷积神经网络（CNN），将同步的ECG和PCG信号在输入层融合，进行二分类；模型经过量化与压缩，部署于带NPU的微控制器上，并与BLE通信能耗进行对比。

Result: 与现有最优方法相比，内存和计算成本降低约三个数量级，精度保持竞争力；在边缘设备上的推理能耗低于持续BLE数据流传输。

Conclusion: 在资源受限的医疗边缘设备上部署轻量化深度学习模型进行心血管监测是可行的，且本地推理比持续无线数据传输更节能。

Abstract: The vast majority of cardiovascular diseases may be preventable if early signs and risk factors are detected. Cardiovascular monitoring with body-worn sensor devices like sensor patches allows for the detection of such signs while preserving the freedom and comfort of patients. However, the analysis of the sensor data must be robust, reliable, efficient, and highly accurate. Deep learning methods can automate data interpretation, reducing the workload of clinicians. In this work, we analyze the feasibility of applying deep learning models to the classification of synchronized electrocardiogram (ECG) and phonocardiogram (PCG) recordings on resource-constrained medical edge devices. We propose a convolutional neural network with early fusion of data to solve a binary classification problem. The model is trained and validated on the synchronized ECG and PCG recordings from the Physionet Challenge 2016 dataset. Our approach reduces memory footprint and compute cost by approximately three orders of magnitude compared with the state-of-the-art while maintaining competitive accuracy. We further demonstrate the applicability of the proposed model on medical edge devices by measuring its energy consumption on a microcontroller equipped with a neural processing unit (NPU) and benchmarking the energy of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) communication on a representative BLE evaluation kit across a range of payload sizes. The comparison confirms that on-device inference can be more energy efficient than continuous data streaming.

</details>


### [476] [NCSAM Noise-Compensated Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Noisy Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.19947)
*Jiayu Xu,Junbiao Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从优化视角研究带噪标签学习，建立了标签噪声与SAM平坦性偏好之间的理论联系，并提出噪声补偿的锐度感知最小化（NCSAM）方法，通过补偿扰动来抵消带噪标签引起的优化偏差，从而在保持优化简洁性的同时减轻对噪声标签的记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有带噪标签学习方法多依赖标签校正或样本选择机制，本文希望从优化角度出发，利用SAM的平坦性偏好来应对标签噪声问题，避免复杂的两阶段或样本选择流程。

Method: 首先建立标签噪声与SAM平坦性偏好之间的理论联系，分析噪声标签对SAM扰动方向的扭曲效应；然后提出NCSAM，通过设计噪声补偿的扰动项来抵消噪声标签引入的优化偏差，从而修正被扭曲的SAM扰动，使优化过程更倾向于平坦极小值而非记忆噪声样本。

Result: 在合成噪声和真实噪声的基准数据集上，NCSAM一致优于基于SAM的优化基线方法，并与代表性的带噪标签学习方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 从优化角度处理标签噪声是可行且有效的，NCSAM通过简单的优化修正即可达到与复杂样本选择/标签校正方法相当的性能，兼具简洁性和有效性。

Abstract: Learning from Noisy Labels (LNL) remains a fundamental challenge in deep learning because real-world datasets often contain corrupted annotations. Most existing methods rely on label correction or sample selection mechanisms. In contrast, we study LNL from an optimization perspective by establishing a theoretical connection between label noise and the flatness-seeking behavior of Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM). Based on this analysis, we propose Noise-Compensated Sharpness-Aware Minimization (NCSAM), which uses a noise-compensated perturbation to counteract the optimization bias induced by noisy labels. By correcting distorted SAM perturbations, NCSAM mitigates the memorization of noisy labels during training while preserving the simplicity of optimization-based learning. Experiments on synthetic and real-world noisy-label benchmarks show that NCSAM consistently improves over SAM-based optimization baselines and remains competitive with representative noisy-label learning methods.

</details>


### [477] [The Principles of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.21890)
*Chieh-Hsin Lai,Yang Song,Dongjun Kim,Yuki Mitsufuji,Stefano Ermon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本书系统阐述了扩散模型的核心原理，从三种互补视角（变分视角、基于分数的视角、基于流的视角）揭示其共同数学基础——一个时间依赖的速度场，其流将简单先验分布输送到数据分布，采样即求解该流对应的微分方程。在此框架上，进一步讨论可控生成引导、高效数值求解器及扩散驱动的流映射模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型虽已取得显著成功，但其多种数学表述（变分扩散、分数匹配、连续流等）之间的内在联系尚未被系统阐明。本书旨在揭示这些看似不同的方法如何源于共享的数学思想，为读者提供统一且概念性的理解。

Method: 本书采用三个互补视角分析扩散模型：(1) 变分视角——从VAE启发，逐步去除噪声；(2) 基于分数的视角——从能量模型出发，学习数据分布随时间演化的梯度；(3) 基于流的视角——从归一化流出发，学习将噪声平滑输送到数据的速度场。共同核心是一个时间依赖的速度场，其流实现先验到数据的传输。

Result: 揭示了扩散模型中变分、分数匹配和流三种视角共享同一数学骨干——时间依赖的速度场，采样等价于求解该场的微分方程。并在此统一框架上拓展讨论了可控生成引导、高效数值求解器以及直接学习任意时间点间映射的流映射模型。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的核心思想可统一为通过一个时间依赖的速度场实现从噪声到数据的连续传输，这为后续的可控生成、高效采样和流映射模型等扩展研究提供了坚实的数学基础。本书适合具备基本深度学习知识的读者获取概念性且数学严谨的理解。

Abstract: This book presents the core principles that have guided the development of diffusion models, tracing their origins and showing how diverse formulations arise from shared mathematical ideas. Diffusion modeling starts by defining a forward process that gradually corrupts data into noise, linking the data distribution to a simple prior through a continuum of intermediate distributions. The goal is to learn a reverse process that transforms noise back into data while recovering the same intermediates. We describe three complementary views. The variational view, inspired by variational autoencoders, sees diffusion as learning to remove noise step by step. The score-based view, rooted in energy-based modeling, learns the gradient of the evolving data distribution, indicating how to nudge samples toward more likely regions. The flow-based view, related to normalizing flows, treats generation as following a smooth path that moves samples from noise to data under a learned velocity field. These perspectives share a common backbone: a time-dependent velocity field whose flow transports a simple prior to the data. Sampling then amounts to solving a differential equation that evolves noise into data along a continuous trajectory. On this foundation, the book discusses guidance for controllable generation, efficient numerical solvers, and diffusion-motivated flow-map models that learn direct mappings between arbitrary times. It provides a conceptual and mathematically grounded understanding of diffusion models for readers with basic deep-learning knowledge.

</details>


### [478] [Segment to Focus: Guiding Latent Action Models in the Presence of Distractors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02259)
*Marcus Fechner,Hamza Adnan,Constantin C. Lüth,Matthew T. Jackson,Alexey Zakharov,J. Marius Zöllner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MaskLAM方法，通过利用分割基础模型（如SAM）零样本生成agent掩码，在预训练时仅对agent像素进行重建约束，从而消除动作相关视觉干扰物（如动态背景、相机抖动）对潜在动作模型训练的影响，显著提升下游策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在动作模型（LAMs）在存在动作相关视觉干扰物的真实视频中表现不佳，因为标准重建目标会驱使潜在动作编码外生运动（如动态背景）而非智能体控制的内生动力学。

Method: 提出MaskLAM，利用现成的分割基础模型（如SAM）零样本获取agent掩码，将重建目标限制在agent像素区域，迫使潜在动作仅解释智能体控制的内生动力学，无需修改架构、添加辅助损失或使用动作标签。

Result: 在Distracting Control Suite和Distracting Meta-World两个连续控制基准上，MaskLAM相比LAPO将归一化线性探针MSE降低最多3.51倍，归一化回报提升最多4.97倍，且接近使用真实动作监督的LAOM-Labels方法。

Conclusion: 通过空间分离内生/外生因素并利用分割基础模型获得agent掩码，可以有效解决LAMs在视觉干扰场景下的预训练失败问题，缩小与有监督方法的性能差距。

Abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) offer a promising path to pre-training embodied agents on large amounts of action-free video. They infer latent actions between consecutive observations that can later be decoded to ground-truth actions using a small number of labels. However, recent work has shown that this recipe fails in the presence of action-correlated visual distractors common in real-world video, such as dynamic backgrounds, camera shake, or other moving objects. In these scenarios, the standard reconstruction objective drives latent actions to encode exogenous motion instead of agent-controlled dynamics, resulting in policies that underperform when fine-tuned. We observe, however, that endogenous and exogenous factors are typically spatially separated in pixel space: control-relevant change is concentrated on the agent, while distractor motion occurs elsewhere. We exploit this observation by restricting the reconstruction objective to agent pixels, forcing latent actions to explain agent-controlled dynamics rather than exogenous ones. We call this method MaskLAM; it obtains the agent mask zero-shot from off-the-shelf segmentation foundation models (e.g., SAM) and requires no architectural changes, auxiliary losses, or action labels during pre-training. Across two continuous-control benchmarks (Distracting Control Suite, Distracting Meta-World), MaskLAM reduces normalized linear-probe MSE by up to $3.51\times$ and improves normalized return by up to $4.97\times$ over LAPO, while narrowing the gap to LAOM-Labels, which relies on ground-truth action supervision.

</details>


### [479] [Cost-Sensitive Evaluation for Binary Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22016)
*Pierangelo Lombardo,Antonio Casoli,Cristian Cingolani,Shola Oshodi,Michele Zanatta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出加权准确率(WA)作为面向总分类成本(TCC)最小化的评估指标，并建立了一个通用的重加权框架来处理成本敏感场景中的类别不平衡问题，证明WA最大化等价于TCC最小化，且在不同不平衡度和成本场景下与TCC保持稳健对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分类器评估指标缺乏明确对齐TCC最小化的范式，且类别不平衡常被当作独立问题处理，导致与TCC最小化目标脱节。
