To address this, we propose the Nexus optimizer, which encourages the closeness of these minima by maximizing gradient similarity during optimization. Experiments across models ranging from 130M to 3B parameters, various data mixtures and hyperparameter schedules, show that Nexus \textit{significantly boosts downstream performance}, despite \textit{achieving the same pretraining loss} (see \cref{fig:demo:benchmark}). Notably, on the 3B model, Nexus reduces the out-of-distribution loss by 0.012 and yields up to a 15.0\% accuracy improvement on complex reasoning tasks (e.g., GSM8k). This finding challenges the reliance on pretraining loss as the sole proxy for model evaluation and demonstrates the importance of implicit biases in unlocking downstream generalization.

</details>


### [517] [SaFeR-Steer: Evolving Multi-Turn MLLMs via Synthetic Bootstrapping and Feedback Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16358)
*Haolong Hu,Hanyu Li,Tiancheng He,Huahui Yi,An Zhang,Qiankun Li,Kun Wang,Yang Liu,Zhigang Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SaFeR-Steer框架，通过分阶段合成引导+导师循环GRPO实现多轮多模态安全对齐，并发布STEER数据集，在Qwen2.5-VL上显著提升安全性与有用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态大模型的安全对齐主要基于单轮数据和固定模板对话，无法应对多轮交互中攻击者通过视觉-文本历史逐步升级恶意意图、利用长上下文安全衰减的问题，存在训练与部署之间的不匹配。

Method: 提出SaFeR-Steer渐进式多轮对齐框架：1) 分阶段合成引导（staged synthetic bootstrapping）生成多轮安全数据；2) 导师在环GRPO（tutor-in-the-loop GRPO）在自适应在线攻击下训练单一学生模型；3) 引入轨迹一致总结奖励（TCSR），聚合历史最小和平均轮次奖励，使任何低质量轮次影响整条轨迹的回报。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B上：单轮安全/有用性从48.30/45.86提升至81.84/70.77（3B），56.21/60.32提升至87.89/77.40（7B）；多轮从12.55/27.13提升至55.58/70.27（3B），24.66/46.48提升至64.89/72.35（7B）。失败案例向后轮次推移，鲁棒性超越单纯扩展模型规模。

Conclusion: SaFeR-Steer有效弥合了多轮安全对齐的训练-部署鸿沟，所发布的STEER数据集为多轮多模态安全研究提供了标准化评测资源。

Abstract: MLLMs are increasingly deployed in multi-turn settings, where attackers can escalate unsafe intent through the evolving visual-text history and exploit long-context safety decay. Yet safety alignment is still dominated by single-turn data and fixed-template dialogues, leaving a mismatch between training and deployment.
  To bridge this gap, we propose SaFeR-Steer, a progressive multi-turn alignment framework that combines staged synthetic bootstrapping with tutor-in-the-loop GRPO to train a single student under adaptive, on-policy attacks. We also introduce Trajectory-Consistent Summative Reward (TCSR), which aggregates the historical minimum and average of turn rewards so that any low-quality turn affects the trajectory-level return.
  I. Dataset. We release STEER, a multi-turn multimodal safety dataset with STEER-SFT (12,934), STEER-RL (2,000), and STEER-Bench (3,227) dialogues spanning 2-10 turns. II. Experiment. Starting from Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B, SaFeR-Steer substantially improves Safety/Helpfulness on both single-turn (48.30/45.86 $\rightarrow$ 81.84/70.77 for 3B; 56.21/60.32 $\rightarrow$ 87.89/77.40 for 7B) and multi-turn benchmarks (12.55/27.13 $\rightarrow$ 55.58/70.27 for 3B; 24.66/46.48 $\rightarrow$ 64.89/72.35 for 7B), shifting failures to later turns and yielding robustness beyond scaling alone.
  Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SaFeR-Steer

</details>


### [518] [Reasoning on the Manifold: Bidirectional Consistency for Self-Verification in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16565)
*Jiaoyang Ruan,Xin Gao,Yinda Chen,Hengyu Zeng,Liang Du,Guanghao Li,Jie Fu,Jian Pu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出几何视角下的扩散LLM推理验证方法：通过双向流形一致性（BMC）无监督度量生成轨迹的稳定性，无需训练即可在诊断、推理采样和奖励对齐三个环节有效判别答案正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散LLM虽具备全局规划的结构优势，但如何高效验证它们通过有效推理轨迹到达正确答案仍是一个关键挑战。

Method: 提出双向流形一致性（BMC），一种无需训练、无监督的度量方法。核心思想是有效生成轨迹位于学习分布的高密度流形上作为稳定吸引子，无效路径则存在流形外漂移。BMC通过前向掩码-反向重建循环量化生成序列的稳定性。

Result: 在三个推理生命周期任务中验证有效性：(1)诊断：无需真实答案即可鲁棒判别解的有效性；(2)推理：通过拒绝重采样将计算资源集中在复杂推理任务上；(3)对齐：作为密集几何奖励，将稀疏结果监督转化为细粒度指导，使模型超越标准基线实现自我进化。

Conclusion: 内在几何稳定性可作为扩散LLM答案正确性的稳健指标。

Abstract: While Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer structural advantages for global planning, efficiently verifying that they arrive at correct answers via valid reasoning traces remains a critical challenge. In this work, we propose a geometric perspective: Reasoning on the Manifold. We hypothesize that valid generation trajectories reside as stable attractors on the high-density manifold of the learned distribution, whereas invalid paths exhibit off-manifold drift. To operationalize this, we introduce Bidirectional Manifold Consistency (BMC), a training-free, unsupervised metric that quantifies the stability of the generated sequence through a forward-masking and backward-reconstruction cycle. Empirically, we demonstrate BMC's versatility across the full reasoning lifecycle: (1) in Diagnosis, it serves as a robust discriminator of solution validity without ground truth answer; (2) in Inference, it enables rejection resampling to effectively concentrate computational resources on complex reasoning tasks; and (3) in Alignment, it functions as a dense geometric reward that transforms sparse outcome supervision into fine-grained guidance, empowering models to self-evolve beyond standard baselines. Our results establish intrinsic geometric stability as a robust indicator of correctness for dLLMs.

</details>


### [519] [FSEVAL: Feature Selection Evaluation Toolbox and Dashboard](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18227)
*Muhammad Rajabinasab,Arthur Zimek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了FSEVAL，一个用于特征选择算法综合评估与可视化的标准化工具箱，旨在帮助研究人员轻松进行特征选择算法的全面评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征选择是机器学习中区分冗余特征与信息特征的关键任务，但目前缺乏标准化、统一的评估与可视化工具，导致研究人员难以全面比较不同特征选择算法的性能。

Method: 开发了FSEVAL评估工具箱，包含特征选择算法评估功能与可视化仪表盘，提供标准化和统一的评估流程。

Result: 提出了一个集评估与可视化于一体的特征选择算法评估工具箱。

Conclusion: FSEVAL能够使研究人员轻松对特征选择算法进行广泛而全面的评估，促进该领域的标准化研究。

Abstract: Feature selection is a fundamental machine learning and data mining task, involved with discriminating redundant features from informative ones. It is an attempt to address the curse of dimensionality by removing the redundant features, while unlike dimensionality reduction methods, preserving explainability. Feature selection is conducted in both supervised and unsupervised settings, with different evaluation metrics employed to determine which feature selection algorithm is the best. In this paper, we propose FSEVAL, a feature selection evaluation toolbox accompanied with a visualization dashboard, with the goal to make it easy to comprehensively evaluate feature selection algorithms. FSEVAL aims to provide a standardized, unified, evaluation and visualization toolbox to help the researchers working in the field, conduct extensive and comprehensive evaluation of feature selection algorithms with ease.

</details>


### [520] [S2MAM: Semi-supervised Meta Additive Model for Robust Estimation and Variable Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19072)
*Xuelin Zhang,Hong Chen,Yingjie Wang,Tieliang Gong,Bin Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于双层优化的半监督元加性模型（S²MAM），该模型能够自动识别有用变量、更新相似度矩阵，并实现可解释的预测，解决了传统流形正则化半监督学习中图拉普拉斯矩阵对预设相似度度量敏感、易受冗余噪声变量影响的问题。实验证明该方法在多种数据集上具有鲁棒性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于流形正则化的半监督学习依赖于图拉普拉斯矩阵，而该矩阵严重依赖预设的相似度度量，在处理冗余或噪声输入变量时会导致不恰当的惩罚，影响模型性能。

Method: 提出S²MAM（半监督元加性模型），采用双层优化方案：内层优化识别信息变量并实现可解释预测，外层优化更新相似度矩阵，整体框架将变量选择、相似度学习与半监督学习统一在同一优化过程中。

Result: 在4个合成数据集和12个真实世界数据集上，在不同程度和类型的噪声干扰下进行了实验评估，验证了该方法的鲁棒性和可解释性。同时提供了计算收敛性和统计泛化界的理论保证。

Conclusion: S²MAM有效解决了传统流形正则化方法对预设相似度度量的依赖问题，能够自动识别信息变量，在噪声环境下保持鲁棒性，并提供可解释的预测结果。

Abstract: Semi-supervised learning with manifold regularization is a classical framework for jointly learning from both labeled and unlabeled data, where the key requirement is that the support of the unknown marginal distribution has the geometric structure of a Riemannian manifold. Typically, the Laplace-Beltrami operator-based manifold regularization can be approximated empirically by the Laplacian regularization associated with the entire training data and its corresponding graph Laplacian matrix. However, the graph Laplacian matrix depends heavily on the prespecified similarity metric and may lead to inappropriate penalties when dealing with redundant or noisy input variables. To address the above issues, this paper proposes a new Semi-Supervised Meta Additive Model (S$^2$MAM) based on a bilevel optimization scheme that automatically identifies informative variables, updates the similarity matrix, and simultaneously achieves interpretable predictions. Theoretical guarantees are provided for S$^2$MAM, including the computing convergence and the statistical generalization bound. Experimental assessments across 4 synthetic and 12 real-world datasets, with varying levels and categories of corruption, validate the robustness and interpretability of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [521] [LASER: Learning Active Sensing for Continuum Field Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19355)
*Huayu Deng,Jinghui Zhong,Xiangming Zhu,Yunbo Wang,Xiaokang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LASER是一个基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的闭环主动感知框架，通过连续场潜在世界模型和强化学习策略，在潜想象空间中模拟"what-if"感知场景，动态引导传感器向高信息区域移动，在稀疏约束下实现了优于静态和离线优化策略的高保真连续物理场重构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真连续物理场测量在稀疏和受限感知条件下仍然困难，传统重构方法依赖固定传感器布局，无法适应动态演化的物理状态。

Method: 将主动感知建模为POMDP，核心是连续场潜在世界模型（捕获物理动力学并提供内在奖励反馈），强化学习策略在潜想象空间中模拟感知场景，并基于预测的潜状态条件化传感器移动，导航至高信息区域。

Result: LASER在多样化连续场中始终优于静态和离线优化策略，在稀疏感知条件下实现了高保真重构。

Conclusion: LASER通过闭环主动感知框架有效解决了稀疏感知下的连续场高保真重构问题，其潜想象空间中的"what-if"推演机制为自适应传感器布局提供了新范式。

Abstract: High-fidelity measurements of continuum physical fields are essential for scientific discovery and engineering design but remain challenging under sparse and constrained sensing. Conventional reconstruction methods typically rely on fixed sensor layouts, which cannot adapt to evolving physical states. We propose LASER, a unified, closed-loop framework that formulates active sensing as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). At its core, LASER employs a continuum field latent world model that captures the underlying physical dynamics and provides intrinsic reward feedback. This enables a reinforcement learning policy to simulate ''what-if'' sensing scenarios within a latent imagination space. By conditioning sensor movements on predicted latent states, LASER navigates toward potentially high-information regions beyond current observations. Our experiments demonstrate that LASER consistently outperforms static and offline-optimized strategies, achieving high-fidelity reconstruction under sparsity across diverse continuum fields.

</details>


### [522] [HardNet++: Nonlinear Constraint Enforcement in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19669)
*Andrea Goertzen,Kaveh Alim,Youngjae Min,Navid Azizan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HardNet++ 提出一种通过阻尼局部线性化迭代调整网络输出的方法，能够在线性和非线性等式/不等式约束下保证约束满足，并在非线性模型预测控制问题中展示了紧密约束满足且不损失最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软约束方法无法保证推理时的约束满足，而投影方法依赖可行集的易处理投影结构，难以处理缺乏特殊结构的非线性约束问题，因此需要一种能施加通用非线性约束的方法。

Method: 通过阻尼局部线性化对约束进行迭代调整网络输出，每次迭代可微，支持端到端训练，约束满足层在训练期间保持激活。

Result: 在一定的正则性条件下，该方法能将非线性约束满足强制到任意容差；在非线性模型预测控制的学习优化场景中，实现了紧密的约束满足且不损失最优性。

Conclusion: HardNet++ 是一种无需可行集特殊结构即可强制执行通用非线性约束的有效方法，在控制与决策应用中具有良好前景。

Abstract: Enforcing constraint satisfaction in neural network outputs is critical for safety, reliability, and physical fidelity in many control and decision-making applications. While soft-constrained methods penalize constraint violations during training, they do not guarantee constraint adherence during inference. Other approaches guarantee constraint satisfaction via a projection layer, but often rely on the existence of a tractable projection onto the feasible set, limiting their utility in more general problem settings. Many real-world problems of interest are nonlinear and lack the special structure admitting a tractable projection, motivating the development of methods that can enforce general nonlinear constraints. To this end, we introduce HardNet++, a constraint-satisfaction method that enforces linear and nonlinear equality and inequality constraints. Our approach iteratively adjusts the network output via damped local linearizations of the constraints. Each iteration is differentiable, admitting an end-to-end training framework, where the constraint satisfaction layer is active during training. We show that under certain regularity conditions, this procedure enforces nonlinear constraint satisfaction to arbitrary tolerance. Finally, we demonstrate tight constraint adherence without loss of optimality in a learning-for-optimization context, where we apply this method to a nonlinear model predictive control problem.

</details>


### [523] [C-MORAL: Controllable Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization with Reinforcement Alignment for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23061)
*Rui Gao,Youngseung Jeon,Swastik Roy,Morteza Ziyadi,Xiang 'Anthony' Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: C-Moral是一个基于强化学习后训练的框架，用于可控多目标分子优化，通过在两个基准上取得最佳性能（C-MuMOInstruct上SOR达48.9%/39.5%，S²-Bench MolOpt上LogP/MR/QED优化均最优），有效对齐分子LLM与连续且受约束的药物设计目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在分子优化方面具有潜力，但使其与选择性且相互竞争的药物设计约束对齐仍然具有挑战性。

Method: 提出C-Moral框架，采用强化学习后训练，结合了基于组的相对优化、异构目标的属性分数对齐，以及瓶颈敏感的非线性奖励聚合，以改善跨竞争分子属性的稳定性。

Result: 在C-MuMOInstruct上，域内任务SOR达48.9%，域外任务达39.5%，并保持骨架相似性；在S²-Bench MolOpt上，LogP、MR、QED优化任务均取得最优结果。

Conclusion: C-Moral是将分子LLM与连续且受约束的分子设计目标对齐的有效方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise for molecular optimization, but aligning them with selective and competing drug-design constraints remains challenging. We propose C-Moral, a reinforcement learning post-training framework for controllable multi-objective molecular optimization. C-Moral combines group-based relative optimization, property score alignment for heterogeneous objectives, and bottleneck-sensitive non-linear reward aggregation to improve stability across competing molecular properties. Experiments on C-MuMOInstruct and S$^2$-Bench MolOpt show that C-Moral achieves the best performance among compared methods on both benchmarks. On C-MuMOInstruct, C-Moral achieves the best Success Optimized Rate (SOR) of 48.9\% on in-domain tasks and 39.5\% on out-of-domain tasks while preserving scaffold similarity. On S$^2$-Bench MolOpt, it also achieves the strongest results across LogP, MR, and QED optimization tasks. These results suggest that C-Moral is an effective way to align molecular LLMs with continuous and constrained molecular design objectives. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/Rwigie/C-MORAL.

</details>


### [524] [Graph Memory Transformer (GMT)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23862)
*Nicola Zanarini,Niccolò Ferrari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图记忆 Transformer (GMT)，用可学习的记忆图（含质心与有向转移矩阵）替代传统解码器-only Transformer 中的前馈网络子层，保留自注意力机制。82.2M参数的GMT v7在验证损失和困惑度上落后于103M的密集GPT基线（3.5995/36.58 vs 3.2903/26.85），但零样本基准表现接近，且提供了质心使用、转移结构和源到目标移动等可直接检查的计算量，证明了用图记忆导航替代密集逐token变换的可行性与结构可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索是否可以用显式学习的记忆图替代解码器-only Transformer中的前馈网络子层，从而在保持自回归架构的同时获得更好的结构可解释性。

Method: 提出图记忆Transformer (GMT)，每个Transformer块中用包含128个质心、128×128边矩阵、引力源路由、token条件目标选择和门控位移读出的记忆单元替代FFN；单元返回从估计源记忆状态到目标记忆状态的位移而非检索值。

Result: 82.2M参数的GMT v7在验证损失3.5995/困惑度36.58，不及103M密集GPT基线的3.2903/26.85；零样本基准表现接近；训练稳定且质心使用、转移结构等计算量可直接检查。

Conclusion: 用图记忆导航替代密集逐token变换是可行的，提供了结构可解释性，但非SOTA声明，更大规模扩展、优化内核和更广泛基准评估留待后续工作。

Abstract: We investigate whether the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) sublayer in a decoder-only transformer can be replaced by an explicit learned memory graph while preserving the surrounding autoregressive architecture. The proposed Graph Memory Transformer (GMT) keeps causal self-attention intact, but replaces the usual per-token FFN transformation with a memory cell that routes token representations over a learned bank of centroids connected by a learned directed transition matrix. In the base GMT v7 instantiation studied here, each of 16 transformer blocks contains 128 centroids, a 128 * 128 edge matrix, gravitational source routing, token-conditioned target selection, and a gated displacement readout. The cell therefore returns movement from an estimated source memory state toward a target memory state, rather than a retrieved value. The resulting model is a fully decoder-only language model with 82.2M trainable parameters and no dense FFN sublayers, compared with a 103.0M-parameter dense GPT-style baseline used in the evaluation. The base v7 model trains stably and exposes centroid usage, transition structure, and source-to-target movement as directly inspectable quantities of the forward computation. It remains behind the larger dense baseline in validation loss and perplexity (3.5995/36.58 vs. 3.2903/26.85), while showing close zero-shot benchmark behavior under the evaluated setting. These results are not intended as a state-of-the-art claim; they support the viability and structural interpretability of replacing dense within-token transformation with graph-mediated memory navigation. Broader scaling, optimized kernels, and more extensive benchmark evaluation are left for subsequent work.

</details>


### [525] [Rethinking Layer Redundancy: Calibration Matters More Than Search in LLM Depth Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24938)
*Minkyu Kim,Vincent-Daniel Yun,Youngrae Kim,Suin Cho,Woosang Lim,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从功能角度实证研究大语言模型的深度剪枝，发现校准配置对剪枝模式和效果的影响远大于搜索算法的选择，简单的一次性方法在固定校准配置下与复杂搜索算法表现相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度剪枝工作将层冗余视为预训练网络的固有结构属性，过度关注重要性标准和搜索算法，而忽略了校准配置对剪枝效果的影响。作者希望从功能视角出发，系统探究校准配置与搜索算法在深度剪枝中的相对重要性。

Method: 在多个代表性LLM系列上，使用不同的校准配置和多种搜索算法（包括一次性方法和复杂搜索算法）进行深度剪枝实验，对比分析不同配置下的剪枝模式、校准困惑度以及下游推理准确率。

Result: 不同校准配置产生不同的剪枝模式；在固定校准配置下，复杂搜索算法相比简单一次性方法性能提升微乎其微，且收敛到相似的剪枝子集；校准配置对剪枝模式和校准困惑度的影响远大于搜索算法，两者对下游推理准确率方差的贡献相当。

Conclusion: 未来深度剪枝研究应优先关注校准配置的优化而非搜索算法的复杂性，因为校准配置在塑造剪枝模式和影响模型性能方面扮演着更为关键的角色。

Abstract: Depth pruning improves the inference efficiency of large language models by removing Transformer blocks. Prior work typically treats layer redundancy as an inherent structural property of pretrained networks, emphasizing importance criteria and search algorithms to identify removable layers. In this study, we empirically investigate depth pruning from a functional perspective. Evaluating representative LLM families across diverse calibration configurations and multiple search algorithms, we show that different configurations produce different pruning patterns. Furthermore, under a fixed calibration configuration, complex search algorithms yield marginal performance improvements over simple one-shot methods, converging to similar pruned subsets. Overall, our results suggest that the calibration configuration plays a substantially larger role than the choice of search algorithm in shaping pruning patterns and calibration perplexity, while contributing comparably to variance in downstream reasoning accuracy. This indicates that future pruning efforts may benefit from prioritizing the calibration configuration over search complexity.

</details>


### [526] [Mesh Field Theory: Port-Hamiltonian Formulation of Mesh-Based Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00394)
*Satoshi Noguchi,Yoshinobu Kawahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Mesh Field Theory (MeshFT)及其神经实现MeshFT-Net，通过分离网格物理的拓扑与度量结构，证明物理动力学可局部分解为端口-哈密顿形式，其中保守互连由网格拓扑唯一确定，度量效应仅通过本构关系和耗散进入。该方法在解析和真实数据集上实现了近零能量漂移、正确的色散和动量守恒，以及鲁棒的外推和高数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的物理模拟方法常将拓扑与度量结构混杂学习，导致模型学习大量非物理解耦自由度，能量漂移大、泛化能力差。作者旨在通过严格的数学归约，明确哪些物理结构必须固定（拓扑），哪些可以学习（度量），从而为网络设计提供原理性归纳偏置。

Method: 基于最小物理原理（局部性、置换等变性、定向协变性、能量平衡/耗散不等式），证明网格物理的归约定理，推导出端口-哈密顿形式的局部分解；据此设计MeshFT-Net，网络仅学习度量相关的本构关系和耗散项，拓扑结构由离散微分几何固定。

Result: 在解析和真实数据集上，MeshFT-Net实现近零能量漂移、正确色散关系与动量守恒；在分布外验证中展现出鲁棒的外推能力和高数据效率。

Conclusion: 通过消除非物理自由度并仅学习度量依赖结构，MeshFT为稳定、忠实且数据高效的基于学习的物理模拟提供了原理性归纳偏置，证明了结构保持框架在物理AI中的价值。

Abstract: We present Mesh Field Theory (MeshFT) and its neural realization, MeshFT-Net: a structure-preserving framework for mesh-based continuum physics that cleanly separates the physics' topological structure from its metric structure. Imposing minimal physical principles (locality, permutation equivariance, orientation covariance, and energy balance/dissipation inequality), we prove a reduction theorem for mesh-based physics. Under these conditions, the physical dynamics admit a local factorization into a port-Hamiltonian form: the conservative interconnection is fixed uniquely by mesh topology, whereas metric effects enter only through constitutive relations and dissipation. This reduction clarifies what must be fixed and what should be learned, directly informing MeshFT-Net's design. Across evaluations on analytic and realistic datasets, physics-consistency tests, and out-of-distribution validation, MeshFT-Net achieves near-zero energy drift and strong physical fidelity (correct dispersion and momentum conservation) along with robust extrapolation and high data efficiency. By eliminating non-physical degrees of freedom and learning only metric-dependent structure, MeshFT provides a principled inductive bias for stable, faithful, and data-efficient learning-based physical simulation.

</details>


### [527] [Learning in the Fisher Subspace: A Guided Initialization for LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01046)
*Zhi-Quan Feng,Ying-Jia Lin,Hung-Yu Kao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Fisher信息的数据感知LoRA初始化方法，通过下游数据的曲率信息选择适配子空间方向，相比传统基于权重几何的初始化方法显著提升下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LoRA初始化策略仅依赖预训练权重的固有几何特性（如权重幅度），忽视了模型与下游数据分布的交互，导致适配能力可能分配到与任务无关的方向上，严重制约了下游性能。

Method: 将LoRA初始化建模为在目标数据分布下识别参数空间方向影响程度的问题，提出基于Fisher信息的数据感知框架，利用下游数据诱导的曲率信息刻画参数扰动对模型预测的影响，从而建立原则性的任务依赖方向选择准则。

Result: 在多种任务和模态上的实验结果表明，数据感知的初始化方法相较现有方法持续且显著地提升了下游性能。

Conclusion: 数据感知的敏感性（而非仅权重幅度）应主导适配子空间的选择，该视角为LoRA初始化提供了更优的理论基础和实践效果。

Abstract: LoRA adapts large language models (LLMs) by restricting updates to low-rank subspaces of pre-trained weights. While this substantially reduces training cost, the effectiveness of adaptation critically depends on which subspace is chosen at initialization: a poor initialization that allocates capacity to task-irrelevant directions can severely hinder downstream performance. Existing initialization strategies primarily rely on the intrinsic properties of pre-trained weights, implicitly assuming that weight geometry alone reflects task relevance. However, such criteria overlook how the model interacts with the downstream data distribution. In this work, we formulate LoRA initialization as identifying the degree of impact of directions in parameter space under the target data distribution. We argue that data-aware sensitivity, rather than weight-only magnitude, should govern the choice of adaptation subspaces. Building on this perspective, we propose a Fisher-guided framework that leverages curvature information induced by downstream data to characterize how parameter perturbations influence model predictions. This perspective yields a principled, task-dependent criterion for selecting LoRA directions that better align adaptation with the target objective. Empirical results across diverse tasks and modalities demonstrate that data-aware initialization consistently and significantly improves downstream performance over existing approaches.

</details>


### [528] [Break the Block: Dynamic-size Reasoning Blocks for Diffusion Large Language Models via Monotonic Entropy Descent with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02263)
*Yan Jiang,Ruihong Qiu,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出b1框架，通过单调熵下降目标结合强化学习，为扩散大语言模型学习动态大小的推理块，取代固定块大小生成范式，提升推理连贯性和效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定大小块生成是扩散LLM推理的瓶颈：(1)不同推理任务需要不同最优块大小；(2)同一任务内刚性块划分会破坏逻辑流和推理连贯性。

Method: 提出b1后训练框架，利用单调熵下降（Monotonic Entropy Descent）目标结合强化学习，学习动态大小的推理块，可作为即插即用模块集成到现有dLLM后训练算法中。

Result: 实验发现：正确推理的块间熵呈现一致下降趋势，而错误推理则波动不稳。b1在多种推理基准上持续优于固定大小块基线。

Conclusion: 动态大小推理块能有效提升扩散LLM的推理连贯性和效果，b1框架具有良好兼容性和通用性。

Abstract: Recent diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have demonstrated both effectiveness and efficiency in reasoning via a block-based semi-autoregressive generation paradigm. Despite their progress, the fixed-size block generations remain a critical bottleneck for effective and coherent reasoning. 1. From a global perspective, different reasoning tasks would correspond to different optimal decoding block sizes, which makes a ``one-size-fits-all'' assumption ineffective. 2. Even within a single reasoning task, the rigid block partitioning would break the logical flow and reduce reasoning coherence. Through empirical observations, we reveal that for block-wise entropy, incorrect reasoning exhibits a fluctuating and unsteady trend between blocks, whereas the correctly generated tasks follow a consistent descending trend. Therefore, this paper proposes b1, a novel post-training framework for dLLMs that learns dynamic-size reasoning blocks via a Monotonic Entropy Descent objective with reinforcement learning to enhance reasoning coherence.b1 integrates seamlessly as a plug-and-play module with existing dLLM's post-training algorithms. Extensive experiments across various reasoning benchmarks showcase b1's consistent improvement over existing fixed-size block baselines. Our code has been released at https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/Block-R1.

</details>


### [529] [Understanding Self-Supervised Learning via Latent Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03517)
*Fabian A Mikulasch,Friedemann Zenke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出潜在分布匹配（LDM）框架，将自监督学习统一为最大化潜在表示的log概率（对齐）和熵（均匀性），并由此推导出基于卡尔曼滤波的非线性贝叶斯时序模型，证明预测性LDM在温和条件下可获得可识别的潜在表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督学习方法多样但缺乏统一的理论框架，无法解释不同方法的内在联系，也难以指导新方法的设计。

Method: 将SSL形式化为潜在分布匹配（LDM），即同时最大化对齐项（潜在表示在假设模型下的log概率）和均匀性项（潜在熵防止坍塌）；在该框架下统一了ICA、对比学习、非对比学习和预测性SSL方法；进一步推导了基于卡尔曼滤波器的非线性无采样贝叶斯滤波模型用于高维时间序列。

Result: 证明了预测性LDM在温和假设下（即使使用非线性预测器）也能得到可识别的潜在表示；LDM框架为现有SSL方法提供了统一的解释。

Conclusion: LDM澄清了现有SSL方法背后的假设，并为设计新方法提供了原则性指导。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) excels at finding general-purpose latent representations from complex data, yet lacks a unifying theoretical framework that explains the diverse existing methods and guides the design of new ones. We cast SSL as latent distribution matching (LDM): learning representations that maximize their log-probability under an assumed latent model (alignment), while maximizing latent entropy to prevent collapse (uniformity). This view unifies independent component analysis with contrastive, non-contrastive, and predictive SSL methods, including stop gradient approaches. Leveraging LDM, we derive a nonlinear, sampling-free Bayesian filtering model with a Kalman-based predictor for high-dimensional timeseries. We further prove that predictive LDM yields identifiable latent representations under mild assumptions, even with nonlinear predictors. Overall, LDM clarifies the assumptions behind established SSL methods and provides principled guidance for developing new approaches.

</details>


### [530] [LLMs are not (consistently) Bayesian: Quantifying internal (in)consistencies of LLMs' probabilistic beliefs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06915)
*Chacha Chen,Matthew Jörke,Adam Goliński,Masha Fedzechkina,Guillermo Sapiro,Sinead Williamson,Nicholas Foti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将LLM视为信息处理规则，利用信息处理差距研究LLM更新概率信念时的内部(不)一致性。实验发现某些方法产生(近似)贝叶斯更新，另一些使用学习到的启发式，且非贝叶斯启发式更新在下游任务中往往优于精确贝叶斯计算，表明LLM的世界概率模型存在误设。该测量方法可用于诊断LLM推理系统的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学、科学、法律等复杂领域中，AI系统不仅需要产生正确答案，还需要在获得新证据时表示和更新对世界的不确定信念。作者旨在研究LLM作为信息处理规则时，其概率信念更新的内部一致性问题。

Method: 提出信息处理差距（information processing gap）来衡量LLM信念更新的内部一致性；通过多种方式让LLM将证据纳入信念，比较贝叶斯更新与启发式更新的差异。

Result: 部分方法产生(近似)贝叶斯更新，部分使用学习到的启发式；非贝叶斯启发式更新在下游任务中往往优于精确贝叶斯计算，表明LLM的世界概率模型存在误设。

Conclusion: 提出的测量方法可作为诊断工具，识别LLM推理系统中的问题。

Abstract: Modern AI systems are being deployed in complex domains such as medicine, science, and law, where it is important that they not only produce correct answers, but also represent and update uncertain beliefs about the world as new evidence arrives. We introduce the novel technique of studying LLMs as information processing rules and utilize the information processing gap to study the internal (in)consistencies of how LLMs update their probabilistic beliefs from evidence. Our extensive experiments evaluate multiple approaches in which LLMs can incorporate evidence into their beliefs. Some of these approaches produce (nearly) Bayesian updates; others seem to use a learned heuristic. Surprisingly, the non-Bayesian heuristic updates often outperform exact Bayesian computation in terms of downstream task performance -- indicating the LLMs' probabilistic models of the world are misspecified. Lastly, we show how our measure can provide diagnostics to identify issues with LLM-powered inferential systems.

</details>


### [531] [MLS-Bench: A Holistic and Rigorous Assessment of AI Systems on Building Better AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08678)
*Bohan Lyu,Yucheng Yang,Siqiao Huang,Jiaru Zhang,Qixin Xu,Xinghan Li,Xinyang Han,Yicheng Zhang,Huaqing Zhang,Runhan Huang,Kaicheng Yang,Zitao Chen,Wentao Guo,Junlin Yang,Xinyue Ai,Wenhao Chai,Yadi Cao,Ziran Yang,Kun Wang,Dapeng Jiang,Huan-ang Gao,Shange Tang,Chengshuai Shi,Simon S. Du,Max Simchowitz,Jiantao Jiao,Dawn Song,Chi Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MLS-Bench基准，评估AI系统能否发明通用且可扩展的机器学习方法。包含140个任务、12个领域，测试代理改进ML系统组件并验证泛化性和可扩展性的能力。实验表明当前代理远未超越人类设计的方法，工程式调优比真正的方法发明更容易，瓶颈在于科学洞察而非单纯增加搜索或计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理、编码等任务中展现出高级能力，但能否"发现"（而非仅应用）通用的、可扩展的机器学习方法仍不清楚。现有基准多关注模型应用已有方法的能力，缺乏对其方法发明能力的系统评估。

Method: 构建MLS-Bench基准，包含140个任务、12个领域，每个任务要求代理改进ML系统或算法的某个特定组件，并在多种受控设置和规模下验证改进的泛化性和可扩展性。研究测试时计算扩展、自适应计算分配、上下文提供等因素对发现性能的影响，并进行行为案例研究。

Result: 当前AI代理远未可靠地超越人类设计的方法；工程式调优（engineering-style tuning）对代理而言比真正的方法发明更容易；瓶颈不仅在于提出新方法，更在于所需的科学洞察力（规划、验证和扩展声明）；更多搜索、计算或上下文本身无法消除这一瓶颈。

Conclusion: 提出MLS-Bench作为评估AI方法发明能力的基准，揭示了当前代理在科学洞察方面的根本瓶颈，并发布了社区平台以支持累积性和可比较的迭代研究。

Abstract: Modern AI progress has been driven by ML methods that are generalizable across settings and scalable to larger regimes. As large language models demonstrate advanced capabilities in reasoning, coding, and engineering tasks, it is increasingly important to understand whether they can discover such methods rather than only apply existing ones. We introduce MLS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating whether AI systems can invent generalizable and scalable ML methods. MLS-Bench contains 140 tasks across 12 domains, each requiring an agent to improve one targeted component of an ML system or algorithm and demonstrate that the improvement generalizes across controlled settings and scales. We find that current agents remain far from reliably surpassing human-designed methods, and that engineering-style tuning is easier for them than genuine method invention. We further study the effects of test-time scaling, adaptive compute allocation, and context provision on agents' discovery performance, together with case studies of their behavior. Our analyses suggest that the bottleneck is not only in proposing new methods, but also in the scientific insight needed to plan, validate, and scale claims about them. More search, compute, or context alone does not remove this bottleneck. We build and maintain a community platform for cumulative and comparable iteration, and release the data and code at https://mls-bench.com.

</details>


### [532] [Test-Time Compute for Dense Retrieval: Agentic Program Generation with Frozen Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11374)
*Han Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，测试时计算不仅能提升大型推理模型，也能改善小型嵌入模型的检索质量。通过一个无参数、无外部模型的代理程序搜索循环，在冻结编码器上发现12个帕累托最优程序，这些程序在不重新训练的情况下提升了nDCG@10指标，并独立重现了多种经典检索方法。选定的单一程序在未见过的编码器族和检索任务上，平均对61%的模型-任务对有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"测试时计算仅对大型推理模型有益"的普遍认知，探索其对小型嵌入模型的效用，并实现无需重新训练即可提升检索质量。

Method: 采用代理程序搜索循环，在冻结编码器API上探索144个候选程序，生成12个帕累托最优程序，通过额外推理计算换取检索质量提升。

Result: 前沿程序在所有14个搜索任务上均提升了nDCG@10；选定的单一程序在3个未见过的编码器族和19个保留检索任务上，对61%的模型-任务对实现了nDCG@10提升。

Conclusion: 测试时计算对小型嵌入模型同样有效，且通过程序搜索发现的优化策略具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Test-time compute is widely believed to benefit only large reasoning models. We show it also helps small embedding models. Since modern embedding models are distilled from LLM backbones, a frozen encoder should benefit from extra inference compute without retraining. An agentic program-search loop explores 144 candidate programs over a frozen encoder API and produces twelve Pareto-optimal programs that trade extra inference compute for retrieval quality. The search independently rediscovers Rocchio pseudo-relevance feedback, ColBERT-style MaxSim at sentence granularity, reciprocal rank fusion, and the Fisher linear discriminant, all without trainable parameters or external models. Every frontier program improves nDCG@10 over the frozen baseline on all 14 tasks used during program search. Generalization is validated separately: a single fixed program, selected from the discovery frontier before any held-out evaluation, improves nDCG@10 on 61% of model-task pairs across three unseen encoder families and nineteen held-out retrieval tasks, without any per-task selection.

</details>


### [533] [GHGbench: A Unified Multi-Entity, Multi-Task Benchmark for Carbon Emission Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13743)
*Yifan Duan,Siyuan Zheng,Lihuan Li,Chao Xue,Flora Salim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GHGbench是一个面向公司和建筑层面温室气体排放预测的开放数据集和基准，包含32,000+公司-年记录和491,591建筑-年记录，定义了分布内和跨区域迁移等任务，揭示了建筑排放更难预测、分布内到分布外差距大于模型间差距、多模态遥感嵌入在表格泛化失效时有效等发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实体级碳排放预测的开放数据集和基准在访问、规模、粒度和评估方面存在碎片化问题，缺乏统一、标准化的评估框架。

Method: 构建公司和建筑两大track的数据集：公司track整合Scope 1+2和Scope 3披露数据及财务/行业信号；建筑track整合13个开放来源的491,591条建筑-年记录，统一模式并覆盖26个大都市区域，包含气候协变量和多模态遥感嵌入。定义规范的数据划分，包括分布内和跨区域/城市迁移任务，以及时间留出和短期预测辅助任务。基线方法包括梯度提升树、表格基础模型、MLP、FT-Transformer和多模态融合，辅以LLM面板，采用多种子配对自举检验评估。

Result: 三个基准层面发现：(i)建筑排放预测在结构上比公司排放更难；(ii)分布内到分布外的差距远大于任何模型间的差距，表格基础模型首次在多城市建筑排放任务中打开与调优树之间的配对自举显著差距；(iii)多模态遥感嵌入在表格泛化失效时精确发挥作用。同时暴露出灾难性的城市迁移和行业因子查找天花板等系统失败模式。

Conclusion: GHGbench为碳排放预测提供了标准化基准，揭示了当前方法的局限性和未来方向，代码和重建配方已公开。

Abstract: Open datasets and benchmarks for entity-level carbon-emission prediction remain fragmented across access, scale, granularity, and evaluation. We introduce GHGbench, an open dataset and benchmark for company- and building-level greenhouse-gas prediction. The company track contains 32,000+ company-year records from 12,000+ firms with Scope 1+2 and Scope 3 disclosures and financial/sectoral signals; the building track harmonises 491,591 building-year records from 13 open sources into a single schema across 26 metropolitan areas (10 U.S., 15 Australian, 1 Singaporean), with climate covariates and multimodal remote-sensing embeddings. GHGbench defines canonical splits with in-distribution and cross-region/city transfer as primary tasks and temporal hold-out plus short-horizon forecasting as supplementary appendix evidence; headline baselines span gradient-boosted trees, a tabular foundation model, MLP, FT-Transformer, and multimodal fusion, with an LLM panel as auxiliary, all evaluated under multi-seed paired-bootstrap tests. Three benchmark-level findings emerge: (i) building emissions are structurally harder than company emissions; (ii) the in-distribution to out-of-distribution gap dwarfs any within-model gap across both the company track and the building track, and a tabular foundation model is, to our knowledge, the first baseline to open a paired-bootstrap-significant gap over tuned trees on a multi-city building-emissions task; (iii) multimodal remote-sensing embeddings help precisely where tabular generalisation breaks. GHGbench also exposes catastrophic city transfer and the sector-factor lookup ceiling as systematic failure modes. Code and reconstruction recipes are available at GHGbench.

</details>


### [534] [Smooth Multi-Policy Causal Effect Estimation in Longitudinal Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14284)
*Wenxin Chen,Weishen Pan,Kyra Gan,Fei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对传统纵向因果推断方法分别估计每个策略导致有限样本方差膨胀的问题，本文提出一种策略感知的重参数化迭代条件期望Q函数方法（PEQ-Net），通过共享策略编码器实现联合估计，并利用核均值嵌入保证表征空间反映策略差异性，经LTMLE校正后对二阶余项施加结构约束，在半合成数据集上显著降低均方根误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统纵向因果推断方法对多个动态治疗策略分别进行估计，导致反事实信息无法共享，产生未受控制的结构性二阶偏差，即使经过LTMLE标准去偏后仍会膨胀有限样本方差。

Method: 提出策略感知的重参数化ICE Q函数方法，通过共享策略编码器（Policy-Encoded Q Network, PEQ-Net）实现联合估计；编码器使用核均值嵌入训练，使表征空间反映群体层面的策略不相似性；最后应用LTMLE校正步骤，对二阶余项施加结构约束以稳定有限样本方差。

Result: 在半合成数据集上的实验表明，PEQ-Net一致优于现有基于ICE的方法，在评估密切相关的策略时尤其显著，实现了均方根误差的大幅降低。

Conclusion: 共享表征的联合估计框架能有效克服传统分离估计范式的二阶偏差问题，为多个动态治疗策略的比较评估提供了一种方差更稳定的因果推断方法。

Abstract: Comparative evaluation of multiple dynamic treatment policies is essential for healthcare and policy decisions, yet conventional longitudinal causal inference methods estimate each in isolation, preventing information sharing across counterfactuals. We demonstrate that this separate estimation paradigm induces a structurally uncontrolled second-order bias, inflating finite-sample variance even after standard debiasing with longitudinal targeted maximum likelihood estimation(LTMLE). To address this, we propose a policy-aware reparameterization of Iterative Conditional Expectation (ICE) Q-functions that enables joint estimation through shared representations. We implement this approach in the Policy-Encoded Q Network (PEQ-Net), an architecture centered on a shared policy encoder. The encoder is trained using kernel mean embeddings, ensuring that the learned representation space reflects population-level policy dissimilarities. After applying an LTMLE correction step, we prove this design imposes a structural constraint on the second-order remainder, thereby stabilizing finite-sample variance. Experiments on semi-synthetic datasets demonstrate that PEQ-Net consistently outperforms existing ICE-based methods, achieving substantial reductions in root-mean-square error, particularly when evaluating closely related policies.

</details>


### [535] [GFMate: Empowering Graph Foundation Models with Test-time Prompt Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14809)
*Yan Jiang,Ruihong Qiu,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GFMate，一种预训练无关的测试时图提示调优方法，通过质心和层提示避免与源域纠缠，并利用测试时互补学习目标同时利用有标和无标目标域数据，在12个基准数据集上达到最高30.63%的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图提示方法将源域信息嵌入提示中，与特定源域和预训练策略纠缠，限制了跨域和跨模型泛化能力；且仅依赖少样本调优，忽略了测试集中丰富的无标签数据。

Method: 提出GFMate，包含：(1) 预训练后应用于目标域的质心提示和层提示，避免与源域和预训练纠缠；(2) 测试时互补学习目标，同时利用有标和无标目标域数据进行有效调优。

Result: 在12个基准数据集上，GFMate展现出优越的性能和效率，最高提升30.63%。

Conclusion: GFMate通过预训练无关的测试时提示调优有效提升了图基础模型的泛化能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Graph prompt tuning has shown great potential in graph learning by introducing trainable prompts to enhance the model performance in conventional single-domain scenarios. Recent research has extended graph prompts to improve Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) by few-shot tuning auxiliary prompts. Despite their progress, most existing methods embed source-domain information into prompts, which serve either as input to GFMs or encoded during model pre-training. Such prompt entanglement with specific source domains and GFM pre-training strategy restricts their generalisability to other domains and different GFMs. Furthermore, existing GFM prompts merely rely on few-shot tuning for adaptation, neglecting the rich information in unlabelled target domain test data. Motivated by these insights, this paper aims to empower GFMs with pre-training-agnostic test-time graph prompt tuning, named GFMate. GFMate introduces centroid and layer prompts applied after pre-training on target domains, avoiding entanglement with specific source domains and model pre-training. In addition, a test-time complementary learning objective is devised to exploit both labelled and unlabelled target domain data for effective test-time prompt tuning. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance and efficiency of GFMate, achieving improvements of up to 30.63%. Code is available at https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/GFMate.

</details>


### [536] [GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Large Language Model Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15250)
*Fanxu Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出组查询潜在注意力（GQLA），作为多头潜在注意力（MLA）的改进变体。GQLA的训练权重暴露两条代数等价的解码路径：MQA吸收路径（与MLA相同）和GQA路径（每组扩展缓存）。运行时根据硬件自动选择最优路径，无需重新训练或定制内核。单个GQLA权重集可在H100（MQA吸收路径）和H20（GQA+多令牌预测路径）上均达到近最优性能，并支持GQA路径上最多8路无冗余张量并行。此外，通过TransGQLA方法可将预训练GQA检查点转换为GQLA模型，在LLaMA-3-8B上实现MQA吸收路径的KV缓存压缩至GQA基线的28.125%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLA虽然计算效率高（几乎完美匹配H100 roofline），但其训练权重仅暴露单一解码路径（吸收式MQA形式），导致：（1）推理效率高度依赖H100级别的计算-带宽比；（2）无法沿注意力头维度进行张量并行；（3）在如H20这类出口受限的商用推理GPU上无法获得多令牌预测（MTP）增益。因此需要一种能灵活适配多种硬件的注意力机制。

Method: GQLA是对MLA的最小化修改，其训练权重同时暴露两条代数等价的解码路径：MQA吸收路径（与MLA相同）和GQA路径（每组扩展缓存）。运行时根据目标硬件自动选择路径。同时提出TransGQLA方法，可将预训练GQA检查点转换为GQLA模型，避免从头预训练。

Result: 单个GQLA权重集在H100（MQA吸收路径，s_q=1）和H20（GQA+MTP路径，s_q=2）上均能达到近最优性能，支持GQA路径上最多8路零冗余张量并行。在LLaMA-3-8B上，TransGQLA将MQA吸收路径的每令牌KV缓存压缩至GQA基线的28.125%。

Conclusion: GQLA通过暴露多条解码路径，在不改变训练参数的前提下，使单一模型能灵活适配不同硬件特性，解决了MLA在非H100硬件上的效率瓶颈，为跨平台部署提供了一种优雅的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), the attention used in DeepSeek-V2/V3, jointly compresses keys and values into a low-rank latent and matches the H100 roofline almost perfectly. Its trained weights, however, expose only one decoding path - an absorbed MQA form - which ties efficient inference to H100-class compute-bandwidth ratios, forfeits tensor parallelism along the head axis, and yields no Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) gain on commodity inference GPUs such as the export-restricted H20. We propose Group-Query Latent Attention (GQLA), a minimal modification of MLA whose trained weights expose two algebraically equivalent decoding paths over the same parameters: an MQA-absorb path identical to MLA's, and a GQA path with a per-group expanded cache. The runtime picks the path that matches the target hardware - no retraining, no custom kernels - so a single set of GQLA weights pins the rooflines of both H100 (MQA-absorb, s_q=1) and H20 (GQA + MTP, s_q=2), while supporting up to 8-way zero-redundancy tensor parallelism on the GQA path. To avoid pretraining from scratch we extend TransMLA into TransGQLA, which converts a pretrained GQA checkpoint into a GQLA model; on LLaMA-3-8B it compresses the per-token KV cache to 28.125% of the GQA baseline on the MQA-absorb path while structurally preserving GQA-level traffic on the per-group path.

</details>


### [537] [SNLP: Layer-Parallel Inference via Structured Newton Corrections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17842)
*Ligong Han,Kai Xu,Hao Wang,Akash Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出结构化牛顿层并行（SNLP），通过将Transformer层间依赖视为非线性残差方程并用牛顿法近似求解，实现了层并行训练与推理。在残差Transformer中导出恒等牛顿（IDN），在mHC架构中导出HC牛顿（HCN），在0.5B模型上取得最高2.58倍加速，且可通过配置实现无损加速（1.40倍，PPL不增加）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型逐层串行执行Transformer层造成延迟瓶颈，传统张量/流水线并行无法解决该问题。核心动机是放松层间严格依赖，以并行化层计算。

Method: 将隐状态迹视为非线性残差方程的解，采用牛顿法并行求解。关键创新是用架构诱导的廉价替代动力学替换精确雅可比矩阵：残差Transformer中IDN简化为前缀和式更新，mHC架构中HCN利用残差混合矩阵。同时提出SNLP感知训练，包括预训练正则化和直接SNLP前向SFT。

Result: 0.5B模型上达到2.58倍墙钟加速；保守配置实现1.40倍加速且PPL不增加。SNLP前向SFT可保持下游任务精度，SNLP可作为自推测解码的草稿模型。

Conclusion: SNLP通过有偏有限迭代计算（而非精确恢复串行迹）在实际加速与质量之间取得有用折衷，为Transformer层并行提供了实用的速度-质量前沿。

Abstract: Autoregressive language models execute Transformer layers sequentially, creating a latency bottleneck that is not removed by conventional tensor or pipeline parallelism. We study whether this layerwise dependency can be relaxed by treating the hidden-state trace across layers as the solution of a nonlinear residual equation and solving it with parallel Newton-style updates. While this view is principled, exact Newton corrections require expensive Jacobian-vector products and naive fixed-point iterations are unstable on trained Transformers. We introduce Structured Newton Layer Parallelism (SNLP), a training and inference framework that replaces exact layer Jacobians with cheap architecture-induced surrogate dynamics. In residual Transformers, this yields Identity Newton (IDN), where the correction reduces to a prefix-sum-like update; in mHC-style architectures, HC Newton (HCN) uses the model's residual mixing matrix. We also study SNLP-aware training, including pretraining regularization and direct SNLP-forward SFT. Experiments on Nanochat-scale Transformers show that SNLP exposes a practical speed-quality frontier: on 0.5B models, it reaches up to 2.58x wall-clock speedup, and a less aggressive configuration reaches 1.40x speedup without increasing PPL. The useful tradeoff comes from the biased finite-iteration computation induced by IDN/HCN rather than exact recovery of the sequential trace. We further show that SNLP-forward SFT can preserve downstream task accuracy, and that SNLP can serve as a drafter for self-speculative decoding while a sequential verifier preserves output correctness.

</details>


### [538] [Detecting and Mitigating the Correct-Answer Extinction Window in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Majority Voting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19444)
*Hongxiang Lin,Zhirui Kuai,Erpeng Xue,Lei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了测试时强化学习（TTRL）在数学推理中的准确性提升主要源于对已可解题的锐化而非真正学习，错误修正问题远多于真正学会的问题，且一旦多数投票锁定错误答案则损伤不可逆。作者提出TTRL-Guard框架，通过翻转率感知奖励缩放、少数保留采样和风险条件稀疏更新三种机制，在多个模型和基准上取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTRL方法在数学推理基准上报告了显著的准确性提升，但这些提升被系统性误解：多数反映的是对已可解题的锐化而非真正学习，且错误修正问题数量超过真正学会的问题，多数投票锁定错误答案后损伤不可逆。

Method: 提出TTRL-Guard框架，包含三种机制：Flip-Rate-Aware Reward Scaling (FRS) 根据翻转率下降对高风险更新进行降权；Minority-Preserving Sampling (MPS) 保留少数正确答案的梯度信号；Risk-Conditioned Sparse Updatings (RCSU) 对极化问题暂停更新。核心基于Correct-Answer Extinction Window现象和Flip Rate (FR)指标。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B上取得最佳平均pass@1；在AIME 2025上相较TTRL相对提升+54%。

Conclusion: TTRL的准确性提升被系统性高估，TTRL-Guard通过针对性机制有效缓解了正确答案信号被抑制的问题，实现了更稳健的推理性能提升。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) reports substantial accuracy gains on mathematical reasoning benchmarks using majority vote as a pseudo-label signal. We argue these gains are systematically misinterpreted: most reflect sharpening of already-solvable problems rather than genuine learning, while problems corrupted from correct to incorrect outnumber truly learned ones, and this damage is irreversible once majority vote locks onto a wrong answer. Per-problem tracking reveals that correct-answer signals in low-ability problems are briefly active before being permanently suppressed, a phenomenon we term the \textit{Correct-Answer Extinction Window}, with Flip Rate (FR) as its leading indicator. We thus propose TTRL-Guard, a lightweight framework with three mechanisms targeting the extinction window: Flip-Rate-Aware Reward Scaling (FRS) down-weights at-risk updates as FR declines, Minority-Preserving Sampling (MPS) retains gradient signal from minority correct answers, and Risk-Conditioned Sparse Updatings (RCSU) suspends updates on polarized problems. Experiments across three models and four benchmarks show that TTRL-Guard achieves the best average pass@1 on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B, improves relatively over TTRL by +54\% on AIME 2025.

</details>


### [539] [B-cos GNNs: Faithful Explanations through Dynamic Linearity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19778)
*Joschka Groß,Mohammad Shaique Solanki,Verena Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出B-cos GNN，一种内在可解释的图神经网络，其预测可分解为每个节点、每个特征上的贡献，通过单一输入相关的线性映射实现，在不依赖辅助解释器的情况下实现可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN可解释性方法多依赖事后（post-hoc）解释器，这些方法计算成本高、依赖额外模块，且无法保证解释的忠实性。本文旨在设计一种内在可解释的GNN架构，使其预测天然可分解为节点和特征级别的贡献。

Method: 将标准GNN中的非线性消息函数和更新函数替换为B-cos变换，采用线性（求和）聚合方式，使模型形成任务相关的权重-输入对齐，通过模型的动态线性性直接获取解释。

Result: 在多种合成和真实世界基准上，B-cos GNN（实例化为GIN）在预测精度上略有损失，但实现了最先进的可解释性，且解释生成速度比事后方法快数个数量级。

Conclusion: B-cos GNN通过架构设计实现了内在可解释性，在精度与可解释性之间取得了良好权衡，为图神经网络的可靠应用提供了高效且忠实的解释方案。

Abstract: We introduce B-cos GNNs, an inherently explainable class of graph neural networks whose predictions decompose exactly into per-node, per-feature contributions via a single input-dependent linear map. B-cos GNNs use linear (sum-based) aggregation and replace non-linear message and update functions with B-cos transforms. This induces meaningful, task-specific weight-input alignment that is directly accessible through the model's dynamic linearity. Instance-level explanations follow from a single forward and backward pass, requiring no auxiliary explainer, modified learning objective, or perturbation procedure. Instantiated as a GIN, our approach trades small losses in predictive accuracy for state-of-the-art explainability across diverse synthetic and real-world benchmarks, producing explanations orders of magnitude faster than post-hoc baselines.

</details>


### [540] [The General Theory of Localization Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20635)
*Congwei Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为"定位方法"的通用机器学习框架，基于定位核和局部均值两个核心概念，为自注意力机制提供了理论基础。该方法通过局部模型公式化和定位技巧两大支柱构建，系统揭示了与核方法、懒惰学习、MeanShift算法、松弛标记、Hopfield网络、LLE、模糊推理、去噪自编码器等众多现有方法的联系，并展示了Transformer可通过层次局部模型构建，为统一解释和设计灵活自适应学习系统提供了新视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习模型/方法众多且缺乏统一的理论框架来解释它们之间的内在联系，尤其是自注意力机制缺乏严格的理论基础。本文旨在提出一个通用框架来统一理解这些方法，并为设计新的自适应学习系统提供方法论工具。

Method: 提出了"定位方法"框架，核心包括：(1) 定位核与局部均值两个核心概念；(2) 局部模型公式化和定位技巧两大理论基础支柱；(3) 系统分析该框架与核方法、懒惰学习、MeanShift、松弛标记、Hopfield网络、LLE、模糊推理、DAE等方法的联系；(4) 扩展自适应核、层次局部模型、非局部模型等高级变体，并证明Transformer可通过层次局部模型构建。

Result: 成功建立了定位方法与多种机器学习方法之间的理论联系，揭示了Transformer等现代架构可被定位方法统一解释和构建，证明了该框架的理论统一性和实践适用性。

Conclusion: 定位方法为理解现有机器学习模型提供了一个统一的理论视角，并为设计灵活、数据自适应的学习系统提供了新的方法论工具，有望推动对深度学习和传统方法的统一理解与创新发展。

Abstract: This paper proposes a general machine learning framework called the localization method, which is fundamentally built on two core concepts: localization kernels and local means -- key components that underpin the self-attention mechanism. To establish a rigorous theoretical foundation, the framework is formally defined through two essential pillars: the formulation of the local(-ized) model and the localization trick. We systematically investigate the connections between the localization method and a wide range of existing machine learning models/methods, including (but not limited to) kernel methods, lazy learning, the MeanShift algorithm, relaxation labeling, Hopfield networks, local linear embedding (LLE), fuzzy inference, and denoising autoencoders (DAEs). By dissecting these relationships, we clarify the broader theoretical significance of the localization method and demonstrate its practical applicability across diverse machine learning tasks. Furthermore, we explore advanced extensions of the framework, such as adaptive kernels, hierarchical local models, and non-local models. Notably, we show that the Transformer -- a cornerstone of modern sequence modeling -- can be constructed using hierarchical local models, revealing the ability of the localization method to unify and generalize state-of-the-art architectures. This work not only provides a unified theoretical lens to reinterpret existing models but also offers new methodological tools for designing flexible, data-adaptive learning systems.

</details>


### [541] [Decision-Path Patterns as Tree Reliability Signals: Path-based Adaptive Weighting for Random Forest Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20716)
*Youngjoon Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出利用决策树决策路径的结构模式作为每样本可靠性信号，对随机森林中更可靠的树进行差异化加权，从而减少可消除误差，在36个二分类基准上取得统计显著的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机森林中每棵树使用不同的随机化特征表示，均匀投票在那些错误表示概率上超过正确表示的区域内无法纠正错误，即使集成整体拥有足够的正确信息——这是一种可消除的误差，现有方法未能有效解决。

Method: 利用每棵树决策路径的结构模式作为每个样本的可靠性信号，在推理时识别并差异化加权更可靠的树。路径级可靠性比树级加权具有更细粒度，通过森林自身识别的边界区域中路径模式的可靠性差异来发挥作用。

Result: 在36个二分类基准上取得统计显著的准确率提升（Wilcoxon p < 0.0001）；可消除误差估计与实际增益强相关（Pearson r=+0.840, p<0.0001）；在识别出的合格组上平均提升+0.99 pp（7/0/0严格胜出）；零次少数类召回率退化，一次多数类召回率退化（0.2 pp阈值）。

Conclusion: 决策路径的结构信息（此前被忽视）可以有效提升随机森林性能，且改进方向是偏向减少偏差而非类别权衡。

Abstract: Random forests construct each tree with a different, randomised representation of the feature space. Their uniform voting cannot correct errors in regions where trees with incorrect representations probabilistically outnumber correct ones, even when the ensemble collectively holds enough correct information -- a reducible error that this paper addresses. We propose using the structural pattern of each tree's decision path as a per-sample reliability signal to identify and differentially weight the more reliable trees. At inference, a random forest reaches its prediction through the root-to-leaf path the sample traverses in each tree, so path-level reliability offers a finer granularity than tree-level weighting can access. We show that this reliability varies meaningfully across path patterns in the boundary region identified by the forest itself, and that using this signal yields a statistically significant accuracy improvement over RF on 36 binary classification benchmarks (Wilcoxon p < 0.0001). We further devise a way to quantify the reducible error accessible to the method from the fitted RF alone; this estimate correlates strongly with per-dataset gain (Pearson r = +0.840, p < 0.0001), and on the qualifying group it identifies, the method delivers a mean +0.99 pp accuracy improvement with strict wins on every dataset (7/0/0). Class-recall regression -- the typical failure mode of RF correction methods -- is measured: zero minority-recall regressions and a single majority-recall regression at the 0.2 pp threshold, indicating that the correction operates in the direction of bias reduction rather than class trade-off. Our work suggests that the structural information of decision paths, previously overlooked in random forest research, can contribute to RF performance improvement.

</details>


### [542] [One LR Doesn't Fit All: Heavy-Tail Guided Layerwise Learning Rates for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22297)
*Di He,Songjun Tu,Keyu Wang,Lu Yin,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Layerwise Learning Rate (LLR)，一种基于重尾自正则化理论的逐层自适应学习率分配方法，为Transformer不同层分配不同学习率，在LLaMA、GPT-nano等架构上实现最高1.5倍训练加速，并将1B和3B模型的零样本准确率分别提升至49.02%和50.61%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习实践对所有层使用统一学习率，忽略了Transformer各层的结构异质性，限制了LLM的性能潜力。

Method: 基于重尾自正则化(HT-SR)理论，通过权重相关矩阵的谱密度(ESD)量化各层的重尾程度，对重尾弱的层分配较大学习率加速训练，对重尾强的层分配较小学习率，实现逐层差异化学习率配置。

Result: 在LLaMA、GPT-nano等架构、AdamW和Muon优化器、60M到3B参数规模、最高100B训练token的实验条件下，LLR实现最高1.5倍训练加速；将1B模型零样本准确率从47.09%提升至49.02%，3B模型从48.58%提升至50.61%。

Conclusion: LLR通过低调参开销（可从均匀基线直接迁移学习率设置）实现更均衡的逐层训练，加速收敛并提升泛化性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Learning rate configuration is a fundamental aspect of modern deep learning. The prevailing practice of applying a uniform learning rate across all layers overlooks the structural heterogeneity of Transformers, potentially limiting their effectiveness as the backbone of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we introduce Layerwise Learning Rate (LLR), an adaptive scheme that assigns distinct learning rates to individual Transformer layers. Our method is grounded in Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory, which characterizes the empirical spectral density (ESD) of weight correlation matrices to quantify heavy-tailedness. Layers with weaker heavy-tailedness are assigned larger learning rates to accelerate training, while layers with stronger heavy-tailedness receive smaller learning rates. By tailoring learning rates in this manner, LLR promotes more balanced training across layers, leading to faster convergence and improved generalization. Extensive experiments across architectures ranging from LLaMA to GPT-nano, optimizers including AdamW and Muon, and model scales from 60M to 3B parameters with up to 100B training tokens demonstrate the effectiveness of LLR. LLR achieves up to 1.5x training speedup and consistently outperforms uniform-learning-rate baselines. In particular, it improves the average zero-shot accuracy of 1B models from 47.09% to 49.02%, and that of 3B models from 48.58% to 50.61%. A key advantage of LLR is its low tuning overhead: it can transfer nearly optimal learning-rate settings directly from the uniform baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/hed-ucas/Layer-wise-Learning-Rate.

</details>


### [543] [MARGIN: Runtime Confidence Calibration for Multi-Agent Foundation Model Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22949)
*Joss Armstrong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MARGIN是一种无需模型访问、无需保留数据、无需重新训练的在线校准方法，通过对称指数加权移动平均和贝叶斯收缩混合，在18个基础模型、8个基准测试和44,000+观测上实现3-6倍更低的校准误差，将多智能体选择的成对分辨率从43-50%提升到70-89%，填补了Raw-to-Oracle pass@1差距的37-78%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在多智能体部署中，协调者需要决定信任哪个智能体的响应。标准方法根据智能体自我报告的置信度进行加权，但基础模型置信度系统性地校准不良，在困难任务上与准确率呈负相关。现有的设计时校准方法（温度缩放、Platt缩放、直方图分箱）无法解决此问题，因为它们对保留数据拟合固定修正，在分布偏移下性能下降。

Method: MARGIN（通过增量归一化的多智能体运行时评分）是一种在线校准方法，从任务流中学习每个智能体、每个置信度带的校准因子，无需模型访问、保留数据和重新训练。使用对称指数加权移动平均与贝叶斯收缩混合，具有三个超参数及其鲁棒默认值。

Result: 在18个基础模型、8个基准测试、44,000+观测上，MARGIN在分布偏移下实现了比最佳设计时基线低3-6倍的校准误差。在多智能体选择中，原始口头置信度在困难基准上的成对分辨率仅为43-50%（不如随机）。MARGIN将其提升至70-89%，在五个代码生成基准上关闭了37-78%的Raw-to-Oracle pass@1差距，无需任何关于哪个模型最强的先验知识。

Conclusion: 六个形式化命题表征了收敛性、跟踪速度以及非策略智能体对称更新的最优性，所有预测均通过实证验证。MARGIN有效解决了基础模型置信度校准不良问题，在多智能体场景下显著提升了选择性能。

Abstract: Foundation model agents increasingly operate in multi-agent deployments where a coordinator must decide which agent's response to trust. The standard approach weights agents by their self-reported confidence, but recent evidence shows that foundation model confidence is systematically miscalibrated and, on hard tasks, inversely correlated with accuracy. Design-time calibration methods (temperature scaling, Platt scaling, histogram binning) cannot address this problem because they fit a fixed correction to held-out data and degrade under distribution shift. We present MARGIN (Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation), an online calibration method that learns per-agent, per-confidence-band calibration factors from the task stream itself, requiring no model access, no held-out data, and no retraining. MARGIN uses symmetric exponentially weighted moving averages with Bayesian shrinkage blending, and has three hyperparameters with robust defaults. Across 18 foundation models, 8 benchmarks, and over 44,000 observations, MARGIN achieves 3-6x lower calibration error than the best design-time baseline under distribution shift. In multi-agent selection, raw verbalized confidence fails to beat random at pairwise resolution (43-50%) on hard benchmarks. MARGIN corrects this completely, raising pairwise resolution to 70-89% and closing 37-78% of the Raw-to-Oracle pass@1 gap across the five code-generation benchmarks without any oracle knowledge of which model is strongest. Six formal propositions characterize convergence, tracking speed, and the optimality of symmetric updates for non-strategic agents, with all predictions illustrated empirically.

</details>


### [544] [Treatment Effect Estimation with Differentiated Networked Effect on Graph Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24358)
*Xiaofeng Lin,Han Bao,Hisashi Kashima*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种融合部分注意力和消息放大器的干扰建模机制，用于捕捉图数据中的差异化网络效应（DNE），从而提升个体治疗效应（ITE）的估计精度，实验表明该方法显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ITE估计方法在处理图数据干扰时忽略了差异化网络效应（DNE），即邻居节点重要性和规模差异带来的影响，导致ITE估计不精确，进而可能产生错误决策。

Method: 提出包含两种部分注意机制和消息放大器的干扰建模机制：部分注意机制自动估计不同邻居在干扰中的重要性；消息放大器根据邻居规模调整干扰建模结果，从而捕获DNE。

Result: 在三个真实世界图数据上的实验表明，所提方法在ITE估计任务上显著优于现有方法，验证了显式捕获DNE的重要性。

Conclusion: 捕获差异化网络效应（DNE）对于从图数据中准确估计个体治疗效应至关重要，所提机制有效解决了这一问题。

Abstract: Estimating individual treatment effect (ITE) from observational graph data is crucial for decision-making in the fields such as commerce and medicine. This task is challenging due to interference, where individual outcomes can be influenced by the treatments and covariates of their neighbors. Existing methods attempt to model such interference for accurate ITE estimation. However, a critical issue is often overlooked: differentiated networked effect (DNE), an effect caused by local networks consisting of neighbors with varying importance and scales. Capturing DNE is vital; otherwise, we will end up with imprecise ITE estimation due to an erroneous characterization of interference, which can result in misguided decisions. To address this challenge, we propose a novel interference modeling mechanism that incorporates two partial attention mechanisms and a message amplifier. The partial attention mechanisms automatically estimate the importance of different neighbors in contributing to interference, while the message amplifier adjusts the results of the interference modeling mechanism based on the scale of neighbors, all of which enables the model to capture DNE. Experiments on three real-world graphs demonstrate that our methods outperform existing approaches for ITE estimation from graph data, which corroborates the importance of explicitly capturing DNE.

</details>


### [545] [An Effective-Rank Audit of Alignment-Induced Activation Shifts: Confound Control, Constructive Calibration, and Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24583)
*Yuki Nakamura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过有效秩 rho_eps 量化对齐修改矩阵，在三个开源指令微调LLM上验证了Arditi等人(2024)的单一拒绝方向观察，并提出了三个贡献：混淆控制测量、构造性校准以及秩基诊断的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐研究依赖单一拒绝方向观察但缺乏连续量化指标，且对齐诱导的残差流激活变化与其他因素（如聊天模板）混淆，同时秩基诊断的安全特异性、因果排序一致性及谱隙假设均未得到充分验证。

Method: 使用四变量分解（M_naive, M_template, M_aligned, M_DiD）分离混淆因素；在3层MLP上对rho_eps进行构造性校准（lambda=5 vs 50）；通过LRH基线、SVD主序vs因果序比较及谱隙假设检验分析秩基诊断的局限性。

Result: (1) M_DiD恢复Arditi拒绝方向，cos绝对值分别为0.77/0.86/0.50；聊天模板控制后rho_eps为0.0029/0.0048/0.0044，中心化SVD残差大4-7倍。(2) 温和秩最大化(lambda=5)带来消融鲁棒性，强正则化(lambda=50)则否。(3) LRH基线是安全值的2-3倍；Llama u_2主序第二但因果惰性；仅1/90层-参考对满足谱隙假设。

Conclusion: rho_eps是脆弱的诊断指标而非机械性提升的目标；匹配的Mirsky路线下界仍是开放问题；秩基诊断存在安全特异性、因果序不对齐和谱隙假设失败三重限制。

Abstract: We audit alignment-induced shifts in residual-stream activations of three open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Gemma-2-9B-it, Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct) using the effective rank of the alignment modification matrix on safety-relevant inputs, rho_eps := rank_eps(M_Ds)/d, which formalizes the single-refusal-direction observation of Arditi et al. (2024) as a continuous quantity. The paper has three contributions. (1) Confound-controlled measurement: a four-variant decomposition (M_naive, M_template, M_aligned, M_DiD) separates chat-template formatting, alignment-stage shift, and the refusal-mediating direction, and recovers the Arditi refusal direction on M_DiD at |cos| in {0.77, 0.86, 0.50} (Llama/Gemma/Qwen); chat-template-controlled rho_eps is {0.0029, 0.0048, 0.0044}, and the centered SVD residual is 4-7x larger. (2) Constructive calibration on a 3-layer MLP across rho_eps in {0.008, 0.17, 0.33, 0.40} exhibits a sweet-spot vs. brittle distinction: mild rank-maximization (lambda=5) buys ablation robustness, while strong regularization at the same nominal rho_eps (lambda=50) does not. rho_eps is a diagnostic for fragility, not a target whose mechanical inflation buys robustness. (3) Limits of rank-based diagnostics: (a) not safety-specific (LRH baseline is 2-3x the safety value); (b) SVD principal ordering does not match causal ordering (Llama u_2 inert despite ranking second; cumulative ablation non-monotone at k=5); (c) the spectral-gap hypothesis required to upgrade the O(rho_eps * d) achievability bound to a matching Mirsky-route lower bound fails empirically (1/90 Llama layer-reference pairs, 0/36 MLP combinations) and structurally (kappa_lb <= 2/(eps * r)). The matching lower bound remains an open problem.

</details>


### [546] [Quantifying Empirical Compute-Supervision Tradeoffs in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25252)
*Ryo Mitsuhashi,Patrick Chen,Isabelle Tseng,Jasin Cekinmez,Addison J. Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实验验证了在RLVR框架中，验证器噪声（尤其是假阴性）对模型性能的损害无法通过增加计算量来弥补，且假阴性比假阳性更具破坏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验近期理论预测——验证器噪声仅影响学习速率而不影响最终结果——是否在实践中成立，即足够计算量是否能弥补不完美验证器带来的性能差距。

Method: 对Qwen2.5（0.5B, 1.5B）模型使用GRPO在GSM8K数据集上进行后训练，向二元正确性信号中注入受控的假阳性和假阴性噪声，并以每提示的rollout次数作为计算量轴进行缩放实验。

Result: 验证准确率差距在大量计算缩放下持续存在，计算回报呈现急剧递减趋势；假阴性噪声比假阳性噪声更快地单调降低模型性能。

Conclusion: 验证器质量与训练计算量不可互换；降低假阴性比单纯缩放计算量更有效。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training language models, but in practice, verifiers are rarely perfect. Recent theoretical work predicts that verifier noise affects the rate of learning but not its final outcome, implying that sufficient compute should close any gap induced by imperfect supervision. We test this prediction empirically by post-training Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B) with GRPO on GSM8K while injecting controlled false-positive and false-negative noise into the binary correctness signal, and varying rollouts per prompt as a compute axis. In practice, the gap in validation accuracy persists under substantial compute scaling, with returns to compute that are sharply diminishing. We further find a structural asymmetry where false negatives monotonically degrade performance more quickly than false positives. These findings suggest verifier quality and training compute are not interchangeable, and that reducing false negatives is a more effective lever than scaling compute alone.

</details>


### [547] [GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26092)
*Maoyang Xiang,Bo Wang,Tao Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ORP（正交残差投影）算法-硬件协同设计框架，针对超低位宽（<4-bit）下对数幂次（PoT）量化的低角度分辨率问题，通过双基几何投影和移位加操作合成高分辨率残差格点，在无需密集MAC运算下实现高效量化，LLaMA-2-7B校准仅需15分钟，3-bit下困惑度达6.10，28nm RTL综合显示有效缓解乘法树时序瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型和视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署受内存限制和密集MAC阵列时序瓶颈制约；超低位宽下PoT量化的非均匀指数格点存在低角度分辨率结构缺陷（sub-4-bit时尤其严重），导致高维特征流形显著退化。

Method: 提出ORP框架：将量化建模为双基几何投影，利用移位加操作自适应合成高分辨率残差格点；采用解析求解器替代计算密集的梯度优化，大幅降低校准时间。

Result: 3-bit（W3/A16）下LLaMA-2-7B困惑度6.10，媲美AWQ等MAC密集型基线且无需非对称缩放；4-bit场景保持竞争精度；28nm标准单元RTL综合显示有效缓解密集乘法树时序瓶颈。

Conclusion: ORP在超低位宽量化中有效克服了PoT量化的几何限制，兼顾模型精度与硬件效率，为边缘设备部署LLM/ViT提供可行方案。

Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds.
  To address this geometric limitation, we propose Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, ORP adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, ORP's analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately \textbf{15 minutes}.
  Extensive evaluations demonstrate ORP's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, ORP achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that ORP effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees.

</details>


### [548] [Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26189)
*Yingying Cheng,Jinquan Shi,Li Zhou,Zhiyang He,Zhaoyi Sun,Fan Zhang,Jie Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文系统研究了低比特浮点数(HiF8 W8A8)量化感知训练(QAT)中两种正交的失效模式：amax饱和（前向裁剪导致知识表示损坏）和灾难性遗忘（激进学习率覆盖预训练常识），并提出了保守的最大算法DTS策略和BF16预热+低学习率QAT的解决方案，最终在多项基准上实现接近BF16基线的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特浮点数QAT在LLM部署中引入标准训练指标无法检测的细微失效模式，现有研究缺乏对这些失效模式的系统解耦和针对性修复。

Method: 通过8组对照实验，利用延迟张量缩放(DTS)视角系统识别amax饱和和灾难性遗忘两种失效模式；采用64步历史窗口的保守最大算法DTS策略缓解amax饱和；采用500步BF16预热后以lr=10^{-5}进行QAT缓解灾难性遗忘。

Result: 最终配置在MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC-Challenge上分别仅有0.43%、0.58%、0.22%的性能下降，训练损失APE仅为0.11%。

Conclusion: 两种修复方法（保守DTS策略和BF16预热+低学习率QAT）对HiF8 QAT成功部署既必要又充分，且标准训练损失无法检测这些失效模式。

Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) with low-bit floating-point formats enables efficient LLM deployment, yet introduces subtle failure modes invisible to standard training metrics. We present a systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 QAT for OpenPangu-Embedded-1B through the lens of Delayed Tensor Scaling (DTS). Across eight controlled experiments, we identify and disentangle two orthogonal failure modes: (i)amax saturation, where delayed scale estimates silently corrupt knowledge-sensitive representations via forward-pass clipping, and (ii)catastrophic forgetting, where an aggressive learning rate overwrites pretrained commonsense knowledge independently of quantization. Neither is detectable from training loss alone. We address amax saturation with a conservative max-algorithm DTS strategy over a 64-step history window, and mitigate forgetting via a 500-step BF16 warmup followed by QAT at lr=10^{-5}. Both fixes are necessary and sufficient: our final configuration achieves 0.43% MMLU drop, 0.58% HellaSwag drop, and 0.22% ARC-Challenge drop versus a matched BF16 baseline, with a training loss APE of only 0.11% over 10,000 steps.

</details>


### [549] [Balancing Plasticity and Stability with Fast and Slow Successor Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26357)
*Raymond Chua,Doina Precup,Blake Richards*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 深度强化学习在渐变非平稳环境中，稳定性（如突触巩固）优于塑性（如参数重置），且多时间尺度巩固后继特征（SFs）是最有效的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界环境往往通过持续漂移逐渐演变，而现有研究多采用突变式非平稳性，这忽略了渐变场景中稳定性与可塑性权衡的特殊性，因此需要设计更自然的非平稳基准来研究RL智能体的适应机制。

Method: 修改Miniworld和MuJoCo环境以引入渐进式持续非平稳性；对比稳定性方法（突触巩固）与塑性方法（参数重置）；将神经启发的突触巩固应用于后继特征（SFs）而非传统Q值；在多时间尺度上稳定SFs以捕捉环境变化的不同方面。

Result: 1）稳定性方法优于塑性方法；2）SFs作为巩固目标比Q值效果更好；3）多时间尺度巩固SFs在持续变化环境中表现最优。

Conclusion: 在渐进式持续变化的环境中，稳定性比可塑性更为关键；多时间尺度巩固预测性表征（SFs）是一种有效的持续学习策略。

Abstract: A hallmark of intelligence is the ability to adapt in non-stationary environments, yet deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often struggle in such settings. Prior studies introduce non-stationarity through abrupt shifts in features or dynamics, whereas real-world environments often evolve gradually through continual drift. This distinction has important implications for the "stability-plasticity dilemma" in RL, as abrupt task changes may demand more plasticity than naturalistic settings. To address this, we modify existing 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments to incorporate naturalistic, continual non-stationarity, and use them to examine how stability and adaptation affect performance under continuous environmental change. We find that methods favoring stability, such as synaptic consolidation, outperform approaches focused on plasticity, such as parameters resetting. Motivated by this result, and prior evidence that Successor Features (SFs) reduce interference, we investigate whether SFs are better consolidation targets than Q-values. Across both environments, applying neuro-inspired synaptic consolidation to SFs yields superior performance on continually changing settings. Moreover, consolidation is most effective when SFs are stabilized across multiple timescales, which capture complementary aspects of gradual environmental change. Together, these results suggest that stability is more critical in continual learning when changes are gradual, and that multi-timescale consolidation of predictive representations is an effective approach.

</details>


### [550] [Aligning Few-Step Generative Models by Amortizing Sample-based Variational Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26552)
*Jaewoo Lee,Hyeongyu Kang,Dohyun Kim,Kyuil Sim,Woocheol Shin,Minsu Kim,Taeyoung Yun,Jeongjae Lee,Sanghyeok Choi,Tabitha Edith Lee,Jong Chul Ye,Jinkyoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FAV是一种基于样本变分推断的通用对齐框架，仅需生成器和参考分布的样本访问权限，通过Stein变分梯度下降和固定点回归实现少步生成模型对齐，在机器人操作和图像生成任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐框架通常依赖严格假设（如可处理的似然、特定的ODE/SDE求解器或特定模型族），缺乏适用于少步生成模型的通用对齐方法。

Method: 将对齐问题形式化为从奖励倾斜分布中采样，利用Stein变分梯度下降作为基于样本的变分推断方案，并通过固定点回归将粒子更新摊销到生成器参数中。

Result: 在机器人操作领域，FAV在56个离线RL任务和30个离线到在线RL任务上优于现有策略提取基线；在图像生成对齐上，能有效微调GAN、漂移模型、一致性模型和流映射等多种少步生成模型，支持从ImageNet-256到1024^2文本到图像合成。

Conclusion: FAV提供了一个不依赖特定模型结构或求解器的通用对齐框架，在多个领域和多种生成模型上均有效。

Abstract: Aligning a few-step generative model is challenging, since existing alignment frameworks typically rely on restrictive assumptions: a tractable likelihood, a specific ODE/SDE solver, or a particular model family. We introduce FAV, Few-step Generative Models Alignment via Sample-based Variational Inference, a general alignment framework that requires only sample access to the generator and the reference distribution. We cast alignment as sampling from a reward-tilted distribution anchored to a reference distribution. We leverage Stein Variational Gradient Descent as a sample-based variational inference scheme and amortize its particle updates into the generator parameters via fixed-point regression. We evaluate FAV on two domains: robotics manipulation and image generator alignment. On generative policy alignment for robotic manipulation, FAV outperforms prevailing policy extraction baselines across 56 offline and 30 offline-to-online RL tasks. For image generator alignment, FAV fine-tunes diverse few-step backbones, including GAN, drifting model, consistency models, and flow maps, scaling from ImageNet-$256$ to 1024$^2$ text-to-image synthesis. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaewoopudding/FAV.

</details>


### [551] [Pretrained Approximators for Low-Thrust Trajectory Cost and Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26790)
*Zhong Zhang,Giacomo Acciarini,Dario Izzo,Hexi Baoyin,Francesco Topputo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用机器学习代理模型近似低推力轨迹优化中的燃料消耗和转移可行性，发现其遵循缩放定律，并引入自相似变换实现跨轨道参数泛化，在多个任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低推力轨迹设计需要反复评估燃料消耗和转移可行性，而每次评估都依赖昂贵的最优控制求解，计算成本高，难以在大规模场景下快速进行。

Method: 1) 构建大规模数据集，采用同伦-射线策略生成；2) 引入自相似变换，使模型能泛化到不同半长轴、倾角和中心天体；3) 训练神经网络代理模型，观察并利用缩放定律（性能随数据和模型规模对数线性提升）。

Result: 模型能准确预测最优燃料消耗和最小转移时间，适用于单圈和多圈转移；在公开数据集、GTOC多小行星飞越问题及小行星交会任务上验证了性能和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 机器学习代理可以有效替代昂贵的轨迹优化求解，且遵循缩放定律；自相似变换使单个模型适用于多种轨道环境和任务类别，模型和数据集已开源。

Abstract: Low-thrust trajectory design relies heavily on repeated evaluations of fuel consumption and transfer feasibility, which require expensive optimal control solutions. In this work, we show these quantities can be accurately approximated by machine learning surrogates, enabling fast and scalable evaluation across a wide range of scenarios. By increasing both dataset size and model capacity, we observe that low-thrust trajectory optimization follows a scaling law, with performance improving linearly with the logarithm of training data and network parameters, and no evidence of saturation within the explored regime. Guided by this observation, we construct a large-scale dataset using the proposed homotopy-ray strategy tailored to mission design requirements. A key is the introduction of a self-similar transformation, which allows generalization across semi-major axes, inclinations, and central bodies avoiding retraining. As a result, the same neural approximator can be applied to diverse orbital environments and mission classes. The proposed models accurately predict optimal fuel consumption and minimum transfer time for single- and multi-revolution transfers. Their performance and generalization are demonstrated on a public dataset, a multi-asteroid flyby problem from the Global Trajectory Optimization Competition, and an asteroid rendezvous mission design. The models and datasets are released as open-source to support the space community.

</details>


<div id='cs.SI'></div>

# cs.SI [[Back]](#toc)

### [552] [Graph Neural Networks for Source Detection: A Review and Benchmark Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20657)
*Martin Sterchi,Nathan Brack,Lorenz Hilfiker*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文系统回顾了基于图神经网络（GNN）的疫情源检测方法，在受控条件下对四种代表性GNN架构与多种传统及MLP基线方法进行了复现和基准测试。实验表明，GNN在各种网络拓扑上显著优于其他方法。论文最后提出疫情源检测可作为评估GNN架构的自然且有吸引力的基准任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GNN的疫情源检测研究在方法清晰性和可重复性方面存在不足，导致GNN是否真正优于传统方法这一问题尚未明确。本文旨在通过系统回顾和受控条件下的复现实验，厘清GNN在源检测任务中的实际表现。

Method: 首先系统回顾现有GNN-based源检测方法，明确各方法适用的特定设置和使用的架构。然后在受控可比条件下，复现并基准测试四种代表性GNN架构，与多种传统方法和MLP基线进行对比。同时探究可检测性随时间演化、性能随训练集规模变化、以及对观测时间和流行病参数不确定性敏感度等关键问题。

Result: 在各种网络拓扑上，GNN在所有测试方法中大幅领先，表现显著优于传统方法和MLP基线。尽管作者最初试图质疑GNN在源检测中的有效性，实验结果反而证明了其卓越性能。

Conclusion: GNN在疫情源检测任务中具有显著优势，该任务可作为评估GNN架构的自然且具有吸引力的基准任务。所有代码和数据已开源以确保可重复性。

Abstract: The source detection problem arises when an epidemic process unfolds over a contact network, and the objective is to identify its point of origin, i.e., the source node. Research on this problem began with the seminal work of Shah and Zaman in 2010, who formally defined it and introduced the notion of rumor centrality. With the emergence of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), several studies have proposed GNN-based approaches to source detection. However, there is room to strengthen methodological clarity and reproducibility across these works. As a result, it remains unclear whether GNNs truly outperform more traditional source detection methods across comparable settings. In this paper, we first systematically review existing GNN-based methods for source detection, clearly outlining the specific settings each addresses and the architectures they employ. We then reproduce and benchmark four representative GNN architectures against a diverse set of traditional and MLP-based baselines under controlled, comparable conditions. We also investigate key questions surrounding this problem, including how detectability evolves over time, how performance scales with training set size, and how sensitive methods are to uncertainty in observation timing and epidemic parameters. Our experiments show that GNNs substantially outperform all other methods we test across a variety of network topologies. Although we initially set out to challenge the notion of GNNs as a solution to source detection, our results instead demonstrate their remarkable effectiveness for this task. To ensure full reproducibility, we release all code and data on GitHub. Finally, we argue that epidemic source detection constitutes a natural and attractive benchmark task for evaluating GNN architectures.

</details>
